tei:titleStmt.tei:title: 1)༄༅/gsol 'debs kyi skor rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa 'dod 'byung yid bzhin bang mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs so/2)na mo ma hā gu ru rat+na sarba sid
1)༄༅/gsol 'debs kyi skor rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa 'dod 'byung yid bzhin bang mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs so/2)na mo ma hā gu ru rat+na sarba sid

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ gsol 'debs kyi skor rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa 'dod 'byung yid bzhin bang mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs so/ 2)na mo ma hā gu ru rat+na sarba sid+dhi hūm̐/ dpal ldan bla ma dus gsum rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor kun bdag lha yi lha// srid zhi'i khyab bdag mya ngan 'das pa'i ye shes mchog la dbang bsgyur ba'i// skyabs mchog drin can sangs rgyas mi gzugs gang 'dul ston mkhas khyed zhabs la// rnam pa kun tu bdag ni rab 'dud rtse chen thugs rjes skyabs tu gsol/ de yang khyab bdag gdod ma'i mgon po lhun grub rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas zhing khams rgya mtsho'i sprul pa'i sku sogs dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi sku gsung thugs kyi bkod pa'i sgyu 3)'phrul bsam gyi mi khyab pa'i bdag nyid 'dren mchog rtsa ba'i bla ma mtshungs bral rje btsun mchog de'i mkhyen pa'i ye shes brtse ba'i thugs rje mdzad pa'i phrin las skyob pa'i nus mthu bsam gyi mi khyab pa mnga' ba'i phyir/ 'gro ba kun la tshad med thugs rje'i gzigs pa g.yol ba med cing nam mkhas gar khyab brtan g.yo kun gyis snang tshul mtha' dag lag thil tu kyu ru ra'i 'bras bu bzhag pa ltar sgrib med du gzigs pa kho na nyid las ma g.yos kyang*/ rang nyid 'khrul pa'i dri ma 'thug pos sbags shing ma rig 4)ling tog gis ldongs phyir ma yis bor ba'i khye'u ltar re ltos kyi gnas gzhan med pas 'khor ba ngan song gi 'jigs chen nyid la rab tu skrag cing pha mchog khyed la ra mdar sbron pa'i smre ngag gdung ba'i dbyangs kyis 'o dod 'bod cing mchis pa 'di la stong nyid snying rje tshad med kyi ngang nas gsan cing gzigs su gsol/ ༈ pha gcig gsol ba 'debs so rje btsun gyi bla ma// re sa gzhan na med do thugs rje yi bdag nyid// nyams thag 'gro ba kun la g.yel med du gzigs dang*// byin rlabs ye shes char rgyun da lta rang phobs shig

༈ dpal ldan bla ma skye med chos kyi sku// khams gsum sems can gdul bya'i gnyen gcig pu// bdag sogs re sa gzhan na ma mchis pas// nyams thag bu 'bangs yal bar 'dor phod dam// mi shes mun thoms nyon mongs 'dam 5)du bying*// bdag lta'i las ngan mtha' med 'khor ba'i mtshor// sdug bsngal shes kyang 'dod ba'i nus stobs bral// de slad thugs rje'i stobs ldan khyod 'bod na// mkhyen brtse'i gru chen thugs rje'i rlung shugs bskyod// nus pa'i ba dan dkar po mngon 'phyar ba'i// byin rlabs stobs ldan thar pa'i ded dpon mchog /ngan 'gro'i mtsho chen sgrol nus khyed las su// ma rig 'khrul rtog gcong chen gyis gzir zhing*// dug lnga'i nad kyi thar pa'i srog gcod pa'i// sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras nyid kyis rtag gdung ba// bdag 'dra 'dor ba phod dam brtse chen khyed// rten 'brel 'byung ldog don kun rab mkhyen cing*// rgyu 'bras chos kun gnad la mnga' brnyes pa'i// phan bde'i go 'phang bla med ster mkhas rje// sman pa mtshungs med khyed min 6)su la re// srid pa'i bde ba ltar snang sdug chen la// gtan bder 'dzin pa'i 'khrul snang log rtog dgra// brgyad khri bzhi stong dpung chen tshogs mang pos// byang chub snying srog gcod la gzigs re ran// dpag yas mkhyen rab brtse ba'i go shub can// nus rtsal thog med ye shes mtshon char gyis// gdul bya'i legs lam gcod pa'i log sde kun// myur du ming gi lhag mar mi mdzad dam// kye ma kye ma rgyal ba'i zhing rab 'byams// ma lus khyod kyi 'phrin las kyis khyab bzhin// bdag sogs da dung 'khor ba'i dong nyid du// mgon med bskyur ba 'di lta rigs sam ci// drin can pha khyod skal bzang gdul bya'i ngor// pad+ma las 'khrungs rdo rje thod phreng rtsal// rigs lnga mtshan brgyad rnam 'gyur mtha' yas par// bstan mod bdag 'dra'i snang ngor cis mi bston// la lar zhi tshul rab

7)dkar gangs ri'i 'od// mngon gsal 'gro blo'i mun chen bcom mdzad na// bdag blo rmongs pa'i mun nang rtag 'thim yang*// gsal bar mi mdzad mgon khyod ci zhig dgongs// 'phral yun bde legs 'dod dgu kun stsol ba'i// bla ma mchog khyid gser mdog brjid pa'i zhabs// legs bstan dngos grub char chen 'bebs mdzad pa'i// 'phrin las de lta'ang bdag la cis mi stsol// khams gsumadabang bsgyur dpal ldan khyed mthu yis// brtan g.yo mtha' dag gdul byar mngon mdzad nas// bdag gi gsol ba 'debs pa'i skabs tsam las// med 'di khyod la nye ring cang mchis sam// thogs med phrin las rdzu 'phrul drag rtsal gyis// se gol yun la'ang stong gsum sgrol nus na// bdag 'dra kho na sdug bsngal 'dam nang du// gtan du 8)'dor ba 'dor ba 'di lta rung lags sam// mtshan tsam thos pas ngan 'gro stongs nus pa'i// stobs ldan khyed la bdag ni dus kun tu// smre ngag nga ro'i gsol ba 'debs 'di la// mi gzigs khyed kyi thugs rje cir gyur tam/ kye ho/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu rje btsun bla ma mchog sku gsum gyi ngo bo dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin// khams gsum gyi 'dren mchog sangs rgyas mi gzugs can// skyabs gnas kyi dam pa pha khyod dus 'dir dran// ye shes kyi gzigs pa dri med mnga' na yang*// las nyon gyis 'thum pa'i skye bo bdag sogs la// rlabs chen gyi thugs rje rgyun chad med pa yis// g.yel med du gzigs shig rje btsun chos kyi rje// nyi 'od ltar khyab pa'i thugs rje rab ldan pa'i// 'jig rten gyis 'dren mchog sangs rgyas mang byon kyang*// byang bstan gyi phug ltar rang gi skyon gyis bsgrib/ 9)/bdag nyid kyi ltos yul khyod las gzhan ma mchis// ngan song gi sdung bsngal dpag med bzod dka' dang*// rigs drug gi las snang sna tshogs sdug bsngal sogs// rab 'jigs kyi 'khor ba zo chu'i khyud mo bzhin// mtha' med du 'khyams las khyod kyis skyabs su gsol// sangs rgyas kun gcig bsdus rdo rje'i slob dpon mchog

/byin rlabs kyi gter mdzod nus mthu'i mnga' dbang phyug /snyigs dus kyi gdul bya mgon med bdag sogs la// 'bral med du gzigs shig gsol ba snying nas 'debs/ ༈ dus 'di bzung byang chub kyi mthar thug bar// skyabs mtshungs bral rigs kun gyi bdag po mchog /gnas spyi gtsug bde chen gyi yang thog tu// sku mi 'gyur gzi brjid kyi dpal 'bar zhing*// gsung mi 'gags tshangs dbyangs kyi chos sgra 10)sgrogs// thugs mi g.yo mnyam nyid kyi klong yangs nas// bu mos pa'i gsol 'debs la brtser dgongs te// gdan pad zlar g.yo med du bzhugs su gsol// phyi snang srid snod bcud kyi zhing kun dang*// lus longs spyod gtan srid kyi mdun mar bcas// pha khyod la ltos med du mchod par 'bul// bdag skyid sdug legs nyes dang 'phral yun gyi// las lus ngag yid gsum bya byed rnams// dge mi dge bzang ngan dang mtho dman sogs/ blo rtsis gdab the tshoms kyis ci zhig bya// kun khyed kyi phrin las su 'gyur bar mdzod// mtho sangs rgyas zhing khams kyi bkod pa yang*// dma' na rag dmyal khams kyi 'jig rten kun// don khyod kyi rnam rol las gzhan min phyir// bdag gzhan du re ltos kyi yul dang bral/ ༈ de phyir du bdag dang mkha' mnyam gyi// sems can kun khyod kyis ma bskyangs na/ pha ma 11)dang bral ba'i dwa phrug ltar// skyabs med du 'dor ba khyod phod dam// 'gro drug kun las nyon gyi duḥkhas gzir// thar med kyi ngan song las skyobs nus khyed// gzhan don la ngal med kyi phrin las ste// dus skabs 'dir nges babs su ma lags sam// bdag sogs kun dmu+us long gi khyu chen bzhin// mgon po khyod lam mkhan gyi dmigs bu lags// 'jigs rung gi ngan song g.yang chen las// bde blags su drongs dang thugs rje can// las ngan gyi dug chen longs spyad pas// sdug bsngal la gtan du spyod bzhin du// sdug chen la bde bar 'khrul ba yi// snying med kyi sems can thugs rjes skyobs// bde ba nyid don du gnyer na yang*// bde thabs kyi 'dun ma mi shes par// sdig chen la hab thob byed pa yis// smyon pa dang 'dra ba'i 'gro la gzigs//

12)e ma hoḥ srid pa gsum na 'gran zla thams cad dang bral zhing legs pa'i yon tan mtha' dag lhun gyis grub pa/ rgyal ba thams cad kyi ngo bo/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi 'dren pa/ 'khor ba'i g.yul ngo bzlog pa'i dpa' bo/ nyon mongs gcong nad 'byin pa'i sman pa/ ngan 'gro'i phrang las sgrol ba'i skyel ma/ rin chen thar gling 'khrid pa'i ded dpon/ dgos 'dod re ba bskong ba'i nor bu/ byin rlabs kyi gter mdzod thugs rje'i bdag nyid/ skyabs gnas kyi dam pa/ dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po snying nas mkhyen no/ bdag sogs khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad la thugs rjes gzigs su gsol/ byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ lam sna 'dren du gsol/ bar chad bsal du gsol/ mgon po khyod dang gnyis su med par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ snang srid thams cad bla ma'i rnam rol du// byin rlabs sprin thib thugs rje'i 13)glog stong 'khyug /dngos grub char 'bebs zab chos 'brug sgra ldir// smin grol byang chub myu gu bskyed du gsol/ om̐/ chos dbyings skye med lhun grub chen po'i ngang*// bla ma stong nyid chos skur ya la la// bdag gi yid la byin gyis brlabs nas kyang*// rtog bral chos sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ āḥ rang mdangs 'gag med 'od gsal pho brang nas/ bla ma gsal dag longs skur lam se lam/ bdag gi ngag la byin gyis brlabs nas kyang*/ rang gsal longs sku 'grub par byin gyis rlob/ hūm̐/ cir snang dag pa shar grol zhing khams nas// bla ma gang 'dul sprul skur 'khyugs se 'khyug /bdag gi lus la byin gyis rlabs nas kyang*// 'gro 'dul sprul sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ hrīḥ ngo bo dbyer med bde chen klong yangs nas// bla ma rang byung ye shes mer re re// bdag gi sgo gsum byin 14)gyis rlabs nas kyang*// sku gsum lhun gyis grub par byin gyis rlobs// skye ba 'di dang skye gzhan thams cad du// dpal ldan bla ma mchog dang dbyer med cing*// phrin las rnam 'phrul rgya mtsho mtha' yas kyi// 'gro la phan bde 'ba' zhig sgrub byed shog

/phyogs bcu'i zhing gi rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i drung*// chos 'khor bskul zhing gus pas mchod pa dang*// sangs rgyas yon tan mtha' dag bdag grub nas// bsdu ba rnam bzhis 'gro kun 'dren par shog /dkyil 'khor kun bdag bla ma'i sa non cing*// mchog gsang rdo rje theg la mnga' dbang 'byor// skad cig tsam la'ang grangs med phrin las ston// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho skem pa'i mthu ldan shog /ces pa 'di ni grub rigs dam pa'i rgyud las 'khrungs pa tshe brtan bsod nams dpal bzang pos bskul bar mdzad pa ltar/ dpal ldan bla ma mchog la gdung dbyangs kyis gsol ba 'debs pa byin rlabs char 'bebs ces bya ba 'di nyid/ gnas 15) chen chu bo g.yas 'khyil gyi sa'i snying po mtsho rdzong nor bu rir bkod pa'o/ hrīḥ rang byung pad+ma bkod pa'i zhing khams nas// rigs mchog gtso bo snang ba mtha' yas la// gsol ba 'debs so brtse bas rjes bzung nas// ka dag chos sku rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// gdangs gsal 'od lnga tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor nas// longs spyod rdzogs sku rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas la// gsol ba= lhun grub longs sku thob par byin gyis rlob// dkar gsal mdang ldan rin bo ta la nas// thugs rje'i mnga' bdag spyan ras gzigs dbang la// gsol ba= /'gro 'dul sprul sku grub par= bde chen pad+ma 'od kyi pho brang nas// 'gro ba'i skyabs cig pad+ma 'byung gnas la/ gsol ba= /'chi med rig 'dzin thob par= /mi 'gyur lhun grub dpal gyi bsam yas nas// chos rgyal chen po khri srong lde btsan la/ gsol ba= /dag snang phyogs med 16)'byongs par byin= /mkha' spyod rnam dag bde chen pho brang nas// mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo ye shes mtsho rgyal la/ gsol ba= /bde stong ye shes skye bar= /gar bzhugs bde chen chos kyi pho brang nas// rig 'dzin chen po sangs rgyas gling pa la// gsol ba= /zab mo'i gsang mdzod 'dzin par byin=

/nags khrod bde chen bsam 'grub yang dben nas// rgyal ba'i gdung 'dzin ye shes rdo rje la// gsol ba= /rang rig 'od gsal rtogs par byin= /gzhan don phrin las rmad byung pho brang nas// lung zin chos bdag gzhon nu seng ge la// gsol ba= /'gro don lhung gyis grub par byin= /bdag 'dzin 'khrul rtog rang grol pho brang nas// bstan pa'i sgron me gu ru 'od zer la// gsol ba= /gnas lugs ye shes rtogs par= /ye grol lhun 'byams gdal khyab pho brang nas// gnyug ma'i don ston tshul khrims rgyal mtshan la// gsol ba= /gang shar zhen med rtogs par= 17)/gzung 'dzin log rtog tshar gcod pho brang nas// mthu stobs dbang phyug bsod nams rnam rgyal la// gsol ba= ngar 'dzin nyon mongs thul bar byin= /rang gzhan don gnyis lhun grub pho brang nas// mkhas grub mchog gyur o rgyan bstan 'dzin la/ gsol ba= /mdo sngags bstan pa dar bar byin= /spyi gtsug nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan steng nas// rnam grol lam ston bstan 'dzin rdo rje la// gsol ba= /don gnyis lhun gyis grub par= /zhen log nges 'byung drag po'i pho brang nas// sgrub pa'i srog shing sna tshogs rang grol la// gsol ba= /gtan 'dun byang chub 'grub par= /rang snang rnam dag bde chen pho brang nas// yi dam zhi khro dam can chos skyong la// gsol ba= /rkyen ngan bar chad zhi bar byin gyis rlobs// de ltar bdag cag mos pa'i yid kyis ni// thugs rje'i mnga' bdag rnams la gsol btab 18)pas// 'di dang phyi ma dus rnams thams cad du// brtse bas rjes su 'dzin par mdzad du gsol// yang nas yang du 'khor bar rab 'khyams shing*// sdug bsngal gyis gzir skyabs med bdag cag la// thugs rje'i 'od zer zhags pas bzung nas kyang*// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho skem par byin gyis rlobs/ ces bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i rgyud rim rnams la gus pas gsol ba btab pa'o//

nub phyogs bde chen dbang gi pho brang nas// bcom ldan snang ba mtha' yas 'od dpag med// kun khyab rang byung de la gsol ba 'debs// sems nyid chos skur rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// shar phyogs dkar gsal dag pa'i pho brang nas// khar+sa pā ṇi 'phags mchog thugs rje can// 'gro ba'i ded dpon de la gsol ba 'debs// brdos bcas 'od skur grol bar babyin gyis rlobs// lho nub pad+ma 'od kyi pho brang nas// snang srid zil gnon 'od 'bar thod phreng rtsal// rgyal 19)ba kun 'dus de la gsol ba 'debs// ngar 'dzin 'gong po zhi bar byin gyis rlobs// byang phyogs gangs can ljongs kyi 'gro ba'i mgon// rig 'dzin 'ja' tshon snying por mtshan bzung nas// zab gter mdzod 'dzin de la gsol ba 'debs// sgrub pa mtha' ru phyin par byin gyis rlobs// gar bzhugs bde chen chos kyi pho brang nas// rgyal ba'i bstan 'dzin mkhas mchog legs grub sogs// zab chos bka' babs rnams la gsol ba 'debs// dag snang phyogs med 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs// rang byung rol pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po nas// sna tshogs sgyu ma'i rol gar ston mdzad pa// yi dam zhi khro'i tshogs la gsol ba 'debs// dngos grub rnam gnyis thob par byin gyis rlobs// phyi nang gnas yul nye ba'i dur khrod nas// legs nyes stangs 'dzin bka' yi bya ra ba// mkha' 'gro dam can tshogs la 20)gsol ba 'debs// rkyen ngan bar chad zhi bar byin gyis rlobs/ skyabs mcho rnams la gsol ba btab pa'i mthus// ma rig 'khrul pa'i snang ba rang dag nas// stong gsal spros dang bral ba'i chos nyid don// yang dag gtan la dbab par mdzad du gsel// srid pa'i ngang tshul rmi lam sgyu ma 'di// rtag par 'dzin pas rjes su 'brangs byas nas// sdug bsngal du ma'i dra bas bcings 'di las// myur ba nyid du thar bar mdzad du gsol// snang stong sgyu ma chu zla'i don rtogs shing*// grags stong bden med brag cha lta bu dang*// rig stog mtha' bral dbu ma'i lta ba nyid/
'gro kun rab rtogs ka dag mngon gyur shog

ces yang zab dkon mchog spyi 'dus kyi bla ma brgyud pa rnams la gsol ba btab pa'o/ ༈ bcom ldan drug pa chos sku rdo rje 'chang*// ye shes mkha' 'gro grub chen tshem bu pa// lha mi'i gtsug rgyan rnams 21) la gsol ba 'debs// rang sems chos skur rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// spyi bo lhas pa stag sde brag dmar ba// lha btsun dgon par thugs rje brtson 'grus pa// 'gro ba'i mgon po rnams la gsol ba 'debs// bar do longs sku grol bar byin gyis rlobs// brag kha seng ge rin dpal chos dpal ba// snye thang blo brtan blo gros rnam rgyal ste// bstan pa'i bdag po rnams la gsol ba 'debs// thugs rje sprul sgyur nus par byin gyis rlobs// karma phrin las gtsug lag 'phreng ba dang*// bstan 'dzin rdo rje bsod nams dbang po sogs// skyes chen dam pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs// rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// gnas dang yul dang nye ba'i dur khrod dang*// sgyu lus phung po gzhal yas la gnas pa'i// mkha' 'gro dam can tshogs la gsol ba 'debs// sa lam bar chad zhi bar 22)byin gyis rlobs// de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs kyi// brdos bcas sha khrag zag med 'od skur grol// rig pa'i ngo bo ka dag chos skur thim// gzung 'dzin 'khrul snang dag par mdzad du gsol// mthong man med pa'i lta ba'i lam bzang la// gsal 'grib med pa'i sgom pa'i grogs dang bcas// blang dor med pa spyod pas rgyab bsten nas// re dogs med pa 'bras bu'i sar phyin shog ces thugs rje chen po'i dmar khrid brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs 'di ni/ grub mchog tshe dbang don 'grub pas bskul ba'i ngor bkod pa'o// ༈ hrīḥ chos dbyings 'pho 'gyur med pa'i zhing khams nas// rgyal ba dgongs rgyud chos sku'i bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// ka dag mngon du gyur par byin gyis rlobs// rang mdangs 'od gsal lhun grub pho brang nas// longs sku'i rnam 'phrul rig

23)'dzin brda rgyud la// gsol ba 'debs= /'od gsal ma bu 'phrod par byin gyis rlobs// gang 'dul der snang sprul sku'i zhing khams nas// gang zag snyan rgyud sprul sku'i bla ma la// gsol ba= /gzhan don mtha' yas 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// brgyud pa kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma la// gsol ba= /bskyed rdzogs nyams len mtha' ru phyin nas kyang*/ gdod ma'i kun bzang go 'phang myur thob shog ces pa 'di ni lung rigs smra ba o rgyan legs bshad kyis bskul ngor/ gter ston bde chen gling pa'i gdan sa pad+ma chos gling gi chos grwar bkod pa'o// ༈ chos dbyings mkha' la mkhyen rtse'i dkyil 'khor rgyas// thugs rje'i 'od kyi 'gro blo'i mun sel ba// rigs kun khyab bdag bcom ldan snang mtha' yas// ka dag chos kyi sku la gsol ba 'debs// chos sku'i dbyings las gzugs kyi skur bzhengs 24)te/ gsal la ma 'dres 'od lnga'i tshom bur bzhugs// tshe dpag med pa rigs lnga 'gro ba'i mgon// lhun grub longs spyod rdzogs la gsol ba 'debs// dpag med 'gro la thugs rje nyi 'od kyis// sdug bsngal rgya mtsho skem mdzad mthu stobs can// khams gsum dbang sdud pad+ma thod phreng rtsal// thugs rje sprul pa'i sku la gsol ba 'debs// mkha' spyod bde chen dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro la// rnga yab gling du ma gcig dung sman rgyal// bod yul zab gter bka' yi bsdu ba mdzad// ye shes mtsho rgyal zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// chos rgyal sras mo mtshan ldan pad+ma gsal// skye bar rim brgyud zab gter gsang mdzod 'dzin// snod ldan smin mdzad rgyal sras pad+ma gling*// rig 'dzin gtso mchog de la gsol ba 'debs// gting dpag dka' ba'i thugs kyi klong yangs nas// snyan rgyud gdams 25)pa'i bdud rtsi dga' ston 'gyed// mun sel zla ba grags pas sa steng khyab// rgyal ba'i gdung 'dzin de la gsol ba 'debs// dpag med bsod nams 'bras bu legs smin mthus// ma rung bdud sde'i dpung las rnam par rgyal// gsang sngags bstan pa phyogs mthar khyab mdzad pa// rig 'dzin chen po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// gzhung lugs rab 'byams thugs su chud pa'i mthus// mkhas grub du ma'i gtsug gi rgyan du gyur// o rgyan bstan 'dzin 'chad rtsod rtsom la dbang*// dam chos sgron me de la gsol ba 'debs// bstan pa'i rtsa lag shākya'i gdung 'dzin zhing*// bai ro'i rnam sprul rdo rje'i slob dpon mchog

/snga 'gyur bstan pa'i mnga' bdag dpal bzang po// rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// snyigs dus las kyi mnar ba'i sems can rnams/ 26) /thar pa'i lam du 'khrid mkhas ded dpon mchog /rgyal dbang pad+ma'i phrin las legs spyod pa'i// dngos grub nus rtsal ldan der gsol ba 'debs// chos dbyings rab 'byams rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor nas// sna tshogs skur ston phrin las yongs kyi bdag /dngos grub kun stsol yid dam lha tshogs dang*// chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs la gsol ba 'debs// de ltar rtse gcig gdung bas gsol 'debs na// thugs rje'i chu 'dzin phung po rab 'khrigs nas// byin rlabs mi zad bdud rtsi'i char chen gyis// dad pa'i myu gu smin par mdzad du gsol// khams drug ldan pa dal 'byor mi lus 'di// 'chi bdag bdud kyi bcom par nye ba na// dus min 'chi ba'i 'jigs las skyabs nas kyang*// 'chi med rdo rje'i lus su byin gyis rlobs// pha mar gyur pa'i rigs drug sems can tshogs// tshe thung nad mang sdug bsngal nyams thag kun// 'chi med bdud rtsi'i 27)sman gyi tshim byed cing*// rang gzhan don gnyis lhun gyis grub par shog ces pa tshe khrid rdo rje 'phreng ba'i bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs 'di nyid mdo khams spu 'bor gyi bla ma sbyin pa bstan 'phel gyis bskul ngor bris pa'o// ༈ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ bskal mang sngon nas tshogs gnyis rab bsags shing*// srid pa'i 'gro ba sgrol bar dam bcas pas// zhing 'dir snga 'gyur bstan pa'i bdag po mchog /drin can rtsa ba'i bla mar gsol ba 'debs// thog ma'i mgon po kun bzang chos kyi sku// nges pa lnga ldan gzugs sku longs spyod rdzogs// bstan 'gro'i don du sprul pa sku'i tshul// drin can rtsa ba'i bla mar= /tshogs gnyis 'bras bu mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sku// yan lag drug cu chos kyi sgra sgrog gsung*// chos kun ji lta ji snyed mkhyen pa'i

28)thugs// drin can= /'gro mgon khyod zhabs gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing*// lus dang longs spyod sgo gsum mchod par 'bul// bskal par bsags pa'i nyes ltung sdig sgrib bshags// ngo mtshar mtha' yas mdzad phrin yi rang ngo*// chos 'khor rgyun chad med par bskor bar bskul// zhing 'dir bskal brgya'i bar du zhabs brtan gsol// 'khor gsum yongs dag chos kyi dbyings su bsngo/ ༈ rgyal ba sras bcas thugs rje nus mthu dang*// yi dam chos skyong srung ma'i mthu stobs kyis// rtsa ba'i bla ma mkhas mchog legs grub rtsal// sku tshe brtan zhing phrin las rgyas gyur cig /'gro kun dge ba ji snyed yod pa dang*// bdag gi lhag bsam rab dkar bden stobs kyis// bsam pa'i don kun 'bad med 'byung ba dang*// smon lam gang btab deng 'dir 'grub par shog ces pa 'di ni rang gi bston pa rang gi byed pa 'ad ི 29) ni rigs pa ma yin mod kyang*/ mos 'dud du byed pa'i gang zag 'ga' zhig gis nan gyis bskul ba'i ngo ma chog nas bris pa lags shing*/ rang mthong gi bsam pa sogs tshul ma yin pa'i blo dang ma 'dres pas nyes pa cher med dam bsam pa dang*/ gsang sngags nang pa ltar na rang gi phung khams skye mched thams cad lha'i rang bzhin las ma 'das pa dang*/ phyag rdzogs sogs kyi lta ba ltar na'ang rang rig pa las gzhan pa'i sangs rgyas logs na med pa'i dgongs pa ltar na phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul gzhan du byed srol med par gsungs pa sogs dang bstun na tshul 'di la 'gal ba cher mi yong ba 'dra bsam nas/ bskul pa po'i 'dod pa dang mthun par gsol 'debs yan lag bdun pa dang bcas pa sprin gyi nga ro zhes bya ba 'di bkod pa'o// rje sangs rgyas kun 'dus rin po che// dpal sku bzhi'i dbang phyug rje btsun mgon// pha 'gro ba'i ded dpon chos kyi rgyal// bdag 30)mos pa'i bu la thugs rjes gzigs// sku mdzes shing zhi dul nyan thos tshul// gsung yan lag drug cu'i chos sgra sgrog

/thugs 'khor 'das dus gsum thams cad mkhyen// bdag rmongs pa'i 'gro la thugs rjes gzigs// mgon byin rlabs 'byung gnas bla ma rje// yab dngos grub kun stsol lhag pa'i lha// mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug phrin las mdzod// bdag mgon skyabs med la thugs rjes gzigs// dbyings skye med rang byung chos kyi sku// mdangs 'gags med rang shar longs spyod rdzogs// rtsal sna tshogs rang gol sprul pa'i sku// bdag 'khrul snang can la thugs rjes gzigs// khyed stong gsal dbyings nas thugs rje'i 'phrul// 'od ma rig mun sel sgron me mchog /zer phyogs bcur 'phro ba'i phrin las kyis// bdag mi shes mun pa bsal du gsol// gting dpag par dka' ba'i bsdug bsngal mtshor// nyams thag pa'i bdag 31)sogs 'gro ba kun// rje mthu stobs dbang phyug khyod kyis ni// zhing rnam dag gling du khrid du gsol// lus brdos bcas zag med 'od skur grol// ngag grags stong gsung gi rdo rjer 'grub// yid blo 'das byar med zad sar 'khyol/ mgon khyod dang dbyer med gcig par shog ces pa 'di ni brag gsum dar ma 'dam mtshor gnas mjal la phyin tshe/ bla ma dran pa'i gdung dbyangs gsol 'debs su smras pa'o/ ༈ ka dag gdod ma'i mgon dang dbyer med pa'i// kha ba can 'dir rtsol med chos kyi rje// ga ru bzhugs kyang 'gro ba'i don la brtson// nga yi re sa'i skyabs gcig de nyid la// gsol ba 'debs so smin grol dngos grub stsol// ca co brjod bral stong nyid don rtogs kun// cha lugs khrims ldan nyan thos tshul 'dzin cing*// ja sogs longs spyod 'du 'dzi kun spangs te// nya rgyas zla ltar yon tan yongs rdzogs la// gsol ba= 32)ta la'i sdong bzhin mkhyen brtse'i lo 'dab rgyas// tha mal skye bo thar lam 'god mdzad pa// da lta'i dus 'dir 'gro ba'i 'dren pa mchog /nam mkha' lta bur kun khyab thugs rje can// gsol ba=

/pa wa sang gi gzhung lugs rig gnas dang*// pha rol phyin pa'i chos sogs gang 'dul gyis// ba glang lta bu rmongs pa'i 'gro kun kyang*// ma rig mun pa sangs mdzad gang de la// gsol= /rtsa rlung las rung 'khor 'das sems su shes// tsha grang nad sogs rkyen ngan lam du lhongs// dza lan+dhā ri'i gnas sogs yul kun tu// wa ltar myul kyang 'gran zla kun bral der// gsol ba 'debs so= /zha ltar rgyun du spyi bor 'khur byed cing*// za dang 'thung ba'i phud kyi mchod byed pa'i// 'a cag dad gus can gyi bu slob la// ya mtshan byin rlabs rgyun chad med pa ru// gsol ba= /ra sa la sogs gnas chen du ma dang*// la 33)lung mang por gzhan phan rlabs chen mdzad// sha ri'i bu bzhin bstan pa'i sgron me sbar// sa steng 'gro ba kun gyi mgon gcig pu// gsol ba= /ha cang gdung shugs drag pos gsol btab mthus// a ti rdzogs chen nyams len mthar phyin zhing*// sku bzhi'i go 'phang myur du thob nas kyang*// rang gzhan don 'bras lhun gyis 'grub par shog ces pa 'di ni gnas chen chu bo g.yas 'khyil gyi sgrub grwa nas/ dge slong tshe dbang dpal 'byor gyis bskul ngor bkod pa'o// ༈ skyabs gnas bslu med dkon mchog rnam pa gsum// sangs rgyas kun 'dus dpal ldan bla ma rje// rgyal dang rgyas sras bla ma'i tshogs bcas la// g.yel ba med par rtag tu phyag 'tshal lo/ e ma/ dal 'byor mi lus lan gcig thob dus 'dir// don med las la mi tshe ma skyal bar// dgos ngo shes pa'i dam pa'i lha chos la/ 34)/de ring nyid nas brtson par mi 'thad dam// phyi snod 'jig rten nam zla'i 'gyur ldog dang*// nang bcud sems can mi rtag 'chi ba'i tshul// 'di dag mthong bzhin da dung long yod du// yang yong ngang la bsdod pa khyed khom mam// deng sang tshe lo sum cu kha ral dus// tshe mthar phyin pa nyin skar las kyang dkon// rlung dmar nang gi mar me ji bzhin du// nam 'chi cha med yin pa mi shes sam// rang nyid 'chi ba'i dus la bab tsam na// gces par bskyangs pa'i lus kyang bya khyis 'drad// brtsigs shing bzos pa'i khang khyim shul du lus// btsal zhing bsags pa'i nor rnams gzhan gyis khyer// yun du 'grogs pa'i grogs kyang so sor gyes// bar do'i 'phrang la gcig pur 'gro ba'i tshe// dam pa'i chos dang mtshan ldan bla ma las// skyabs kyi dam pa gzhan du cang 'dug gam// snying po med pa'i 'jig rten bya ba 'di// byas kyang don med

35)chu yi ri mo 'dra// rang mgo rang gis g.yog pa 'di spangs nas// mdun ma chos phyogs dril ba mi 'thad dam// da res mi lus don yod ma byas na// yang yang rnyed dka'i dal 'byor thob mi 'gyur// rin chen gling nas stong log ma byed par// rang don rang gi bsgrub pa'i dus la bab// 'khor ba'i gnas la bde ba nam yang med// ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal bzod par dka'// de las skyabs kyi mchog gyur bla ma la// 'bral med gus pa'i snying nas gsol ba thob// na mo ka dag spros bral chos kyi sku// rang bzhin lhun grub gsal mdangs longs spyod rdzogs// thugs rje kun khyab gang 'dul sprul pa'i sku// sku gsum kun 'dus dpal ldan bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so smin grol dngos grub stsol// byin rlabs kun 'byung rtsa rgyud bla ma'i tshogs// dngos 36)grub stsol mdzad yi dam zhi khro'i lha// 'gal rkyen bar chad sel ba'i mkha' 'gro ma// rtsa gsum gcig bsdus dpal ldan bla ma la// gsol ba= /lha mi'i ston pa mnyam med sangs rgyas dang*// bden gnyis zung 'jug rtogs pa dam pa'i chos// 'phags pa'i bstan 'dzin tshogs mchog dge 'dun te// mchog gsum yongs 'dus dpal ldan bla ma la// gdul bya'i khams dang mos pa sna tshogs la// gang 'dul chos kyi 'gro ba smin mdzad pa'i// rgya bod mkhas grub skyes chen dam pa'i tshogs// rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas mdzad thams cad la// gsol ba= /skye med dbyings las 'gags med rol pa'i rtsal// sna tshogs gzugs kyi phrin las cir yang ston// zhi dang khro sogs yi dam lha tshogs dang*// bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs bcas la// gsol ba= /de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i 37)byin rlabs kyis// bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus kun// ngan song 'khor ba'i 'jigs las sgrol nas kyang*// bde chen thar pa'i zhing du bsgrod par shog /ma rig rmongs pa'i mun pas rab 'thum zhing*// nyon mongs dbang gi sdig la spyod byed pa'i// las ngan rlung gis bskyod pa'i 'gro ba rnams// yang dag dge legs lam bzang zhugs par shog

/dmyal ba'i tsha grang yi dwags bkres skom dang*// dud 'gro'i bkol spyod mi yi brel 'phongs dang*// lha min 'thab rtsod lha yi 'pho ltung sogs// sdug bsngal kun bral bde la spyod par shog /sems can kun gyi ji ltar 'dod pa'i don// gang ltar bsam pa de bzhin 'grub pa dang*// kun kyang dam pa'i chos la rab spyod 38)nas// rdzogs pa'i byang chub myur du thob par shog /yangs pa'i rgyal khams 'jig rten khams kun tu// nad mug 'khrug rtsod nyer 'tshe kun zhi zhing*// 'gro kun dga' bde'i dpal la longs spyod nas// sangs rgyas bstan pas phyogs kun khyab par shog /dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs rje'i bden stobs dang*// 'gro kun dge tshogs las byung nus mthu yis// smon lam thams cad gegs med 'grub pa dang*// bde legs yid bzhin 'byung ba'i bkra shis shog

ces pa'i mi rtag rgyud bskul gsol 'debs smon lam dang bcas pa 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes/ sangs rgyas rig 'dzin gyis bskul ngor bris pa'o// ༈ na mo gu ra we/ dpag med rgyal ba'i thugs rje'i mkha' dbyings las// 'gro blo'i mun sel sdug bsngal chu bo skem// phrin las 'od gsal phyogs mthar khyab mdzad pa// dpal ldan bla ma'i sku la gsol ba 'debs// zab cing 39)rgya che'i gsung rab dam pa'i mdzod// bde legs kun 'byung dam chos yid bzhin nor// dad ldan re ba skongs mdzad thugs rje can// dpal ldan bla ma'i gsung la gsol ba 'debs// kun khyab lha lam rab yangs klong chen las// rnam dag mkhyen brtse'i chu 'dzin rab 'khrigs te// thugs rje'i char gyi 'gro ba'i tsha gdung sel// dpal ldan bla ma'i thugs la gsol ba 'debs// ngo mtshar kun rdzogs yon tan sdong po las// gang 'dul phrin las lo 'dab phyogs bcur rgyas// gdul bya'i bya tshogs kun gyi gnyen gcig pu// dpal ldan bla ma mchog la gsol ba 'debs// de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs kyi// dus 'di nas bzung byang chub mthar thug bar// mi mthun rkyen bral bsam don chos bzhin 'grub// rang gzhan smin grol nus par byin gyis 40)rlobs// bskyed rdzogs gnyis la brtan pa thob pa dang*// lta sgom spyod gsum ma nor mngon gyur cing*// phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyi grub nas kyang*// gzhan phan dpag yas 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// gzugs sgrar lha sngags rol par shar ba dang*// dag snang mos gus phyogs med 'byongs pa dang*// cir snang gsal stong dbyings su ro gcig pas// gdod ma'i gtan srid zin par byin gyis rlobs/ ces pa 'di ni rig grol yon tan ldan pa o rgyan rin chen gyi thugs bzhed ltar mtshams mal nas bris pa'o// ༈ na mo gu ru/ dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// 'gags med chos sgras 'gro kun smin mdzad gsung*// mkhyen brtse'i byin rlabs rmad byung zab gsal thugs// yon tan kun 'byung rtsa ba'i bla mar 'dud// dpag med 'gro la ris med thugs rje yis// 'khor ba'i mtsho sgrol ngan 'gro'i g.yang las

41)skyobs// bde chen zhing du 'gro kun 'dren mdzad pa// thar pa'i ded dpon rtsa ba'i bla mar 'dud// zhing rnams kun tu grangs med sprul pas khyab// sna tshogs 'gro ba'i mos blo ji bzhin du// tshad med thugs rje rmad byung zlos gar gyis// gdul bya byang chub snying por myur 'god shog /brtse ldan khyed kyi thugs rje rlabs g.yos te// bdag sogs mos pa'i skal ldan bu slob rnams// rjes su bzung zhing byin gyis brlab nas kyang*// sgo gsum smin cing grol bar mdzad du gsol// rang rig mi 'gyur ka dag chos kyi sku// rang ngo ma rtogs 'khrul pa'i gzeb tu chud// rang gsal thugs rje'i 'od kyis gsal mdzod la// rang byung klong du grol bar mdzad du gsol// chos kun mthar thug rdzogs pa chen po'i don// snang bzhi mthar phyin sgron bzhi gnad du tshud// chos nyid 42) kun bzang go 'phang myur thob nas// mkha' mnyam 'gro kun 'dren pa'i dpal du shog ces pa 'di ni gtsang gi la stod srid gsum rnam rgyal nas rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i rnam 'byor pa gar dbang 'od gsal rang grol gyi bskul ngor bris pa'o// ༈ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ ngo bo ye nas ka dag chos kyi sku// rang bzhin gsal la ma 'gags longs spyod rdzogs// thugs rje rol rtsal kun khyab sprul pa'i sku// sku gsum ston mchog rnams la gsol ba 'debs// dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs rje las sprul te// grangs med 'gro la gang 'dul chos ston pa// rgya bod mkhas grub gter ston rig 'dzin tshogs// skyes mchog dam pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs// gzhan yang zhal mthong gsung thos rjes bzung ba'i// rtsa rgyud bla ma bka' drin can rnams dang*// skyabs mchog rgyal dbang pad+ma 'byung gnas la// rtse gcig 43)snying nas gus pas gsol= /de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs kyis// bdag sogs mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus rnams// bde chen thar pa'i zhing du myur phyin te// gdod ma'i klong du mngon sangs rgyas par shog

ces pa 'di ni gnas chen ma skung lung gi phyogs su sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i bla ma gcod pa ba sangs rgyas bkra shis gyis/ bdag la spyir gsar rnying bka' gter gyi bla ma mkhas grub skyes chen rnams dang*/ khyad par rang nyid kyis zhal mjal gsung thos 'brel thogs kyi drin can thams cad dang*/ yang dgos su gu ru rin po che pad+ma 'byung gnas dang bcas pa la gsol 'debs nyung bsdus shig dgos zhes gsungs pa'i ngor 'di bzhin bris nas mtshams mal nas phul ba'o// ༈ na ma gu ra we/ rgyal kun thugs rje'i lha lam yangs pa las// mtshan dpe'i cha shas yongs rdzogs 'od zer gyis// gdul 44)bya'i lam bzang mngon par snang byed pa// dpal ldan bla ma'i sku la gsol ba 'debs// rab 'byams rgyal ba'i gsung gi gsang ba'i mdzod// ma lus dbang sgyur dam chos yid bzhin nor// grangs med 'gro la stsol mdzad sku drin can// dpal ldan bla ma'i gsung la gsol ba 'debs// skyabs bral mgon med srid pa'i 'gro rnams la// tshad med thugs rje dpag med phrin las nyid// ris med nam mkha' lta bur khyab mdzad pa// dpal ldan bla ma'i thugs la gsol ba 'debs// yon tan rgya mtsho dpag med 'byung ba'i gnas// phrin las 'dod dgur bsgyur ba'i mthu stobs can// skyabs gnas kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma la// rtse gcig snying nas gus pas gsol ba 'debs// de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs kyis// 'gal rkyen kun zhi mthun rkyen chos 45)bzhin 'grub// tshogs gnyis myur rdzogs sgrib gnyis rab byang ste// khyed dang dbyer med gcig par byin gyis rlobs/ ces pa 'di yang kong yul nyang kha smad kyi sa'i thig le stag rtse rnam par rgyal ba'i sgang nas mi dbang karma bstan dbang gis bskul ngor bris pa'o// ༈ rgyal ba'i bstan 'dir ston pa'i rgyal tshab mchog /khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po 'gro ba'i mgon// gtsug lag rgya mtsho'i sprul pa'i sku mchog ni// bstan 'gro'i don du myur du 'byon mdzad gsol// grangs med bskal mang gong nas thugs bskyed ltar// 'khor ba'i mtshor lhung nyams thag 'gro kun dang*// bdag sogs gdul bya'i mgon skyabs dpung gnyen du// zhing 'dir sprul sku myur du 'byon mdzad gsol// rtsa rgyud bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/

46)/chos skyong srung ma'i byin rlabs nus mthu dang*// bdag sogs lhag bsam dag pa'i bden stobs kyis// gsol btab don ldan 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ /rje btsun dam pa gtsug lag rgya mtsho dga' ba'i dbyangs kyi sprul pa'i sku myur du 'byon par gsol ba btab pa'o// ༈ kye ma/ zas gtsang sras po 'gro ba'i bla ma de// rtsa mchog grong du mi rtag tshul bstan ltar// bstan pa'i sgron me gtsug lag rgya mtsho de// lcags pho rta lo tha skar zla ba yi// gral tshes bdun gyi nyi ma rtse shar dus// sras mkhar dgyes mdzad rdo rje'i pho brang du// zab gsal chos kyi 'khor lo rgyun bcad de// gdul bya gzhan don gshegs pa'i dus kyang byung*/ kye ma kyi hud 'jig rten mgon po khyod// gdul bya'i don du zhing 'dir mi bzhugs par// chos kyi dbyings su snyoms par bzhugs pa na// gangs can bstan 47)pa'i srog shing su yis byed// snyigs dus sems can dmu rgod gdul dka' yang*// sngon nas 'gro ba'i don du thugs bskyed pa'i// thugs rje'i dam bca' yal bar 'dor rung ngam// bdag sogs nyams thag 'gro la brtser dgongs te// bstan pa'i don du zhing 'dir myur byon nas// dam chos sgron me sbar bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa 'di yang rje de nyid mya ngan las 'das tshe gdung bas gsol ba btab pa'o// ༈ skyabs gnas bslu med rtsa ba'i bla ma la// mos pa'i yid kyis rtag tu gsol ba 'debs// bdag sogs khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can la// thugs rje brtse bas g.yel med gzigs su gsol// rnyed dka'i dal 'byor lan gcig thob dus 'dir// gtan mdun chos la brtson pa dgos na'ang*// yang yengs le lo'i ngang la mi tshe 'das// don med stong log mkhan 48)la thugs rjes gzigs// tshe la nges med blo gtad mi thub cing*// do nub 'chi ba'i nges pa'ang med mod kyang*// da dung lo brgya'i bar du sdod rtsis kyis// tshe 'di'i bya ba bsgrub la thugs rjes gzigs// phyi snod dbyar dgun nam zla'i 'gyur ldog dang*// nang bcud skye 'gro mi rtag 'jig pa'i tshul// de dang mtshungs pa rang yang 'gro nges kyang*// bsam med dud 'gro 'dra la thugs rjes gzigs// 'chi ba'i tshe na lus dang longs spyod dang*// yul dang gnyen 'khor nor rdzas la sogs pa// cis kyang phan pa med pa shes bzhin du// don med bya ba bsgrub la thugs rjes gzigs// dge sdig rgyu 'bras blang dor gnas rnams kun// go zhing rig kyang spang blang go log bsgrub// slar yang 'khor ba'i sa bon 'debs byed pa// rang gis rang bslu mkhan la thugs rjes gzigs// byams dang snying rje dad dang mos gus sogs// dge legs bsam

49)pa rgyud la mi 'byong bar// ma rig nyon mongs thib pos non pa yi// las ngan 'khrul snang can la thugs rjes gzigs// thos bsam chos la sgro 'dogs ma chod cing*// sgom sgrub gdams pas rang rgyud ma smin par// chos par rlom nas dkor la bag med spyod// ngan 'gro'i rgyu gsog mkhan la thugs rjes gzigs// snyigs dus chos med ser gzugs bdag 'dra la// skyabs mchog rnams kyi thugs rje'i shugs bskyed nas// nyon mongs las kyi 'khrul 'khor bzlog nas kyang*// ma nor don gyi lam la 'god du gsol// rmi lam lta bu'i tshe 'di'i snang ba kun// sgyu ma lta bur bden med rtogs gyur cing*// chu zla lta bu'i snang stong dbyer med dang*// nam mkha' lta bu'i stong nyid rtogs par shog /dpal ldan bla ma'i thugs rje'i byin rlabs kyis// bdag dang mkha' mnyam sems can 50)ma lus kun// 'khor ba'i 'dam las myur du thar nas kyang*// gdod ma'i klong du gtan srid zin par shog ces pa 'di nyid o rgyan phrin las kyis bskul ngor bris pa'o// ༈ na mo gu ru/ dus gsum rgyal dang rgyal sras ma lus kyi// mkhyen brtse nus mthu gcig tu bsdus pa'i dpal// bdag gi skyabs gcig drin can bla ma la// rtse gcig gus pa'i snying nas gsol ba 'debs// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho pha mtha' mi mngon zhing*// las dang nyon mongs sdug bsngal rba klong 'khrug /'di las sgrol mdzad ded dpon dam pa mchog /drin can rtsa ba'i bla mar gsol ba 'debs// bdag sogs khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can rnams// nyon mongs nad kyis rtag tu gzir ba las// skyobs mdzad byams mgon sman pa'i rgyal po mchog /drin can rtsa ba'i bla mar gsol ba 51)'debs// rtse gcig dad pa'i yid kyis gsol 'debs shing*// nyams thag nga ro'i 'o dod 'bod bzhin du// khyed kyis thugs rje'i spyan gyis mi gzigs na// skyabs bral mgon med sems can su la re// thugs rje'i bdag nyid rje btsun bla ma khyed// byin rlabs nus pa'i dpung chen rab bskyed nas// rtse gcig gsol ba 'debs pa'i skal ldan la// dngos grub char chen dbab pa'i dus la bab// 'di phyi bar do dus kun thams cad du// bdag la khyod las skyabs gzhan ma mchis na// byams pa'i thugs dang brtse bas rab dgongs te// g.yel ba med par rtag tu gzigs su gsol// de ltar khyed la gsol ba btab pa'i mthus// bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus kun// tshe 'di nyid la dag pa'i zhing mchog tu/

52)/khyed dang dbyer med gcig par byin gyis rlobs/ ces pa 'di ni dge slong bkra shis kyis bskul ngor bris pa'o// ༈ phyogs dus rgyal ba'i phrin las gcig bsdus pa// sku gsum mngon gyur rgyal dbang pad+ma 'byung*// byin rlabs gzi brjid 'od stong rab 'bar zhing*// bka' brgyud bla ma rig 'dzin 'khor gyis bskor// skyabs gnas kun dpal mgon bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so phyin rlabs char rgyun phob// zhi dang khro sogs yi dam kun gyi gtso// gar dgu'i nyams ldan ma rung bdud dpung 'dul// khro rgyal 'bar ba pad+ma drag po rtsal// dkyil 'khor yongs kyi spyi dpal he ru ka /yi dam kun 'dus dbang drag 'bar ba la// gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol// zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las kun gyi mdzod// dam med tshar gcod dam ldan bu bzhin skyong*// mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo 53)dpal 'bar seng gdong can// ma sring dam can rgya mtsho sprin ltar gtibs// mthu stobs mnga' bdag ḍāk+ka'i rgyal mo la// gsol ba 'debs so bar chad bgegs tshogs thul// rtsa gsum lha tshogs rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor la// gus pa'i yid kyis gsol ba btab pa'i mthus// 'gal rkyen kun zhi bsam don chos bzhin 'grub// dngos grub mchog thob sku gsum mngon gyur nas// srid gsum 'gro kun thar lam 'dren par shog zhes yang zab dkon mchog spyi 'dus kyi rtsa ba gsum la gsol ba gdab pa 'di nyid bstan 'dzin gyis skul ngor bkod pa'o// ༈ gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐ bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams su blang bar 'dod pas/ mkha' mnyam gyi sems can thams cad rdzogs byang la 'god phyir de nyid nyams su len snyam pa'i 'dun pa dang ldan pa'i ngang nas/ rang lus yi dam gyi lha spyan 54)ras gzigs sam rdor sems la sogs pa gang ltar mos pa skad cig dran rdzogs su lam gyis bskyed pa'i spyi bor/

seng khri pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la dkon mchog kun 'dus kyi ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid la rnam pa slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas gsal bar bya ste/ de yang thig le nyag gcig mtshon pa'i zhal gcig thabs shes kyi phyag gnyis chos nyid 'gyur med kyi rdo rje dang dngos grub mdzad med kyi ka pā la'i nang na tshe bum can bsnams pa/ bden gnyis zung 'jug gi skyil krung can/ theg pa rim pa dgu'i zab ber/ mdo sngags zung 'jug gi chos gos/ sku lnga yongs rdzogs kyi 'dab ldan rigs lnga/ dug gsum rtsad gcod kyi kha ṭ+wāṃ la sogs chas rnams rdzogs pa/ 'ja' 'od kyi klong na bzhugs par gsal ba'i gnas gsum du 'bru gsum gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ rnga yab gling nas rje btsun pad+ma la 'khor 55)sangs rgyas byang sems grub thob rig 'dzin yid dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong sogs sprin thib pa ltar byon nas spyi bo'i bla ma la thim pas byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od cher 'bar bar bsam la/ snang srid snod bcud lus dang longs spyod 'di phyi bar gsum gyi mdun ma thams cad ltos med maṇ+ḍal du 'bul zhing mos gus rtse gcig pa'i ngang nas/ rgyal ba kun 'dus dpal ldan bla ma la// rtse gcig gus pas yid kyi gsol 'debs na// mchog dang thun mongs dngos grub ma lus kun// myur du stsol zhing byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes gsol ba 'debs pa ci nus byas rjes/ bla ma'i sku gzugs las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum 'phros nas rang gi lus ngag yid gsum la phog sgo gsum gyi sgrib pa dag 'bras bu sku gsum thob pa'i rten 'brel mtha' dag 'grig mthar 56)bla ma yang 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pa tsam gyis bzhi rdzogs kyi dbang rnams dus gcig la thob/ de nas bla ma bsgom rgyu sgom mkhan bsgom pa thams cad rang rig ka dag blo 'das su 'ub chub ste/ gsal stong zung 'jug sgom sgom med yengs med gyi ngang la gnas pa ni don dam pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor yang dag pa ste/

'bras bu ye rdzogs chen po'i dngos grub re dogs dang bral ba/ stan thog de gnyid du thob par gdon mi za zhing*/ ༈ rjes thob lam khyer gyi gnad ni/ 'gro ba'i dus su g.yas phyogs kyi nam mkhar bla ma bzhugs par bsam na gar 'gro bskor ba'i rang bzhin du gyur/ gnyid kyi dus su snying pad+ma 'dab bzhi kha zum pa'i dbus su bla ma bsgom na nyid 'od gsal du 'gro ba'i gdams par gyur/ zas skom la spyod tshe mgrin pa'i rtsa 'khor gyi dbus na bla ma bsgom na bza' btung tshogs 'khor du 'gyur/ 57)gtum mo bsgom tshe lte 'og gi me nyid ngo bo bla mar mos/ bde ba lam du slong na spyi bor bla ma haṃ yig 'dzag par bsam/ lus la nad kyi rnam pa phyi nang gang du byung yang na ba'i sar bla ma'i sku phra la gsal bar bsgom pa'i sku las bdud rtsi babs pas nad thams cad dag par bsam na sman gyi dam par 'gyur/ de las gzhan pa'i dus thams cad du bla ma spyi bor 'bral med bsgom na 'chi kar 'pho ba yang de kas chog cing*/ gal te bar dor 'khyams pa'i tshe na'ang bar do'i gdams pa mchog tu 'gyur/ mdor na bka' mdo rgyud lung man ngag gsang sngags gsar rnying thams cad kyis dgongs bzhed gcig tu mthun pa'i gdams ngag 'di lta bu la blo gtad nas rgyun ldan du nyams len ma byas na/ shes shes mang kyang dgos dus mi phan zhing mi tshe hril por chos byas par brlom kyang 'chi khar blo'i 58)gtad sa gcig kyang med pa 'gyod pa dang bcas pas 'chi zhing*/ de tshe shul du dge ba byed pa la re zhing kha chems 'jog pa rnams ni mi tshe stong zad/ byas pa don med rang gi rang bslus su song ba yin pas/ des na lam zab snying po 'di lta bu la brtson par mdzad nas rang gzhan gyi don gnyis bsgrub 'tshal/

e ma sngon nas las 'phro'i rten 'brel gyis// khyab gdal lhun grub mos gus zhing sa la// karma rig 'dzin zab don char chen phabs// sku gsum lo 'bras legs par smin pa ni// smon lam dag pa'i shugs las grub par nges// 'di las byung ba'i rnam dkar dge ba'i mthus// 'gro kun 'khor ba'i 'ching ba rab grol te// bde chen zhing du bde ba'i chos spyod pa'i// rgyu 'bras chos la yang dag spyod par shog ces pa 'di bod yul dbus kyi rgyal khams kyi bye brag gong dkar gyi phyogs nas/ dad ldan khyab 59) gdal lhun grub kyis bskul ba'i ngor bkod pa'o// na mo gu ru/ rgyal ba kun 'dus kyi ngo bo// dam chos thams cad kyi 'byung gnas// tshogs mchog dge 'dun gyi spyi dpal// drin can bla ma rang mkhyen no// 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi 'dam las// zab don man ngag gi gru bos// bde chen thar gling du sgrol mdzad// ded dpon dam pa rang mkhyen no// dug gsum nyon mongs nad kyis// thog mtha' dus ring du gzir la// dam chos bdud rtsi yis phan mdzad// bde ba'i 'byung gnas rang mkhyen no// rab 'jigs ngan song gi dgra las// skyobs mdzad skyabs mgon gyi dam pa// 'khor ba'i g.yul zlog gi dpa' bo// thugs rje'i 60)bdag nyid rang mkhyen no// ༈ bu gcig ma la 'bod 'dra'i gdung dbyangs kyis// gdung pa'i nga ro'i pha khyod 'bod lags na// dgongs pa'i klong nas brtse ba'i shugs phyungs te// thugs rje'i rlabs chen g.yo ba'i dus la bab// sgra dang ldan pa'i tshig gis 'bod pa'i tshe// rmongs pa'i dud 'gro'ang go zhing rgyug byed na// pha khyod dran pas dbyangs kyi bos pa'i tshe// mos pa'i bu la thugs rjes mi dgongs sam// bdag gis mos gus gdung shugs drag po yis// skyabs gnas khyod la gsol ba btab pa'i mthus// mchog dang thun mongs dngos grub ma lus pa// myur du stsol zhing byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

ces pa 'di ni tshe'i rig byed 'dzin pa'i dbang po karma 'gro phan gyi bskul ngor bris pa'o// ༈ rang gi spyi bor pad nyi zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma rnam pa slob dpon rin po che pad+ma 'byung gnas 61) kyi sku mtshan dang dpe byad kyi brgyan pa gsal btab la/ dad pa mos gus kyi gdung shugs dang ldan pas gsol ba 'di ltar du gdab par bya ste/ na mo/ ye grol ka dag gdod ma'i gnas lugs la// rang byung rang rig spro med brjod mtha' bral// 'gyur med 'od gsal klong yangs 'dus ma byas// bla ma chos kyi sku la gsol ba 'debs// rang bzhin lhun grub gsal dag thig le'i klong*// kun bzang gdangs las 'gags med rol rtsal 'phro// lta bas mi ngom snang stong 'od kyi sku// bla ma longs spyod rdzogs la gsol ba 'debs// phyogs bcu mtha' yas rgyas rab 'byams zhing khams su// sku dang mdzad phrin sna tshogs bsam yas kyis// gdul bya'i re ba yid bzhin skong mdzad pa// bla ma sprul pa'i sku la gsol ba 'debs// bla ma yi dam 62) mkha' 'gro chos skyong sogs// rnam 'gyur chad lugs du mar snang ba kun// dbyer med bla ma'i ngang du ro gcig pa'i// kun 'dus bla ma mchog la gsol ba 'debs// skyabs gnas dpal mgon rtsa ba'i bla ma la// mos gus gdung ba'i gsol ba btab pa'i mthus// smin grol byin rlabs char rgyun dbab nas kyang*// sku gsum mngon du 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs/ ces bla ma'i rnal 'byor mdor bsdus pa 'di ni/ chos mdzad o rgyan dar rgyas kyi bskul ngor bris pa'o// ༈ khams gsum 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon dam pa nyid// thugs rje chen pos dad ldan 'gro ba kun// ma nor lam la 'god mdzad bka' drin can// drin can rtsa ba'i bla mar gsol ba 'debs// sku mchog mthong bas dad pa'i rba rlabs g.yo// tshangs dbyangs thos pas ngan 'gro'i g.yang sa gcod// dran pa tsam gyis grol ba'i lam

63)la 'god// drin can rtsa ba'i bla mar gsol ba 'debs// mdzad pa'i phrin las yon tan rgya mtsho las// ngo mtshar 'dod 'byung yid bzhin gter mdzod kyis// 'gro ba'i re skong mdzad pa'i rin po che// drin can rtsa ba'i bla mar gsol ba 'debs// khyed mthong thos dang dran dang reg pas kyang*// gnas skabs mthar thug 'dod don ma lus kun// yongs su 'grub cing go 'phang mchog thob pa'i// skyabs mchog khyed kyis thugs rjes dgongs nas kyang*// rjes su bzung zhing byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ ces pa ni dad ldan bzang po'i ming can gyis bskul ngor sbyin pa'o// ༈ rang nyid tha mal spyi gtsug pad nyi'i steng*/ sku drin 'khor med rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid/ rigs 'dus rgyal ba thod phreng rtsal gyi sku/ sku mdog dmar po zhi ma khro yi nyams// cung zad 64)'dzum dang bzhad pa'i zhal ldan pa// spyan gsum zlum zhing dmar bas phyogs bcur gzigs// dbu skra thor tshugs rin chen prog zhu gsol// sku la rin chen rus brgyan dar dpyangs mdzes// phyag gnyis rdo rje dril bu thugs kar bsnol// zhabs gnyis g.yas bskum g.yon rkyang dor stabs tshul// 'ja' 'od rab 'khrugs me dpung 'bar ba'i klong*// khams gsum dbang bsdud srid gsum zil gnon pa'i// 'khor du rtsa rgyud bla ma yi dam dang*// mkha' 'gro chos skyong sprin ltar stibs pa'i dbus// brjid pa'i sku las chos gsungs tshangs dbyangs ldan// thugs rje brtse bas bdag la dgongs par gsal// sku gsung thugs nas 'od zer 'phros pa las// rnga yab gling nas rje btsun pad+ma 'byung*// 'khor bcas byon nas spyi bo'i bla mar thim/ hūm̐/ phyi nang snod bcud snang srid 'khor 'das chos// dngos dang dngos 65)min bdag lus longs spyod sogs// ma lus blo yis blangs te 'bul lags na// khyod dang dbyer med gcig par dngos grub stsol// gu ru rat+na maṇ+ḍal la pū dza me gha sa mu drā s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/

na maḥshri gu ra we/ srid las rnam grol srid zhi'i rol gar ston// mkhyen rab mkha' la mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer 'phro// gdul ka'i 'gro rnams gdul thabs bsam yas kyis// sku gsum la 'god sku gsum kun 'dus pa'i// dpal ldan bla ma bla med skyabs mgon mchog /dngos grub kun stsol kun bzang rdo rje 'dzin// byin rlabs mchog stsol mchog gi go 'phang la// khyod kyis bdag dang bdag 'dra'i sems can rnams// myur du bkod mdzod bkod pa mtha' yas kyi// zhing khams rgya chen rgya mtsho dpag med par// yongs 66)su 'dren par 'dren mchog khyed nyid la// myur du gsol zhing gsol ba snying nas 'debs// thugs rjes dgongs shing dgongs pas nyer bzung ste// nyon mongs 'khor ba'i 'khor lo gzhom du gsol// bdag tu lta ba'i lta ngan zhig tu gsol// ka dag glong du glong grol chen por shog /de ltar rtse gcig gsol ba btab pa las// bla ma'i sku gsung thugs las 'od 'phros nas// bdag la thim pas sgo gsum sgrib pa dag /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub thob gyur cing*// slar yang bla ma 'od zhu rang la thim// dus gsum 'gyu dran rtog pa'i 'phro 'du la// dgag sgrub bcos slad re dogs med pa'i ngang*// sgom med yengs med gnas lugs don la glod// glod ces bya ba'ang ming dang tshig tsam ste// ming tshig brjod pa'i yul las 'das par bskyur// bskyur 67)mkhan bskyur rgyu gnyis su ma grub pas// gnyis med ngang du yengs med rig pas bskyangs// mtshon byed dpe yi bla ma gzugs tsam ste// mtshon bya don gyi bla ma rang rig nyid// rang rig rang ngo shes na bla ma'i mchog /'di don rtogs na sangs rgyas logs na med// yang dag snying po'i don la 'dris par mdzod/ ༈ bla ma dran dang bsgoms pa las byung ba'i// dge ba 'di dang dge gzhan kun bsdoms nas// bla med bla ma mchog gi go 'phang la// bdag dang 'gro kun myur du reg par shog

ces pa 'di ni long yul bde chen dgon du dad ldan gar dbang bstan 'dzin la gdams pa // ༈ na mo ma hā gu ru sarba sid+dhi hūm̐/ ngo bo ka dag spros bral chos kyi sku// rang bzhin gsal la ma 'gags longs spyod rdzogs// thugs rje sna tshogs gang 'dul sprul pa'i sku// sku gsum dbyer med bstan 'dzin rdo rje'i dpal/ 68)/bzang po'i zhabs la snying nas gsol ba 'debs// byin rlabs char rgyun dbab par mdzad du gsol// khyed kyi thugs rje rnam rol 'phro 'du las// phyogs bcu'i zhing khams mtha' yas rgya mtsho ru// gang la cir 'dul 'gro ba'i don mdzad cing*// bdag sogs snang ngor pad+ma legs grub rtsal// rig 'dzin rnam par rgyal la gsol ba 'debs// thugs rje g.yel ba med par gzigs su gsol// sangs rgyas byang sems bla ma yi dam lha// mkha' 'gro chos skyong du mar snang ba kun// dbyer med bla ma'i rol par gcig pa'i ngang*// kun 'dus bla ma mchog la gsol ba 'debs// khyod kyi thugs rjes bdag sogs 'gro ba kun// chos dbyings klong du grol bar mdzad du gsol/ ces rang gi skye ba gong 'og gnyis kyi gsol 'debs shig dgos ces chos mdzad mgon pas bskul ba'i ngo ma chog par bris pa'o// 69)na mo gu ra we/ chos dbyings mkha' la mkhyen brtse'i dkyil 'khor rgyas// mdzad pa'i phrin las 'od stong phyogs bcur 'phro// sku bzhi'i bdag nyid drin can bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol// sngon tshe 'dren mchog shākya seṅge nyid// tshong dpon khye'u chu 'bebs gyur pa'i dus// de yi bu mchog chu yi snying po zhes// tshogs gnyis 'bras bu smin la gsol ba 'debs// mdo sde 'dzin pa'i nye gnas kun dga' bo// shākya'i rigs 'khrungs ston pa'i zhabs 'bring mdzad// 'od srungs chen pos bstan pa'i snying po gtad// bka' yi bsdu ba po la gsol ba 'debs// spyan ras gzigs dngos srong btsan sgam po'i dus// chos blon mchog gyur thon mi sam+bho ṭa// bod yul mun pa'i smag rum sel

70)mdzad pa// 'jam dbyangs mi gzugs can la gsol ba 'debs// mi 'gyur lhun grub dpal gyi bsam yas su// sgra bsgyur kun gyi mchog gyur bai ro rje// dam chos sgron me sbar ba'i thugs rje can// /bstan pa nyin mor byed la gsol ba 'debs// gzhan yang rtsod dus 'gro la brtser dgongs te// 'jam dbyangs rnam 'phrul paṇa chen sa skya pa// grub pa'i dbang phyug khyung po rnal 'byor sogs// skyes chen dam pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs// bsam yas mthil du g.yag char sngon po dang*// g.yo ru grwa nas mtshungs bral rdo rje gling*// zab lung gnas su kun skyong gling pa sogs// rig 'dzin gter bdag rnams la gsol ba 'debs// slar yang bstan pa'i me ro slong phyir du// yongs 'dzin dam pa bstan 'dzin rdo rje zhes// snga 'gyur bstan pa'i sgron me mchog gyur pa/ 71)/mnyam med bla ma rje la gsol= /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong tshul// du mar snang yang dbyer med bla mar gcig /dran mchog rgyal po sna tshogs rang grol rtsal// rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid la gsol ba 'debs// phyogs bcu'i zhing khams grangs med dpag yas su// gang 'dul gzugs kyi 'gro ba 'dren mdzad pa// sprul dang yang sprul sna tshogs skur ston la// rtse gcig gus pa'i yid kyis gsol ba 'debs/ mgon po khyod kyi thugs rjes nyer dgongs te// bdag sogs khams gsum 'gro ba ma lus kun// las nyon sdug bsngal mtsho las rab bsgral nas// dpal ldan bla ma'i go 'phang myur thob shog ces rang nyid kyi skyes rabs gsol 'debs shig dgos zhes dbon po rin chen gyis yang yang bskul bar brten nas 72) mtshungs med de nyid kyi skyes rabs ltar bkod pa yin no// e ma ho/ ko sha'i mtsho gling dri med pad sdong las// rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs pad+ma 'byung gnas dpal// khams gsum 'gro ba kun gyi skyabs gcig pu// drin can bla ma rje la gsol ba 'debs// za hor yul du dge slong sam+bha wa// ra ga ra tir blo ldan mchog sred rtsal// dga' ba'i 'tshal du pad+ma rgyal po zhes// rnam 'gyur bsam mi khyab la gsol ba 'debs// ma rig mun sel nyi ma'i 'od zer 'phro// shākya'i bstan 'dzin shākya seng ger sprul// mu stegs log 'dren seṅge sgra yis bcom// gang 'dul 'gro ba 'dren la gsol ba 'debs// gangs can khrod du lha srin gdug pa can// thugs rjes gdul phyir gar dgu'i nyams ldan pa// rdo rje gro lod dpal chen drag po rtsal// bdud 'dul he ru ka la gsol ba

73)'debs// rnga yab gling gi zangs mdog dpal gyi rir// bgres rgud mi mnga' rdo rje'i skur bzhugs nas// gzhan gyis mi thub srin tshogs chos la bkod// rak+ṣa thod phreng rtsal la gsol ba 'debs// snyigs ma'i yang snyigs bstan pa'i mtha' ma 'dir// 'gro ba'i don phyir zab gter grangs med sbas// gter ston so sor sprul nas 'gro don mdzad// thabs mkhas thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs// ma 'ongs shāka thub bstan pa rdzogs pa'i tshe// klu yi yul du zab gter 'gro don skyong*// o rgyan sprul pa dri med dpal 'phreng zhes// zab gter bstan zhabs skyong la gsol ba 'debs// rtsa gsum zhi khro rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs// du mar snang kun bla mar ro gcig pa'i// skyabs gnas kun 74)'dus rgyal ba pad+ma 'byung*// rigs kun khyab bdag rnams la gsol ba 'debs// thugs rje brtse ba'i dgongs pas nyer bzung nas// bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus pa// srid zhir mi gnas myang 'das grong mchog tu// khyed dang dbyer med gcig par byin gyis rlobs// zhes pa 'di dge bshes bstan 'dzin la'o// na mo ma hā gu ru ye/ srid zhi ma lus pa'i khyab bdag dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi ngo bo// skyabs mchog drin can gyi bla ma// rtse gcig gsol ba rang 'debs so// lung rtogs dam chos kyi 'byung gnas// smin grol legs bshad kyi mnga' bdag /mkhyen brtse nus pa yi bdag nyid// thugs rjes g.yal med du gzigs shig /rnam grol dge legs kyi lam bzang*// ston mdzad byams ldan gyi bla ma// tshogs mchog dge 'dun gyi spyi dpal// re sa gzhan 75)na med do/ ༈ bla ma yid bzhin gyi nor bu// dngos grub char chen rang phob dang*// bla ma sman mchog gi rgyal po// 'khor ba'i gcong nad rang sel dang*// bla ma 'dren mchog gi ded dpon// thar gling bde chen du khrid dang*// bla ma stobs ldan gyi dpa' bo// 'khor ba'i g.yul ngo rang zlog dang*/

༈ mos gus dad pa'i chu 'dzin thibs se thib// gsol 'debs gdung dbyang 'brug sgra 'u ru ru// nges 'byung bzod med mchi ma sha ra ra// rtse gcig snying nas gsol ba 'debs lags na// thugs rjes breng tsam bdag la mi dgongs sam// mgon med 'khor ba'i sems can bdag sogs la/ pha gcig khyed kyis dgongs pas nyer bzung nas// 'bral med byin gyis rlobs shig thugs rje can/ ces pa 'di kun bzang rig 'dzin la'o/ ka dag dang po'i sangs rgyas kun 76)tu bzang*// lhun grub longs sku'i gtso mchog rdo rje 'chang*// gang 'dul sgyu ma'i gar mkhan rdo rje sems// rigs kun khyab bdag rnams la gsol ba 'debs// grub mchog kun gyi gtso bo dga' rab zhabs// gnas lnga rig pa'i mchog gyur shrī seng*// khams gsum zil gnon rgyal ba pad+ma 'byung*// rig 'dzin khyu mchog rnams la gsol ba 'debs// cog ro klu rgyal gter ston karma gling*// sras mchog nyi zla mtshungs bral nyi zla 'od// nam mkha' rgya mtsho kun dga' lhun grub ste// zab chos mnga' bdag rnams la gsol 'debs// bsod nams rnam rgyal bsod nams rin chen dang*// ngag dbang pad+ma grub mchog bsod nams dbang*// drin chen rje btsun rtsa ba'i bla ma sogs// skyabs gnas dam pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs// de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs kyis// khams gsum 'khor ba bar do'i sems can 77)kun// 'khrul snang rang grol rang byung ye shes mchog /myur du rtogs nas mngon sangs rgyas par shog/

ces bar do thos grol gyi bla ma brgyad pa'i gsol 'debs nyung bsdus 'di dge 'dun bkra shis la gdams pa'o// ༈ chos dbyings mkha' khyab ye shes gzhal yas khang*// skye med dbyings las 'gags med rnal rol can// kun bzang rdor sems dga' rab pad+ma 'byung*// sku gsum ston pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs// thog med dus nas smon lam rgya chen mthus// sna tshogs thabs kyis bstan pa'i sgron me sbar// bai ro la sogs rje 'bangs nyi shu lnga// mkhyen brtse'i bdag nyid rnams la gsol ba 'debs// rgyal bas byin rlabs snyigs dus 'gro ba'i skyabs// smin grol gdams pa'i chos mdzod 'dzin pa'i dpal// kun skyong dza yig rig 'dzin yab sras dang*// bstan 'dzin rdo rje'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ 78)/rgyal kun ye nas chos skur ro gcig kyang*// mos blo'i snang ngor gang 'dul gzugs brnyan ston// bsod nams dbang po rtsa ba'i bla ma dang*// yi dam chos skyong tshogs la gsol ba 'debs// de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs kyis// cis kyang dgos med dran pa'i zhen log dang*// snang srid bla mar 'char ba'i dag snang dang*// thams cad chos skur grol ba'i gdeng tshad bcas// rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub pa'i dngos grub mchog /myur du stsol zhing byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes rdor sems snying thig gi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs 'di gnas chen dur khrod 'go dgur bkod pa'o// ༈ skyabs gnas rnams la gus pas btud byas nas// bdag dang ma rgan sems can bsgral ba'i phyir// bla med bla ma mchog gi sgrub pa la// zhugs nas de yi go 'phang thob par bya// rang lus skad cig dran 79)rdzogs rdo rje sems// dkar gsal rdor dril zhi 'dzum longs sku'i tshul// yongs rdzogs 'od 'phror gsal ba'i spyi bo'i gtsug /pad+ma nyi zla brtsegs pa'i khri stengs su// ngo bo drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid// rnam pa gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal// sku mdog mthing nag gcer bu rus rgyan can// g.yas g.yon phyag gnyis rdo rje dril stabs tshul// rdo rje skyil krung gzi brjid mdangs ldan zhing*// yum chen mtsho rgyal dkar dmar 'od mdangs can// gri thod 'dzin pas yab la 'khril bar bskyed// phyi rim mtha' skor brgyud pa'i bla ma ni// kun bzang rdor sems dga' rab pad 'byung dang*// bai ro kun skyong chos rje rdza yig pa// rig 'dzin yab sras bstan 'dzin rdo rje dang*// bsod nams dbang po yi dam chos skyong sogs// skyabs gnas ma lus sprin phung

80)ltar bzhugs snyam// de dag kun kyang ngo bo gcig pa la// rnam 'gyur cha lugs gang 'dul rol rtsal can// nges med sna tshogs cho rol cir yang ston// bdag sogs byin gyis rlob pa'i mthu ldan 'gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ snang srid snod bcud bdag lus longs spyod dang*// 'di phyi bar gsum mdun ma thams cad kun// skyabs gnas rnams la mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal du// 'bul gyi thugs rjes bzhes la byin gyis rlobs/ bar 'dir gsol 'debs rgyas bsdus ci rigs byas la/ de nas dbang bzhi blang pa ni/ de ltar gsol ba btab pa la brten nas/ skyabs gnas kun gyi gnas gsum 'bru gsum las// 'od 'phros bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum thim// sgrib tshogs kun dag dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs thob// slar yang 'khor rnams gtso bo nyid la thim// gtso bo yab yum rang la dbyer med thim/ 81)/mtshon byed dpe yi bla gzugs bsgom pa dang*// mtshon bya don gyi bla ma rang rig gnyis// mkha' las sprin byung mkha' la thim pa bzhin// so so ma yin tha dad med par 'dres// 'dres dang ma 'dres sems kyi btags pa tsam// ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje'i rol pa nyid// stong pa'i rang mdangs gsal ba'i bla ma de// slar yang stong pa nyid du phyam gdal bar// rig cing rtogs la bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhes// ming du btags pa dag snang 'char sgo'i 'phrul// rang byung ye shes gdod ma'i gnas lugs la// bzang ngan dgag sgrub bzo bcos ma byas par// sgom med klong du ma yengs gnas par bya// 'khor 'das bde sdug re dogs med pa yi// dngos grub thob bya thob byed dbyer med pa'i// sgrub thabs mchog gyur gdams pa'i yang snying la// 'du 'bral med par nyams su blang bar 82)bya// 'di las byung ba'i dge tshogs ji snyed pa// 'di don ma rtogs 'khrul pa'i 'gro ba la// yongs su bsngo zhing bsngo bya bsngo byed kyang*// chos dbyings spros pa med pa'i klong du phaṭaḥ

rdor sems snying thig gi bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom thabs ngag 'don du bgyis chog pa 'di bzhin dgos zhes/ gtsang rong gong ra ba'i grub chen pa grogs mched rnams kyis bskul ngor pho brang chen po rin chen sbungs pa dang nye ba'i bla ma'i gdan sar bkod pa'o// ༈ na mo ma hā gu ru nirma kā ya hūm̐/ phyogs dus rgyal ba'i thugs rje'i 'od zer las// 'gro ba'i don slad sna tshogs rol gar can// srid par gnas kyang srid pas ma gos pa'i// dpal ldan bla ma mtshungs med spyi bos 'dud// 'dren mchog shākya'i drung na kun dga' bo// srong btsan spyan sngar mkhyen rab thon ma'i zhabs// zla med skad gnyis smra ba bai ro rje// chos kyi spyan ldan rnams la gsol ba 'debs// rdor 83)gling kun skyong gling pa mchog ldan mgon// zab gter chos kyis skye dgu smin grol mdzad// slar yang snying po'i bstan pa spel mdzad pa// bstan 'dzin rdo rje'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// byams pa'i ljon shing snying rje'i yal ga rgyas// byang chub sems kyi lo 'bras dpal gyis phyug /zab don snying po'i 'bras bu sbyin mdzad pa// drin can bla ma mchog la gsol ba 'debs// snang srid rnam dag rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor che// cir snang chos nyid dbyings kyi rol pa la// bzang ngan blang dor dgag sgrub las 'das pa// srid gsum rgyal ba'i zhing la gsol ba 'debs// deng nas bzung ste tshe rabs thams cad du// mchog dngos grub nas rnam 'phrul rgya mtsho yis// mkha' mnyam 'gro kun srid mtsho las sgrol ba'i// phrin las rgyal ba kun dang mnyam par shog ces pa 'di gnas chen chu bo g.yas 'khyil 84) gyi dge 'dun rnams kyi zhal 'don du mdzad chog pa zhig dgos zhes grub chen chos 'phel bzang pos bskul pa ltar bris pa'o// ༈ na maḥm ha gu ru sarba sid+dhi hūm̐/ rgyal ba kun dngos pad+ma 'byung gnas dpal// de yis byin rlabs bstan 'dzin rdo rje'i zhabs// gang 'dul gzugs sprul pad+ma legs grub rtsal// gsol ba 'debs so byin rlabs char chen phob// dkyil 'khor kun gtso pad+ma thod phreng rtsal// bstan pa'i gsal byed bstan 'dzin rdo rje'i zhabs// smin grol mnga' bdag rig 'dzin rnam par rgyal// gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub chu rgyun stsol// sangs rgyas kun 'dus pad+ma saṃ bha wa// dam chos mdzod 'dzin bstan 'dzin rdo rje'i zhabs// dge 'dun 'dren mchog sna tshogs rang grol rje// gsol ba 'debs so mkhyen pa'i spyan gyis gzigs// khams gsum dbang bsdus pad+ma rgyal ba'i sras// srid gsum 'gro sgrol bstan 'dzin rdo rje'i zhabs// sku gsum don ston rtsa

85)ba'i bla ma rje// gsol ba 'debs so brtse ba'i thugs kyis dgongs// byin rlabs kun 'byung pad+ma 'byung gnas dang*// dngos grub mchog brnyes bstan 'dzin rdo rje'i zhabs// phrin las thogs med rtsa ba'i bla ma mchog /skyabs gnas rnams la gsol ba snying nas 'debs// de ltar gus pas gsol ba btab pa'i mthus// deng nas byang chub snying po ma thob par// g.yel ba med par rtag par rjes bzung nas// lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis brlab tu gsol// thugs rje can gyi thugs rjes ma skyabs na/ mgon med nyam thag sems can su la re// byin rlabs mthu stobs nus pa'i dpung bskyed nas// 'khor ba'i 'dam nas myur du drang du gsol// kye ma kyi hud mgon po thugs rje can// brtse ba chen pos bdag la mi dgos sam// da lta nyid du byin 86)gyis brlab tu gsol/ khyed kyi thugs dang dbyer med gcig par shog/ de ltar bdag nyid kyi skye ba gong 'og dang*/ gu ru rin po che pad+ma 'byung gnas dang bcas pa la lhan cig tu gsol ba btab chog pa zhag dgos zhes/ sa skyong lha dbang rnam rgyal gyi nan tan du bskul ba la brten nas 'di lta bu bkod pa lags shing*/ bdag 'dra las dang nyon mongs kyi 'dam du gtan du chud bzhin pa'i dbang gis gzhan rgyud byin gyis rlob pa'i nus pa ni mngon sum du gsal ba 'di ka yin mod kyang*/ bskul pa po'i nan ma chog par 'di ltar bris pa la mkhyen can rnams kyi mi 'khrel bar gsol// ༈ na mo ma hā gu ru ye/ dus gsum rgyal kun gyi ngo bo// mkhyen brtse zhus ldan gyi bla ma// rtse gcig gsol ba rang 'debs so// thugs rjes g.yel med du gzigs dang*// rab 'byams dkyil 'khor gyi spyi dpal// mchog thun 87)dngos grub kyi 'byung gnas// dad ldan mos gus kyis 'bod la// brtse ba'i spyan gyis rang gzigs dang*// mtha' yas zhing khams kyi gdul bya// ma lus 'dren mdzad kyi ded dpon// bdag sogs nyams thag gi 'gro la// dgongs pas 'dor med du skyobs shig

/'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi me 'ob// bzod med tsha gdung gi gzir la// thugs rje'i chu 'dzin gyis dkrig cing*// phan bde'i char chen rang phob dang*// dug gsum rgyu 'bras kyi nad kyis// thog mtha' bar med du mnar ba'i// snying rje'i yul gyur gyi 'gro la// dam chos bdud rtsi yis skyobs dang*// 'khor ba ngan song gi lam du// mi shes blun rmong gi 'gro la// lam bzang 'khrid mkhas kyi mgon khyed// yang dag lam mchog rang ston zhig /nyon mongs dug lnga yi dgra bos// thar lam bar 88)chod du gyur tshe// dug ldang ye shes su sgrol ba'i// stobs ldan dpa' bo khyed mkhyen no// gdung dbyangs 'o dod kyi sgra yis// skyabs gnas pha khyod la 'bod na// thugs rjes brtser dgongs kyi klong nas// 'bral med byin gyis rang rlobs shig /bla ma yid bzhin gyi nor bu// bla ma sman mchog gi rgyal po// bla ma 'jigs skyobs kyi dpa' bo// bla ma thar gling gi ded dpon// bla ma re ltos kyi skyabs gnas// bla ma thugs rje yi bdag nyid// gsol ba snying nas rang 'debs so// byin rlabs char chen rang phob cig /da lta nyid du byin gyis brlab tu gsol// myur ba nyid du byin gyis brlab tu gsol// thugs rjes nus pa'i rtsal chen sprugs nas kyang*// mgon po khyod dang dbyer med gcig par shog ces pa 'di ni rig 'dzin chen po sog zlog pa'i zhabs pad la reg pa'i dad 89) ldan lhun grub khyab gdal gyis bskul pa'i ngor/ dpal skad gnyis smra ba'i dbang po mchog gi gdan sar bkod pa'o// ༈ na maut+ta re bh+yaḥ dal 'byor rin chen lan cig thob dus 'dir// rang gzhan don gnyis legs par bsgrub slad du// rigs 'dus bla ma'i sgrub pa nyams blangs nas// rdzogs pa'i byang chub dam pa thob par bya// rang lus skad cig yi dam lhar gsal ba'i// spyi gtsug seng khri pad+ma nyi zla'i steng*// ngo bo rje btsun rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid// rnam pa gu ru mtsho skyes rdo rje'i tshul// sku mdog mthing ga zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa// rdo rje dril bu bsnol bas yum la 'khyud// yum chen man+da ra ba dkar dmar mdangs// gri gug thod 'dzin yab yum 'khril sbyor tshul// gnyis ka zhi 'dzum dar dang rin chen rgyan// rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs pa'i mtha' skor du// rtsa rgyud bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro

90)dang*// chos srung ma lus khrom tshogs ltar bzhugs par// bdag lus longs spyod snang srid snod bcud kun// mchod par 'bul gyi thugs rjes bzhes su gsol/ na mo/ phyogs dus rgyal ba ma lus gcig bsdus pa'i// dpal mgon bla ma rnam sprul rgya mtshor bcas// thugs rje'i mnga' bdag rnams la gsol ba 'debs// byin rlabs char phob smin grol dngos grub stsol/ ces gsol 'debs tshar ci mang byas la/ de nas dbang bzhi blang thabs ni/ de nas bla ma'i sku gsung thugs rnams las// 'od 'phros bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum phog /sgrib tshogs yongs dag dngos grub kun thob cing*// slar yang 'khor rnams gtsor thim gco bo yang*// rang la thim nas chu la chu bzhag ltar// gyur pa'i mong la rang sems 'di nyid ni// sngon bsu rjes gcod bzo bcos kun spangs te// gang ltar 'dug pa de ka'i ngang nyid 91)la// rang babs ngo bo shes pa'i thog tu glod// dran med zhi gnas had po ma yin pa'i// spros bral stong gsal rig pa'i snying po can// rnam rtog phra rags 'gyu dran las 'das shing*/{ 'di la 'gyu ba ched du bkag dgos pa ni ma yin te/ blos byas dang bral ba'i don/ } /gnas lugs don thog rang babs glod pa ni// rdzogs chen don gyi mthar thug snying rje nyid// de la rnam rtog phra rag gang shar yang*// spong bsgyur dgag sogs dgrar 'dzin mi bya bar// gang shar ngo bor cer gyi blta ba dang*// bsgom rgyu'i mtshan ma rdul tsam med mod kyang*// yengs 'khrul dbang du cung zad mi gtong ba// dran rig rtsi yis rgyun du zin pa ni// phyag chen nyams len snying por dril ba yin// phyag rdzogs bzhed srol dbye ba mang na yang*/ nang don sgom don yengs med 92)kho nar gcig /lam 'dir brten pas 'bras { sa skya'i lam 'bras/ }bu mchog lhun grub/ nad gdon sdug bsngal sgom gyi rol par{ pha dam pa'i zhi byed/

}grol// gzung 'dzin mngon zhen ma bshig rang bzhin { lam sgron gyi gcod/ }zhig /de phyir chos kun gnad 'gag gcig bsdus la// brtson pas 'bad nas don gnyis 'grub par bya// de las byung ba'i dge tshogs ji snyed mthus// mkha' mnyam 'gro kun chos kyi sku thob shog ces pa 'di ni yar 'brog sna dkar rtse nas rig sngags 'dzin pa phrin las rgya mtshos bskul ngor/ gtsang rong gong ra lhun grub chos sdings su bkod pa'o// ༈ 'gro la ma las lhag pa'i brtse ba can// bcom ldan shākya'i rgyal dang mi pham mgon// thogs med dbyig gnyen 'phags btsun grol sde gnyis// gsol ba 'debs so byang chub sems mchog stsol// yon tan bshes gnyen seng bzang gang ba spel// ku sa li 93)pa che chung gser gling pa// bstan pa'i srog shing jo bo a ti sha/ gsol ba 'debs so= /rgyal ba 'brom dang pu to sha ra ba// 'chad kha ba dang po spyi lha 'gro mgon// lha sdings khu dbon yon dpal bde ba dpal// gsol ba= /ka bzhi pa dang bsod nams grags pa dang*// blo sbyong mnga' bdag rgyal sras thogs med zhabs// dpal ldan byang chub rgyal dbang mtshan can la// gsol= /sku zhang chos rje sangs rgyas dpal 'byor ba// shāka dbang chos grags kun spangs pad dkar mtshan// wa gin+d+ra dang mi pham 'ja' mtshon pa// gsol= /sku drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma dang*// phyogs dus rgyal dang sras ma lus la// rtse gcig gus pa'i yid kyis gsol 'debs na// byang chub sems mchog 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs/ 94)/thog med dus nas 'khor bar 'phen byed pa'i// bdag 'dzin 'gong po ma rungs gdug pa can// rdul du rlag nas byang sems rin po che// bdag bas gzhan gces 'dzin par byin gyis rlobs// tshe rabs dpag tu med nas da lta'i bar// gzhal med drin gyis bskyangs pa'i pha ma la// 'khon 'dzin gnod 'tshe'i bsam sbyor gtan spangs nas// phan bde'i rgyu 'bras rgya chen sbyin byed shog

/bdag ni nam yang ci 'drar gyur kyang sla'i// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho gting mtha' ma stong bar// rang 'dod kun bral rgyal sras spyod zhugs te// 'gro ba 'dren la rtag tu g.yel med shog /thams cad bla med byang chub sar 'god shog /rgyal kun phrin las bdag gi 'grub par shog /byang chub spyod la bar chad med par shog /smon lam btab pa bzhin du 'grub par shog 95)

ces blo sbyong rgyud pa'i gsol 'debs 'di ni/ chos 'di nyid la mos pa'i rnal 'byor pa a d+yī sha ka zhes bya ba'i bskul ngor/ bla ma'i gdan sa lhun grub chos sdings su bris pa dge'o// ༈ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ 'og min bde chen zhing khams nas// snang ba mtha' yas 'od dpag med// chos kyi sku mchog la gsol ba 'debs// ka dag rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ ri bo ta la'i gnas mchog nas// 'gro ba'i mgon mdzad spyan ras gzigs// longs spyod rdzogs sku la= /'od lus 'grub par= oṃ ma ṇi= sna tshogs 'gro 'dul zhing khams nas// gang 'dul cho 'phrul cir yang ston// pad+ma 'byung gnas= /'gro don 'grub par= oṃ= smin grol gdams pa'i mnga' bdag mchog /gu ru { gter ston/ }chos dbang sman { yar lung sprul ska ུ / }lung pa// sangs rgyas dwags ston { dbang phyug rdo rje } 96)la gsol= /smin cing grol bar byin= oṃ= bka' babs byin rlabs mdzod 'dzin pa'i// gnyan ston { dzñā na badz+ra/ }pa dang se sdengs { yon tan bzang po/ }pa// chos { 'khar po kun mkhyen/ }sku 'or zer la= /don gnyis 'grub par= oṃ= bdud dpung 'joms pa'i mthu stobs can// dpal 'byor { sgom po rta chu 'od 'bum/ }dbang phyug nam { rgyal sras nam mkha' gu ru /}mkha'i mtshan// rig 'dzin yab { bsod nams rnam rgyal/ }sras { o rgyan bstan 'dzin/ }la gsol ba= /bar chad zhi bar= oṃ= snga 'gyur bstan pa'i sgron me mchog /bstan 'dzin rdo rje dpal bzang po// rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol= /bstan pa dar bar= oṃ= snang gzugs thugs rje chen po'i sku// grags tshad rang byung yig bdun sgra// dran rtog sna tshogs chos nyid klong*// rang grol rtogs par byin= oṃ= 'di bzung 'khor ba ma stong bar// rang don zhi bde mi bsgrub cing*// dpag med 'gro ba 'dren pa la// ngal ba med par byin= oṃ ma=

97)phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas kyis// 'gro don ji ltar mdzad pa kun// gcig bsdus mthu stobs bdag 'grub nas// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho stongs par shog oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ chos dbang gi gter kha'i thugs rje chen po yang snying 'dus pa'i bla rgyud gsol 'debs 'di rnal 'byor pa skyabs mchog dpal gyi bskul ba'i ngor/ gtsang rong ring lung phug tu bkod pa'o// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ phyi nang snang srid bdag lus dngos kun kyang*// mi dmigs spros bral stong pa'i rangs mdangs las// skad cig dran rdzogs chu la chu bur bzhin// bdag nyid 'phags mchog thugs rje spyan ras gzigs// zhal gcig phyag bzhi thal sbyar 'phreng ba dang*// pad+ma dkar po 'dzin cing rgyan gyis mdzes// snang la dngos med gsal stong zung 'jug skur// gsal ba'i spyi bor pad+ma nyi zla'i steng*// ngo bo drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid// rnam pa rgyal mchog 98)'od dpag med pa'i tshul// dmar gsal mdangs ldan sprul sku'i cha lugs can// skyil krung mnyam bzhag ngur smrig na bza' mdzes// thugs rje'i 'od zer phyogs bcu 'phro bar gsal// bdag gi 'khor 'das dus gsum bya byed kyi// mdun ma thams cad gzhan la mi re bar// skyid rung sdug rung dpal mgon bla ma la// blo rtse gcig tu gtad cing snod bcud kun// ltos med rgyal ba mchog la maṇ+ḍal du// phul la gus pas 'di ltar gsol ba gdab/ na mo ma hā gu ru bh+yaḥ spyi gtsug 'bral med kyi cod paṇa// yid bzhin 'dod 'byung gi nor bu// sku drin 'khor med kyi bla ma// rtse gcig gsol ba rang 'debs so// dus gsum rgyal kun gyi rol pa// sna tshogs gang 'dul du snang ba// thams cad khyed nyid kyi rnam 'phrul// kun byed bla ma rang mkhyen no// bdag sogs snyigs dus kyi sems can// rnam mang 99)sdug bsngal gyis gzir la// mkhyen brtse byin rlabs kyi mnga' bdag

/khyed kyis thugs rjes rang gzigs shig /byin rlabs char chen rang phob cig /de ltar rtse gcig gsol ba btab pa'i mthus// bla ma 'od dpag med pa'i mnyam bzhag gi /steng na tshe bum bdud rtsis gang ba nas// dngos grub bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun nar gyis babs// tshangs bug nas zhugs lus na thams cad gang*// sgrib bzhi dag cing dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs thob// khyad par 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub brnyes// de rjes bla ma 'od zhu rang la thim// rgyal kun gcig bsdus bla ma'i thugs ye shes// bdag gi yid dang dbyer med gcig tu 'dres// 'dres zhes bya ba'ang ming gi tha snyad tsam// don la chos sku kun tu bzang po nas// 'jag mig nang gi srin bu yan chad kun// bde gshegs snying por ye nas gcig pa'i don// gnas 100)lugs nyid la bzang ngan rdul tsam med// de don rtogs dang ma rtogs khyad par gyis// sangs rgyas sems can gnyis su 'khrul grol byung*// don gyi snying po'i nyams len mthar thug ni// da lta'i rang sems tha mal shes pa la/ dgag sgrub bzang ngan rtog tshogs zhena'adzin sogs// bcos ma'i lhad kyis bslad pa ma yin par// gshis kyi 'dug tshul ji ltar 'du pa de// spro dang bsdu dang mtshan bcas dmigs gtad kun// rgyangs kyi bskyur nas rig pa'i ngo bo la// cer gyis blta bya lta byed bral bar blta// bskyur dang blta ba'ang ming gi 'du byed las// yang dag don la blang dor bya rgyus dben// ma bcos chos sku bcom mar ma song zhing*// dran med stong lta had por ma 'byams par// ma yengs mi sgom rig pa'i rol rtsal kun// gang shar chos nyid dbyings kyi rol pa las// gu yangs 101)spyod pa'i rnal 'byor chos kun rtogs// bar chad kun gyi rtsa ba bdag 'dzin 'di// khrol gyi thongs dang rkyen ngan gzhi rtsa med// nad gdon sdug bsngal sdig sgrib 'phyags ma nyid// sgom gyi bogs don yin no lam du 'khyer// snang srid snod bcud skye 'gro rgyal ba'i zhing*// dkyil 'khor gcig tu shes pa'i dag snang sbyongs// mdo rgyud man ngag rgya chen chos kun gyi// snying po gcig tu shes pas nyams su longs// theg pa'i mthar thug rdzogs chen snying po'i don// ma rtogs tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'grub pa dka'// don rtogs tsam gyis chog par ma 'dzin par// tshe dang sgrub pa mnyam na don chen 'grub// 'jig rten 'di yi snang ba rmi lam 'dra// yud tsam 'di la gtan don bsgrub re ran// da lta mi 'bad 'chi ba slebs tsa na// 'gyod kyang phan pa med pas myur du rem// snying gtam gdams

102)ngag snying la bcags pa yis// blang dor tshul bzhin gyis dang rnal 'byor pa// 'di ltar gdams pa'i dge bas 'gro kun kyang*// 'di don rtogs na srid las mthar gyur cig ces pa 'di mang yul gung thang gi phyogs nas byon pa'i rnal 'byor pa dh+yā na rat+na zhes bya bas mos gus gdung shugs chen pos bskul te snying gtam gdams ngag nyams len gcig chog blo bde zhig dgos gsungs ba'i dgongs bzhed skong phyir/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ tshe sgrub/ thugs rje chen po'i lha khrid sgom don gyis gnas bsdus dang bcas te phyogs gcig tu bsdoms pa 'di ni/ chos kyi rgyal po rim par byon pa'i pho brang chen po rin chen spungs pa'i yang thog gi gzim chung khams gsum rnam rgyal nas zab par gdams pa // ༈ na mo gu ru we/ rang rig mchog tu mi 'gyur stong nyid kyi rang mdangs// rnam kun mchog ldan ye shes gdod ma yi mgon po// snang ba mtha' yas zhes grags rigs kun gyi gtsug rgyan// pha gcig gsol ba 103)'debs so byin gyis rang rlobs shig /rang gsal 'od lnga lhun grub ye shes kyi snang bas// rmongs pa'i mun pa sel mdzad zla 'od kyi mdangs ldan// spyan ras gzigs dbang zhes grags snying rje yi gter chen// pha gcig gsol ba= /rang 'byung pad+ma'i dbus nas 'gro kun gyi gnyen gcig /srid pa'i rgud pa kun bral yid bzhin gyi nor bu// pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes grags grub mchog gi spyi dpal/ pha gcig= /nyon mongs gcong rnying gis gzir khams gsum gyi 'gro la// bde stong ye shes sman gyis rang grol du bsal mdzad// ye shes mtsho rgyal zhes grags ma las kyang lhag pa'i// pha gcig= /ting 'dzin rgyun chad med pa'i 'od gsal gyi sgron mes// gdul bya'i lam bzang snang byed sgrib bral gyi nyi ma// ting 'dzin bzang po zhes grags grub thob kyi rgyal po/ 104)/pha gcig= /snyigs dus dmu rgod 'gro ba mgon med kyi tshogs la// zab chos nyi ma 'bum shar mkhas grub kyi gtsug rgyan// 'ja' tshon snying po zhes grags rig 'dzin gyi gtso mchog

/pha gcig= /chos brgyad 'gong pos zin pa'i ser gzugs kyi tshogs la// ma nor lam mchog ston slad gang 'dul gyis rol pas// sna tshogs rang grol zhes grags drin can gyi bla ma// pha gcig= /skyabs gnas nor bu'i phreng ba drin can gyi tshogs la// gsol ba snying nas 'debs pa'i gdung dbyangs kyi nga ro// lhang lhang 'o dod 'bod do thugs rjes rang gzigs dang*// pha khyod bu la mi gzigs btang snyoms su 'dor ram// thugs rjes myur du gzigs dang rtsa rgyud kyi bla ma// byin rlabs char chen phobs dang rtsa rgyud kyi bla ma// smin grol lam la bkod dang rtsa rgyud kyi bla ma// re sa gzhan na med do bla ma rang mkhyen no/ 105) zhes pa 'di yang dad ldan karma 'gro phan la gdams pa'o// ༈ na mo gu ru/ rang rig stong nyid kyi ngo bo kun bzang snang mtha' yas// rang mdangs 'gag med kyi 'char sgo longs sku zhi khro'i tshogs// rnam rol thugs rje las sprul pa rig 'dzin rgyud par bcas// gsol ba snying nas rang 'debs so rtsa rgyud kyi bla ma rnams// 'gro blo'i mos khams dang mthun pa'i rnam 'gyur bsam yas pas// zhi rgyas dbang drag gi phrin las sna tshogs mdzad pa po// 'dod 'byung yid bzhin gyi nor bu rtsa ba'i bla ma mchog /gsol ba snying nas rang 'debs so re sa'i gnyen gcig pu// da dus rtsod ldan gyi mtha' ma bdud rigs stobs rgyas shing*// dam chos tshul bzhin du spyod kyang bar chad dbang btsan tsho// mthu stobs dbang phyug gi pha khyod ra ma dar 'bod lags na// thugs rje byin rlabs kyi 106)dpung chen myur du bskyed mdzod la// 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi mtsho las da lta bsgral du gsol/ zhes pa ni gus ldan dge 'dun bkra shis la'o// na mo pad+ma kā ra ye/ mkhyen pa'i lha lam rab yangs par// brtse ba'i 'od zer 'gyed mkhas pas// 'gro ba'i re 'dod skong ba'i pha// pad+ma thod phred rtsal la gsol ba 'debs// chos sku stong nyid mkha' dbyings las// longs sku gsal mdangs mtshan dpe'i gzugs// sprul sku gang 'dul rol gar can// pad+ma thod phreng=
