/rnam pa sna tshogs skur sprul kyang*// rang bzhin rgyal ba kun gyi dngos// ngo bo kun bzang snang mtha' nyid// pad+ma= /rnam 'gyur zhi bas 'dul ba la// dge slong pad+ma sam bha wa// mkhyen rab blo ldan mchog sred rtsal// pad+ma= /la lar rgyas dang dbang sogs kyi// gdul slad nyi ma 'od zer 107)dang*// pad+ma rgyal po shākya seng*// pad+ma= /gang dag zhi dang rgyas sogs kyi// mi thul log 'dren 'dul ba'i dpal// rdo rje gro lod seṅge sgra// pad+ma= /rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul chen du// sum stong drug brgya'i lo zhugs nas// bdud btul bstan pa 'phel mdzad pa// bod yul mun pa'i smag rum du// dam pa'i chos kyi sgon me sbar// 'gro rnams bde la bkod mdzad rje// pad+ma= /da dus snyigs ma lnga bde'i tshe// las kyi mnar ba'i 'gro ba la// pha ma las lhag brtse ba can// pad+ma= /'di dang phyi ma dus kun tu// re sa khyod las gzhan med na// rlabs chen thugs rje'i rmad byung gis// 'bral ba med par gzigs su gsol// bdag dang khams gsum sems can kun// mgon po khyod kyis rjes bzungs nas// tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'grub 108)pa yis// dngos grub dam pa bstsal du gsol/ ces pa ni bha dra'i ming can la gnod mdzes mthar du gdams pa'o/ ༈ ka dag gnas lugs gdod ma'i pho brang nas// kun bzang snang ba mthas yas rdo rje 'chang*// rdor sems spyan ras gzigs sogs sku gsum lha// ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rjer gsol ba 'debs// lhun grub 'od gsal klong nas rdo rje'i sku// dga' rab 'jam dpal shrī sing pad+ma 'byung*// khri srong lha sras mtsho rgyal sprul pa'i sku// gang 'dul der ston rnams la gsol ba 'debs// spyi gtsug mos pa rgya mtsho yid bzhin nor// bsod nams bla ma bsod nams rin po che// ngag dbang pad+ma grub mchog bsod nams dbang*// rtsa ba'i bla ma'i mchog= /rtsa rgyud bla ma rab 'byams zhi khro'i lha// mkha' 'gro chos srung tshogs la gsol btab pas// gdod ma'i gnas lugs ji bzhin mngon gyur nas// rtog med sprul pas 'gro

109)ba 'dren par shog bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i zab chos phyag rdzogs gnyis thun mong gi bla brgyud gsol 'debs mdor bsdus 'di ni/ gtsang pa rnal 'byor grogs mched gsum gyis bskul ngor gnas chen dur khrod mgo dgur bris pa'o// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rig stong snying po don gyi gzhal yas nas// kun bzang rdo rje 'chang dang rdo rje sems// pad+ma thod phreng yum chen mtsho rgyal la// gsol ba 'debs so ye shes rang gsal stsol// dung mtsho ras pa sangs rgyas drang srong rje// bde chen ras pa rang zhig zang thal dang*// rnam grol bzang po rgya la ras pa la// gsol ba= /rgyal mtshan 'od zer sangs rgyas brtson 'grus dang*// rgyal mtshan ye shes bud+dha ke tu'i zhabs// dge 'dun rin chen dge 'bum rin rdor rje// gsol ba= /ngag dbang grags dang grub mchog blo gros mtshan// gzhan phan rdo rje rtsa ba'i bla ma dang*/ 110)/rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor rab 'byams rigs brgya la// gsol= /tshe gcig sangs rgyas rdzogs chen yang snying mchog /ye shes rang snang mngon sum ston pa'i chos// 'di la brten nas stan thog 'di nyid du// mngon sangs rgyas nas 'khor ba dong sprugs shog rdzogs chen yang ti brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs nyung bsdus 'di ni/ chos 'di la mos pa'i dge slong tshul khrims bzang pos bskul ngor bkod pa'o// ༈ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rigs kyi rigs mchog rgyal kun rigs kyi bdag /kun bzang rgyal ba rigs lnga rdo rje sems// gsang bdag phyag rdor skal ldan rgyal po dzaḥ /ku ku rā dzā rnams la gsol ba 'debs// shākya pu tra sing ha rā dzā dang*// u pa rā dzā go ma de wi'i zhabs// bai tri ka ma la dang ā tsar+ya// dzi na mi tra rnams la gsol ba 'debs// rdo rje bzhad pa nyin byed seṅge dang*// bde ba gsal mdzad shākya 111)bo dhi'i zhabs/ so kya de wa sgeg pa rdo rje dang*// chos blon dā+e bar bcas la gsol ba 'debs// rgya gar mkhan po chos rgyal skyong gi mtshan// grub pa'i dbang phyug gnubs ban mthu stobs bdag

/ma hā yo ga rgyud pa'i bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so smin grol dngos grub stsol// rigs mchog kun tu bzang dang rigs lnga'i lha// zhi dang khro gar ston mdzad thugs rje can// 'jam dbyangs spyan ras gzigs dang rdo rje 'dzin// grags ldan phyogs skyong rnams la gsol ba 'debs// rig 'dzin skar mda' gdong dang laṅka'i bdag /klu rgyal 'jog po dri med li tsā bi// gsang sngags sgron mas 'jig rten snang byed pa// dam pa'i rigs can rnams la gsol ba 'debs// rgyal po dza dang u pa rā dza'i mtshan// in+d+ra bo dhi klu rgyal nā ga pu// ga ya pū tra ku ku rā dzā 112)dang*// ro langs bde ba rnams la gsol ba 'debs// rdo rje bzhad pa rā dzā pra ha ti// dha na rak+ṣi ta dang hūm̐ ka ra// s+thi ra ma ti bde ba gsal mdzad mchog /dharma bo dhi rnams la gsol ba 'debs// mkhan po dharma'i mtshan dang nor 'dzin zhabs// gtsug lag dpal dge bru sha tshe btsan skyes// sangs rgyas ye shes la sogs a nu'i brgyud// gsol ba 'debs so smin grol dngos grub stsol// chos sku kun bzang longs sku rdo rje sems// sprul sku bka' yi sdud pa rdo rje 'dzin// dga' rab rdo rje 'jam dpal bshes gnyen dang*// dha na ta lo rnams la gsol ba 'debs// rā dzā ha sti sras mo sa ra ni// byang chub mo dang klu rgyal 'jog po'i mtshan// gzungs ma a ra li dang ak+ṣo bh+yeḥ /ku ku rā dzā bcas la gsol ba 'debs// bud+dha pā la bud+dha sa ma dhi/ 113)/ma hā rā dzā go ma de wi dang*// slob dpon rab snang khyi rgyal phyi ma dang*// ma hā rā dzā rnams la gsol ba 'debs// drang srong bha ṣi ta dang bdag nyid ma// na gardzu na de wa rā dzā dang*// 'jam dpal phyi ma rig 'dzin dge bsnyen legs// bud+dha gu h+ya rnams la gsol ba 'debs// shrī singha dge slong kun dga' mo// bi ma bai ro tsa na g.yu sgra snying*// dzñā na sog po dpal ye gnubs ban mchog

/rdzogs chen rgyud pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs// yo ga gsum sogs mdo dbang smin grol gyi// byin rlabs chu bo ma lus gcig 'dus pa'i// gnubs ban mchog gi thugs sras rnam bzhi dang*// dge mched bco lnga sogs la gsol ba 'debs// gsang ba'i bu gcig yon tan rgya mtsho dang*// ye shes rgya mtsho byang chub rnam pa gsum/ 114)/nam mkha' lde dang zhu ston zur chen rje// zur chung sher grags rnams la gsol ba 'debs// de yi sras bzhi skyo ston shāka ye dang*// gsang bdag shāka seng 'gar ston sreg ston pa// glan ban rdo rje 'od dang brtson 'grus seng*// glan ston bsod rgyal rnams la gsol ba 'debs// bud+dha shrī lha 'bum bsod nams mgon// sher dpal gzi ston shāka bzang bsam rdor mtshan// mdo dbang pad tshal rgyas mdzad 'od stong can// zur ston thams cad mkhyen la gsol ba 'debs// zur mo dge 'bum shākya bshes gnyen dang*/ mkhas grub chos 'bum dkon bzang rdor bzang rje// 'phags mchog bya btang mkhas grub rdor rgyal ba// g.yu 'brug rdo rje rnams la gsol ba 'debs// gangs can 'gro ba'i skyabs gcig sog zlog pa// mkhas grub kun gyi mchog gyur lo 115)tsā ba// smin grol nor bu'i phreng 'dzin rgyud par bcas// bdag sogs gus pa'i snying nas gsol 'debs// sbyang bya lus ngag yid dang shes bya'i sgrib// sbyong byed smin dbang zab don mngon gyur cing*// sbyang 'bras sku bzhi'i go 'phang mchog thob nas// 'gro ba kun kyang de 'dra'i sar 'god shog

'dus pa mdo dbang chen po'i bla brgyud kyi gsol 'debs nyung ngur sdom pa zhig dgos zhes/ rnal 'byor pa a dhi sha ka sogs kyis bskul ngor gnas chen chu bo g.yas 'khyil gyi yang dben du bkod pa'o// ༈ ston pa'i ston pa kun bzang thog ma'i mgon// lhun grub 'od gsal skur ston rdo rje sems// theg pa'i yang rtse ston mkhas dga' rab zhabs// sku gsum dbyer med mchog la gsol ba 'debs// 'jam dpal bshes gnyen dha na ta lo dang*// thu bo 116)rā dzā me tog gsal sgron ma// 'jog po byang chub ma dang sa ra ni// mkhan po rab snang rnams la gsol ba 'debs// bud+dha sa man ku ku rā dzā che// ma hā rā dzā sras mo go ma de// ā tsar a lo ke dang khyi rgyal phye// drang srong bha ṣi rnams la gsol ba 'debs// klu sgrub bdud rtsi ma dang mañdzu shrī// de ba rā dzā bud+dha kuṭ+ṭa'i mtshan// kun dga' mo dang shrī sing bai ro rje// bi ma mi tra { bai ro dang bi ma gnyis rgyud pa mthar chags min kyang snga 'gyur phyi 'gyur so so nasaganyags dzñā nar 'dus so/ }bcas la gsol ba 'debs// dzñā na ku mar sog po dpal ye shes// 'o bran sangs rgyas ye shes bar rgyud pa'i// rdzogs chen sems sde brgyud pa'i bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so rang byung ye shes ston// kun bzang rdor sems dga' rab 'jam dpal dang*/ dha na ta lo rā dza me tog gsal// klu rgyal 117)gnod sbyin pa ra ni rab snang*// bud+dha sa man rnams la gsol ba 'debs// khyi rgyal ma hā rā dza a lo ka /khyi rgyal phyi ma bud+dha kuṭ+ṭa dang*// 'jam dpal bzang po drang srong bha ṣi ta// gzungs ma bdud rtsi ma la gsol ba 'debs/ shan+ting ghar+bha klu sgrub shrī sing ha// kun dga' mo dang bi ma bai ro gnyis// rdzogs chen klong sde rgyud pa'i bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so ka dag klong grol stsol// kun bzang rdor sems dga' rab bde mchog {

rdzogs chen man ngag gi sde la rgyud lugs mi gcig pa mang kyang*/ 'di sdud pa bram ze'i skor gyi brgyud pa'o/ }snying*// shrī singha bi ma ting 'dzin bzang*// 'brom ston ye shes snying dang myang dbang phyug /yon tan mchog sogs rnams la gsol ba 'debs// skor thung rngog ston gtsug gzhon shākya dbang*// chu bo ri pa rdor 'od 'gos dge slong*/ 118)/shāka rgyal dpal bzang rdor rgyal bde legs pa// 'jam dbyangs bshes gnyen rnams la gsol ba 'debs// chos dpal bstan 'dzin bzang po rat+na gling*// tshe dbang grags sogs rgyud pa mu stig 'phreng*// rdzogs chen man ngag rgyud pa'i bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so rig pa gcer mthong ston// kun bzang zhi khri rdor 'chang rdo rje sems// gsang bdag dga' rab 'jam dpal shrī sing*// dzñā na sū tra bi ma myang ban dang*// ldang ma lhun rgyal rnams la gsol ba 'debs// lce btsun seng dbang zhang ston nyi ma 'bum// jo 'ber sangs rgyas dbon po me long rdor// rig 'dzin ku mar klong chen yang gsang rgyud// gsol ba 'debs so snang bzhi mthar phyin stsol// kun bzang rdor sems dga' rab 'jam dpal dang*// shrī sing dzñā na sū tra bi ma la// pad+ma 'byung gnas gnyags lo ku ma ra// slob ma dpal rgyal bcas 119)la gsol ba 'debs// klu yi dbang phyug klu yi rgyal mchan dang*// 'phags pa shes rab tshul rgyal zhang dzñā na// ye shes tshul khrims spa tshab stong grags dang*// byang chub snying por bcas la= /byang sgom rin bzang byang pa 'jam dpal dang*// shangs pa nag po glan ston rdo rje 'od// bsod rgyal dngos grub mngon dang shāka rgyal ba// dpal bzang rdor rgyal rnams la gsol= /bde legs pa dang 'jam dbyangs bshes gnyen dang*// chos dpal bsam gtan bzang po rat+na gling*// rdzogs chen spyi ti rgyud pa'i bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so kun bzang dgongs pa ston// gdod ma'i mgon po kun bzang rdo rje sems// dga' rab 'jam dpal shrī sing pad+ma 'byung*// dung mtsho ras sogs gter gyi rgyud pa dang*// gnyags dang {

'di yan rgyud pa mi gcig pa mang kyang*/ 'di nas gcig pa shas che'o/ yang ti bka' ma ltar na/ } 120)dpal chen brgyad la= /klu dbang klu rgyal sba klu 'brog mi dang*// zhang ston khams pa ye tshul spa tshab stong*// nags shod ye snying byang sgom rin chen bzang*// 'jam dpal shangs par bcas la= /sems klong man sngags yang zab spyi yang ti// rgyud pa'i chu bo kun 'dus chos kyi mdzod// glan ston rdor 'od gsol rgyal dngos grub mtshan// bsam 'phel dngos grub mgon la= /shāka rgyal dpal bzang rdo rje rgyal mtshan dang*// bde legs dpal dang 'jam dbyangs bshes gnyen mtshan// chos dpal rgyal mtshan chos rje bsam gtan bzang*// rig 'dzin rat+na gling la= /rgyal sras tshe dbang rje btsun ngag dbang grags// ngag dbang nor bu nor bu yongs grags rje// mtshungs med nor bu dbang rgyal tshul khrims mtshan// gzhan phan rdo rje'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// kun bzang rigs lnga sdud po rigs gsum mgon// lha klu 121)gnod sbyin srin po mi'i rig 'dzin// rgyal po dzang dang in+t+ra bū ti dang*// nā ga pu tri rnams la gsol ba 'debs// gu h+ya bo dhi khri rgyal ro langs bde// rdo rje bzhad pa mkhan po pra ha ti// shākya rnam gsum dha na rak+ṣi ta// s+thi ra ma ti rnams la gsol= /bde ba gsal mdzad dharmā bo dhi dang*// ba su dha ra sangs rgyas ye shes sogs// a nu yo ga rgyud pa'i bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so mchog gi dngos grub stsol// kun bzang rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas rigs gsum mgon// de las gdul bya so sor rim brgyud de// 'jam dpal grags ldan mchog skyong rin chen 'od// tshangs dang kun sgrol gtsug 'dzin brgya byin sogs// lha yi rig 'dzin 'bum la= /spyan ras gzigs dbang klu rgyal mgrin nag po// klu mo kha 'dul klu mo 'dul tshangs ma/ 122)/yid 'ong dga' ba'i klu dang klu'i rgyal po// 'jog po klu tshogs 'bum dang gsang bdag sogs// gnod sbyin rig 'dzin 'bum=

/rigs can drwa ma lnga dang rgyal po dzā// ku ku rā dzā in+t+ra bū ti dang*// sing ha rā dzā u pa go ma dhi// bud+dha kuṭ+ṭa me tri ka ma la// sangs rgyas gsang bar bcas= /rma ban rin chen mchog dang gtsug rin bzhon// gye re mchog skyong khyung po dbyig gi 'od// dar rje dpal grags rgyal ba'i yon tan dang*// sangs rgyas ye shes la sogs tan+t+ra sde// bco brgyad rgyud pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs// kun bzang rdor sems dga' rab 'jam dpal dang*// dha na ta lo gtsug lag dpal dge ba// khrag 'thung nag po ba su dha ra dang*// sangs rgyas ye shes 'jam dpal sku yi rgyud// gsol ba 'debs so sku yi dngos grub stsol// pad+ma dbang gi rgyal po he ru ka// nā gardzu na pad+ma thod phreng rtsal/ 123) /rgyal ba mchog dbyangs rma ban rin chen mchog /gtsug ru rin gzhon rnams la= /khyung po dbyig rdor dar rje dpal gyi grags// khyung po dbyig gi 'od dang zhang rgyal yon// bud+dha dzñā na pad+ma gsung gi rgyud// gsol ba 'debs so gsung gi dngos grub stsol// kun bzang rigs lnga rig gsum mgon po dang*// dga' rab shrī sing u pa rā dzā che// in+d+ra bhu ti ku ku ri pa dang*// rdo rje 'phreng ba'i 'od la gsol ba 'debs// rdo rje rnon po sha ra tshogs kyi dbang*// blo gros gzi brjid dud khrod bde ba dang*// kha che ku ku ri pa hūm̐ ka ra// pad 'byung bi ma gnyags dang sangs rgyas ye// yang dag thugs kyi rgyud pa'i bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs kyi dngos grub stsol// kun bzang rdor sems 'jam dbyangs rdo rje chos// tshang pa thor tshugs can dang tsa ra ka /tha skar nabs so skyes dang ljang sngon dang*// rkang thub brgyud 'dzin rnams 124)la gsol= /'gro skyob gshol ma 'dzin dang me bzhi 'jug /dzi na mi tra glu rgyal 'jog po dang*// dga' bo nyer dga' 'byung lnga'i lha mor bcas// rig 'dzin li tsa wi la=

/dga' rab 'jam dpal ku ku rā dzā che// u pa rā dzā o rgyan thor cog can// sing ha rā dzā in+t+ra bhu ti dang*// ma hā rā dzā rnams la= /nyin byed seng ge sangs rgyas gsang ba dang*// bi ma pad+ma 'byung gnas gnyags dzñā na// sog po 'o bran gnubs ban bdud rtsi'i rgyud// gsol ba 'debs so yon tan dngos grub stsol// kun bzang che mchog rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha// rigs lnga phyag rdor in+d+ra bhu ti dang*// pra chen hasti pad+ma sam bha wa// yum chen mtsho rgyal rnams la gsol ba 'debs// lce ston ku ku la byed lang lab dang*// sna nam stong tshab rgya ston ngab thung ba// 'gos ston rdor rgyal dar 125) seng yon rdo rje// 'dam ston grub pa rnams la= /dngos grub rgyal mtshan dngos grub mgon shāka rgyal// dpal bzang rdor rgyal dge legs 'jam dbyangs mtshan// chos dpal bsam gtan rat+na phur pa'i rgyud// gsol ba 'debs so phrin las dngos grub stsol// khyab bdag rdor 'chang zla gsang rin chen dang*// rigs lnga phyag rdor dam pa'i rigs can lnga// rgyal po dza dang u pa khyi rgyal che// s+thī ra ma ti nyi rdor bha hu ra// sangs rgyas gsang ba bi mā mi tra// dha na sam skṛ 'brog mi gnyags dzñā na// rin chen mchog dang gtsug tu gye re mchog /dar rje rgyal ba'i yon tan gnubs ban che// ma mo rbod gtong rgyud pa'i bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so bar chad bgegs tshogs bzlog /rgyal mchog rdor 'chang rigs lnga gsang ba'i bdag /rgyal po dza dang in+d+ra klu'i byang chub// gu h+ya 126)bo dhi ku ku ro lang sa bde// rdo rje bzhad pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs// pra chen hasti shākya seṅge dang*// dha na rak+ṣi s+thī ra ma ti'i mtshan// bde gsal dharma bo dhi zla ba mgon// dol sgang lce ston sogs la= /khang sar ba dang 'bum grags dngos grub rgyal// sras chung dge slong dngos grub mgon shāka rgyal// dpal bzang rdor rgyal bde legs bka' srung rgyud// gsol ba 'debs so bstan srung phrin las stsol// snga 'gyur rgyud sde du ma'i chu bo kun// ma lus gcig tu gzhol ba'i chos kyi mdzod/

rgyud 'bum bla rgyud la/ gtsang rgyud dang dbus rgyud gnyis ldan yod kyang*/ 'di man chad gtsang rgyud bzhin bkod pa yin // gnubs ban sangs rgyas ye shes rin po che// gsang bdag mi gzugs can la gsol= /yon tan rgya mtsho ye shes myang sher mchog /ye 'byung zur chen zur chung skyo ston dang*// gsang bdag 'gro mgon shāka rgyal lha rje 127)che// thang ston 'bum me rnams la= /bla skyabs lce ston sgrub 'bum dpal ye shes// mkhas btsun sangs rgyas ye bzang g.yung ston dang*// zur mo sras btsun shākya mi tra rje// sog po dpal ye rnams la= /kun bzang dpal ba bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang*// rnam grol bzang po chos kyi dbang po'i zhabs// karma chos skyong bkra shis lhun grub kyi// gzhan phan mchog gi rdor= /bstan pa'i snying po yo ga rnam gsum sogs// zab rgyas chos kyi rgya mtshos rang dang gzhan// smin grol lam gyi 'bras bu mngon gyur pa'i// byin rlabs mthu dpung bskyed cig bla ma'i tshogs// khams gsum 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ma stong bar// zab rgyas chos kyi bstan pa ma nub cing*// nyan 'chad sgom pa'i nyi ma 'bum shar bas// 'gro kun thar lam snang ba'i sgron mer shog/ ces 128) gsang sngags snga 'gyur gyi rgyud 'bum rin po che'i bla ma rgyud pa'i gsol 'debs 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes/ gtsang gi rnal 'byor pa skyabs mchog dpal gyis yang yang bskul mod kyang*/ rgyud sde re re'i bla rgyud kyang mi gcig pa mang ba'i phyir dang*/ rgyud 'bum spyi bsdoms nyid la'ang gtsang rgyud dbus rgyud so sor mchis pa'i dbang gis mtha' dag ni brjod par mi spobs shing*/ de dag la brgyud lugs re mdor bsdus te bkod pa'i dge bas zab chos 'di dag 'jig rten kun tu dar zhing rgyas pa'i cha rkyen du gyur cig// ༈ hrīḥ bde ba can gyi zhing mchog dam pa nas// bcom ldan rigags kyi bdag po snang mtha' yas// deng 'dir gsol ba 'debs pa'i bu rnams la// 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub tu bstsal tu gsol// ye shes lnga ldan thugs rje'i gzhal yas nas// longs spyod rdzogs sku rigs lnga tshe dpag med// deng 'dir gsol=

/'chi med tshe= /rnam dag pad+ma 'od kyi pho brang nas// tshe dbang grub mchog pad+ma 'chi med sku// deng 'dir= /'chi med= 129)/snyigs dus 'gro la phan bde stsol mkhas pa'i// 'dren mchog rig 'dzin hūm̐ nag me 'bar mtshan// deng 'dir= /'chi med= /rig stong rdzogs pa chen po'i yang dag don// ma nor ston mdzad pad+ma legs grub rtsal// deng 'dir= /'chi med= /dam chos tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i skyes bu rnams// long med 'chi bdag bdud kyi rab bcom pa'i// 'jigs chen 'di las thar te byang chub lam*/ myur du bgrod nas 'gro kun 'dren par shog ces pa 'di ni tshe sgrub gnam lcags rdo rje'i rgyud pa'i gsol 'debs nyung bsdus so/ ༈ khyab bdag rigs kyi bdag po 'od dpag med// 'gro la brtse ba'i bdag nyid spyan ras gzigs// gsol ba 'debs so bdag sogs gdul bya'i tshogs// skye med klong du grol bar byin gyis rlobs// gangs 130)can 'gro ba'i pha gcig srong btsan sgam// snang srid zil gnon rgyal ba pad+ma 'byung*/ gsol ba 'debs so dus mtha'i 'gro ba kun// zag med 'od skur grol bar byin gyis rlobs// rtsod ldan 'gro ba'i ded dpon las 'phro gling*// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rgyal ba rgya mtshor bcas// gsol ba 'debs so khams gsum sems can rnams// thugs rje'i zer gyis grol bar byin gyis rlobs// rtsa rgyud bla ma rab 'byams rgyal kun gyi// thugs rje gcig bsdus 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs// khyed kyi thugs rje nus pa'i nyi 'od kyis// sdug bsngal srid mtsho skems par da mdzod cig /nyon mongs las kyi rlung chen bzlog tu gsol// ma rig mun pa'i smag rum bsal du gsol// dngos grub phan bde'i char rgyun dbab tu gsol/ 'gro rnams bde chen zhing du khrid du gsol/ ces 'phags pa 131) thugs rje chen po ngan song rang grol gyi rgyud pa'i gsol 'debs so/

oṃ āḥhūm̐/ chags med 'gro la thugs rje chags pa'i mgon// spros dang bral yang rnam 'gyur spro mkhas pa// khyab bdag kun bzang snang ba mtha' yas kyis// bdag sogs byin gyis rlobs shig thugs rje can// zla bral thugs rje'i zla snang rab rgyas pas// 'gro blo'i mun sel 'gro mgon spyan ras gzigs// gdug pa 'dul mdzad gar gyi dbang phyug dpal// mchog thun dngos grub stsol zhig lhag pa'i lha// rgyal dang de sras thugs rje gcig bsdus pa// mkhyen dang brtse ba'i bdag nyid sprul pa'i sku// dpal ldan pad+ma thod phreng srid zhi'i dpal// mgon med bdag sogs skyobs shig 'gro ba'i mgon// bde stong ye shes stsol mdzad mtsho rgyal ma// gdos bcas 'od skur grol ba ting 'dzin bzang*// bdag sogs 132)'gro ba kun kyang khyed bzhin du// gnyis med klong du sgrol cig drin can gnyis// da dus dus ngan ngan spyod skye 'gro kun// thar lam lam bzang bzang por 'khrid mdzad rje// dus gsum gsum rig rig 'dzin 'ja' tshon snying*// skyabs mchog mchog dngos dngos grub dus 'dir stsol// skyabs gnas kun kyang rtsa ba'i bla ma'i skur// rang rig klong du dbyer med gnyis 'dzin bral// 'khrul pa'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i dpal// ye shes thugs rjes gzigs shig drin can rje// bla ma'i bla ma mchog gyur khyed rnams kyis// 'khor bar 'khor ba bdag sogs rjes bzung nas// thams cad thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang la// skad cig skad cig 'di la 'god du gsol/

ces pa rta phag yid bzhin nor bu'i rgyud pa'i gsol 'debs te/ de ltar le mtshan gong 'og 'di rnams ni/ lha 133) btsun phrin las gsang sngags kyi bskul ngor bkod pa'o// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ thabs shes bde stong me rlung 'du 'phro yis// bcud ldan zag med bdud rtsi'i rol mtsho bskyil// ngo mtshar rmad byung 'dod yon sna tshogs 'phro// rab 'byams rgyal ba ma lus mchod par bgyi// spros bral stong nyid ye shes snod mchog tu// zag med bde chen bdud rtsis yongs gang bas// dgongs brgyud bla ma rgyal ba'i tshogs mchod pas// rang rig rtogs pa mngon gyur dngos grub stsol// gsal mdangs ma 'gags lhun grub snod mchog tu// zhen med 'od gsal nyams kyi bdud rtsis gtams/ brda brgyud grub mchog rig 'dzin rnams mchod pas// snang srid 'od skur grol ba'i dngos grub stsol// cir snang dag pa rab 'byams snod nang du// gang shar rang grol 'dzin med bdud rtsis bkang*/ 134)/snyan brgyud bshad sgrub bla ma kun mchod pas// 'bad med yongs grol chen po'i dngos grub stsol// drin chen bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha// rtsa khams dag pa'i dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma// ma rungs mjoms mdzad dam can rgya mtsho la// zag med bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'di 'bul gyi// mchog thun dngos grub dus 'dir bstsal du gsol/ ces pa'i ja mchod 'di/ sbyangs pa mngon gyur gyi rnal 'byor shī la bha dras bskul ngor bris pa'o// ༈ lha bcas 'jig rten kun gyi mgon gcig pu// 'gro ba yongs la bde legs stsol ba'i pha// rje btsun mchog gi bla ma mtshungs med rje// snying nas gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes gzigs// mthong thos dran pa tsam gyi srid pa 'jil// thar pa'i lam mchog ston la ngal med pa'i// pha khyod snying rje'i gzigs pa mi g.yel bar// gsol 135)'debs bu la thugs kyi dgongs par mdzod// skye ba kun tu dpal ldan bla ma dang*// rtag tu mi 'bral theg chen zab mo'i don// mngon du gyur zhing don gnyis mthar phyin par// gsol btab 'bras bu 'grub par mdzad du gsol/

ces pa ni rje btsun bla ma mchog gi zhabs 'bring ba ni dhi pa te zhes pa'i bskul ngor bkod pa'o// ༈ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ mkha' mnyam 'gro kun bde chen la 'god phyir// bdag gi rgyal ba kus 'dus bla ma sgrub// rang nyid rigs 'dus rdo rje sems dpar gsal// spyi gtsug seng khri pad zla'i gdan gyi steng*// drin can bla ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku// mthing gsal rdo rje dril 'dzin skyil krung bzhugs// yum chen mdzes 'dzum dkar dmar gri thod 'khril// yab yum gnyis 136)ka dar dang rin chen rgyan// 'ja' 'od klong na gzi mdangs lam mer bzhugs// kun bzang rdor 'chang pad+ma 'byung gnas sogs// rnam 'gyur cha lugs ming tshul cir snang kun// dbyer med drin can bla ma'i rol par gcig /snang srid phyi nang dngos po lus longs spyod// mtha' dag gtan mdun bcas pa mchod par 'bul/ ༈ ma hā gu ru sarba sid+dhi hūm̐/ mtha' yas zhing du rnam 'phrul sna tshogs kyis// skye dgu'i skyabs mgon dpung gnyen gcig pu nyid// bdag sogs snang ngor rdo rje'i slob dpon tshul// ston mdzad drin can bla mar gsol ba 'debs// thog med dus nas las nyon shugs goms pas// mtha' med srid mtshor 'khyams pa'i gdul bya la// thog med myur 'gyogs thugs rje'i lcags kyu yis// mtha' med 'khor ba'i 'dam las myur du drongs/ 137)/dkon mchog bla ma rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs// gcig bsdus gzugs sku'i rol gar sprul mkhas khyod// bdag nyid dad pa'i ze'u 'bru mngon gsal rtser// byang chub bar du g.yo med brtan bzhugs gsol// las nyon dug chen nad las grol bar mdzod// bde chen ye shes snang ba rgyas par mdzod// bzod dka' 'khor ba'i mtsho chen skem par mdzod// khyab bdag sku bzhi'i dbang phyug myur thob mdzod// bla ma'i sku las byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i rgyun// cher babs tshangs bug nas zhugs lus kun khyab// dbang thob sgrib dag sku bzhi'i rten 'brel 'grigs// slar yang bla ma 'od zhu rang la thim// dus gsum 'gyu dran phra rag rtog tshogs kun// ma spangs mi 'brang sgom yengs med pa'i klong*// cir snang rang grol gshis kyi 'dug

138)tshul thog /mnyam yangs chen po bla ma'i rnal 'byor dngos// sgrib bral ji bzhin rtogs de'i dge 'bras kun// khams gsum ma rgan don du yongs su bsngo// zhes pa ni gus ldan shākya bstan 'dzin sogs kyi bskul ngor long yul pad+ma chos gling zhes bya ba'i gnas su bkod pa'o// phyogs bcu dus gsum rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi// thugs rje gcig bsdus dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin// drin can rje btsun bla ma chos kyi rje// bdag gi spyi gtsug dad brgya'i 'dabs stong dbus// 'bral ba med pa rtag tu bzhugs nas kyang*// dus 'di nas bzung byang chub mthar thug bar// byams chen thugs rjes bzung zhing byin rlabs nas// smin grol mchog gi dngos grub bskul du gsol// tshe rabs kun tu dpal ldan bla ma dang*// 'bral med theg chen chos la gus spyod cing*// rnam mang sprul pa rgya mtsho mtha' yas kyis// 'gro la phan pa dpag med 139)bsgrub par shog /phyogs bcu'i zhing gi rgyal ba sras bcas kyis// byang chub thugs bskyed 'gro phan gang mdzad pa'i// rlabs chen spyod pa'i phrin las ma lus kun// gcig bsdus mthu stobs bdag gis 'grub par shog /dpal ldan bla ma'i byin rlabs nus stobs dang*// rgyal ba sras bcas thugs rje rmad byung mthus// rnam dag smon lam bden tshig 'grub pa dang*// mchog gi dngos grub myur du thob par shog ces pa ni tshes ri rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo rnam par bkod pa nas/ karma chos nyid dpal bzang gis bskul ngor bris pa'o// ༈ na mo gu ru rat+na sarba sid+dhi hūm̐/ grangs med bskal mang gong nas sems bskyed cing*// 'gro la phan bde sgrub par dam bcas pa'i// smon lam 'bras mchog mngon gyur drin can rje// rtag par spyi bo'i rgyan du bzhugs su gsol// sngon tshe 140)rgyal ba'i zhabs 'bring kun dga' bo// gangs can blo mun sel mdzad thon ma'i zhabs// snga 'gyur bstan pa'i sgron me bai ro rje// mchog sprul zla med rnams la gsol ba 'debs// lnga rig mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan sa paṇa zhabs// mchog dngos bde blag grub pa'i khyung po ba// zab gter mnga' bdag mtshungs bral rdo rje gling*// 'gro ba'i 'dren mchog rnams la gsol ba 'debs// zhing khams kun nyul dpa' bo kun skyong gling*// snyigs dus gdul bya 'dren mkhas mchog ldan mgon// bstan pa'i srog shing bstan 'dzin rdo rje dpal// rnam 'dren mtshungs med rnams la gsol=

/da dus gdul dka'i skye ba mtha' yas rnams// phan bde'i lam la 'khrid phyir gang 'dul gzugs// sprul bsgyur zlos gar du mas 'gro 'dul ba// rtsa ba'i 141)bla ma mchog der gsol ba 'debs// dkyil 'khor kun bdag rdo rje'i slob dpon nyid// sangs rgyas kun bdag rdo rje'i slob dpon nyid// sangs rgyas kun las lhag pa'i mkhyen brtse can// mgon khyod bskal brgyar zhabs pad rab brtan zhing*// bdag sogs 'gro la smin grol dngos grub stsol/ ces pa yang dad ldan rig 'dzin dbang po'i mtshan can la'o// ༈ rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor rab 'byams kun gyi gtso// srid zhi'i khyab bdag dpal mgon bla ma mchog /spyi gtsug dad brgya'i ge sar snying po'i dbus// ji srid byang chub bar du rtag bzhugs gsol// bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro la brtser dgongs te// dbang bzhis rgyud smin gdams pa'i don gnyis 'grub// sku gsum dbyer med mchog la myur 'god pa'i// thugs rje'i phrin las rmad byung bstan du gsol// skye ba kun tu rdo rje slob dpon dang*// rtag par mi 'bral theg chen snying rje'i don/ 142)/mngon du gyur nas rnam 'phrul rgya mtsho yis// 'gro phan mtha' yas bdag gi 'grub gyur cig ces dge slong brtson 'grus chos 'phel grogs mched la'o// ༈ sangs rgyas kun 'dus dpal ldan bla ma mchog /bdag gi spyi gtsug dad pa'i pad mo'i dbus// 'bral ba med par rtag tu bzhugs nas kyang*// smin grol bdud rtsis bdag sogs rjes bzung gsol// mgon khyod sku tshe bskal brgyar zhabs brtan zhing*// zab rgyas chos 'khor rgyun chad med pa dang*// thugs rje'i phrin las rnam rol dpag med kyis// mkha' mnyam 'gro kun grol bar mdzad du gsol// skye ba kun tu dpal ldan bla ma dang*// 'bral med chos kyi thugs rjes rtag skyong zhing*// bla med byang chub snying po'i go 'phang la// myur du bgrod nas 'khor ba stongs par shog

ces bsod nams phun tshogs la gdams pa'o// ༈ na maḥgu ru sarba bud+dha bo dhi sa twa bhāḥ rgyal ba kun 143)gyi thugs rje'i mkha' dbyings las// ngo mtshar rmad du 'byung ba'i rin po che// 'dod dgu'i re ba skongs mdzad chos kyi rje// mchog gi dpal ldan bla mar gsol ba 'debs// bskal pa grangs med rgya mtsho ji srid du// skye sprul dpag med rgya mtsho du ma yis// gdul bya'i legs lam rgya mtsho snang mdzad pa// bka' drin 'khor med mchog la// 'gro ba'i rnam 'dren shākya'i zla zer gyis// legs smin dgra bcom 'phags mchog kun dga' bo// bstan pa'i ku mud phyogs mthar rgyas mdzad der// gsol ba 'debs so chos kun khong chud shog /spyan ras gzigs dbang srong btsan thugs rje'i mkhar// skyes mchog thon mi'i mkhyen rab rta bdun 'phyo// rig gnas dam chos tsha zer stong 'gyed par// gsol ba 'debs so 'gro blo'i mun sel shog /mdo sngags rgyu 'bras gsung rab 144)khang bzang tshogs// mdzes byed sgra bsgyur lha bran grangs med dbus// mkhyen brtse'i spyan stong bkra ba bai ro rje// gsol ba 'debs so shes bya kun mkhyen shog /rgyal ba kun yab pad 'byung thugs rje'i mtshor// ngo mtshar 'dod 'byung gter 'dzin ded dpon mchog /chos kyi 'byung gnas mtshungs bral rdo rje gling*// gsol ba 'debs so tshe gcig sangs rgyas shog /dga' ldan chos kyi pho brang sa skya'i gdung*// chos kyi spyan ldan byams mgon kun dga'i mtshan// gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇa chen bstan pa'i bdag /gsol ba 'debs so 'gro ba'i 'dren par shog /stug po bkod mtshungs shangs yul zhong zhong nas// skal ldan mchog dngos ster mdzad rdo rje 'chang*// thabs mkhas gang 'dul gzugs 'dzin khyung po ba// gsol ba 'debs so sgyu lus lhar 'grub shog /gu ru'i gter chos 145)rin chen gser gyi gling*// zab dgu'i bang mdzod 'dod 'byung dbang bskur ba// gdeng can mkha' 'gro'i gtso bo kun skyong gling*// gsol ba 'debs so mkha' spyod myur 'grub shog

/bod khams mtha' dmag gdug pas gtses pa las// yongs su skyobs mdzad gdul thabs sna tshogs kyis// 'gro ba skyabs mdzad rig 'dzin mchog ldan mgon// gsol ba 'debs so gdug pa thul bar shog /snyigs dus rtsod ldan tha ma'i dus nyid la'ang*// shākya'i bstan pa rma med spel mdzad pa'i// snga 'gyur snying po'i bstan 'dzin rdo rje dpal// gsol ba 'debs so rgyal bstan 'dzin par shog /sna tshogs 'gro ba'i mos khams bsam yas la// de dang mtshams pa'i gang 'dul phrin las kyis// byang chub bla med ster mkhas legs grub stsol// gsol ba 'debs so 'gro phan 'grub par shog /sngon rabs 146)dge 'bras dpag med legs bskrun cing*// rlabs chen byang chub spyod la ngal med pas// ngo mtshar skyes rabs 'phreng bar sprul mdzad der// gsol ba 'debs so 'bral med byin gyis rlobs// de ltar gsol ba btab las byung ba'i dges// bdag sogs 'di gzung tshe rab thams cad du// mnyam med bla ma mchog gi rjes bzung nas// rtag tu bstan 'gro'i don mchog 'grub par shog ces pa'i skyes rabs gsol 'debs 'di/ dge slong chos bstan 'dzin dpal bzang pos bskul ngor bkod pa'o// ༈ na mo gu ru/ rang nyid spyi gtsug seng khri pad zla'i steng*// drin can rje btsun rtsa ba'i bla ma ni// mdzes 'dzum mtshan dpe gzi 'od 'bar bzhugs pa'i// mtha' skor rgyud pa'i bla ma sprin ltar stibs// snang srid bdag lus longs spyod ma lus kun// mchod par bzhes la bdag sogs sems can rnams/ 147)/thugs rjes bzung nas 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las// myur du sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol// phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rgya mtsho mtha' yas kyi// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rab 'byams ma lus pa'i// thugs rje gcig bsdus dpal ldan bla ma zhes// grags pa rab dkar kun khyab der phyag 'tshal// zhing khams rgya mtshos rnam 'phrul dpag med kyis// 'gro re'i mdun du rdzu 'phrul bkod pa res// phan dang bde ba bla med ster ba'i bdag

/mtshungs bral rgyal ba mchog der gsol ba 'debs// gnas skabs 'dod don phra mo tsam la'ang*// ji ltar smon pa gegs med stsol byed na// gtan gyi bde ba bla med byang chub mchog /'dod la ci phyir khyod kyi sbyin mi mdzad// rnam rol bsam mi khyab pa'i zhing kun tu// mtshan dpe ngo mtshar du mas brgyan pa'i sku/ 148)/sna tshogs mdzad pa dus gsum dus med kun// rgyun chad med gang khyod kyis phrin las lags// dri med zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba// khyed zhal mtshungs yang nyes tshogs chu 'dzin gyis// sgrib min thugs rje kun khyab gter mchog gi /yon tan khyod mtshungs 'jig rten gsum na med// 'gags med tshangs dbyangs rdo rje chos kyi sgo// brgyad khri bzhi stong gang la gang 'dul gyis// 'gro la chos char 'bebs mdzad thams cad mkhyen// khyod kyi phrin las dus de 'di lags mod// zab yangs gsal stong dbyer med chos kyi sku// ye thog dang po'i sangs rgyas kun tu bzang*// de nyid mgon po khyed thugs gdod ma'i gshis// kho na nyid 'drar bdag kyang 'gyur bar mdzod// dpag med yon tan rin chen dbang gi rgyal// skal ldan 'dod dgur bsgyur ba'i dngos grub char// rtog med klong nas rgyun chad med phab pa'i/ 149)/mthu stobs mnga' khyod bdag la gzigs re ran/ rigs drug sems can nam mkhas gar khyabs su// bsam mi khyab pa'i phrin las sna tshogs pas// 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon dpung gnyen gcig pu ru// gyur khyod skal dman bdag 'dra 'dor phod dam// zhi bas dul dang rgyas pa dbang dang drag /gang ltar 'dod pa'i gdul bya'i yul de dang*// mchog tu mthun pa'i thugs rje yid bzhin ster// las kyi mnar ba bdag la stsal du gsol// 'khor ba thog ma med nas da bar du// ma rig 'thug po'i mun nang rtag 'thum zhing*// las ngan 'khrul pa'i sbubs su rab chud pa'i// sdug bsngal 'dam du tshud las bsgral du gsol// bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong dang byang chub sems// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong sogs// ming dang rnam 'gyur sna tshogs ci bstan kyang*// rgyal mchog

150)khyed kyi rol par bdag yid ches// ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje'i mkha' dbyings su// 'dus byas 'dus ma byas pa'i chos rnams kun// dbyer med bde ba chen por ro gcig pa// 'di ni mgon po khyed kyi rnam thar lags// zhi dang khro sogs snang tshul du ma dang*// gtso dang 'khor sogs rnam 'gyur sna tshogs kun// rigs bdag bla ma kho na'i rol gar du// gcig nyid de phyir gsol ba snying nas 'debs// skye ba 'di nas tshe rabs thams cad du// dpal ldan rnam 'dren mchog nyid rtag bsten cing*// ris med thugs rje'i nyi 'od sgrib bral gang*// bdag yid dad pa'i pad tshal smin mdzad gsol// bdag gi lus dang longs spyod gtan mdun bcas// rje btsun khyed la mchod par 'bul lags na// byang chub bla med snying po ma thob bar// brtse chen thugs rjes rtag tu bzung tu gsol// mtshungs 151)bral mchog la gsol ba btab pa'i mthus// sgo gsum sgrib dag dbang bzhis rgyud smin zhing*// rang gzhan don gnyis 'bad med lhun grub nas// 'gro kun thar pa'i lam la 'god byed shog

ces rtsa ba'i bla ma la bstod cing gsol ba gdab pa 'di ni/ kong yul gsang ba mchog gi sa'i thig le nas dad ldan lha dbang don 'grub la gdams pa'o// ༈ na maḥsarba bud+dha gu ru rat+na bh+yaḥ gzhig bral ye shes 'khor lo'i dbyings nyid du// mi 'gyur kun 'gro khyab pa'i gar gyi bdag /bsam yas gdul bya'i zhing mang de snyed du// sgrib bral mchog gi snang byed rnams la 'dud// rab 'byams rgyal ba'i thugs rje'i chu gter las// mngon byung ngo mtshar pad+ma'i ze 'bru rgyas// legs rgod byin rlabs sbrang rtsi'i 'byung gnas kyi// ge sar yid bzhin snying rje de la 'dud/ 152)/gzhal med thugs rje'i phyogs su lhung bral ba'i// rgyal ba'i nyi ma kun kyang btang snyoms su// mdzad 'dir mun sel sgron gcig karma pa// thugs rje'i cha shas yongs rdzogs de la 'dud// byang sems gru bor smon 'jug ba dan 'phyar// las 'phro'i rlung chen yang dag rab bskyod pas// zab gter nor gling bsgrod pa'i ded dpon mchog /'gro ba'i dbul ba sel ba de la 'dud// karma'i gdung rigs sā la'i ljon 'phreng dbus// mngon mtho nges legs yal 'dab khyon yangs pos// 'gro la phan bde'i grib bsil sbyin pa'i stobs// mi pham dge legs dpag bsam de la 'dud// dus ring thog ma med goms ma rig mun// thib pos rab ldongs 'gro la chos kyi sgron// sna tshogs rab sbar rang byung ye shes don// rang grol mngon sum ston mdzad de la 'dud/ 153)/kye ma ma rig 'khrul pa'i rgya mtsho cher// mi zad sdug bsngal shugs drag rba klong gi /dbang med bskyod pa'i gru bo kha lo gang*// thar pa'i phyogs su bsgyur dang drin can rnams// rtag tu blang dor la rmongs nyes spyad pa'i// rnam smin mi zad ha la'i stobs drag pos// byang chub snying srog gcod pa'i zug tu 'di// myur du zhi bar mdzod cig thugs rje can// phan bde'i grong khyer bsgrod lam rgyus kyi dben// ngan song 'khor mtshor las nyon gshed mas 'khrid// nyams len goms shugs chung mthus mi bzlog na// brtse bas gcig char skyob cig skyabs gnas rje// lhag bsam smon pa'i sa bon sngon bskrun kyang*// tshogs gnyis chu rgyun char gyis ma rlan zhing*// mi mthun tsha gdung gis skem myu gu la// byin rlabs chu rgyun phobs dang rje btsun

154)mgon// blang dang dor ba'i gnas la rab rmongs zhing*// srid dang zhi ba'i lam 'khyams pa'i bu// bdag 'dra da dung mtha' med 'khor dong 'dir// 'dor bar phod dam 'phags mchog dam pa'i tshogs// mkhyen pa'i dbyings nas brtse ba'i glog stong 'gyu// zab chos 'brug sgrog thugs rje'i sprin chen stibs// byin rlabs char chen dbab pa'i phrin las 'phrul// gang de mdzad pa'i dus ni 'di lags mod// thugs rje gzigs dang dpal ldan bla ma'i tshogs// byin gyis rlobs dang nus pa'i mnga' bdag rnams// rtag par skyobs shig re sa'i gnas rnams kyis// da lta nyid du smin grol dngos grub stsol// skye ba 'di dang skye gzhan thams cad du// rnam grol mgon po mchog gi rjes bzung te// phrin las nam mkha' ji srid gnas bar du// legs spyod rgyal ba kun dang dbyer med shog ces pa 'di ni/ rig pa 'dzin pa 155) tshar du dngar ba'i gdung las 'khrungs pa rgyal sras karma las grub kyi bskul bar mdzad pa la rten nas bris pa'o// na ma ma hā gu ru rat+na sarba sid+dhi hūm̐/ mchog tu mi 'gyur bde ba chen po'i bdag nyid rgyal ba skun bzhi'i ngo bo khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje'i slob dpon mtshungs bral skyabs kyi dam pa nyid/ bdag gi spyi gtsug bde chen rtse mo rnam par bkod pa'i yang thog tu mi 'gyur rin po che seng ge'i khri la 'bral ba med par bzhugs su gsol/ bzhugs nas kyang thugs rje brtse ba chen pos bdag gi lus dang longs spyod mtha' dag 'di phyi gtan gyi mdun ma dang bcas pa mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal du 'bul gyis bzhes nas/ sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi dngos grub ma lus pa dus 'di nyid du bstsal du gsol/ gu ru rat+na maṇ+ḍal la pū dza mai gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma 156)ye āḥhūm̐/ ༈ phyogs bcu rab 'byams kyi zhing khams// ma lus dbang bsgyur gyi gtso bo// rje btsun dpal ldan gyi bla ma// sku bzhi'i dbang phyug rang mkhyen no// mtha' bral ka dag gi klong las// 'gags med rang gsal gyi sku mchog

/gang 'dul sgyu 'phrul gyi gar mkhan// sku gsum dbyer med rang mkhyen no// rgyud lung man ngag gi rgya mtshor// smin grol theg brgyad kyi bang rim// mngon mtho nges legs kyi gzir 'bar// thugs rje'i lhun po rang mkhyen no// mkhyen pa lha lam gyi dbyings nas/ brtse chen thugs rje yi 'od kyis// gdul bya'i pad tshal rnams rgyas mdzad// bstan pa'i nyi ma rang mkhyen no// las ngan 'khor ba yi sems can// nyon mongs gcong nad kyis gzir la// phan bde'i sman mchog gis zhi mdzad// bde ba'i 'byung gnas rang mkhyen no// rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas gyi lam la// thar 'dod 157)rjes 'jug gi gdul bya// ma rig mun 'khyams la brtse mdzad// thar pa'i lam mkhan rang mkhyen no// tshogs gnyis bde chen gyi gling du// myur mgyogs thogs med du sgrol ba'i// ded dpon mnyam med kyi bla ma// srid zhi'i 'jigs skyobs rang mkhyen no// bla ma yid bzhin gyi nor bu// byin rlabs char chen rang phobs dang*// bla ma sman mchog gi rgyal po// 'khor ba'i gcong chen rang sol dang*// bla ma stobs ldan gyis dpa' bo// nyon mongs dpung chen rang bzlog dang*// bla ma ded dpon gyi dam pa// las ngan mtsho chen las sgrol dang*/ bla ma re sa yi gnyen cig /bla ma skyabs gnas kyi dam pa// bla ma kun rig gyi bdag po// bla ma rgyal kun gyi ngo bo// g.yel med thugs rje yi gzigs dang*// 'bral med byin gyis rang rlobs dang*// rtag tu rjes su rang gzungs dang*// re sa gzhan 158)na rang med do// dpal ldan bla ma dus gsum sangs rgyas mkhyen no// 'dren mchog rgyal po rje btsun bla ma mkhyen no// byin rlabs mtshungs med rtsa ba'i bla ma mkhyen no// bka' drin 'khor med bla ma dam pa mkhyen no// ༈ dpal ldan bla ma'i sku la gsol ba 'debs// lus la zag med bde chen bskyed du gsol// dpal ldan bla ma'i gsung la gsol ba 'debs// ngag la thogs med nus pa sbar du gsol// dpal ldan bla ma'i thugs la=

/sems la rtog med ye shes bskyed du gsol// sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyis rlabs nas kyang*// sgo gsum rdo rje gsum du 'gyur bar mdzod// gang 'dul sprul bsgyur cir yang ston mdzad pa// dpal ldan bla ma'i sku yi rnam thar lags// rnam thar de ni bdag kyang myur 'grub nas// gang 'dul sprul pas 'gro ba 'dren par shog /rnam mang gdul bya'i dpal du chos ston pa// dpal ldan bla ma'i gsung 159)gi rnam thar lags// rnam thar de ni= /chos sgo du mas 'gro ba smin byed shog /dran pa tsam gyi ye shes 'char mdzad pa// dpal ldan bla ma'i thugs kyi rnam thar lags// rnam thar de ni= /'gro la sangs rgyas lag bcangs ston par shog /gsol ba btab pas 'dod dgu 'byung ba yi// dpal ldan bla ma'i yon tan rnam thar lags// rnam thar de ni= /'gro la 'dod dgu'i char chen 'bebs par shog /spyi bor bsgoms pas bar chad kun zhi ba// dpal ldan bla ma'i phrin las rnam thar lags// rnam thar de ni= /'gro ba'i las nyon bar chad sel bar shog /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong sogs// rnam 'gyur mtshan grangs sna tshogs cir snang yang*// dbyer med bla ma'i ngo bor bdag yid ches// bla ma khyed rang lta bur bdag 'grub shog /mi mthun bar chad zhi bar byin gyis rlobs// chos mthun 'dod dgu 'byung 160)bar byin gyis= /tshe dang sgrub pa mnyam par= /rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub par= /tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ ces pa 'di ni skye ba du mar dam pa'i spyod pa la goms pa'i skyes mchog gsang sngags bstan 'dzin rdo rjes bskul bar mdzad pa'i ngor bkod pa'o// ༈ na mo gu ru/ srid dang zhi ba'i khyab bdag 'khor 'das kun gyi spyi dpal/ dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi gtso mchog sangs rgyas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo/ bka' drin 'khor med kyi rje btsun dran mchog rgyal po rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa nyid/

bdag gi spyi gtsug bde chen 'khor lo'i yang rtser/ sku mtshan dpe gzi rjid kyi phung po dpal du 'bar zhing*/ gsung grags stong tshangs dbyangs kyi chos sgra rgyun chad med pa/ thugs mi rtog mnyam nyid ye shes chen po'i klong nas thugs rje rgyun mi chad par gzigs te 'bral med rtag tu bzhugs su gsol zhing*/ bdag gi lus dang longs spyod 'khor 'das dus gsum gyi dge rtsa 161)mtha' dag gtan gyi mdun mar bcas pa mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal du 'bul gyis bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas 'di bzung byang chub kyi bar du brtse chen rgyun chad med pa'i thugs rjes skyob cing byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ e ma kye hoḥ dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi spyi gzugs// chags bral dam chos kyi 'byung gnas// rig grol dge 'dun gyi gtsug rgyan// dpal ldan bla ma rang mkhyen no// kun bzang skye med kyi dbyings nas// zhi khro 'gags med kyi dkyil 'khor// thams cad gcig bsdus kyi pad 'byung*// dbyer med rje btsun rang mkhyen no// thogs med byin rlabs kyi gter mdzod// 'dod dgu dngos grub kyi 'byung gnas// 'gro 'dul phrin las kyi mnga' bdag /mtshungs med chos rje rang mkhyen no// bdag 'dra las ngan gyi sems can// dug gsum nyon mongs kyi sdong po// 'khor ba'i gcong nad kyi nyam thag /'di 'dra 162)'dor ba ru phod dam// khams gsum 'khor ba'i brtson ra// ci byas sdug bsngal gyi 'khrul 'khor// thar med las ngan gyi rgya mtsho// 'di las da lta rang drongs dang*// ma rig 'khrul snang gi mun par// bdag 'dzin lcags sgrog gi 'ching bas// bcings 'di brtsan thabs su grol bar// mthu chen khyod kyis rang mdzod dang*// bde chen byang chub kyi lam la// bsgrod 'dod rgyal bstan la zhugs kyang*// zab don nyams len gyis dben pa'i// chos med bdag 'dra la gzigs dang*// rgyud lung man ngag gi chu bo// brtse bas rgyun ldan du phab kyang*// bdag blo bsra 'thas su lus pa'i// las ngan sems can la skyobs dang*// thog med da bar gyi 'khor bar// rdza mkhan 'phang lo ltar 'khyams pa// bdag 'dra brtse chen gyis skyabs nas// myur du smin grol rang mdzod cig

/e ma rgyal ba kun gtso bla ma rje// thugs rje nus 163)pa'i bdag khyod gang du bzhugs// bu yis gsol ba 'debs 'di dgongs mdzod la// byin rlabs thugs rje'i dpung chen skyod du gsol// khyed kyi thugs rje phyogs ris med na yang*// re ltos bcas pa'i bu la khyad par du// brtse bas mi dgongs yal bar 'dor mdzad na// thugs bskyed go cha chen po'ang cir 'gyur grags// des na las nyon phung po'i gdul bya bdag /snying nas gsol ba 'debs la nyer dgongs te// thugs rje rgyun chad med pa'i phrin las te// dus 'di kho na nyid du mdzod cig pha// las nyon sgrib tshogs dag par byin gyis rlobs// 'gal rkyen bar chad zhi bar= /ci bsam lhun gyis 'grub par= /mi tshe chos la 'dril bar= /rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub par= /khyod dang dbyer med gcig par= /tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'grub par= /gsol btab don ldan 'grub par= ces pa 'di yang 164) rig pa 'dzin pa karma las grub la'o// na mo gu ru/ mtha' yas zhing khams rgya mtsho dpag med na// sna tshogs phrin las 'dod ster rol pa can// rab 'byams rgyal ba sras bcas ma lus la// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// rig stong spros pa bral ba chos kyi sku// gsal mdangs 'gags med shar ba longs spyod rdzogs// rnam 'phrul cir yang ston mdzad sprul pa'i sku// gsol ba 'debs so= /bskal mang thog med dus nas thugs bskyed cing*// 'dod 'byung chos sgo grangs med 'gro la ston// rgya bod mkhas grub gsar snying skyes chen tshogs= /gsol ba= /gdul bya du ma'i mos blo sna tshogs par// 'dul byed cha lugs rnam 'gyur mtha' yas pas// dngos grub stsol mdzad yi dam lha tshogs la// gsol ba= /don dam chos dbyings skye ba med pa las// log rtog gdug pa 'dul bar skur sprul pa'i// bstan srung 165)chos skyong rgyal ba rgya mtsho la// gsol ba=

/rgyal ba sras bcas bla ma yi dam lha// mkha' 'gro dam can so sor snang ba kun// gcig bsdus dpal ldan bla ma rigs kyi bdag /gsol ba= /skyabs gnas rgyal ba sras bcas yi dam lha// rtsa rgyud bla ma mkha' 'gro chos skyong la// dad mos gdung bas gsol ba btab pa'i mthus// smin grol byin rlabs char chen dbab tu gsol// las ngan sdig sgrib ma lus byang ba dang*// nad gdon bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*// mthun rkyen bsam pa mtha' dag 'grub pa yi// byin rlabs dngos grub deng 'dir bstsal du gsol// nyon mongs 'khor ba'i 'dam las thar ba dang*// theg chen dam pa'i chos dang mjal ba dang*// mtshan ldan bla ma mchog gi rjes bzung ste// tshe gcig thar lam bsgrod par mdzad du gsol// rang don chos sku mngon du 'gyur ba dang*// gzhan don gzugs skus 'gro ba 166)ba 'dul ba dang*// phrin las thogs med phyogs bcur 'gyed pa yi// mchog gi dngos grub myur du bstsal du gsol/ ces pa ni mi dbang karma don 'grub la gdams pa'o// ༈ na maḥgu ru rat+na bh+yaḥ dpal ldan tshogs gnyis du ma'i rgya mtsho las// legs byung theg brgyad bang rim mngon mtho'i rtser// smin grol khang bzang dbang 'asgyur lha yi lha// mtshungs med bla ma mchog la gsol ba 'debs// grangs med sngon nas byang chub thugs bskyed cing*// smon lam rab dkar sa bon cher bskrun pas// phan bde'i sdong po byin rlabs lo 'bras phyug /'dod 'byung dpag bsam mchog la gsol= /thos bsam chu gter dbus su legs bsgrod cing*// rim gnyis zab mo'i nor bu len pa'i mthus// gdul bya'i dbul ba sems la mnga' brnyes pa// ded dpon dam pa mchog la gsol ba 'debs// rgyal ba kun 'dus dkyil 'khor kun gyis gtso// mnyam med bla ma 167)mchog la gsol btab pas// rang gzhan don gnyis lhun grub smin grol gyi// dngos grub ma lus myur du bstsal du gsol/

ces pa 'di ni dpal ldan bsam 'grub bde chen nas dge slong kun dga' snying po la'o// ༈ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ bde chen dbang drag rol pa'i pho brang nas// h+ya gṛ wa klu 'dul he ru ka /dus gsum rgyal ba 'dus pa'i bcom ldan 'das// gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol// chos sku stong nyid zhi ba'i dbyings chen las// longs sku gsal mdangs nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi// sprul sku 'od brgyas ma rig mun tshogs 'joms// gsol ba 'debs so nad gdon bar chad bzlog /byams chen ngang las khro bo 'bar ba'i gzugs// mthing nag zhal dkyil chu 'dzin 'khrigs pa las// spyan gsum glog stong bskal pa bsreg bzhin brjid// gsol ba 'debs so gdug 168)pa'i gdon tshogs 'thul// srid gsum za bar 'chas 'dra'i zhal gdangs shing*// kai la sha 'phreng dkrigs mtshungs mche dbal can// drag po'i skan sgras 'byung po'i snying srog gcod// gsol ba 'debs so bgegs dpung rdul du rlog /rab 'bar sma ra ag tshom me spungs dang*// gnam lcags ral pa srid rtser 'phyo ba las// khro tshogs rdo rje'i tshwa tshwa skar ltar 'phro// gsol ba 'debs dgra bgegs gzhob tu bsreg /lcags kyu 'bar bas dgra bgegs snying bzung nas// rno dbal ral gris gzugs phung dum bur btub// lcags kyi sdig pas gnod byed rngam zas byed// gsol ba 'debs so dgra bgegs tshar chod mdzod// ri rab lta bu brjid pa'i sku mchog gi /rngam pa'i zhal nas ha ha'i gad rgyangs sgrog /srid gsum g.yo 'khrugs 'thor ba'i 'jigs gzugs ston// gsol ba 'debs so las nyon srid rtsa gcod// thod skam rin chen rigs 169)lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*// phyag zhabs rin chen gdub skor g.yo ba'i 'od// khams gsum mun pa sel ba'i gzi mdangs can// gsol ba 'debs so ye shes snang ba stsol// bdud srin ma rungs bsgral ba'i mgo 'phreng tshogs// klad zhag khrag gis sbags rnams sbrul thag bcas// dpal chen sku la dpa' ba'i rtags 'chang ba// gsol ba 'debs so bstan pa'i rū dra sgrol// dar nag ber chen rdo rje'i gsang gos dang*// ko rlon g.yang gzhi stag sham sbrul chun brgyan// pad nyi klu gdon gdan la gar dgus rol// gsol ba 'debs so dbang dang dngos grub stsol// me dpung klong nas gtum chen khrag 'thung sku'i// sprul pa yang sprul grangs med 'khor tshogs bcas// rang bzhin dbyings nas 'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs// byang chub bar du 'bral ba med par mdzod// lus
170)dang longs spyod snang srid 'dod yon kun// khyed la mchod 'bul gus pas bstod bgyi na// dmigs med brtse ba chen pos nyer gzigs nas// khyed dang dbyer med gcig tu byin gyis rlobs/

ces dpal rta mgrin nā ga klu 'dul la sku mdog phyag mtshan cha lugs kyi sgo nas bstod cing gsol ba 'debs pa 'di yang*/ rig 'dzin karma las grub kyis bskul ngor bkod pa'o// ༈ āḥ.oṃ hūm̐/ ye thog dang po'i sangs rgyas bon gyi sku// kun bzang mchog dang dran pa nam mkha'i mtshan// tshe dbang rig 'dzin pad+ma mthong grol la// gsol ba 'debs so ka dag mngon gyur shog /bon dbyings klong nas thugs rje'i rnam 'phrul mchog /lo chen bai ro mkha' 'gro srid pa'i rgyal// zab gter mnga' bdag bon zhig g.yung drung gling*// gsol ba 'debs so ye shes rang gsal stsol// rang don mngon gyur gzhan don lhun grub pa'i// mtshungs med bsod blo g.yung drung 171)rgyal mtshan zhabs// rig pa rang shar bla ma gsas chen pa// gsol ba 'debs so 'gro don 'grub par shog /bla ma sras chung sbyin pa rgyal mtshan dang*// sngags 'chang khro gsal nam mkha' rgyal po'i mtshan// nam mkha' dbang ldan rig 'dzin lhun gyis grub// gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol// bstan pa 'od zer tshul khrims rin chen dang*// drin can rje btsun rtsa ba'i bla ma dang*// g.yung drung zab mo rgyud pa'i bla ma la// mi phyed dad pas snying nas gsol ba 'debs// de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs kyis// mi 'gyur bon gyi ngo bor byang chub cing*// stong gsal 'gags med g.yung drung thugs rje'i 'phrul// gshen rab sprul bsgyur du mas 'gro 'dren pa'i// phrin las rgyal ba kun dang dbyer med shog ces pa bon khrid zab mo sku gsum bcud 'dril gyi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs 'di 172) ni/ bla ma dam pa blo gros rgyal mtshan gyi thugs bzhed ltar bkod pa'o// na mo gu ru/ rang nyid tha mal mdun gyi nam mkha' ru// rin chen seng khri nyi zla pad+ma'i steng*// skyabs gnas dkon mchog rab 'byams rgyal ba'i tshogs// ma lus sprin phung 'khrigs bzhin bzhugs par gyur// bdag gi 'khor 'das dus gsum dge rtsa las// byung ba'i mchod tshogs rgya mtsho yongs 'bul zhing*// 'gal rkyen sgrib pa'i rigs rnams ci mchis pa// gnong 'gyod drag pos mthol bshags byang gyur cig

/bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro kun dus 'di nas// byang chub bar du bla ma kun tu bzang*// sprul 'khor bcas la snying nas skyabs su mchi// 'khor ba dong sprugs sku gsum mngon gyur shog /'gro khams ye sangs rgyas pa chos sku'i don// ma rig lhan skyes dri mas sbags pa las// rang grol ye shes mngon sum rtogs pa ru// bla med byang chub sems 173)mchog bskyed par bgyi// rang gi spyi gtsug dri med pad zla'i khrir// skad cig dran rdzogs dpal ldan rdo rje sems// stong gsal thugs kar hūm̐ la yig brgyas bskor// 'od 'phros bdag gzhan nyes tshogs kun dag gyur/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya= rdor sems 'od zhu rang dang dbyer med pa'i// spyi gtsug pad sdong khri 'phang brtsegs pa yi// 'ja' 'od gur nang rtsa ba'i bla ma nas// kun bzang 'od mi 'gyur ba man chad kyi// rgyud pa'i bla ma tshar dngar bzhugs rnams la// snang srid snod bcud 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i// brtan g.yo mtha' dag mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal du// rtag par 'bul gyis thugs rjes bzhes nas kyang*// lhan skyes ye shes mchog gi dngos grub stsol/ bar 'dir gsol 'debs rgyas bsdus ci rigs byas la/ de nas snying nas gsol ba btab pa'i 'thus// bla ma rnams kyi 174)sku las ye shes kyi// bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs bdag gi tshangs bug zhugs// bde chen 'khor lo'i rtsa 'dab so gnyis po// bdud rtsis gang bas lus kyi sgrib pa dag /bum dbang thob nas sprul sku'i rten 'brel 'grigs// longs spyod 'khor lo'i rtsa 'dab bcu drug gang*// gsang ba'i dbang thob longs sku'i rten 'brel 'grigs// chos kyi 'khor lo'i rtsa 'dab brgyad gang bas// sher ye'i dbang thob chos sku'i rten 'brel 'grigs// sprul 'khor rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi gang*// tshig dbang thob nas ngo bo nyid sku thob// slar yang bla brgyud gcig la gcig thim nas// kun 'dus 'dren mchog rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid// 'od du zhu nas bdag dang dbyer med thim// sgrib pa kun dag dbang rnams yongs rdzogs thob// drin can mtshon byed dpe yi bla ma dang*// rang rig mtshon bya don gyi bla ma dang*// gnyis

175)med rang grol chen po'i gnas lugs dang*// sgom med yengs bral chos kyi dbyings su phaṭaḥ /spros bcas spros pa med pa'i chos rnams kyi// yang snying bla ma bsgom zhing sgrub pa'i mthus// 'dus byas 'dus ma byas pa'i dge tshogs kun// gcig bsdus ma rgan 'gro ba yongs la bsngo/ zhes rdzogs pa chen po snying po gser gyi yang zhun gyi khrid kyi sngon 'gro'i rim pa 'ga' zhig gi gsol 'debs ngag 'don du byas chog pa 'di bzhin gyis zhes/ lha btsun karma gzhan phan bzang pos bskul ba la brten nas bkod pa // ༈ na mo bud+dhā ya/ srid gsum 'gran zla kun bral lha yi lha// chos dang 'phags pa'i dge 'dun 'byung gnas gtso// rgyal ba thub dbang 'gro mgon shākya'i sras// gsol ba 'debs so slab gsum mthar phyin stsol// shā ri'i bu dang gnas 176)brtan sgra gcan 'dzin// bram ze sgra gcan 'dzin dang klu sgrub zhabs// yon tan lhun grub rin chen bshes gnyen la// gsol ba 'debs so= /chos kyi bzang po yon tan rgya mtsho dang*// chos kyi 'phreng ba blo gros 'byung gnas sbas// paṇa chen shākya shri byang chub dpal// gsol= /dbang phyug grags pa gzhon nu byang chub dang*// gnas brtan yon rgyal yon tan blo gros zhabs// 'dul 'dzin seṅge dpal dang rab 'byor seng*// gsol= /chos grub seṅge mtshungs med dbyangs can bzang*// dkon mchog yan lag dbang phyug rdo rje'i zhabs// gtsug lag rgya mtsho rtsa ba'i bla ma rje// gsol= /bstan pa'i gzhi ma sde snod gsum gyi snying*// bslab gsum rin chen khang bzang dam pa ru// 'khrid mdzad rgyal ba sras dang brgyud par bcas// bdag sogs gus pa'i gsol ba snying nas 'debs// deng nas bzung ste skye ba thams cad du// rgyal bstan dri med la zhugs bshes gnyen mchog 177)/dam pas rjes bzung sdom gsum mthar phyin pas// rin chen bstan la bya ba byed par shog

/bag chags ngan goms nyon mongs rlung shugs kyis// mi bskyod rgyal sras mdzad spyod nyer zhugs te// tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab sbyangs yon kun// mngon gyur rnam mkhyen thob nas 'gro 'dren shog ces paṇa chen shākya shrī nas brgyud pa'i sdom rgyun deng sang grub mtha' phal mo che dang*/ khyad par rgyal ba yab sras brgyud pa'i mkhan brgyud rnams la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di bzhin dgos zhes/ lha btsun karma gzhan phan bzang pos bskul ba ltar bkod pa dge'o// ༈ na mo gu ru/ spyi gtsug dri med seng khri pad zla'i steng*// bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma'i sku// byin rlabs mtshan dpe gzi 'od rab 'bar ba// rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor kun 'dus bzhugs pa'i drung*// snang srid snod bcud bdag lus longs spyod kun// ltos med mchod 178)pa'i maṇ+ḍal nyid du 'bul// thugs rje bzhes la 'di bzung byang chub bar// 'bral med rtag tu byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ e ma hoḥ dus gsum rgyal ba'i sku mchog kun 'dus shing*// dam chos yid bzhin 'byung ba'i rin po che// 'phags mchog 'dus pa'i gtsug rgyan chos kyi rje// drin can rtsa ba'i bla mar gsol ba 'debs// rab 'byams phyogs bcu'i zhing khams ji snyed par// rmad byung mdzad pa phrin las dpag med pas// mtha' yas gdul bya 'dren pa'i rol gar can// bla ma yid bzhin 'dod 'byung gtsug gis mchod// bdag sogs dad ldan gdul bya rnams kyi phyir// bskal mang grangs med gong nas da bar du// dpag med thugs rje'i rnam 'phrul 'gyed mkhas pa// khyed kyis da dung bdag sogs skyabs tu gsol// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i 'gro ba bdag 'dra'i rigs// las dang nyon mongs bag chags tshan chas pas/ 179)/gting mtha' med pa 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor 'khyams// bla ma mkhyen pas gzigs la thugs rjes skyob// zhi dang rgyas pa dbang drag snang tshogs kyi// thugs rje'i phrin las sgo brgya phyes mdzod la// sdug bsngal 'khor ba'i 'dam chud bu rnams kyi// re sa gzhan na med do thugs rjes skyobs// byin rlabs thugs rje 'gran zla ma mchis pa'i// dpal ldan bla ma yid bzhin nor bu la// gsol ba btab pas dbang bzhi'i char phabs te// sku bzhi'i go 'phang tshe 'dir 'grub par shog

/bdag ni deng nas skye ba thams cad du// mnyam med bla ma mchog nyid ma gtogs pa// gsol 'debs skyabs yul gzhan na ma mchis pas// skyabs gnas mchog dang 'bral ba med par shog /dpal mgon bla mas rjes su bzung ba'i mthus// 'khor ba ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal mi myong zhing*// dal 'byor theg chen 180)rigs skyes smin grol lam// mthar phyin chos sku'i go 'phang mngon gyur shog /rang don brtsan sa zin nas gzhan don du// gang 'dul thugs rjes mtha' yas sprul pa'i skus// ma rgan mkha' khyab 'gro rnams thar lam la// legs 'khod mthong thos dran reg smin grol shog /de srid gar skye'i gnas skabs kun tu yang*// byang chub sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen kun zhi zhing*// bsam don chos dang mthun par 'grub pa sogs// smon lam gang btab gegs med 'byung bar shog ces pa 'di ni dad ldan chos mdzad tshe ring rgyal po la nyer par gdams pa'o// ༈ phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i rgyal ba ma lus kun// gcig tu bsdus nas 'gro ba 'dren pa'i sku// dpal ldan bla ma byin rlabs gter mdzod 'dzin// bdag gi spyi bo'i rgyan du 'bral med bzhugs// lus dang longs spyod dus gsum dge ba kun// zag med mchod pa'i 181)mchog tu 'bul lags na// thugs rjes gzigs nas bdag dang mkha' mnyam gyi// sems can sdug bsngal 'dam las drang du gsol// las nyon sdig sgrib ma lus dag par shog /chos mthun 'dod dgu ma lus 'byung bar shog /mchog thun dngos grub ma lus thob par shog /rang gzhan don kun thogs med 'grub par shog ces pa 'di mkhas btsun dpal bzang la gdams pa'o// ༈ na mo gu ru/ spyi gtsug thabs shes dri med pad zla'i steng*// sku drin 'khor med rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid// mtshan dpe'i gzi 'od dpal 'bar bzhugs pa la// snang srid bdag lus longs spyod mchod pa 'bul// deng nas bzung ste byang chub mthar thug bar// skyabs gnas snying po rje btsun bla ma mchog

/gus pas mchod cing rtse gcig gsol ba 'debs// yid bzhin nor bu bla ma mchog nyid dang*// 'bral 182)med thugs kyi dgongs pas nyer bzungs te// bar chad kun zhi 'dod dgu ma lus 'grub// tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'grub pa'i dngos grub stsol// bla ma'i sku gsung thugs las 'od 'phros pas// bdag la rab phogs sgrib tshogs ma lus dag /dbang dang dngos grub kun thob bla ma yang*// 'od du zhu ste rang la dbyer med thim// rang rig spros bral rdzogs pa chen po'i don// ma nor mngon gyur 'gro ba 'dren par shog ces pa ni gus ldan tshe dbang bstan 'phel la'o// na ma shrī ma hā gu ru rat+na mū la bh+yaḥ dpal dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas ma lus mi lus lus pa med pa'i dkyil lor mtha' dag yongs su rdzogs pa'i spyi dpal chen po rgyal ba sku bzhi'i bdag nyid dam pa phyogs bcu rab 'byams kyi zhing khams kun tu ngo mtshar sprul pa'i gar gyi sgyu 'phrul mngon par 'du mdzad pa'i nyid las khyad par rmad du byung ba'i thugs rjes snyigs ma'i tha ma 183)rtsod ldan rmu rgod kyi gdul bya bdag sogs nyon mngos gcong chen gyi gzir ba'i skye bo rnams 'dul phyir sangs rgyas mi gzugs rdo rje slob dpon gyi tshul du sprul pa'i rgyal ba nyid/ deng yang las ngan sgrib pas 'thums pa'i bu 'bangs bdag 'drar brtse chen rgyun chad med pa'i thugs rjes nye bar dgongs te/ spyi gtsug bde chen rtse mo rnam par bkod pa'i gnas su thabs shes nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la yongs su bzhugs shing*/ lus dang longs spyod gtan mdun dang bcas pa mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal du 'bul ba zag med rol pa chen por bzhes nas/ gdung shugs gus pa'i gsol 'debs smre ngag nga ro'i dbyangs 'di pha'i snyan du gsan te bu'i re ba bskong zhing dmigs med snying rje'i klong nas thugs rje byin rlabs kyi char chen da lta nyid du dbab par mdzad du gsol/

e ma/ pha gcig snying nas rang dran no drin can 184)gyi bla ma// nyam thag las ngan gyis mnar ba'i bu 'bangs la gzigs dang*// lhang lhang 'o dod kyi gdung dbyangs snyan dbang du gsan nam// pha khyed bu la rang brtse bas byin rlabs kyi char phob// ya gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams grangs med kyi bkod par// gang 'dul der snang gi dkyil 'khor ji snyed gcig mchis kyang*// bdag 'dra'i blo gtad kyi yul gyur pha mchog khyed kho nar// bsam zhing rtse gcig tu dran no dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas// ma gi khams gsum gyi 'khor ba gting med kyi rgya mtshor// thog med da bar du 'khyams shing yang srid du 'khor bas// da ni skyabs gnas kyi ltos sa gang na yang ma mchis// brtse bas g.yel med du gzigs dang dran mchog gi rgyal po// tshe gang gtan du rang 'bad kyang don med kyi bya byed// ci byas sdug bsngal gyi sgo thabs las nyon gyi 'phrul 'khor// dam chos byed 'dod kyi 185)ngang du mi tshe 'di stong zad// bdag 'drar rgyun ldan du skyobs dang thugs rje bdag nyid// khyed kyi thugs rje dang phrin las phyogs ris dang bral yang*// ci bya gtol med kyi bu nga las dbang du 'dor na// tshad med thugs bskyed kyi go cha don med du 'gyur grang*// stobs chen rdzu 'phrul gyi mthu ldan da dus la babs so// thugs rjes da lta rang gzigs dang mtshan ldan gyi bla ma// byin rlabs char rgyun rang phob gcig sangs rgyas kun gcig bsdus// las nyon bar chad las skyobs cig drin can gyi rje btsun// mchog thun dngos grub kun stsol cig yid bzhin gyi nor bu/ ces pa 'di yang dge slong dharma shwar la gdams pa // ༈ na mo gu ru/ mchog mi 'gyur bde chen gyi zhing khams nas/ dpal kun bzang yab yum la gsol ba 'debs// gdangs 'gags med 'od gsal gyi sgyu 'phrul sku/ 186)/dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la gsol=

/sku snang stong 'ja' lus kyi zlos gar can// dpal dga' rab rdo rje la= /lam grub pa mchog brnyes kyi rdzu 'phrul bdag /rje shrī sing ha la= /skyabs sangs rgyas kun 'dus kyi thugs rje can// rje pad 'byung yab yum= /chos zab dgu'i gter mdzod kyi rang dbang can// rje karma gling pa la= /thar lam gyi ded dpon dam pa mchog /sras nyi zla chos rje la= /don gnyis kyi 'bras bu cher smin pa// rje sūr+ya tsan+t+ra la= /theg chen gyi bstan pa'i srog shing 'dzin// rje nam mkha' rgya mtsho la= /byang sems kyi brtul shugs phan bde'i gter// rje kun dga' lhun grub la= /snyigs dus kyi 'gro mgon mthu stobs bdag /rje rig 'dzin yab sras= /phyogs med kyi 'gro don chos char 'beb// rje bsod nams rin chen= /gsang sngags kyi bstan srog 'dzin pa'i dpal// rje ngag gi dbang po= /sangs rgyas lag 187)bcangs su sprod mkhas pa// rje bsod nams dbang po la= /rje kun gyi thugs rje gcig bsdus pa// pha rtsa ba'i bla ma la= /rje yid bzhin nor bu tshar dngar ba// khyed rgyud pa'i bla ma thugs rje can// bdag gsol ba 'debs pa'i bu 'bangs la// deng byin gyis rlobs shig bla ma'i tshogs// kun gcig bsdus rtsa ba'i bla ma mchog /phyogs dus kyi sangs rgyas sras bcas dang*// lha yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong sogs// mtshan rnam 'gyur sprul tshogs cir bstan kyang*// don 'gyur med drin can khyod kyi 'phrul// bdag re sa gzhan na ma mchis pas// dus 'di nas mthar thug byang chub bar// mgon khyed kyi thugs rjes skyab tu gsol// bdag las ngan ma rig sgrib pas 'thum// don med kyi bya ba sna tshogs la// long med kyi mi tshe cher 'das shing*// nyon mongs kyi 'dam du rab bying bas// rang byung gi 188)rig pa chos sku'i don// ma rtogs pas 'khor bar 'khor zhing 'khyams// 'khrul snang gi rba la g.yeng ga yeng nas// bde chen gyi skam sar bsgrod dus med// thugs rje can gyis thugs rjes dang gzigs la// nyon mongs kyi 'khrul 'khor gzhom pa dang*// log rtog gi gcong chen zhi ba dang*// thar lam gyi zhing du 'khrid du gsol// rang sems sangs rgyas kyang ye shes che// bde chen lhan skyes kyi rang zhal de// da lta mngon sum du mthong nas kyang*// tshe gcig byang chub kyi dngos grub stsol// thugs rje can gyis gzigs shig rje btsun bla ma mchog

/byin rlabs char rgyun phob cig drin can rin po che// nyams rtogs ye shes stsol cig sangs rgyas mi gzugs can// mchog thun dngos grub stsol cig lha yi lha gcig pu// rang gzhan don gnyis lhun grub smin cing grol bar mdzod// rgyal ba kun 'dus dpal ldan bla ma mkhyen no// 189)

zhes brgya phrag la sogs ci rigs par mos gus drag pos gsol ba phur tshugs su btab pa'i mthar/ kā ya a bhi ṣīñtsa oṃ/ wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ sarba a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ lus la sku yi byin gyis rlobs// lus sprul pas gzhan don 'grub par shog /ngag la gsung gi byin gyis rlobs// ngag chos sgras 'gro ba smin par shog /yid la thugs kyi byin gyis rlobs// yid rang grol chos sku mngon 'gyur shog /pha bla ma'i sku gsung thugs ye shes// bdag sgo gsum dbyer med gcig gyur te// don spros med chos dbyings thugs rje'i klong*// mchog ngo bo nyid sku rtag 'grub shog /dpal ldan bla ma sgom zhing sgrub pa yi// dge ba 'di dang tshe rabs dge tshogs rnams// ma lus mkha' mnyam 'gro ba sangs rgyas lam// thob phyir bsngo ba smon lam kun 'grub shog 190) ces bar do thos grol gyi rgyud rim gsol 'debs dbang bzhi blangs ba dang bcas pa 'di ni rang gi rigs rgyud las byung ba mchog grub snying po la ched du gdams pa'o/ phyogs dus rgyal ba ma lus gcig bsdus pa'i// bla ma rigs bdag rgyal po thugs rje can// bdag sogs khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can la// g.yel med thugs rje chen pos gzigs su gsol// 'gal rkyen bar chad ma lus zhi ba dang*// mchog thun dngos grub myur du thob pa dang*// tshe dang sgrub pa mnyam ste rang gzhan don// myur 'grub rgyal ba khyed dang dbyer med shog ces pa ni dad 'byor ldan pa ting 'dzin dbang mo la'o// rgyal ba sku bzhi dbyer med pa'i// bla ma sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos// bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro ba la// dmigs med thugs rje chen po yi// dus dang rnam pa thams cad du// brtse bas byin rlabs char chen phob// bdag 'dra las ngan 'khor bar 'khyams// nyon mongs sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba/ 191)/'di la skyabs gzhan ma mchis pas// thugs rjes gzigs shig bla ma rje// byin gyis rlobs shig rgyal ba mchog

/tshe gcig sangs rgyas myur thob pa'i// dngos grub stsol cig sku drin can// gsol ba 'debs pa'i bu 'bangs la// rtag par rjes su bzung nas kyang*// mgon po khyed dang dbyer med shog ces pa 'di ni skal ldan tshul khrims dbang po la gdams pa'o// na maḥsarba bud+dha su sa gra ma hā gu ru rat+na bh+yaḥ gang gi thugs rje zla shel snying po ni// gus ldan rab dwangs mtsho mor rtag 'char ba'i// rmad byung bde ster rol pa'i 'od stong can// rje btsun sku bzhi'i dbang phyug spyi bos 'dud// smon lam rgya chen gdul bya'i dpal du bskrun// thugs rje tshad med skal ldan smin grol ster// phrin las mtha' yas byang chen lam 'khar rab// ngo mtshar 'byung gnas de la gsol ba 'debs// snying nas dran no bla ma sangs rgyas dran// thugs rjes 192)gzigs dang rgyal ba'i phrin las pa// gsol ba 'debs so g.yel med brtse bas skyongs// byin gyis rlobs shig las ngan sems can la// re sa gzhan med drin can chos kyi rje// 'dor bar 'phod dam snyigs dus gdul bya'i tshogs// sgrib med gzigs pa mnga' khyed gang na bzhugs// 'bral med mkhyen brtse'i phyag gis bzung du gsol/ oṃ/ sangs rgyas kun gyi 'gyur med dri bral sku// ma lus dpal ldan bla ma'i rdzu 'phrul bkod// kho na nyid du nges shes rtse gcig shar// bdag lus de bzhin nyid du dbyer med shog āḥ rgyal gsung rab 'byams chos sgo ji snyed kun// don gcig bla ma mchog gi gsung 'gags med// grags stong rdo rje'i sngags su lhun grub pa'i// dbyings su bdag gi ngag kyang dbyer med shog hūm̐/ chos sku khyab gdal rgyal ba'i thugs ye shes// gdod ma nyid nas rang rig gnas lugs don// ma bcos yang dag don 193)gyi bla ma'i ngang*// 'du 'bral med pa'i 'bras bu rtogs par shog hrīḥ snang grags ye nas bla ma'i dkyil 'khor dbyings// dran rig rang byung rang grol ye shes kyi// phyi nang gsang ba de nyid dbyer med klong*// bla ma sku bzhi 'bral med mngon gyur shog

ces pa ni dge bshes bstan 'dzin phun tshogs la'o// ༈ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ tshogs gnyis chu gter thugs rje'i rlabs phreng can// smon lam ye shes yon tan du mas gtams// gdul bya'i yid bzhin 'dod gter 'byung gnas che// rje btsun bla ma rgyal ba kun gyi dngos// mkhyen pa'i lha lam brtse chen 'od stong can// rmad byung phrin las nam mkha'i mthar khyab pas// 'gro ba'i las nyon mun chen sel mkhas gang*// bstan pa'i sgron me mchog der snying nas 'dud// gsol ba 'debs so bla ma 'gro ba'i mgon// thugs rjes gzigs dang las ngan sems can la// byin 194) gyis rlobs shig re sa'i skyabs gcig pu// 'bral med mkhyen brtse'i spyan gyis gzigs su gsol// bdag sogs 'di bzung byang chub mthar thug bar// skyabs mchog khyed gyi rtag par rjes bzung ste// las ngan 'khor ba'i mtsho las myur sgrol zhing*// rnam grol byang chub snying po mngon gyur shog /skye zhing skye bar dal 'byor dam chos ldan// bstan dang 'gro ba'i don la rtag brtson zhing*// rang gzhan smin grol thos bsam sgom mthar phyin// kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i go 'phang mchog thob shog ces pa 'di dad ldan karma mngon legs dang karma sgrub rgyud grogs mched gnyis la'o// ༈ na mo swa tsit+ta bud+dha ya/ srid zhi gtan sgrol mchog gi dam bca' dang*// smon lam thugs rje'i nyi 'od gsal 'bar bas// mkha' khyab 'gro la dge legs lam ston pa// rnam 'dren bla ma mchog zhabs 195)snying nas 'dud// dus gsum rtag tu 'gro phan ngal med pas// rnam 'phrul rgyun mi chad pa'i zlos gar ni// 'phags mchog kun dga' thon mi sam+bho ṭa// lo chen bai ro gter ston rdo rje gling*// 'jam dngos sa paṇa grub mchog khyung po zhabs// g.yang char sngon po kun skyong mchog ldan mgon// mtshungs bral bstan 'dzin rdo rje legs grub rtsal// la sogs srid pa ji srid gnas bar du// gang 'dul phrin las gter chen rol pa'i bdag

/mnyam med rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs khyed zhabs la// bdag sogs snying nas gus pas gsol ba 'debs// tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'grub pa'i dngos grub stsol/ ces pa 'di ni gtsang rong gi btsun pa su kha sid+dhi la'o// na mo ma hā gu ru gu ṇa sid+dhi hūm̐/ 'gro la phan bde'i spyan gyis skyong mdzad pa'i// bla ma rigs 'dus rgyal ba 196)sman gyi bla// snyigs dus 'gro ba 'dul slad sku sprul pa// mtshungs med bla ma mchog la gsol ba 'debs// bdag dang mkha' mnyam rigs drug skye 'gro rnams// 'khor ba me 'obs sdug bsngal brgyas gang ba'i// rab 'jigs khri mun chen por rtag chud pa// 'di las skyobs shig dpal ldan bla ma rje// snying nas dran no re sa'i skyabs gcig pu// brtse bas gzigs dang thugs rje'i bdag nyid khyod// byin gyis rlobs shig las ngan sems can la// khyed kyi phrin las bri gang med na yang*// bdag 'dra rmongs pa'i bu yis 'bod lags na// g.yel ba med par rjes su bzung nas kyang*// rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas sa la 'god du gsol// na mo/ bdag gis dpal ldan bla ma bsgrubs pa yis// dge ba 'di dang dge gzhan ci mchis mthus// mkha' mnyam pha ma 'gro ba ma lus kun// bdag gi 'dren 197)pa'i nus ldan nyid gyur cig /gang du skyes kyang dal 'byor dam chos dang*// rnam 'dren mchog brnyed dge legs phun tshogs don// rab 'grub rang gzhan phan bde sgrub la mkhas// 'gal rkyen bar chad med pa nyid gyur cig /yid la 'dod dgu'i dpal kun lhun grub nas// lha dang bla ma mnyes shing dam tshig ldan// mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba dbe la 'god// rgyal kun phrin las ma lus bdag 'grub shog ces pa 'di ni gso rig 'dzin pa sman bla tshe dbang la gdams pa'o// na mo ma hā gu ru bh+yaḥ rang gi spyi gtsug steng nyid du// rin chen khri dang pad zla'i khar// skyabs gnas rtsa ba'i bla ma de// slob dpon pad+ma'i cha byad tshul// zhal gcig phyag gnyis mdzes 'dzum can// phyag g.yas rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin// g.yon pa mnyam bzhag thod pa bsnams// mchan khung g.yon du kha ṭ+wāṃ dang*// dbu la

198)'dab ldan rigs lngas mtshan// na bza' zab ber phod ka dang*// chos gos 'od zer 'bar bas mnabs// zhabs gnyis rdo rje dkyil krung bzhugs// 'ja' 'od lnga ldan 'khyil ba'i sku'i// spyi bor oṃ dang mgrin par āḥ /thugs kar hūm̐ gi mtshan pa can// bdag sogs mos pa'i bu rnams la// 'bral med thugs rjes gzigs mdzad cing*// byin rlabs char chen 'bebs bzhugs gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐/ skyabs gnas bla ma bsgrubs pa yi// dge ba 'di dang tshe rabs kyi// dge kun gcig tu bsdoms pa'i mthus// bdag dang 'gro kun byang chub shog ces dad ldan bsod nams chos 'phel la'o// na mo gu ru/ chos kun gdod nas dag pa'i gnas lugs mchog /ye shes rang gsal mngon sum nor bu'i gter// 'gro khams mos pa rgya mtshor stsol mkhas pa// sna tshogs rang 199)grol zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// bskal mang du mar 'gro phan kho na'i thugs// mngon par byang chub mchog tu bskyed mdzad ltar// snyigs mtha'i 'gro ba sdug bsngal brgyas gzir kun// skyob phyir bskal brgyar g.yo med zhabs brtan gsol// bdag dang mkha' mnyam ma gyur sems can rnams// lhan skyes ma rig sgrib bral chos kyi sku// rang byung don gyi sangs rgyas mngon gyur pa'i// dngos grub mchog gnyis myur du 'grub par shog ces pa 'di ni rig 'dzin chen po kun rnam pa'i grwa pa rnams kyis bskul ngor bkod pa'o// ༈ na mo gu ru/ ka dag rig stong gi zhing khams// klong chen khyab gdal gyi bdag nyid// chos sku spros bral gyi bla ma// gsol ba snying nas rang 'debs so// ma bcos mtha' bral gyi thugs rje// 'du 'bral gnyis med du gzigs 200)dang*// rang gsal lhun grub kyi zhing khams// ye shes lnga rdzogs kyi dkyil 'khor// gsal mdangs longs sku yi bla ma// gsol ba snying nas rang 'debs so// rang mdangs 'gags med kyi thugs rjes// 'dzin med rang grol du gzigs dang*// rol rtsal sna tshogs kyi zhing khams// dag pa rab 'byams kyi pho brang*// rnam 'gyur sprul sku yi bla ma// gsol ba snying=

/gang 'dul der ston gyi thugs rjes// srid zhi gtan sgrol du gzigs dang*// dag snang phyogs med kyi zhing khams// phrin las rnam 'phrul gyi 'byung gnas// sku bzhi yongs rdzogs kyi bla ma// gsol ba= /dmigs med brtse chen gyi thugs rjes// las ngan bdag sogs la gzigs dang*/ e ma hoḥ dran pa tsam gyi 'khrul snang 'jigs pa// thugs rje nus ldan gyi bla ma mkhyen no// mthong thos tsam gyi dag snang 'char ba// 'brel tshad don ldan gyi bla ma mkhyen no/ bsgom pa tsam gyis nyams rtogs bskyed pa// sangs rgyas mngon 201) sum gyi bla ma mkhyen no// gsol ba btab pas byin rlabs 'byung ba// skyabs gnas gcig chog gi bla ma mkhyen no// drin can rje btsun khyed kyi thugs rje la phyogs ris med kyang*// bdag 'dra las ngan gyi 'gro la brtse bas gzigs nas// 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi mtsho las myur du bsgral nas// tshe gcig byang chub kyi lam la drang du gsol/ ces pa ni chos dbyings dpal mo la'o// ༈ na mo gu ru/ gdod nas bla ma mchog gi zhabs pad la// gus pas phyag 'tshal snying nas gsol ba 'debs// 'khor 'das dge tshogs mchod 'bul sdig pa bshags// mdzad phrin kun la yi rang chos 'khor bskul// bskal brgyar 'gro ba'i don du zhabs brtan gsol// bdag dang mkha' 202)mnyam 'gro ba thams cad la// rje btsun khyed kyi thugs rjes rab gzigs nas// byin rlabs bde chen ye shes dngos grub kyis// bdag rgyud smin cing grol bar mdzad du gsol// skye ba 'di nas tshe rabs kun tu yang*// dal 'byor dam chos ldan pa'i lus thob nas// bla ma bde chen ye shes dngos grub kyis// bla ma mchog bsten grub pa mthar phyin te// rang gzhan don gnyis yang dag 'grub par shog ces pa ni chos kyi dbang mo la'o/ ༈ phyogs dus rgyal dang rgyal sras thugs rje'i bdag /ma lus gcig bsdus 'gro ba'i 'dren pa mchog

/rab 'byams dkyil 'khor kun gtso drin can rje// bde chen 'khor lo'i rgyan du rtag bzhugs gsol// gling bzhi rin chen zhing khams bye brag brgya// bdag gzhan phung khams skye mched lus longs spyod// dran rig skye mched rang byung mchod par bcas// ma lus ltos med mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal du// 'bul gyi bdag 203)sogs mkha' khyab gdul bya'i tshogs// brtse chen rgyun chad med pa'i thugs rje yis// 'bral med nyer bzung byin rlabs ye shes mchog /don dam bde ba chen po'i dngos grub stsol// skyabs gnas bla ma mchog gi zhabs pad la// gus pas phyag 'tshal sgo gsum gtan mdun kun// nyer mchod nyams chags sgrib tshogs snying nas bshags// rmad byung rnam thar yi rangs theg chen gyi// chos 'khor bskor zhing bskal brgyar bzhugs gsol 'debs// 'dis mtshon 'khor 'das dus gsum dge tshogs kun// rnam mkhyen byang chub kho na'i rgyur bsngo ba'i// dge bas mkha' mnyam 'gro don kun 'grub shog /'di nas zung ste tshe rabs thams cad du// mnyam med bla ma mchog dang dbyer med pa'i// rnam 'phrul dpag yas phrin las rgya chen pos// bstan dang 'gro la phan bde'i mchog 'grub shog /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ma stongs de 204)srid du// 'gro la 'dod dgu'i phan bde stsol ba yi// dngos grub rgya mtsho'i mdzod dbang mthu stobs bdag /mtshungs bral rgyal ba khyed bzhin bdag 'grub shog ces pa 'di ni don gnyer mang pos yang yang bskul te/ zab chos dbang lung 'khrid sogs zhal phye ba'i skabs rnams su maṇ+ḍal yan lag bdun pa smon lam dang bcas pa thams cad tshang la mdor bsdus zhig tshogs 'don du bgyid rung ba dgos zhes zer pa rnams kyi ched du bkod nas spar du bsgrubs pa'o/ / ༈ chos sku 'dus ma byas pa'i mkha' klong nas// thugs rje 'gags med rol pa'i 'phro 'du shar// gang 'dul chu zla'i gar gyi 'gro ba 'dren// mtshungs bral drin can bla ma snying nas dran// spros dang bral yang sprul pa'i spro bsdu mkhan// skye ba med kyang skye 'chi'i snang tshul tsam// 'gro la bstan pa skyes chen rgyud mar byon// dpal ldan karma rig 'dzin rnam par rgyal// zhabs pad spyi bo'i rgyan du rtag bzhugs gsol// so thar byang sems gsang sngags

205)theg pa'i chos// mnga' dbang 'byor pa'i rig 'dzin grub tshogs kun// dgongs pa'i rtse mo gcig dril mnga' gsol ba'i// rje btsun mkhas mchog pad+ma legs grub rtsal// 'bral med rtag tu thugs rjes gzigs mdzad gsol// chos kun snying po'i mthar thug nges don gyi// zab bcud gter kha phyes pas gdul bya'i tshogs// bla med mchog gsang snying por bkod mdzad pa'i// 'dren mchog mtshungs med sna tshogs rang grol rtsal// khyed bzhin bdag sogs sku gsum mngon gyur mdzod// yid bzhin nor bu mnyam med bla ma la// dad dung gus pas dran cing gsol btab pas// bdag sogs 'gro ba kun kyang khyed zhabs drung*// myur du bla med byang chub reg par shog

ces pa 'di yang chos dbyings dpal mos bskul ngor bris pa'o// ༈ srid pa'i 'ching ba las grol kyang*// 'dam gyi pad+mo ji bzhin du/ srid pa nye bar 206)bzhes tshul gyis/ 'gro ba 'dul mdzad khyed phyag 'tshal// spros bral chos sku ro gcig pa'i// rnam par rol pa 'gags med kyis// gang la gang 'dul thugs rje'i gter// yid bzhin nor bu khyed phyag 'tshal// grangs med bskal par byang chub tu// thugs bskyed tshogs gnyis legs bskrun pa// phan bde'i lo 'dab phyogs bcur rgyas// 'dod 'byung dpag bsam khyed phyag 'tshal// 'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho ru// las nyon gcong chen gyis gdungs pa'i// 'gro la bde chen stsol mkhas pa// sman pa bla med khyed phyag 'tshal// skye ba mtha' dag 'gro ba'i mgon// kho nar mdzad phrin sna tshogs pa// rnam par 'phrul pa'i 'byung gnas mchog /thabs chen dpa' bo khyed phyag 'tshal// 'phags pa kun dga' sam+bho ṭa/ 207)/bai ro tsa na rdo rje gling*// khyung po rnal 'byor sa paṇa sogs// mkhas grub kun dngos khyed phyag 'tshal// snyigs ma'i 'gro ba 'dul dka'i skyabs// mchog ldan mgon po la sogs dang*// bstan 'dzin rdo rje dpal bzang po'i// skye ba rim rgyud khyed phyag 'tshal// slar yang thugs rjes nyer sprul pa'i// dpag yas phrin las mi zad pa'i// srid pa ji srid 'gro sgrol mdzad// chos kyi rgyal po khyed phyag 'tshal// bdag sogs las kyi mnar ba yi// skye 'gro ma lus rjes bzung ste// thar lam byang chub snying po'i sar// myur du 'khod par mdzad du gsol/ ces byang chub mtsho mo la'o// ༈ na mo/ skyabs gnas rgyal ba ma lus gcig bsdus pa'i// bla ma rigs bdag rgyal po he ru ka /dmigs med brtse chen thugs rje'i klong yangs nas// mchog dngos tshe 'dir 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// deng nas bla med byang chub ma thob par// chos 208)min bsam sbyor skad cig mi 'byung zhing*// yang dag snying po nges don mchog bsgrub pas// rang gzhan chos dbyings klong grol chen por shog
