ces pa ni rgyal sras rig 'dzin lhun grub kyi bzhed pa bskong phyir bris pa'o// ༈ phyogs dus rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs mchog /pad+ma thod phreng sprul pa'i dbyings// sna tshogs rang grol snying rje'i gter// nam mkha' 'jigs med yid bzhin nor// skyabs gnas thugs rje'i 'byung gnas rnams// 'di bzung rdzogs pa'i byang chub bar// 'bral med bde chen 'khor lo'i rgyan// snying nas gus pas gsol ba 'debs// dal 'byor stong zad mi 'gyur zhing*// zhen log nges 'byung drag po yis// tshe 'di chos kyi 'da' nus shing*// kun bzang dgongs pa mngon gyur shog ces dbon po nam mkha' lhun grub la'o// ༈ grangs med bskal pa'i gong nas thugs bskyed cing*// khams gsum 'gro ba 'dren phyir bsam bzhin du// ngo mtshar skyes rabs 'phreng bar legs brgyud 209)pa'i// rnam 'dren rim par byon la gsol ba 'debs// 'phags pa kun dga' thon mi sam+bho ṭa// lo chen bai ro gter ston rdo rje gling*// khyung po rnal 'byor sa paṇa kun skyong gling*// mchog ldan mgon po rnams la gsol ba 'debs// snyigs ma lnga bdo'i rmu rgod gdul bya la// thabs mkhas thugs rjes lam bzang ston mdzad pa// bstan 'dzin rdo rje mkhas mchog legs grub rtsal// gang 'dul der snang mchog la= /de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs kyis// rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs dpal ldan bla ma dang*// dbyer med mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo la// dbang 'byor phrin las rab 'byams mtha' yas kyi// bstan dang 'gro ba'i don chen 'grub par shog /ngo bo skye med chos kyi sku 'grub cing*// rang bzhin 'gags med gzugs sku'i dkyil 'khor rgyas// sna tshogs gang 'dul sprul sku'i rol rtsal ston// sku bzhi dbyer med ngo bo nyid 'grub shog ces pa ni gsang sngags rgyud sde rab 'byams 210) kyi thos pa 'dzin pa karma mdo sdes bskul ngor bkod pa'o//

༈ phyogs bcu gang ga'i klung gi bye snyed kyi// sangs rgyas ma lus gcig tu bsdus pa'i sku// skyabs mchog rje btsun bla ma rin po che// bdag yid dad brgyas 'dab stong dbus bzhugs gsol// deng nas bzung ste tshe rabs kun tu yang*// dal 'byor rin chen legs thob bstan la zhugs// dge ba'i bshes kyi rjes bzung sgrub la brtson// rang gzhan don gnyis mngon du 'gyur ba shog /bla ma yi dam rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor kun// gcig bsdus snying nas bsgom zhing gsol btab pas// don dam chos sku ye shes bla ma dngos// mchog 'grub mkha' mnyam 'gro ba 'dren par shog ces pa ni rnal 'byor pa 'ja' lus bstan 'dzin la'o// ༈ dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi spyi gzugs mchog /bla med bla ma pad+ma sam bha wa// rig 'dzin gtso bo mtshungs med 'ja' tshon snying*// gang 'dul der snang sna tshogs rang grol rtsal/ 211)/grub thob rgyal po nam mkha' 'jigs med zhabs// gsol ba snying nas 'debs so thugs rjes gzigs// 'jig rten sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'khor rab 'jig cing*// chos brgyad 'khor ba'i 'khor lo rgyun chad nas// mi med dben pa'i ri khrod 'grims nus pa'i// grub thob rgyud pa'i rnam par 'khyongs bar shog /rang rig gdod ma'i gnas lugs ji bzhin nyid// ma nor mngon sum rtogs pa chos kyi sku'i// gtan srid zin nas mkha' khyab 'gro ba la// theg mchog chos kyi dga' ston 'gyed par shog /de lta bu'i gsol ba snying thag pa nas btab cing*/ don dam pa rang gi rig pa byang chub kyi snying po thig le nyag cig stong gsal zung 'jug spros pa'i mtha' thams cad las 'das pa'i rang shes rig pa'i rgyal po nyid yang dag don gyi bla ma chos kyi sku yin pa la yin par shes pa'i bcos min gyi dad pa brtan po bzo med rang babs lhug pa bsgom med 212)yengs med gu yangs khyab gdal chen pos dus 'da' bar bya zhing*/

cir snang bla ma'i rol pa/ gang byung byin rlabs kyi rang bzhin/ ci byed bla ma'i zhabs tog smra brjod gsol 'debs kyi rang bzhin kho nar rtogs na/ dngos grub thob bya thob byed kyi mtshan 'dzin rang sar grol zhing*/ mtshon byed dpe'i bla ma'i sku drin gyi mtshams sbyar te/ mtshon bya don gyi bla ma sku bzhi dbyer med ngo bo nyid dang 'du 'bral med pa'i gtan srid zin pa'i thabs zab mo la rnam pa kun tu nyams su blang bar mdzad 'tshal/ ces skal ldan gyi rnal 'byor dad can kun bzang lhun grub 'od klong la gdams pa // ༈ chos dbyings khyab gdal ye shes snying po'i klong*// rang gsal rang rig 'dus ma byas pa'i gshis// ye thog gdod ma'i bla ma chos kyi sku// 'gags med gsal rigs longs sku mtshan dpe'i dpal// cir 'char snang srid rang grol sprul pa'i sku// shes rig 213)rgyal po sku bzhi dbyer med la// gnyis 'dzin mtshan ma bral bas gsol ba 'debs// bcos slad gza' gtad bral ba'i thugs rjes gzigs// re dogs dgag sgrub bral bar byin gyis rlobs// mtha' bral phyogs lhung med pa'i zhing khams su// bdag sogs mkha' khyab 'gro kun grol bar shog ces chos mdzad karma klong yangs la'o// ༈ na maḥgu ru bh+yaḥ rab 'byams rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor lhun rdzogs pa'i// dpal ldan pad+ma thod phreng he ru ka// srid zhi kun gyi khyab bdag rnam 'dren mchog /rtsa ba'i bla ma rje la gsol ba 'debs// phyogs bcu mtha' yas 'jig rten grangs med kyi// gdul bya'i khams dbang mos pa dang mtshungs pa'i// rnam 'phrul rgya mtsho 'gyed pa'i mthu stobs bdag /mtshungs med drin can bla mar gsol= /deng nas bzung ste byang chub mchis bar du/ 214)/dpal ldan bla ma'i thugs rje zab mo yi// nyer bzung theg mchog snying por rang byan tshud// tshe gcig byang chub dam pa thob par shog /rang don ka dag mngon du 'gyur bar shog

/gzhan don gzugs skus 'gro ba 'dren par shog /rnam 'phrul du mas 'khor ba stongs par shog /rje btsun khyed dang dbyer med gcig par shog ces snying thag pa nas gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab cing*/ mtshon byed dpe yi bla ma la kun rdzob tshig gi gsol ba btab pa de nyid kyang*/ don dam par ni rang sems kyi gsal cha'i bye brag tsam las ma 'das shing*/ rang rig sku gsum dbyer med lhun grub/ rang byung mtshon bya don gyi bla ma ye gdod ma nas rang dang lhan cig 'du 'bral med pa'i rang zhal mjal thabs ma bcos lhug pa'i gnas lugs la rang rig rang ngo shes tsam bskyangs na/ skad cig nyid la gdod ma'i mgon 215)po'i go 'phang thob bya thob byed las 'das pa'i gtan srid zin par the tshom med do/ ces pa ni dbu mdzad nam mkha' rgya mtsho la'o// ༈ dkyil 'khor ma lus kun gyi khyab bdag mchog /skyabs gnas rje btsun rdo rje 'dzin pa la// rab dad gus pas snying nas gsol ba 'debs// g.yel med thugs rjes rtag tu gzigs mdzod la// 'di nas bzung ste tshe rabs thams cad du// zab gsang rdo rje theg pa'i bdud rtsi yi// smin grol dga' ston rgyun chad med stsol zhing*// byams chen mkhyen brtse'i phyag gi bskyab tu gsol// dag pa rab 'byams rgyal ba'i zhing kun las// rmad byung bde chen pad+ma 'od kyi gnas// gang der rgyal ba khyed dang dbyer med pa'i// pad+ma 'byung gnas zhabs pad gtsug bsten shog /de zhabs spyi bor nyer bsten mthu stobs kyis// mchog dngos bde blag 'grub nas gang 'dul gyi// sprul 216) bsgyur chu zla ji bzhin rol pa'i gar// 'gro khams rgya mtshor 'gyed par nus 'grub shog ces pa 'di ni rnal 'byor pa dharma tsakra la'o// ༈ dpal ldan bla ma sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos// rnam 'phrul grangs med gdul bya'i dpal du shar// ngo mtshar sgyu 'phrul thugs rje'i 'byung gnas mchog

/sna tshogs rang grol snying nas dran no pha// thugs rjes gzigs dang rig 'dzin rnam par rgyal// byin gyis rlobs shig mkhas mchog legs grub rtsal// gdung bas gsol ba 'debs pa'i bu 'bangs la// brtse chen rgyud chad med par gzigs su gsol// mtshon byed dpe yi bla ma sprul pa'i sku// mtshon bya don gyi bla ma'i ngo bo dang*// gnyis med khyab bdal gdod ma'i gnas lugs ngang*// mngon sangs rgyas nas 'khor ba dong sprug shog ces pa ni mthong grol rgyal po la'o// ka dag gdod ma'i mgon po chos kyi sku// lhun grub gsal mdangs longs spyod rdzogs pa'i ngang*// dbyer med rang rig bla 217)ma sprul pa'i sku// gsol ba 'debs so smin grol dngos grub stsol// sku drin 'khor med rtsa ba'i bla ma dang*// sku gsum dbyer med rang sems sangs rgyas gnyis// don dam dbyings su 'du 'bral med pa'i ngang*// chos nyid yangs pa chen por grol bar shog ces gsol ba btab pa la 'das ma 'ongs da ltar gyi rtog pa gang shar la rjes phyir mi 'brangs/ gnyen pos ma bslad/ bzo bcos mi bya bar/ gang shar de ka'i ngo bo hrig ger/ rjen ne gu yangs cham mer nyams su blangs ba nyid dus dang rnam pa thams cad du ma yengs par bya'o/ zhes bya btang chos dbyings zag med la'o// ༈ na mo sras bcas rgyal ba ma lus gcig bsdus pa'i// bla ma yid bzhin nor bu rin po che// bdag snying dad brgyas ze 'bru rgyas pa'i dbus// 'gyur med rdo rje'i sku ru bzhugs su gsol// dpag tu med pa'i mkhyen brtse nus stobs kyi// ye shes 218)gzigs pa sgrib med rtag mnga' ba'i// thugs rje mi zad dngos grub mchog gi rgyun// bdag sogs 'dul bya'i tshogs la stsal re ran// skye ba 'di bzung bla med byang chub bar// mnyam med bla ma'i gdul byar bdag gyur te// rang gzhan don gnyis gegs med 'grub pa ru// gsol btab smon lam ji bzhin 'grub par shog

ces chos dbang ye shes la'o// ༈ sku drin mnyam med rje btsun bla ma// rgyal ba kun gyi spyi gzugs chen po// snyigs dus sems can bdag 'dra'i gdul byar// brtse ba chen pos thugs rjes gzigs dang*// snying nas 'bod do bla ma sangs rgyas// nyin mtshan rtag tu gdung ba'i dbyangs kyis// gsol ba 'debs pa'i bu la dgongs nas// byin rlabs dngos grub char rgyun phob dang*// rdo rje'i sku la skye 'chi med kyang*// dad ldan 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon mdzad phyir// bskal brgyar mi 'gyur rdo rje'i gdan la// brtan bzhugs chos kyi sgron me sbor dang*// bdag 219)lus longs spyod gtan 'dun thams cad// rje btsun khyod la mchod pa 'bul gyi// 'di bzung mthar thug byang chub bar du// skyabs mchog nyid kyi gdul byar shog cig ces dpal gyi rgod tshang gi gnas su'o// ༈ e ma/ dus gsum rgyal ba rab 'byams ma lus kun// chos dbyings ye shes dbyings su dbyer med kyang*// sna tshogs gdul bya so sor gang 'dul gyi// rnam 'phrul bsam yas 'gyed la gus phyag 'tshal/ 1 /'og min rdo rje'i mkha' dbyings chos sku'i zhing*// gdod ma'i sangs rgyas kun bzang rdo rje 'chang*// 'od gsal longs sku'i zhing du rigs lnga'i tshul// mngon par byang chub mchog la gsol= 2 /mi 'jed bye ba phrag brgyar sangs rgyas stong*// gsang sngags rgyud sde rab 'byams dkyil 'khor lha// ma dag 'gro blo'i snang ngo rigs mthun gzugs// kun dngos rtsa ba'i bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ 3 /rgyal kun don dam spros bral 'dus ma byas// mnyam rdzogs thig le 220)chen por ro gcig pa'i// thugs rje'i gong bu rje btsun bla ma mchog /snying nas gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje gzigs/ 4 /kye ma bdag sogs khams gsum 'gro ba'i tshogs// thog med bag chags ngan goms las nyon can// lhan skyes ma rig sgrib pas rtag 'thums pa'i// rmongs pa'i mun chen bsal bar mdzad du gsol/

5 /rtag tu bde ba don du gnyer na yang*// gtan bde byang chub sgrub thabs mi shes par// log min sdug bsngal rgyu thabs kho nar brtson// thar pa'i myu gu skem la thugs rjes gzigs/ 6 /phun tshogs dal 'byor dam pa thob gyur cing*// bstan dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'dzom dus 'dir// 'khor ba'i ru bzlog gtan srid mi zin par// don med mgo stong mkhan la thugs rjes gzigs/ 7 /skyes pa'i mtha' ma 'chi las 'das pa med// skad cig res song tshe la snon med 'phri// shi khar 'gyod tshe phan med 'dun ma thal// snyom las phyi shol 221)mkhan la thugs rjes gzigs/ 8 /de ring phan chad yengs 'phrul mi tshe 'das// yang yang phun tshogs 'di 'dra brnyed par dka'// dbang po tshang yang mdo don ma shes pa'i// ser gzugs snying po med la thugs rjes gzigs/ 9 /yid bzhin nor bu rnyed dus yal bar dor// nam zhig ngan 'gror lhung tshe 'gyod kyang phyis// mtha' med ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal dar re drag /las ngan rmongs pa'i 'gro la thugs rjes gzigs/ 10 kye ma hoḥ /snyigs ma rtsod ldan tha ma'i dus ngan 'dir// bstan pa nub rir phyogs shing skye 'gro kun// bde ba'i go skabs bral 'dir long med du// dam chos rtse gcig nus par byin gyis rlobs/ 11 /'khor ba'i mtshan nyid rang gi rig bzhin du// grogs ngan bdud kyis bslu phyir mi 'brangs shing*// skyid 'dod lto gos zhen pas bcing min par// chos phyir dka' spyad nus par byin gyis rlobs/ 12 /dgra gnyen chags sdang 'gran sems phrag dog 222)gi// rkyen tshogs du mas rang blo bdud kyis khyer// 'khor ba pa las dug lnga ches rags pa'i// nyon mongs dgra bo zhi bar byin gyis rlobs/ 13 /ngur smrig gos kyis klubs shing skye bo yis// bkur zhing dad zas la spyod dge sbyong du// brlom kyang chos brgyad mkhar so ma zhig pa'i// blo 'di las su rung bar byin gyis rlobs/

14 /thos bsam tshig la sbyangs kyang ne tso'i ngag /zab don sgom la zhugs kyang go yul tsam// rgyu 'bras rten 'brel shes kyang dred por shor// rang sems rang gi 'thul bar byin gyis rlobs/ 15 /bslab gsum sdom pa tshul chos dri mas sbags// gzhan don sems bskyed lo 'dod khong gcong can// rim gnyis ting 'dzin re dogs zeb rgyas bcings// chos brgyad dri ma bral bar byin gyis rlobs/ 16 /rang skyon ma rig ling thog 'thug po yis// pha rol gzhan gyi yon tan mi mthong bar// bskur 'debs log lta'i dug chen rab zhi nas/ 223)/dag snang phyogs med 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs/ 17 /rang la tshig zur cung zad mi bzod kyang*// gzhan la gnod 'tshe byed pa'i snying khams can// chos min bsam sbyor mtha' dag gtan spangs te// rgyal sras spyod la 'jug par byin gyis rlobs/ 18 /dkor zas me mdag 'dra la tshim med spyod// gnyid dang g.yeng ba phyogs la dus 'da' bzhin// sgrub pa byas zhes ngo sor sgrog byed pa'i// rang phung spyod dang bral bar byin gyis rlobs/ 19 /sangs rgyas dngos mtshungs bla mas thabs mang pos// lam zab sangs rgyas lag bcangs sprad na yang*// kha lta go dred mkhan gyis bu 'bangs la// nyams rtogs myu gu skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ 20 /kyi hud/ las nyon mang po bdag 'dra'i gdul bya la// mkhyen brtse nus ldan sangs rgyas bla ma rje// thugs rje rmad du byung ba'i mthu stobs can// myur ba nyid du bskyed par mdzad du gsol/ 224)21 /'di bzung rnam pa kun tu skyabs kyi mchog /dkon mchog kun 'dus bla ma rje btsan las// re ltos blo gtad gzhan na ma mchis pas// 'bral med thugs rje zhag pas bzung du gsol/ 22 /las ngan 'khrul pa'i rlung gi mi bskyod par// dam chos chig dril nus par byin gyis rlobs// bar chad ngan rkyen dbang du mi 'chor bar// tshe dang sgrub pa mnyam par byin gyis rlobs/
23 /khams gsum 'khor bar gtan 'khyam mi 'gyur zhing*// tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// rang don zhi bde sgrub pa ma yin par// mkha' mnyam pha ma 'gro drug sgrol bar shog

24 ces rang gi rang nyid la mi rtag pa'i bskul ma dang*/ skyon tshang ma lus pa drung nas phyungs te dam pa'i chos la nan gtan du bskul zhing*/ bla ma rje btsun mchog la gdung ba gsol ba 'debs pa dang bcas pa 'di ni/ dad can gyi skal ldan tshul khrims dbang pos bskul ngor bkod pa'o// ༈ bla na med pa'i skyabs mchog 225)rigs kyi bdag /mnyam med rje btsun bla ma sangs rgyas dngos// srid dang zhi ba'i khyabs bdag 'khor lo'i mgon// snying nas gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs// thugs rje phyogs med kun la khyab na yang*// las nyon phung po'i gdul bya bdag sogs la// gang du bzhugs kyang ye shes gzigs pa yis// g.yel ba med par rtag tu gzigs mdzad gsol// skye ba 'di nas tshe rabs thams cad du// rje btsun khyed kyi gdul byar gyur nas kyang*// dam chos zab don bdud rtsi'i char chen gyis// bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro ba smin grol shog ces mkhyen rab dbang phyug la'o// ༈ kye ma/ drin can bla ma dkon mchog rin po che// snying nas 'bod do re sa'i skyabs gnas rnams// mkhyen pas gzigs dang las ngan sems can la// thugs rjes bzungs shig myur du byin gyis rlobs/ kye ma/ mi lus thob cing dbang po tshang ba dang*// chos dang mjal zhing 226)bla ma mchog rnyed kyang*// da dung yengs ma lam la mi tshe skyel// brtson 'grus chos la nus par byin gyi rlobs// zas gos 'jig rten ched du 'bad pa rem// dam chos gtan 'dun don la phyi shol che// go zhing rig pa'i ngang nas snyom las can// blo sems las su rung bar byin gyis rlobs// sdig dang don med las la bsun pa med// sgrub dang dge sbyor phyogs la spro nus zhan// gnyid dang rnam g.yeng long gtam la goms pa'i// bag chags chos la 'byung bar= /grogs ngan bdud kyi bslu phyir 'breng ba dang*// las ngan mi dge ngan goms che ba dang*// ltar snang tshe 'di'i bya ba bsgrub pa sogs// cis kyang 'byung ba med par=

/do nub tsam yang mi 'chi'i blo gtad med// kha bshad tshig gi chos kyi dgos dus bslu// sang bya gnang byar mi tshe mi zad par// long med sgrub la brtson par= /rang skyon nyon mongs me spung 'bar ba yi// rang rgyud bsregs pa'i thal bas gzhan 227)sun 'byin// da dung gzhan skyon rtog pa'i blo nyes po// dag snang gting nas 'byongs par= /thog med da lta'i bar du yang nas yang*// chos med 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor 'khyams lags kyi// da ni dam chos snying nas bsgrub nus shing*// byang chub lam sna zin par= /dal 'byor snying po lon pa= /'chi ba snying nas dran par= /cis kyang dgos med shes par= /dag snang mos gus skye bar= /chos dang rang rgyud 'dre bar= /snying rje byang sems 'byongs par= /dka' spyad chos phyir nus par= /sgrub la bar chad med par= /nyams rtogs mtha' ru phyin par= /ngar 'dzin zhen 'dod zad par= /don gnyis lhun grub 'byung bar= /tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ ces pa 'di mchog grub snying po la'o// ༈ sgrib bral ye shes mchog gi gzigs pa ni// rtag par g.yel ba med pa'i skyabs mchog rje// khams gsum 228)zla med rgyal ba 'ja' tshon snying*// snying nas gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes gzigs// don dam skye 'chi'i mtshan ma mi mnga' yang*// ltar snang gzugs sku'i nyi ma dbyings nub na// 'khor ba'i mun 'khyams ltos bcas bu 'bangs rnams// lam ston ye shes sgron me su la re// chos nyid bde chen dag pa'i dgongs klong nas// 'gags med mkhyen brtse'i rol ba'i thugs rje'i 'phrul// rmad byung phrin las sgo brgya phyes mdzod la// bdag sogs mkha' khyab gdul bya drangs tu gsol/ ces rig 'dzin chen po de nyid dgongs pa chos kyi dbyings su sim pa'i tshe gdung bas gsol ba btab pa'o// ༈ e ma hoḥ snang srid gzugs kyi snang ba ji snyed pa// ma lus dpal ldan bla ma'i sgyu 'phrul skur// gdod nas lhun gyi grub pa'i ye shes kyi// sprul sku'i zhing khams rab 'byams dbang bsgyur shog

/sna tshogs sgra skad bsam 'das ji snyed kyang*// bla ma longs sku'i 'gags med gsung rdo rjer// rgyun chad med pa'i chos 229)sgrar legs rtogs nas// gang 'dul chos char 'gro la 'bebs par shog /bdag gzhan yid kyi dran bsam 'du 'phro'i tshogs// mtha' dag bla ma chos sku'i dbyings gcig par// thig le nyag gcig klong du yongs grol ste// sku gsum dbyer med mngon du 'gyur bar shog ces rang gi bu mo nor bzang chos kyis dbang mos bskul ngor bkod pa'o// ༈ na mo ma hā gu ru rat+na pā da mū le/ de yang srid dang zhi ba 'khor ba myang 'das la sogs rnam grangs kyi gdags gzhi bsam las 'das pa'i rol pa ma lus pa'i khyab bdag 'khor lo'i dbang phyug ni dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje'i slob dpon zhes grags pa'i bdag nyid kho nar mdo rgyud man ngag mkhas grub mtha' dag mgrin gcig pa nyid du zad cing*/ de la mchod dang bstod bsgom bgyis na rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor ma lus pa la mchod sgrub bgyis par 'gyur ba nyid dang*/ rdo rje slob dpon gang de yang phyogs bcu rab 'byams kyi zhing khams so sor ni 230)gang la gang gis 'dul ba'i sku dang rnam 'gyur brjod las 'das pa dang*/ phrin las kyi 'phrul bkod blo'i rwa ba las brgal ba'i chos can yin pa'i phyir/ mtshan dang gdul byed kyi ldog par ni zhing khams la lar sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku zhes mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul ston par gnang ba dang*/ la lar longs spyod rdzogs sku kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan gyi tshul du ston pa dang*/ de bzhin du lha rnams la lha dang*/ lha ma yin rnams la lha min dang*/ byol song rnams la ni byol song gi dbang po'i tshul dang*/ yi dwags rnams la de dang dmyal ba la de'i bdag po'i bkod pa'i zol gyis 'dul ba dang*/ mi rnams la mi'i gzugs kyi snang brnyan ston pa de/ don dam par ni spro bsdu'i dmigs mtshan gyis dben pa'i chos nyid kyi klong las 'gags med rang byung gi rol rtsal cir yang snang tshe/

des na bsam gyi mi khyab pa'i chos nyid kyi don dran par bya yi/ bdag gi 'dren pa 'di ni mi'o/ zag pa 231)dang ma bral ba'o/ kun nas nyon mongs pa'i shun pa dang bcas pa nyid do/ ces yid kyi lam du bcang bar gyur na lhan skyes ye shes mchog gi chos kyi sku'i don la bsgrib par 'gyur bas/ gzugs sgra sems kyi ri mo gang ltar snang yang rang nyid kyi mthong ba dag dang ma dag gi rkyen tshul kho na nyid du nges par shes par byas la/ bla ma sangs rgyas chos kyi sku ye nas ji bzhin pa'i gnas lugs kyi gdeng tshad blo'i mthil phur du bcangs te/ rtag pa rgyun gyi 'khor lor rang gi phung khams skye mched thams cad rigs brgya rigs lnga'i rang bzhin ye gdod ma nas yin par nges pa nyid kyi bde chen 'khor lo'i yang rtse'am/ chos kyi 'khor lo'i gzhal yas su/ dpal ldan bla ma yid bzhin nor bu nyid kyi sku'i snang brnyan bzo bcos mtshan rtog gis ma bsgyur ma bslad par/ stong gsal zung 'jug gi rang rig dang gnyis su ma yin/ gnyis su byar med pa'i dran rig 'dzin med 232)rang bab rang shar rang grol chen por la bzlo pa'i ngang nas/ shugs 'byung mgrin pa'i rdza rnga lhung lhung gi dbyangs su 'di ltar bsgrags par bya'o/ e ma kye hoḥ pha gcig dran no de dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dran// pha gcig dran no de rje btsun gyi bla ma dran// snying nas 'bod do de gdung dbyangs kyi 'o dod 'bod// gsol ba 'debs so de thugs rje yi spyan gyis gzigs/ 1 /gnas ya gi shod bde chen gyi 'og min na// pha rgyal ba mchog drin can gyi bla ma rje// sku snang stong ni 'ja' 'od kyi dkyil 'khor rgyas// gsung zab snyan gyi chos dbyangs de lha se lhangs/ 2 /thugs mkhyen brtse dang ye shes kyi klong yangs nas// bu dad ldan dang mkha' mnyam gyi gdul bya la// dus rgyun ldan du brtse chen gyi gzigs pa de// rje mtshan ldan gyi rnam thar gcig ma lags sam/

3 /khyed sgrib bral gyi spyan ras phyogs bcu yi// gnas ma lus kun lham mer gzigs mnga' na// bdag dus ngan du skyes pa'i bu 'bangs 'di// gtan mtha' med du 'khor 233)bar mnar 'jug gam/ 4 /las ngan goms 'phrul zhen gyi bag chags dang*// rkyen blo bur 'gal mthun gyi gzeb rgya sogs// lam bla med byang chub kyi bar chad tshogs/ 'di zhi bar byin gyis shig mi rlobs sam// lus nyam thag nyon mongs kyi mal nang na// sems 'khrul 'khor gcong chen gyis zin pa'i shugs// ngag 'o dod smre ngag gi gdung dbyangs sgra// pha rje btsun dbang med du dran pas 'bod/ 6 /tshe mi rtag 'chi nges kyi lhag ma ni// lo zla zhag 'ga' zhig gnas ring 'dir// las 'khrul 'byams chos min dang snyom las dgra// bzlog nges par dam chos shig sgrub byin rlobs/ 7 /gtan mdun ma'i yang rtse tshe gcig 'dir// lam sgrub pa snying po chig dril du// 'bad nus la bar chad mi 'byung bar// 'bras mngon gyur chos skur grol bar mdzod/ 8 /mchog thun mongs dngos grub kyi gter mdzod mchog /sku gang 'dul der ston 234)gyi rdzu 'phrul dang*// thugs mnyam nyid ye shes kyi zlos gar sogs// pha khyed dang tshul mthun gyis 'gro sgrol shog 9 ༈ e ma hoḥ mkhyen dang brtse dang mdzad pa'i phrin las la// tshad med rgyal ba kun las lhag pa'i rje// gang gi yon tan bskal brgyar rdo rje'i lce// 'bum phrag du mas brjod par su zhig spobs/ 10 /las nyon 'khor ba'i chu srin gyi 'byung gnas cher// las dbang btsan pos rab 'phyan bdag sogs 'gro// log rtog rlung drag shugs chen gyis bskyod pa'i// log lam srin gling las skyobs lha yi lha/ 11 /dal 'byor dal khom ldan pa'i grur brten nas// bla med bla ma mchog gsungs yid bzhin nor// rab blangs rab zhi don gnyer skye bo dag /skyabs bral skyabs kyi mchog khyed snying nas dran/

12 /sna tshogs las la thog med da lta bar// sna tshogs spyad kyang don med sdug bsngal lus// sna tshogs blangs la da ni yid rab skyo// sna tshogs rang grol 235)pha des gzigs re ran/ 13 srid pa'i ngang tshul tshul min yid byed la// rtag par rab zhen zhen pas rang nyid bcings// 'dus byas mi rtag rtag tu re bas phung*// thugs rjes myur gzigs gzigs pa dri med mchog 14 /mchog tu dag pa'i sku dang tshangs dbyangs gsung*// gsung rab snying po'i bcud ldan 'dod 'jo'i dpal// dpal ldan mtshungs bral khyed thugs ji bzhin du// du ma'i chos kun rang byan tshud par shog 15 /rab dad dad dang dang ba'i yid rtse gcig /gcig 'di 'di nyid nyid las gzhan pa yi// yi dam dam chos chos kun rje btsun khyed// khyed las las gzhan gzhan du bdag mi sems/ 16 /skye ba 'di bzung mthar thug byang chub kyi// go 'phang mngon du ma gyur de srid du// skyabs gnas rgyal ba'i khyab bdag bla ma khyed// bdag snying dad rgya'i ze'u 'brur dbyer med shog 17 /rab 'byams phyogs mtha' btugs pa'i zhing*/ 236)/rnam par yongs dag dkyil 'khor bkod// grangs med de snyed rgyal ba khyed// 'gro 'dul rnam 'phrul ma lags sam/ 18 /gang gi rmad byung thugs rje las// bri gang phyogs su lhung ba'i mtha'// mi mnga' de slad rmongs pa'i 'gro// nyam thag bu nga cis mi gzigs/ 19 /'gro re'i mdun du gang 'dul gyi// sprul bkod de snyed ston pa'i phyir// bdag dang bdag 'dra'i gdul skal du// mgon khyod mngon du 'gyur lags so/ 20 /ma rig lhan skyes rang sgrib kyis// rang la gdod nas sgrib pa'i mun// bsal mkhas thugs rje'i snang byed khyed// bdag gi dpal du shar bar gyur/ 21 /bsnyel dang g.yel ba'i skyon tshogs ni// nam yang thugs rje la mi mnga'// de phyir rtag par rgyun 'khor mor// dad ldan bu la gzigs su gsol/

22 /byin rlabs mi zad chu rlung la// gus ldan skye 'gro ji snyed pas// spyad kyang rgyun chad gtan bral ba// bdag gi rgyud la dbab par mdzod/ 23 /bdag dang 'gro ba'i las nyon khams zab 237)mo// ji srid de bar mgon khyed tshad med kyi// snying rje'i zlos gar bsgyur ba mi dman pas// sdug bsngal 'khor mtsho che las bsgral du gsol/ 24 /bla ma sangs rgyas byang sems yi dam lha// mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtshor btags pa'i mtshan// sna tshogs 'chang ba'i mgon gcig drin can rje// khyed kyi go 'phang myur du 'grub gyur cig 25 /mkha' khyab 'gro 'di bdag gi pha dang ma// kho na las gzhan min kyang bdag nyid kyis// sgrol ba'i nus med de phyir sangs rgyas mchog /gang khyed bdag dang 'gro kun grol bar mdzod/ ༈ kyai/ rje btsun dam pa dpal ldan bla ma rgyal ba ma lus gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bor gyur pa'i bdag nyid chen po mkhyen brtse nus pa phul du byung ba'i skyabs gnas kyi rgyal po mchog gi zhabs la snying nas skyabs su mchi'o/ thugs rjes gzigs su gsol/ byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ lam sna drang tu gsol/ bar chad 238)bsal tu gsol/ rje nyid dang gnyis su med par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ de ltar gsol ba btab pas bla ma'i sku 'od du zhu nas rang la dbyer med thim/ kun rdzob gzugs sku'i bla ma sprul pa'i sku// don dam rang rig chos sku'i dbyings su 'dres/ 27 /'dres dang ma 'dres blo yi btags pa las// gdod nas gnyis med rang babs gshis kyi ngang*// sgrib tshogs 'khrul pa'i bag chags rang bzhin dag /bskur thob mtshan bcas dbang gi brdzun phug rdib/ 28 /sku bzhi'i ngo bor ye nas lhun gyis grub// rtog med gzhan don rtsod bral shugs las 'byung*// dus gsum dus med bla ma'i rnal 'byor che// mthar thug don gyis snying po e ma hoḥ 29 /de don ma rtogs 'khrul pa'i sems can kun// rang snang log pa'i las lam rgyun chad cing*// bde chen 'du 'bral med pa'i mkha' dbyings su// 'gyur med don gyi bla ma mchog 'grub shog

30 ces pa'i gsol 'debs 'di ni sprul pa'i sku mchog rnam rol chos 239) kyi rgyal mtshan pas bskul bar mdzad pa'i ngor bkod pa'o// ༈ na mo gu ru/ bde chen 'khor lo don gyi 'og min na// rgyud pa kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid// sangs rgyas kun las lhag pa'i thugs rje can// mtshan dpe'i gzi 'bar 'ja' 'od sku ru bzhugs// bdag dang 'gro ba'i lus srog longs spyod kun// ltos med mchod par 'bul gyi bzhes nas kyang*// tshad med thugs rje myur mgyogs lcags kyu yis// sdug bsngal nyam thag bu 'bangs drangs su gsol// tshe 'di'i snang ba rmi lam lta bu nub// bzlog med 'chi bdag zhags pa dam pos bcings// rab 'jigs bar do'i 'phrang chen 'grim kha 'dir// thugs rjes myur du gzigs dang bla ma rje// longs spyod gnyen 'dun gces pa'i lus dang bcas// phan med shul du bzhag nas rang rig 'di// dbang med 'khrul snang rlung gis mi skyod par// lam mchog 'pho ba'i zab don mngon gyur shog /bslu byed tshe 'di'i zhen 'dzin bral 240)ba dang*// log lam 'khrul pa'i bag chags mi 'char bar// gsal stong 'dzin med rig pa rjen pa 'di// rje btsun bla ma'i thugs dang dbyer med par// chos dbyings skye med klong du grol bar shog

ces pa 'di 'pho ba'i rigs gang la yang gsol 'debs zur gsal mi 'dug pas 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes rnal 'byor tshul khrims bzang pos bskul ngor bkod pa'o// ༈ rang sems bla ma gdod ma'i chos sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ ma ha sa twa tsit+ta di dharma kā ya gu ru bh+yaḥ gang gi thugs rje'i gzings mchog ni// nges par chung min khyon ldan pas// 'jigs rung chu srin 'byung gnas rlabs// sgrol mdzad ded dpon bla ma mchod// mkhyen brtse stong gi bkra ba'i 'dren byed ni// gang la mnga' des ma rgan nyams nga'i g.yang*// mthar 'phyan bag chags stug po'i skra shad can// skyobs nus de la su yi phyag 'os min// de las rnam 'dren thugs rje'i gzi 'bar baiḍūr+ya/ ldog med mos pa'i mgo skyes nags kyi rtser yang dag /rab 241)mtho'i rgyal mtshan mngon gsal tog tu legs bkod pas// srid gsum nyin dang mtshan snang 'phos pa'ang 'phrog 'di mtshar// e ma gdod nas ye dag rang rig gi /gshis la bcos bsgyur dben kyang rol rtsal gyi// 'du byed phung khams lhag pa'i lha'i dkyil 'khor// lhun grub ye shes lnga gdangs rab gsal 'bar// phyi dang nang ngam bar dang bla 'og ces// kun btags blo snang lto 'gro'i mdud pa brgya// bkrol med rang sar shig gi grol ba'i ngor// 'gags med cir snang sgyu ma'i sgyu 'phrul gar// don gyi 'og min bde chen 'khor lo'i zhing*// rab gsal shel gyi gur khang ga bur dri// bzang ldan mu tig ge sar 'phreng mdzes stong*// gti mug chos dbyings bud+dha gu ru'o// ro 'dus tsakra pad+ma rā ga yi// skyed tshal thun mtshams 'od la rgol pa'i zhing*// gang dbus 'dod chags sor rtogs ye shes su// lhun grub ngo mtshar pad+ma gu rur shar// dran pa rnam bkod 242)dharma tsakra zhes// mthon kha chen po 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang*// mdzes ldan zhe sdang me long ye shes kyi// rnam 'gyur badz+ra gu rur rang bzhin grub// skyed byed sprul 'khor gser gyi sa gzhi ni// mun pa 'phrog nus 'dab yangs 'bum brdal ba'i// dbus der nga rgyal mnyam nyid ye shes nyid// rat+na gu ru sku yi lhun por brjid// rab bde myong byed lha yi dga' tshal ni// margat+ta yi nags ljongs rab yangs par// rtag tu yang dag rol ba bla ma'i sku// phrag dog bya grub karma gu ru'o// kun nas kun tu 'du 'bral yongs dben pa'i// rtsa khams rlung thig sna tshogs grangs yas kyi// bkod pa ma lus bla ma'i sgyu 'phrul la// yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gror grags te mtshar// a la la ho snang srid rig rtsal nyid// gcig dang du mar 'dzin pa'i smig rgyu la// zhen min sku gsum bla ma'i chu gter dang*// mi 'bral skal mchog gdeng can dbang por gyur// bzod ma nyid nas rang rig bla ma dngos/

243)/ngo bo chos sku rang bzhin longs spyod rdzogs// rnam rol sprul sku don la dbyer med pa'i// ye shes rdo rje ye grol gshis kyi ngang*// bskyed dang bstim dang bsgrub dang bsdu ba sogs// sna tshogs byis pa brid byed spros pa'i chos// mtha' dag mnyam nyid chen por la zlos pa'i// chos nyid dbyings la dus gsum 'pho 'gyur bral// bag chags g.yo ba'i sprin tshogs lang long gi /cho 'phrul rang byung rang thim rang grol la// bcos bsgyur dgag sgrub mi dgos dag pa'i mkha'// gdod nas yangs pa chen por lhun grub nyid// 'dod lnga tshogs drug yul snang sgyu 'phrul rmi lam gyi// rgyal srid gang la zhen dang spong dgags gnas bsgyur sogs// blo yi bye brag du ma'i rang ngor theg pa'i rim// ma lus bden dang bden min 'dzin rtog skabs 'dir min// rang rig tha dad bla ma yang ni gzhan pa dang*// byin rlabs re ltos 'bras bu thob byar 'dzin pa sogs// thun mongs gdul ngor spros tshogs shing rta'i 244)'khor lo brgya// bskyod pa'i rtsol bas thang la bgrod kyi chu bor min// gzhi nyid nas la 'bras bu'ang der// grub mod 'on kyang rten 'brel thabs// myug sogs khyad du gsod min par// kun shong nam mkha'i blo ldan gces// ka ye rmongs pa bdag lta'i tshig /mu cor smras 'di rgyal mchog dngos// nyid kyi spyan sngar brim bzod pa// ci mchis 'on kyang nongs kun bshags// gsang don yang dag gnad snying po// cha tsam 'dir bkod dge ba'i zla// dmar phyogs kyis dben 'gro blo yi// ye shes ku muta rgyas byed shog ces bla ma'i rnal 'byor zab don snying por gyur pa gang zag blo rab kyi gdul ngo dang mthun cing snyan ngag gis brgyan pa zhig dgos zhes/ sku rin po ches bka' bstsal pa bzhin bkod nas phul ba dge// ༈ na ma dharma kā ya sam+bho kā ya nirma kā ya shas+t+ra dā sha ya/

ngo bo ka dag spros bral chos kyi sku// rang bzhin lhun grub gsal mdangs longs spyod rdzogs// thugs rje kun khyab gang 'dul sprul pa'i sku// dbyer med rang rig bla 245)mar rtogs pas 'dud// chos sku'i gnas ni bsam 'das chos dbyings zhing*// ston pa gdod nas rang rig kun tu bzang*// rang gsal ye shes rgya mtsho'i 'khor tshogs la// brjod med ma bcos cog bzhag chos 'khor che// dus bzhi 'pho 'gyur med par bskor ba las// kun rdzob 'dus byas phun tshogs lnga ldan gyi// ming dang mtshan mas dben pa'i chos nyid klong*// don de 'gro ba kun gyis rtogs gyur cig /chos sku'i ngang las ye shes rang gsal gyi// gnas ni rang snang stug po bkod pa'i zhing*// ston pa rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas 'khor tshogs ni// rgyal ba rab 'byams chos ni ye shes lnga'i// dgongs par dus gsum rgyun chad med bzhugs 'dus// sprul pa'i dang po gnas ni dga' ldan brtsegs// ston pa khye'u snang ba dam pa'i 'od// pad sdong khri 'phang las 'khrungs sprul pa'i 'khor// bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong dang rtsa gnyis la/ bstan pa'i snying 246)po thal 'gyur rtsa ba'i rgyud// la sogs rdzogs chen rgyud mchog bcu bdun gsung*// ston 'khor ngo bo gcig kyang sprul pa mdzad/ tshe lo dpag med dus na byon der 'dud// gnyis pa gnas ni mi 'jed 'jig rten 'dir// ston pa khye'u 'od mi 'khrugs pa nyid// 'od lnga'i sgo lnga las 'khrungs sprul pa'i 'khor// bde gshegs rdo rje rin chen pad phrin las// rigs kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum phrag gnyis rnams la// chos ni sku gsung thugs yon phrin las rgyud// dus ni tshe lo bye ba thub pa'i tshe// 'gro 'dul rnam sprul de ltar bstan la 'dud// gsum pa gnas ni 'od kyi phung po'i zhing*// ston pa'i mtshan ni 'jam dpal 'jigs skyob ste// drod sher skyes las sku bltams de yi 'khor// rang bzhin byams sems 'bum dang lam gnas 'bum// sems sbyang 'bum dang sems 'dul 'bum phrag dang*// sa gnas 'bum dang phyir mi ldog 'bum ste// 'bum phrag drug la 'khor ba dong sprugs chos// tshe lo 'bum gyi dus na

247)gsungs der 'dud// bzhi pa gnas ni chags 'byung mngal snang zhing*// lha dbang mchog gi yab dang rtse ldan yum// de gnyis sras su gzhon nu rol pa ni// rnam par brtse ba zhes bya'i ston pa 'khrungs// 'khor ni sprul pa'i gnod sbyin stong phrag dang*// yab yum sprul pa'i rig 'dzin grangs med la// rdzogs chen bya stsol bral ba sems sde'i rgyud// tshe lo brgyad khri'i dus na gsung der 'dud// lnga pa'i gnas ni sum cu rtsa gsum gyi// 'tsho byed ldum rar ston pa rdo rje 'chang*// 'khor ni thun mongs thun min rnam gnyis las// thun mong brgya byin sras yum rigs gsum mgon// rnams la gdung sel phar phyin drug chos gsung*/ mthun mong min 'khor thub pa rnam drug dang*// lha bu nor bzang dang bcas bdun po la// thig le kun gsal rgyud sogs rdzogs chen chos// tshe lo bdun khri'i dus na gsungs der 'dud// drug 248)pa gsang mchog me ri 'bar ba zhes// ri rab byang gi bang rim steng nyid na// ston pa gzhon nu dpa' bo stobs ldan gyis// 'khor du byang sems sprin gyi shugs can bdun// gnod sbyin legs spyod dang ni ḍāk+ki'i tshogs// rnams la pha rgyud ma rgyud khyad par du// rig pa rang shar chen po'i rgyud la sogs// tshe lo drug khri'i dus na gsungs der 'dud// bdun pa srin phug ru lu'i sgra ldan gyi// dur khrod chen por ston pa sprul pa'i gzugs// drang srong khros pa'i rgyal por bstan nas ni// 'khor du thub drug nor bzang bdun gyi steng*// srin po bye ba phrag la bstan pa'i chos// ma gshin phur gsum rgyud sde dpag med rnams// dregs byed gdug pa 'dul ba'i don du gsungs// tshe lo khri pa'i dus na byon der 'dud// brgyad pa 'dzam gling bya rgod spungs ri'i gnas// ston pa dgra bcom gser 'od dam pa ni// rgyal po seng bzang mdzes ma 'od ldan yum// gnyis las sku bltams

249)'khor ni nyan thos mchog /kun dga' ba sogs rdzu 'phrul ldan rnams la// bstan pa dam chos 'dul ba lung chen ni// bam po lnga brgya sho lo stong bdun brgya// tshe lo lnga stong dus na gsung der 'dud// dgu pa byang phyogs g.yu yi smin ma can// rang byung bde byed mchod rten drung nyid na// ston pa brtse ba rol ba'i blo gros kyi// sa brgyad byang sems glog 'byung 'od zer dang*// blo gros bzang sogs sems dpa' grangs med la// chos ni kun byed sems lung khu byug rol// kun bzang che ba rang gnas rgyud la sogs// tshe lo stong thub dus na gsungs la 'dud// bcu pa gnas ni lho phyogs bde ldan gyi// bya rgod spungs rir ston pa 'od srungs ches// 'khor ni thub drug bram ze mgon sems rnams// nyan thos gzugs su sprul la dam pa'i chos// mdo sde 'bum phrag nyer lnga khyad par du// rdzogs chen a ti bkod pa chen po ni// tshigs su 250)bcad pa 'bum phrag drug la sogs// tshe lo lnga brgya'i dus na gsungs der 'dud// bcu gcig gnas ni rdo rje gdan drung gi /byang chub snying por ston pa mngon rdzogs rgyal// bram ze legs ldan mkha' 'gro dpal byin gyis// yab yum las 'khrungs dam pa'i 'khor tshogs ni// rigs gsum mgon sogs sems dpa' dpag med la// dam chos nges pa don gyi mdo sde'i tshig /sho lo ka ni stong phrag lnga nyid bdag /tshe lo sum brgya'i dus na gsungs der 'dud// bcu gnyis gnas ni mgon med zas byin gyis// kun dga' ra bar ston pa shākya'i rgyal// thun mong 'khor du dge slong pha ma dang*// dge bsnyen pha ma la sogs rnam bzhi la// bden pa rnam bzhis bsdus pa'i rgyu yi chos// lan grangs bcu gnyis 'das te bskor mdzad pa'i// dus ni tshe lo brgya pa'i rtsod ldan la// mdzad pa bcu gnyis tshul bstan de la 'dud// de ltar chos nyid dbyings las gzugs sku'i dpal// sprul

251)sku'i ston pa grags chen bcu gnyis kyi// rnam par rol pa'i sgyu 'phrul phrin las la// ngo mtshar dad brgyas rab btud phyag bgyi'o// gdul bya'i 'gro ba'i phung po lnga dang ni// 'byung lnga khams lnga nyon mongs dug lnga sogs// sbyong phyir phun sum tshogs pa lnga ldan gyi// 'dul byed dus gsum dus med bstan la 'dud// chos sku kun bzang gcig gi rol pa las// longs sprul rnam 'gyur 'di dang de bzhin gzhan// grangs med bstan kyang don la spro bsdus shog /dbyings dang ye shes dbyer med e ma hoḥ ༈ rdor sems dga' rab 'jam dpal shrī sing*// dzñā na bi ma myang ban ldang ma lhun// lce btsun zhang ston nyi 'bum jo 'ber dang*// 'khrul zhig che dang grub thob me long rdor// ku ma rā dzā sna tshogs rang grol zhabs// bya bral chos rje gzhan phan nam mkha' mtshan// 'od gsal klong yangs bsod nams rin chen rje// ngag gi dbang dang grub mchog bsod nams dbang*// sku drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma sogs/ 252)/chos kun snying po'i mthar thug rdzogs pa che// gnas lugs rang zhal mngon sum ston mdzad pa'i// rtsa brgyud bla mar phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// dag pa gnyis ldan gdod ma'i gnas lugs mchog /bde gshegs snying pos 'gro ba kun khyab kyang*// ma rtogs dbul po'i khyim gyis gter bzhin rmongs// sgrib bral chos khams dge ba mngon gyur shog /sems can khams gang ji snyed yod pa dang*// mtshungs pa'i bde gshegs thugs rje'i bkod sprul gyis// khyab bzhin 'gro 'di las nyon sgrib pas ldongs// dag pa rab 'byams zhing la dbang bsgyur shog /tha mal shes pa bzo med chos sku dngos// rtag par rang la 'bral med bzhugs bzhin du// ma rtogs blos byas bcos ma'i 'jur sgom gyis// bcings las rang grol gnas lugs rtogs par shog /tshogs drug rang snang sgyu ma'i rol rtsal du// ma shes yul dang bdag tu 'khrul pa'i blo// thog med nas goms da dung gzung 'dzin las// sbyangs pas ci bya rang

253)tshang rig grol shog /bdag dang gzhan dang 'khor ba myang 'das sogs// tha dad bzang ngan 'dzin blos da bar phung*// da ni ye grol rang babs gnyug ma'i klong*// phyam gdal mnyam nyid chen por grol bar shog /theg pa'i yang rtse rtsol med a ti'i lam// rtsol bcas bgrod 'dod 'bras bu re ba'i bdud// rang las byung bas rang srog mi gcod par// mnyam rdzogs byang chub gtan srid zin par shog /mtshan bcas bskyed rdzogs 'dzin pa'i gtod pur bud// lta sgom spyod 'bras sa lam rdzun khrid yal/ thob bya thob byed byang chub mngon zhen bral gdod ma'i chos skur 'gro kun lhun rdzogs shog 'di ltar gsang chen a ti yo ga'i 'byung khungs lo rgyus rnams las rgya cher byung ba'i grags chen gyi ston pa bcu gnyis rnams kyi phun sum tshogs pa lnga ldan 'di dag theg pa'am grub mtha' gzhan gyis lo rgyus dag la ma grags pa shas che ba'i dbang gis/ ding sang gi mkhas par rlom pa'i blun po nga rgyal can dag gi thugs la shong bar dka' zhing*/ 254) lar yang rgyal ba rnams kyi mdzad phrin rnam rol gyi sgyu 'phrul dang theg chen gyi chos tshul zab mo la pha mtha' mi mngon zhing so so skye bo'i blo'i ra ba las rgal ba yin mod kyang*/ rang dang mi mthun pa'i chos thams cad mi bden par blta ba la goms pa'i blo can dang khyad par theg pa'i rtse mo rdzogs pa chen po las dam pa'i chos yang dag pa ma yin no zhes mgrin pa'i rnga gsang mthon por sgrog la brtson pa'i gang zag gi rgya mtsho'i gos can khyab pa'i dus 'di 'drar/ tshul 'di dag yi ge'i lam du snang bar byas rung gzhan yid zug rdu ldang ba'i rkyen las ma mchis kyang*/ thos bsam gyi mig 'phangs mi dma' ba'i dge slong bstan 'dzin phun tshogs pas ched gnyer du bskul ba'i ngor/ gsol 'debs su bgyis nas gsal bar bkod pa'i dge bas/ 'gro ba thams cad theg mchog snying po'i bstan pa la gus pas 'jug pa'i rgyur gyur cig//

༈ na mo gu ru/ gzod ma nyid nas spros kun nyer zhi ba'i// chos dbyings 'dus ma byas dbyings kun tu bzang*// 'gags med sgyu 'phrul dpal ldan bla ma'i skur// ston mdzad gzhan phan rdo rjer gsol ba 'debs// gang sku mtshan dpe'i nyi ma thugs rje'i 'od// gdul 255) bya'i gling kun phyogs lhung med khyab na// ci slad bdag sogs mun gling rab 'khyams pa'i// tshul 'di 'dor ba phod dam rje btsun mchog /skye 'chis dben bzhin skye 'chi'i snang tshul du// bdag sogs rmu rgod gdul byar ston mod kyang*// ye shes thugs rje bri gang ma mchis tshe// rtag par brtse bas gzigs shig dgongs su gsol// rab 'byams zhing kun ston pa gang ji snyed// ma lus mgon khyod sprul pa'i rol gar du// gyur mod deng 'dir bdag sogs rmongs pa'i bu// re yul gzhan med snying rjes mi gzigs sam// rgyal ba rnams la 'gro ba'i don nyid las// gzhan pa'i mdzad pa nam yang mchis min na// skyabs med nyam thag bu 'bangs gdung dbyangs kyi// gsol ba 'debs so pha khyod gzigs re ran// rin chen dbang gi rgyal po ji bzhin du// rtsol med gdul bya'i re ba rtag bskong na// bka' 'bangs sdug bsngal 'khor mtshor mi bskyu+ur bar// rdzu 'phrul sprul pa'i zlos gar bsgyur mdzad 256)gsol// chos dbyings zhi bder snyoms par mi bzhugs par// thugs rje'i 'od dkar gdul bya'i dad mtsho ru// snang mdzad mun sel chos kyi sgron me yi// bstan 'gro'i sgron ma slar yang mdzad gsol 'debs// bdag sogs skye ba 'di bzung byang chub bar// rnam 'dren khyod kyis 'bral med rjes bzung zhing*// dam gtsang mnyes gsum mthar phyin don gnyis 'grub// rje btsun bla ma'i go 'phang thob par shog /phyogs dus rgyal ba sras bcas lhag pa'i lha// bslu med bden pa grub pa'i dkon mchog gis// thugs rje nus stobs mthu yi bdag sogs kyis// gsol ba btab pa myur 'grub byin gyis rlobs/

ces pa 'di ni rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa gzhan phan mchog gi rdo rje de nyid gzugs sku'i snang brnyan chos dbyings su thim pa'i tshe gsol ba btab pa'o// ༈ e ma hoḥ gdod ma nas ye grol 'gyur med gshis// ka dag gi gnas lugs rang rig la// kun bzang chos skur mtshan gsol bar// yin lugs rtogs pas gsol ba 'debs// skye med du 257)shigs se shig /rang grol du byin gyis rlobs// chos nyid kyi klong las rang byung gdangs// lhun grub kyi 'od gsal longs spyod rdzogs// rigs lnga rdor 'chang rdo rje sems// rang gsal ngang nas gsol ba 'debs// snang stong du ya la la// 'od lus su byin gyis rlobs// sku gnyis kyi thugs rje shugs 'byung rtsal// kun khyab kyi rol gar sprul pa'i sku// pra dzñā bha wa dga' rab zhabs// rang babs klong nas gsol ba 'debs/ 'gag med du khrol lo lo// shar grol du byin gyis rlobs// bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis mthu// mngon gyur gyi 'bras bu mthar phyin pa// shrī singhā paṇa grub mchog /mos gus sems kyi gsol ba 'debs// bcos min du lams se lam// 'bad med du byin gyis rlobs// dus gsum gyi rgyal ba'i phrin las kun// gcig bsdus kyi ngo bo thugs rje can// 'chi med rdo rje pad+ma 'byung*// gdung shugs drag pos gsol ba 'debs// gang byung kun thugs rjer 258)go /yongs grol du byin gyis rlobs// rgyal yum gyi rdo rje rnal 'byor nyid// zab gter gyi bka' yi bsdud ba mo// ye shes mtsho rgyal mkha' 'gro'i gtso// dag snang yid kyis gsol ba 'debs// tshogs drug gi 'char snang kun// bde chen du byin gyis rlobs// mtha' yas kyi shes bya ji snyed rnams// mkhyen rab kyi gnas lugs ji bzhin gzigs// pad+ma las 'brel klong chen zhabs// mos pa'i bu yis gsol ba 'debs// chos kun gyi snying po'i don// khong chud du byin gyis rlobs// de nyid kyi thugs sras 'gro ba'i mgon// rje gu ru ye shes rab 'byams dang*// mkhas grub chos rje bsam gtan pa// rjes 'jug dad pas gsol ba 'debs// rang gzhan gyi don gnyis kun// lhun grub tu byin gyis rlobs// gnas lugs kyi lta ba'i gdengs thob bzhin// 'od gsal gyi zab bzhes brtson mdzad pa// ye shes mchog brnyes sbyin pa bzang*// grub mchog de la gsol ba 'debs// bag chags kyi 'khrul

259)snang 'di// gzhi med du byin gyis rlobs// mkhas grub kyi skyes chen du ma yis// zhal gdams kyi bdud rtsis rgyud smin pa// zab lung chos rje shākya'i mtshan// 'khrul zhig che la gsol ba 'debs// las nyon gyi rtsa lag kun// gting thon du byin gyis rlobs// chos kun gyi yang rtse a ti'i don// ji bzhin du rtogs nas gzhan don mdzad// bsod nams rin chen rdzogs chen pa/ snying thig bdag por gsol ba 'debs// gdos bcas kyi sgyu lus 'di// lhag med du byin gyis rlobs// rig 'dzin gyi gdung rabs mtshar dngar dbus// mkhyen rtogs kyi nyi 'od gsal 'bar can// ngag dbang pad+ma rnam par rgyal// phrin las can la gsol ba 'debs// smin grol gyi lam bzang la// myur bgrod du byin gyis rlobs// zhen log dang nges 'byung snying rus mthus// nyams rtogs kyi gter kha nang nas phyes// grub thob chen po bsod nams dbang*/ 260)/'gran zla bral der gsol ba 'debs// bdag 'dzin gyi 'ching ba kun// brtsad chod du byin gyis rlobs// snyigs dus kyi gdul bya blo dred rnams// ma nor ba'i lam la 'khrid mkhas pa// mtshungs bral rtsa ba'i bla ma rje// sku drin can la gsol ba 'debs// sgo gsum gyi bya byed kun// chos mthun du byin gyis rlobs// snang srid kun yi dam dkyil 'khor lha// rtsa rlung thig dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// ma skyed rdzogs pa'i ngo bor grub// zung 'jug ngang du gsol= /bde gsal dang mi rtog che// 'dzin med du byin gyis rlobs// sku gsum gyi ston pa rig 'dzin rgyud// bka' sdod kyi srung ma sprul 'khor bcas// skyabs gnas thugs rje'i gter rnams la// rgyun chad med par gsol= /dngos grub char chen phob/ smin grol byin= ༈ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ/ skye 'chi 'pho 'gyur mi mnga' ba'i// ye shes rdo rje'i sku mchog ni// yang dag grub pa khyed bzhin du/

261)/bdag lus 'od skur grol bar mdzod/ āḥ brjod med klong las 'gags med kyi// chos sgras 'gro ba smin nus pa// de bzhin bdag gi ngag 'di nyid// grags stong chos gsung mnga' brnyes mdzod/ hūm̐/ 'khrul rtog bsam pa'i 'du 'phro gang*// ma bkag mi 'dzin ye grol thugs// ye shes klong yangs khyed thugs bzhin// bdag yid chos nyid klong grol mchod/ hrīḥ yid bzhin 'dod 'byung dbang rgyal las// lhag pa'i yon tan kun rdzogs shing*// phrin las gang 'dul rol gar can// khyed bzhin bdag sogs myur 'grub mdzod/ sarba dharma a la la hoḥ thams cad gnyug ma rang rig gshis kyi klong*// 'gags med rtsal snang bla ma lha yi tshul// dbyer med de phyir bdag gzhan tha dad du// 'dzin pa'i 'khrul rtog rba rlabs chu ru thim/ phaṭaḥ mtshon byed dpe'i bla ma brgyud par bcas// byin rlabs rdzu 'phrul bka' drin bsam yas kyi// bdag sogs gdul 262)bya'i sems rgyud yongs smin nas// mtshon bya don gyi bla mar rig grol shog /rang rig kun bzang dug lnga ye shes lnga// 'byung lnga yul lnga tshogs brgyad sems dpa' dang*// sems byung lnga bcu khrag 'thung dkyil 'khor sogs// phung khams gdod nas dag par ngo shes shog /'khor ba myang 'das bzang ngan chos can du// ma grub bzhin du blos btags 'khrul snang tshogs// rmi lam las kyang rmi lam chen po 'di'i// rdzun mtshang gting nas rig ste grol bar shog /sgo gsum las rlung rkyen gyis kha bsgyur bas// bar gcod nad gdon dgra 'dre skyid sdug sogs// thams cad rang sems 'char sgor thag chod pa'i// gdengs thob dgag sgrub spang blang bral bar shog /gnas skabs 'dod don phra mo zhe 'dod kyis// kun btags blo bzo'i bskyed rim mi sgom par// lha nyid rang la rang nyid lhar shes pa'i// 'khyer so gsum gyi dam las 'da' med shog /rdzogs rim bzhi par gnas mkhan lhag

263)gi mthong*// lhag mthong blos byas ma slad zhi bar gnas// gnyis med tha mal shes rig zang thal 'di// gang byung sgom gyi ngo bor lam lhongs shog /mnyam bzhag zhen pas 'jur 'dzin ma yin zhing*// rjes shes 'khrul pa'i thag rul mi 'thud par// gnas 'gyu dbyer med mnyam rjes ro gcig pa'i// khregs chod rig pa bzo med ngo shes shog /sgo gsum bya ba dgu thongs gnas gsum stim// sgron drug rten 'brel goms thog gtan phebs nas// kha dog dbyibs la zhen pa'i lhad med par// thod rgal snang bzhi mtha' ru phyin par shog /de tshe 'khrul pa'i yul snang mi 'byung kyang*// smon lam thugs rje mthun pa'i gdul bya la// chos sku'i dbyings nas gzugs sku'i sgyu 'phrul gyi// mkha' khyab 'gro ba'i don chen 'grub par shog /rgyal rnams ye shes dbyings su ro gcig pa'i// rang mdangs dpal ldan bla ma rgyud bcas rnams// bsgoms 264)shing gsol 'debs smon lam 'di btab pa'i// dge bas 'khor ba dong nas sprug par shog zab chos mkha' 'gro yang rig dngos grub ljon shing gi bla ma rgyud pa rnams la gsol ba gdab pa nyams len gyi ngo sprod gsal 'debs su gyur ba gzhom med rdo rje'i dbyangs zhes bya ba 'di nyid/ rig 'dzin karma las grub kyi bzhed pa ltar sna tshogs rang grol gyi rnal 'byor pas shar phyogs dpal gyi ri bo'i ngogs su bris pa sidhan+tu/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ chos nyid mi 'gyur gdod nas dag pa'i sku// rig gdangs 'gags med mtshan dpe'i dkyil 'khor bkra// kun bzang zhi khro rdor sems rdo rje 'dzin// dgongs brgyud bla mas deng 'dir byin gyis rlobs// chos sku'i dbyings las gzugs sku'i sgyu 'phrul rtsal// gang 'dul sprul sku'i chu zla 'gro la 'gyed// dga' rab 'jam dpal bshes gnyen shrī sing*// rig 'dzin brgyud pas deng 'dir byin gyis rlobs// dzñā na sū tra bi ma la mi tra// zag med 'pho ba chen po'i skur bzhengs te// gsang ba snying tig chos kyi mdzod 'dzin pa/

brda brgyud bla mas deng 265)'dir byin gyis rlobs// bi mas rjes bzungs myang ban ting 'dzin bzang*// gnas lugs mngon gyur ldang ma lhun rgyal mtshan// zag med 'ja' lus lce btsun seng dbang zhabs// snyan brgyud spel mdzad rnams kyi byin gyis= /snying tig bka' gter bdag po rgyal ba zhang*// bshad sgrub bstan pa dar mdzad nyi ma 'bum// mngon sum 'od gsal ston pa'i jo 'ber ba// grub thob brgyud pa rnams kyi byin gyis rlobs// 'khrul zhig seng ge rgyab pa sangs rgyas dbon// grub rtags rdzu 'phrul mnga' brnyes me long rdor// bi ma'i rnam 'phrul rig 'dzin gzhon nu rgyal// rdzogs chen bdag po rnams kyi byin= /mkhyen pa'i klong chen mdo rgyud rab 'byams gzigs// dri med ye shes snang ba'i 'od zer 'gyed// snga 'gyur bstan pa'i nyi ma gcig pu pa// kun mkhyen chen pos deng 'dir byin= /bya bral chos rje bkra shis 'byung 266)gnas dang*// gzhan phan rdo rje de sras nam mkha'i mtshan// 'od gsal klong yangs bsod nams rin chen zhabs// snyigs dus 'dren mchog rnams kyi byin= /gsang sngags chos mdzod 'dzin pa ngag gi dbang*// dngos 'dzin 'khrul zhig bsod nams dbang po mchog /bka' drin zla med rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar// sangs rgyas dngos byon rnams kyi byin= /de ltar gsol ba 'debs pa'i gdung dbyangs 'di// ye shes gzigs pa mnga' ba'i bla ma rnams// sgrib med lha snyan dag pas gsan mdzod la// dmigs bral thugs rje chen pos nyer dgongs gsol// bdag dang mkha' mnyam mar gyur 'gro ba kun// gzod nas dag pa'i chos nyid yid bzhin du// yin par ma shes bag chags rtog sgrib kyis// dus gsum rgyun du 'thum 'di bsal du gsol// 'khor 'das mnyam nyid ye sangs rgyas pa'i gzhir// blang dor mtshan 'dzin dgag sgrub mi 'tshal yang*// sgom byed sgom blo mang pos bslad pas phung*/

267)/sgom 'dzin bcos ma'i mdud rgya zhig tu gsol// snang srid snod bcud dngos por bzung ba yi// 'khrul la yang 'khrul bsnon cing zhen byed pa// 'di kun rang snang 'od gsal thig le'i klong*// shes rab rang byung sgron mar thim mdzad gsol// mngon sum snang ba sgyu 'phrul sprul pa'i sku// gnyid dang rmi lam snang ba longs sku'i tshul// 'chi ba 'od gsal chos skur ma bu 'dres// 'khrul pa'i rgyun thag rtsad nas chod mdzad gsol// chos nyid bar do longs sku'i 'char snang dang*// srid pa bar do sprul sku'i rtsal mdangs rnams// thams cad rang rig chos skur thag chod pa'i// gdeng thob sku gsum rgyal sar 'khod mdzad gsol// sa lam rim pa ma rtsol ngang gi sgrod// rang gzhan don gnyis ma 'bad lhun gyis grub// sprul pa'i zlos gar rtsol med 'gro la snang*// 'khor ba'i rgyu 'bras gtan zad mdzad du gsol// gsang ba bla na med pa 'od gsal rdo rje 268) snying po'i rgyud sde 'bum phrag drug cu'i yang snying bi ma la'i snying thig zab pa spod bzhi dang de dag gi don mdor bsdus pa zab chos bla ma yang thig yid bzhin nor bu dang bcas pa'i bla brgyud la gsol ba btab pa bdud rtsi'i 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba la/ sna tshogs rang grol gyi bkod pa gu ru a dhiṣ+ṭha na ma/ na mo gu ru/ spyi gtsug bde chen 'og min du// khyab bdag rgyal ba kun tu bzang*// rdo rje 'chang chen rdor sems bcas// dbyings nas brtser dgongs thugs rjes gzigs// sprul pa'i rig 'dzin ro langs bde// mañdzu mi tra shrī seng*// ye shes mdo dang bi ma la// dbyings nas= /myang ban che dang blo gros dbang*// rin chen 'bar dang lhun rgyal dang*// lce btsun seng dbang shangs pa ras// dbyings nas= /zwa ston chos 'bar dgyer ston zhabs// gnyan ston shes rab rtse mo ba// ku ma rā dza rgyal ba g.yung*// dbyings nas=

/thugs sras dge 'dun bzang po dang*// mkhas grub rgyal sras chos rje'i zhabs// mon rdzong ras dang thod smyon pa// dbyings nas= 269)/bya btang chos nyid rang grol rje// grub thob nyi zla grags pa'i mtshan// mkhas mchog kun bzang klong yangs pa// dbyings nas/= /skad gnyis smra ba gzhan phan rdor// rje btsun rtsa ba'i bla ma mchog /zhi khro rab 'byams bka' srung bcas// dbyings nas= /skyabs gnas bla ma rgyud par bcas// zag med ye shes dgongs klong nas// rgyun chad med pa'i thugs rje yis// mos pa'i bu la gzigs su gsol// las nyon sgrib tshogs dag pa dang*// nyams rtogs ye shes 'bar ba dang*// gnyis 'dzin 'khrul snang rang grol te// snang bzhi mthar phyin byin gyis rlobs// tshe 'di dus 'di skad cig 'dir// byin rlabs rtsal dbang thob nas kyang*// sku gsum dbyer med mngon gyur nas// gzhan phan lhun grub 'byung bar shog paṇa chen bi ma la nas brgyud pa'i rdzogs chen zab mo yang tig la dpe rgyud dang snyan rgyud gnyis yod pa las dpe rgyud ni gter nas byon pa yin kyang bla ma yang tig dang brgyud 270) rim gcig tshe/ gsol 'debs kyang zur du mi dgos kyi/ snyan brgyud gsang bskor gyi bla ma brgyud rim la gsol ba 'debs pa mdor bsdus dngos grub char 'bebs zhes bya ba / oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'di ltar 'khor 'das chos rnams kun// gdod nas rang sems chos kyi skur// lhun gyis grub pa'i spros bral dbyings// thig le nyag gcig khyab gdal ngang*// de ltar ma rtogs 'khrul pa'i 'gror// bzod med snying rje'i mdangs chen gyis// khyab bdag bla ma'i go 'phang la// 'god phyir byang chub sems mchog bskyed// skad cig dran rdzogs rang nyid kyi// sgo gsum bla ma'i dkyil 'khor du// mkha' la 'ja' shar lta bur gsal// thig le nyag gcig mtshon pa'i zhal// zhi 'dzum 'gro la thugs rjes gzigs// thabs shes zung 'jug phyag gnyis kyis// chos nyid 'gyur med rdo rje dang*// dngos grub 'dzad med thod pa 'dzin// bde stong lhan skyes mtsho rgyal yum// kha ṭ+waṃ tshul du mchan khung brgyan// dbu la ye shes lnga ldan

271)gyi// 'dab ldan rigs lnga gzi brjid 'bar// sku la theg pa rim dgu yi// zab ber dgu brtsegs lhab lhub dang*// mdo sngags zung 'jug chos gos gsol// zhabs gnyis srid zhi mnyam rdzogs kyi// skyil krung pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs// sangs rgyas yon tan ma lus kun// rdzogs phyir mtshan dang dpe byad ldan// a 'thas gdos bcas ma yin par// stong gsal 'od skur lams se lam// thugs rje'i 'od 'bar 'khyil li li// ri rgyal lhun po lta bu'i sku// khams gsum dbang bsdud zil gyis gnon// nam mkha'i mthar thug zhing khams kun// sprul pa'i rnam 'gyur du ma khyab// brtan g.yo 'khor 'das ma lus kyang*// khyab bdag bla ma gcig pu'i 'khrul// mtha' yas zhing khams rab 'byams kyi// sangs rgyas byang sems dkyil 'khor lha// mkha' 'gro chos skyong la sogs pa// mtshan dang cha lugs rnam 'gyur gyi// rol gar sna tshogs cir bstan kyang*/ 272)/rigs bdag bla ma kho na yi// ngo bo yin la yin shes pa'i// nges shes snying nas thag chod cing*// bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos// kun byed rgyal po kun khyab sku// rang gi sgo gsum tha mi dad// bla ma'i sku gsung thugs rang bzhin// dbyer med gdod nas lhun grub pa'i// thugs kar gser gyi rdo rje ni// rtse lnga gyen du langs pa yis// lte ba thugs srog hūm̐ yig ni// 'od zer lnga yi mdangs can gsal// rdo rje de yi phyi skor du// badz+ra gu ru'i sngags 'phreng yang*// 'ja' 'od lnga ldan kha dog can// g.yas skor 'khor 'das 'od zer tshogs// phyogs bcur 'phros pas rgyal kun la// mchod pa phul zhing dngos grub dang*// byin rlabs dbang rnams 'od kyi tshul// tshur byung rang la gnyis med thim// rang gi thugs rje'i 'od zer ni// 'gro drug sems can kun la 'phros// kun gyi sdig sgrib sdug bsngal zhi// thams cad bla ma'i sku ru gyur// snang srid thams cad bla ma'i sku// sgra grags badz+ra gu ru'i sngags// dran rtog

273)ye shes rnam rol thugs// bza' btung tshogs kyi 'khor lo nyid// gos rgyan gdan dang gnas khang yul// tshogs drug mtha' dag mchod pa'i rdzas// gang shar cir snang ye shes kyi// rnam rol chos nyid 'khor lo la// dgag sgrub bzang ngan zhen 'dzin gyi// bcos bslad sgro skur mi bya bar// rang rig gnyug ma ma bcos pa// bsgom bya sgom byed med pa'i klong*// yengs 'khrul bral bar lhod kyi glod// skyid sdug legs nyes tsha grang dang*// dgra 'dre rkyen ngan na tsha dang*// 'chi ba la sogs gang byung kyang*// bla ma'i thugs rje byin rlabs nyid// yin par blo thag rbad kyi bcad// ci phyir zhe na bzang ngan dang*// bde sdug 'dzin pa rnam rtog tsam// rnam rtogs 'khrul phyir 'breng na bslu// rang rig bla ma chos kyi sku// brtan g.yo 'khor 'das kun la khyab// kun khyab rang rig ngo bo la// bde sdug bzang ngan ma grub cing*// bde skyid snang 274)mkhan rang gi sems// nyon mongs dug lnga sdug bsngal dang*// btang snyoms snang ba kun rang sems// sems la bzang ngan bde sdug gi /dgag sgrub spros pas dben pas na// gang shar chos nyid ye shes dbyings// 'gag med rang byung rig rtsal gyi// rang sgra sngags kyi chu rgyun ni// rgyun mi chad par bzla bar bya'o/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐/

thun mtshams su bskyed rim bsdud bar spro na/ snod bcud bdag bskyed sngags 'phreng rdo rje dang bcas pa thams cad thugs srog hūm̐ la thim zhing*/ hūm̐ yang 'ja' yal ba ltar gyur pa'i ngang nas/ gdod ma'i gnas lugs ye shes chos kyi sku'i rang zhal blta zhing*/ dge ba 'gro la bsngo/ slar rgyun spyod thams cad bla ma'i lam khyed kyi ngang nas bya ba ste/ 'on kyang tshul 'di ni gsang sngags kyi bskyed rim spyi 'gro ltar yin mod kyi/ khyad par bla na med pa zab mo bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug gi nyams len ltar na/ bskyed pa dang bsdu ba sogs thun mtshams res 'jog tu mi bya ste/ rnam pa thams cad du/ snod bcud bla ma'i dkyil 'khor/ ngag rlung gi 'gro 'ong dang sgra grags sngags kyi rang bzhin/ sems 275) kyi 'gyu dran rtog tshogs thams cad rang byung rang grol ye shes chen por la bzlo ba kho na rgyun chad med par nyams su blangs zhing*/ tha mal 'khrul 'dzin gyi dbang du skad cig kyang ma shor bar byed pa ni bla med kyi smin grol bskyed rdzogs mtha' dag gi snying po'i yang snying lags tshe/ de ltar thugs nyams su bzhes tshal/ zhes pa'i bla sgrub 'di ni/ rgya bod kyi mtshams/ dar rtse mdo'i shar phyogs la mo rtse zhes bya ba'i dben gnas nas/ bla ma rin chen grub pa'i dbang phyug byams pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams pa'i bzhes pa skong phyir rgod phug nas bris te phul ba'o// ༈ rab 'byams phyogs bcu'i zhing gi rgyal ba kun// bsam yas phrin las rol gar ji snyed kyang*// dbyer med rigs bdag bla ma gcig po'i 'phrul// yin la yin par rtogs pa gsol ba 'debs// gang sku mtshan dpe'i nyi ma thugs rje'i 'od// bstan 'gro'i pad tshal skyong bar mi mdzad par// zhi dbyings nub ri'i phag tu gshegs mdzad na// rmongs thom mun 'khyams gdul bya su yis/ 276)'dren// gdod nas rab dag chos sku'i mgon po khyod// skye 'chi 'pho 'gyur spros mtshan mi dmigs kyang*// bdag sogs rtag 'dzin can gi bu 'bang rnams// dor nas lha yi lha khyod gshegs phod dam// de phyir mkhyen brtse'i klong nas sprul pa'i gar// bstan 'gro'i 'dod pa 'jo ba'i yid bzhin nor// mos gus dad brgya'i rgyal mtshan rtser 'bar ba'i// dbang gi rgyal po sprul pa'i skur 'byon gsol// snyigs mtha'i sems can las nyon rba rlabs 'khrug

/rgyal ba gzhan gyi gdul yul ma gyur pa// bdag sogs skyabs bral skye bo nyam thag rnams// brtse chen khyed kyi slar yang skyob mdzad gsol// mtshan dpe 'bar ba'i sku mchog ston mdzad cing*// theg mchog nges gsang chos 'khor bskor ba dang*// phrin las ngo mtshar bkod pa rgya mtsho yi// dus mtha'i 'gro 'dren mdzad par snying nas gsol// gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po gdod ma'i gshis// ma bcos chos 277)sku rang babs gnyug ma 'di// rje btsun bla ma khyed thugs 'od gsal cher// ro mnyam 'du 'bral med par bdag grol shog /sgom 'dzin zhen pa'i sgrog gis ma bcings shing*// bag chags ngan goms 'khrul phyir mi 'brang bar// ma yengs mi sgom 'dzin med blo 'das ngang*// mgon po khyod kyi phrin las kun 'grub shog /gang shar 'dzin bral rig pa'i me long nang*// bzang ngan bde sdug ri mo cir 'char rnams// gang byung bla ma'i byin rlabs kho na ru// shes nas mkha' mnyam 'gro phan sgrub byed shog /de ltar mos gus gdung shugs drag po yis// dpa' ldan bla ma'i sprul sku myur 'byon phyir// gsol 'debs smon lam btab pa'i bden stobs kyis// rgyal mchog khyed kyi go 'phang myur thob shog ces pa 'di lha sras kyi skye mtha' 'bri gung chos rje chos kyi grags pa de nyid zhing khams su gshegs tshe sprul pa'i sku myur 'byon gyi gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa/ shar kha bla ma rin chen nor 278) bus bskul bar mdzad pa bzhin bkod pa'o/ oṃ swasti sidhan tu/ phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i rgyal ba ma lus kun// rje btsun dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje 'chang*// gsang gsum mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lor rdzogs// zhabs pad spyi bo'i gtsug tu gus pas mchod// gang sku mtshan dpe'i gzi 'bar rta ljang can// rab 'byams gdul bya ris med lha lam du// phrin las 'od brgya 'gyed pa'i rnam par thar// nam yang 'grib med mdzad par gsol ba 'debs// khyod gsung bden don bcu gnyis chos sgra'i dbyangs// skal ldan rna ba'i bcud dang yid kyi gsos// rgyun chad med pa'i dga' ston stsol ba'i dpyid// rtag par re skong mdzad par gsol ba 'debs// nyid thugs chos dbyings zab mo'i chu gter che// rmad byung yon tan dpal gyi yongs gtams pas// dad ldan klu dbang nyer tsho'i bsti gnas mchog

/mi zad 'dod 'byung zad par gsol ba 'debs// ji ltar mtshan mo'i bdag po skye bri'i tshul// snang yang don 279)la skye bris ma gos ltar/ mgon khyod skye 'chi 'pho 'gyur bral bzhin du// skye 'chi'i snang tshul mi ston brtan bzhugs gsol// zhing khams ji snyed gdul bya de snyed dang*// mtshungs par sprul pa'i rol gar ston bzhin du// zhing 'dir bdag sogs gdul mkhas thugs rje'i gter// mchog gi sprul sku bskal brgyar zhabs brtan gsol// dpag bsam shing dang bum bzang yid bzhin nor// ris med 'dod dgu'i char rgyun 'byung ba yang*// gsol ba 'debs pa'i rten 'brel ma ltos bzhin// bdag gis gsol ba btab don 'grub par mdzod// srid zhi 'khor 'das snang srid sems kyi 'phrul// sems nyid gzod nas yongs dag chos kyi dbyings// de nyid bla ma khyod skur chos sku'i ngang*// 'du 'bral med par bdag sogs grol bar shog /rab 'byams rgyal ba rgyal sras bla ma lha// mkha' 'gro chos srung thugs rje'i nus stobs dang*// bdag sogs dad gus gdung bas gsol 280)btab mthus// bskal brgyar zhabs rtan phrin las gong 'phel shog de ltar khams gsum 'gro ba'i 'dren pa rgyal mchog sprul pa'i sku nyid bskal pa nas bskal ba'i bar du zhabs pad mi 'gyur rdo rje'i gdan la g.yo ba med par brten zhing*/ skal pa tha dad dang 'tshams pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi rgyun chad med par rtsol bas gdul bya rnams byang grol la 'god par gsol ba snying khong rus pa'i dkyi nas btab pa 'di ni/ yul mtha' khob las yang kho nyid du gyur pa'i nags khrod dben par gnas bcas pa'i spong ba pa rgan po mkhas mchog pad+ma legs grub stsal gyis/ dngos 'byor zang zing gi mchod pa ma mchis kyang*/ dad mos gdung shugs drag pos kun nas blangs shing*/ sgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal dang bcas te gsol ba btab pa la brten nas/

bdag sogs mkha' mnyam gyi 'gro ba las ngan gcong rong du lhung zhing sdug bsngal gyi rba klong drag por 'khrug pa rnams la brtse ba chen pos nye bar dgongs nas zhabs pad bskal brgyar brtanapa dang*/ bdag rgan po yang ji srid gzung 'dzin gyi ri mo ma zhig gi bar de srid kyi skye ba'i 'phreng ba ji 281) snyed par 'bral med thugs rjes g.yel ba med par skyong shing gzigs par mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa 'di paṇa chen bi ma dang chos rgyal dwags po lha rje sogs kyi rnam par 'phrul pa/ sgam po mchog gis sprul sku'i brtan bzhugs su phul ba'o// rgyal ba khyab bdag ye shes rdo rje'i sku// sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang ba'i mdzod 'chang ba// dmigs med klong nas thugs rje'i 'od zer gyi// skal ldan byin rlobs smin grol dngos grub stsol// sgrib bral shes rab zab mos chos kun gzigs// zag med ting 'dzin bzang po'i phrin las kyi// rol gar ston mdzad te lo 'gro ba'i mgon// skal ldan byin rlobs smin grol= /mkhyen pa'i ye shes gnas lnga rig pa'i mchog /bka' spyad mthar phyin don gyi dngos grub brnyes// mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug dpal ldan nā ro pa/ skal ldan byin= /sngon byang las 'phro rab sad chos kyi phyir// 'phags yul lan mang bgrod pa'i blo gros stobs/ 282)/rmad byung mi yi seng ge lo tsa ba// skal ldan= /snyan brgyud zab mo rdo rje'i dbang mdzod thob// bla ma'i bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin// gangs can grub thob rgyal po mi la rje// skal ldan= /dpag med bsod nams tshogs las bskrun pa'i sku// 'dod 'byung yon tan rin chen 'gro la stsol// bka' brgyud kun gyi 'byung gnas sgam po pa// skal ldan= /dus gsum kun mkhyen mtshungs pa med pa'i rje// ye shes sgyu 'phrul gar mkhan ras chen zhabs// chos kun dgongs pa'i klong grol spom brag pa// skal ldan byin=

/rta mchog he ru ka dngos pak+shi'i mtshan// ḍāk+kis byin rlabs grub mchog o rgyan pa// shes bya'i chos kun mkhyen gzigs rang byung zhabs// skal ldan= /thabs mkhas gdul bya'i re bskong rgyal ba g.yung*// ye shes rol pa'i sgyu 'phrul rdo rje'i sku// chos dbyings mkha' la spyod 283)mdzad gar gyi dbang*// skal ldan= /de bzhin gshegs kun ngo bo chos dpal bzang*// mthu stobs nus ldan chos dpal ye shes dang*// mthong thos dran reg don ldan chos kyi grags// skal ldan= /mkhas grub bstan pa'i srog 'dzin 'jam dpal bzang*// rgyal sras sems dpa' go shrī rin po che// chos kyi spyan snga ye shes dpal bzang po// skal ldan= /thams cad mkhyen pa'i dbang po gtsug lag phreng*// rgyal ba gar gyi dbang po dkon mchog 'bangs// rje btsun gtsug lag rgya mtsho dga' ba'i dbyangs// skal ldan byin rlobs smin grol dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas thams cad gdul bya'i skal ngo dang*// rjes su mthun pa'i rdzu 'phrul bkod pa'i gter// mtha' dag bla ma gcig pu'i ngo bor rdzogs// gsol ba 'debs so smin grol dngos grub stsol/ ༈ thugs rje nus pa'i bdag nyid bla ma rje// rtsa 284)ba brgyud par bcas la gsol btab pas// chos kun mthar thug ye shes phyag rgya che// rang grol mngon sum rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// gzod nas yongs dag gnas lugs chos kyi sku// ma gcos lhun grub gnyug ma'i ye shes dngos// ma rig lhan skyes dri mas sgribs 'di las// rang grol rang rig rang zhal mjal bar shog /mtha' bcas mtha' bral sgro btags sna tshogs kyis// dngos med dngos por bsgrub pa'i thos bsam la// mi tshe'i nyi ma stong zad mi byed par// blta ba'i brdar sha nang nas chod par shog /bsgom du med pa'i rang byung ye shes don// ma yengs mi 'dzin rang sor mi 'jog par// sgom 'dod rtsol bas thog med da bar 'khrul// ma bsgom bcos min ye shes mngon gyur shog

/tshogs drug cir snang gang shar chos nyid rtsal// 'char bya 'char byed gdod nas rnam dag kyang*// spong len dgag sgrub thag brgya'i mdud pas 285)bcings// da nas spros med rang grol shes par shog /nyams rtogs zhe 'dod g.ya' yis ma gos shing*// lam rtags sgyu ma'i ltad mor mi zhen par/ /thob bya thob byed mtshan 'dzin las 'das pa'i// 'bras bu'i rgyal po chos nyid gdengs thob shog /spros bral chos sku mngon du gyur nas kyang*// 'gag med gzugs sku mtshan dpe'i 'od dkar ni// gang la gang 'dul sprul pa'i zlos gar tshogs// gdul bya'i chu snod ji snyed yongs gang shog /rtsod med bsgrub brgyud bla mar gsol btab pa'i// byin rlabs dge 'bras nus mthu bsam yas kyis// bdag sogs mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus kun// rdo rje 'chang dbang bla ma mchog 'grub shog ces phyag rgya chen po yi ge bzhi pa'i bla brgyud gsol 'debs 'di ni sprul pa'i skyes mchog mi pham mgon pos bskul bar mdzad pa'i ngor bkod pa ste/ spyir phyag rgya chen po'i bla brgyud kyi rtsa ba ni rdo rje 'chang nas/ byang sems blo gros rin chen/ dpal 286) sa ra ha/ ri khrod dbang phyug mai tri pa/ de nas mar pa lo tsā las brgyad pa dang*/ me tri pa'i rgya gar gyi slob ma tha dad las brgyud lugs kyang mang mod kyi skabs 'dir yi ge bzhi pa 'di nyid te lo nā ro nas brgyud tshul dang mthun par bkod pa yin la/ 'di la bod du yang rje sgam po pa yan chad gcig pa las/ de nas phag mo grub pa la brgyud cing*/ phag gru nas gling rgya ras/ de las dbon ras sogs 'brug pa'i gdan sa brgyud pa dang*/ rgod tshang pa nas stod 'brug sogs 'brug brgyud dang*/ yang*/ phag gru nas 'bri stag thil gsum so sor brgyud tshul sogs mtha' yas mod kyang*/ 'di ni sgam po pa nas dus mkhyen sogs karma bka' brgyud ltar bkod pa ste/

bla brgyud kyi mtshan rnams ni mtshal snag tu bris pa las shes par 'gyur ro// ༈ na mo/ rigs 'dus bde gshegs rdo rje 'chang*// phyogs dus dkon mchog gsum dngos la// bdag dang 'gro ba ma lus pa// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// nam mkha' khyab pa'i sems can rnams// sdug bsngal mtsho las bsgral ba'i phyir// rtsa ba gsum gyi go 'phang mchog ma thob bar du sgrub 287)par bya/ zhes pas skyabs su 'gro ba dang byang chub tu sems bskyed nas/ hrīḥm/ skad cig dran rdzogs bdud bzhi pad nyi'i steng*// rang nyid rta phag yab yum 'khril sbyor tshul// khro chas yongs rdzogs gri gug thod khrag bsnams// dbu skra ral pa'i khrod nas rta zhal dang*// phag zhal rang sgras khams gsum zil gyis gnon// zhabs gnyis dor stabs gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan// me spung klong na ri rab tsam gyi sku// srid gsum 'gran zla bral bar brjid cing 'gying*// snang la rang bzhin med par gsal ba yi// spyi bo'i gtsug steng pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i dbus// nyi ma zla ba rtsegs pa'i gdan stengs su// sangs rgyas thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa'i dpal// o rgyan gu ru sman pa'i tshul bstan pa// rje btsun chen po ma hā gu ṇa'i sku// dkar dmar zhi 'dzum mdzes pa'i zhal gdangs can// dar dkar gos dang sku rag mchin 288)khas mdzes// ber dmar gser gyi thig can lhub su gsol// dbu skra thor lcog me tog phreng bas rgyan// phyag g.yas pus mo'i steng du mchog sbyin gyis// sman rgyal gser mdog sdong po rab rgyas 'dzin// phyag g.yon mnyam bzhag bdud rtsi'i bum pa bsnams// lta bas mi ngom mtshan dpe'i gzi 'od 'bar// rdo rje skyil krung 'od lnga'i klong bzhugs pa'i// phyogs bzhi'i pad 'dab dkar ser dmar ljang steng*// ye shes mkha' 'gro rigs bzhi phyogs mdog can// thams cad phyag g.yas gri gug g.yon tshe bum// rin chen rus rgyan dar dpyangs du mas mdzes// gtso la zhal blta gar stabs bzhengs par gsal// gtso bo'i thugs kar zla ba'i gdan gyi steng*// hūm̐ yig mthing kha'i mtha' skor sngags kyi phreng*// kha dog lnga ldan g.yas skor 'khyil le ba// de las 'od zer sna tshogs phyogs bcur 'phros// sangs rgyas byang sems bla ma yi dam lha// mkha' 'gro chos

289)skyong la sogs skyabs gnas kun// rigs 'dus ma hā gu ṇa'i cha lugs su// byon nas gtso bo nyid la dbyer med thim// skyabs gnas kun 'dus ye nas yin bzhin du// slar yang byin rlabs gong bu gcig 'dus pa'i// rtsa ba'i bla ma ma hā gu ṇa la// snod bcud snang srid bdag lus longs spyod dang*// sgo gsum gtan 'dun thams cad mchod par 'bul// bzhes la tshe gcig sangs rgyas dngos grub zhu/ e ma/ rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor grangs med kun// tha dad gdul bya'i snang tshul tsam// bdag gi skal ngor gu ṇa rje// rtsa ba'i bla ma kho na nyid// zhabs kyi pad+mor phyag 'tshal zhing*// snying nas gus pas gsol ba 'debs// 'di bzung bla med byang chub bar// skyabs yul gzhan na ma mchis kyi// g.yel med thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs// las nyon 'gal rkyen bar chad sel// sgo gsum chos su smin 290)grol bas// rang gzhan byang chub lam 'khod mdzod/

ces gsol ba rtse gcig tu gdab cing*/ slar yang gsol 'debs kyi bzlas pa 'di la dus rgyun ldan du 'bad par bya'o// oṃ āḥbadz+ra gu ṇa a yuḥdzñā na sid+dhi hūm̐/ zhes thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa la sems gtad cing mos gus chen po'i ngang nas bzla/ thun mtshams sogs la sman gyi dngos grub bsdu ba'i sngags 'di nyid bzla bar spro na'ang brgya skor tsam du bzla ste/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ a mṛ ta dzī wan+ti bhe ṣa dz+ye sarba sid+dhi hūm̐ hoḥ de nas mtha' skor gyi mkha' 'gro bzhi gtso bo nyid dang bcas pa 'od kyi gong bur gyur nas rang nyid kyi spyi bor thim pas dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs thob cing*/ mtshon byed dpe'i bla ma bsgom zhing bsgrub pa de dag kyang mtshon bya don gyi bla ma'i sprul bsgyur las ma 'das pa'i don gyi snying po rang gi rig pa gsal la dngos por ma grub pa/ stong la had por ma song ba/ de gnyis ya bral du ma yin pa'i rang sems kyi 'dug tshul lam babs tshul ji ltar snang ba de nyid kyi thog tu bzo bcos dgag sgrub blos byas gang yang mi bya bar/ rang gi rang ngo rig tsam du/ lhod de/ shig ge gu yangs cham 291) me ba 'jog pa ni yang dag don gyi bla ma'i rnal 'byor mthar thug pa yin te/ rang sems rang ngo rig pa de nyid bla ma chos sku'i rang zhal mjal ba yin tshe/ dus dang rnam pa kun tu/ 'gro 'dug za nyal/ skyid sdug nyin mtshan 'chi kha dang bcas pa'i dus thams cad du rang sems gang shar rang ngo rig pa bya ba dang mi 'bral ba ni/ bka' mdo rgyud lung man ngag phyag rdzogs sogs kun gyi dgongs don gcig tu mthun pa'i gnad kyi snying po dam pa lags shing*/ de ltar nyams su len pa'i tshe/ bzang ngan gyi rnam par rtog pa cazhag khyugs kyi byung ba dang*/ de la dgag sgrub sogs thabs dang gnyen po gzhan ci yang mi bya bar/ rnam rtog shar ba de ka rang ngo khrig gis rig par bya ba kho nas rnam rtog kho rang rang grol du 'gro ba chos nyid yin pas na/

bcos bslad gzhan gang yang mi dgos pa lags pas de ltar thugs dgongs zab mor bcags ngos/ dge sbyor gang byed pha ma sems can mkha' khyab thams cad rdzogs byang thob slad kho nar dmigs nas/ sgo gsum snyoms las su ma lus par dal 'byor don yod du mdzad 'tshal/ de ltar byin rlabs bla sgrub kyi bla ma'i rnal 'byor rtsa ba gsum gcig dril du sgrub 292) pa'i nyams len rgyun khyer 'di nyid/ 'tsho mdzad bsod nams rab brtan gyi don du/ rje btsun sog zlog pa chen po'i zhal gdams las byung ba ltar bkod pa dge// ༈ hūm̐/ chos sku kun bzang snang mtha'i dbyings chen las// longs sku rdor 'chang rigs lnga'i nya rgyas shar// sprul sku gdul bya'i rol mtshor shāka thub tshul// dbyer med pad+ma 'byung gnas spyi bos mchod// ma dag snang ngor dug lnga'i rgyu 'bras kun// dag pa chen po'i rang bzhin gzugs kyi sku// thod phreng rigs lnga ye shes rang gsal lha// gsol 'debs byin rlabs char chen dbab tu gsol// rnam shes tshogs brgyad gnas dag sprul pa brgyad// gang 'dul der snang cha lugs sgyu 'phrul gzugs// sna tshogs ngo mtshar phrin las mtshan brgyad shar// gsol 'debs byin rlabs char chen dbab tu gsol// dha na ko sha'i mtsho gling pad sdong las// mtshan dpe yongs rdzogs longs sku'i cha byas bltams// skal ldan rgyal po re skong 293)pad 'byung la// gsol 'debs byin rlabs= /rgyal srid chos kyis bskyangs nas smin grol bkod// dur khrod gnas byin mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dpon mdzad// pad+ma rgyal po khams gsum dbang sdud rje// gsol 'debs= /shes bya'i chos kun mkhyen pa'i rtse mor son// 'chi med 'ja' lus rdo rje'i tshe dbang grub// blo ldan mchog sred mkhas pa'i gtsug gi rgyan// gsol 'debs= /rdzu 'phrul thabs kyis za hor rgyal khams btul// paṇa chen lnga brgya'i dbus na zla med kyi// smra ba'i seng ge pad+ma sam bha wa// gsol 'debs=

/gnas chen brgyad du dpa' bo chen po'i gzugs// mi 'jigs brtul zhugs rol pas 'gro ba 'dul// nyi ma 'od zer he ru kaḥdapal mchog /gsol 'debs byin= /rdo rje'i gdan du ston pa'i rgyal tshab mdzad// log par smra ba'i lta sgrub ngan pa bsnubs// shākya seng ge bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ 294)/gsol 'debs= /phyi rol mu steg gdug pa'i ngan sngags dang*// log pa'i rdzu 'phrul thugs rje'i mthu yis bsgral// seng ge sgra sgrogs bdud las rnam par rgyal// gsol 'debs= /gangs can bod yul lha srin dregs pa'i tshogs// gtum drag brngam pa'i sprul bsgyur du mas btul// rdo rje gro lod gdul dka' 'dul ba'i dpal// gsol 'debs= /sgrub gnas byin rlabs chos gter 'jig rten bkang*// bod khams smin mdzad lho nub rnga yab gshegs// srin po'i kha gnon skye 'gro'i skyabs gcig pu// gsol 'debs byin= /bskal bzang rgyal ba stong gi bstan pa'i yun// de srid rnam 'phrul du mas 'gro ba 'dren// rgyal kun phrin las gcig bsdus gu ru rje// gsol 'debs byin rlabs char chen dbab tu gsol// bdag sogs mkha' khyab sems can sdug bsngal can// re sa gzhan med khyed kyi skyobs mdzod la// bar chad kun zhi chos kyi bsam don 'grub// pad 'byung sku gsung thugs dang gnyis 295)med mdzod// rgyal ba rab 'byams thugs rje'i bdag nyid kun// gcig bsdoms gdul dka'i 'gro ba 'dren pa'i dpal// khyab bdag pad+ma'i go 'phang bdag 'grub nas// 'khor ba dong sprugs chos nyid klong grol shog ces o rgyan rin po che sku gsum rigs lnga mtshan brgyad la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di ni dbon po bstan pa rig 'dzin mched bcas kyi bskul ngor bkod pa'o// gdod ma'i ye shes bri gang bral ba'i gnas lugs don// mkhas mang kun dang grub pa mchog brnyes ma lus kyis// yang dag gzigs pa'i dri bral pad+ma'i chos nyid ltar// yon tan legs rdzogs mchog dngos grub pa'i rgyur gyur gang*// spros kun zhi yang 'gags med rang rtsal bsam yas 'phro// phrin las rnam par rol pa'i bdag nyid rig pa'i sku// log rtog 'khrul 'dzin skyon las rnam par rab rgyal bas// sna tshogs snang ba'i bden zhen rang grol gnyug ma'i gshis// gzod ma nyid nas rang

296)la rang chas gnyis med bzhin// gnyis su bzung bas kun rtog phyir lta'i ra ri kun// da nas rang zhi rang dag chen po'i nges shes kyi// rang rig bla mar rang babs ngang nas gsol ba 'debs// tha dad min la tha dad 'dzin pa'i rmi lam dang*// 'du 'bral med la 'dus shing 'bral snang nying 'khrul tshogs// rang rig bla ma kun khyab chos skur sgrib mun la// bsal bzhag bral ba'i ye shes snang bas khyab mdzad gsol// gsol ba 'debs yul 'debs byed mkhan po bya rtsol gyi// dmigs mtshon 'jur mdud nam mkhar lto 'gro'i mdud ltar grol// bla med bla ma'i go 'phang mchog la mkha' mnyam gyi// ma rgan mtha' dag rab 'god srid zhi gtan sgrol shog ces pa 'di ni 7rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs mchog gi sprul sku bzang po'i zhabs kyi gsung gi sgyu 'phrul las/ bdag rgan po la gsol ba 'debs rgyu ming gi phreng bas bkra bar bgyis pa zhig dgos zhes bka' stsal bar brten/ 297) de lta bu'i dngos don ni sangs rgyas kyi sems can la gsol ba gdab par 'gro bas na 'os shing 'tshams pa'i don por ma gyur la/ 'on te ma phul na'ang bka'i chu klung bzlog pa'i rten 'brel log min du 'gyur dogs pas/ de bas na gsung gi gsang ba'i 'du 'god 'di la bsam mi khyab kyi dgongs pa gzhan dag yod par gor ma chags so zhes rang nyid la rang blos khel ba bgyis nas/ gnas 'di lta bu la spyi'i don dang yi ge'i don gyi 'jug par mi rung gi sbas pa'i don dang mthar thug gi don las brtsams te/ bla ma chos kyi sku la gsol ba 'debs pa'i brda don la rang ming gi phreng bas kyang mtshan par byas nas 'phul ba la bsgrib par ma gyur cig// na mo gu ru rat+na bh+yaḥ dpag tu med pa'i mkhyen brtse dang*// mi zad thugs rje'i gter mnga' ba// skyabs gnas dkon mchog bla ma la// bdag nyid gus pas skyabs su mchi// thog ma med nas las nyon gyis// 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor rab bying zhing*// sdug bsngal rgyu dang 'bras bus mnar// nyam thag bdag la thugs rjes gzigs// dal 'byor 'dzom pa'i lus thob kyang*// dam chos

298)tshul bzhin mi sgrub par// zin med 'jig rten bya bas g.yengs// skal dman bdag la thugs rjes gzigs// lang tsho'i nyi ma nub rir gzhol// nam 'chi cha med ya nga bar// phyi ma'i gtan 'dun mi 'grub pa'i// las ngan bdag la thugs rjes gzigs// sgyu ma'i phung po bor ba'i tshe// 'khor ba gar skyes sdug bsngal las// nam yang bde ba mi 'byung na// skyabs med bdag la thugs rjes gzigs// rtag tu sgo gsum dam chos la// sems kyang 'khor ba'i bag chags shugs// a 'thas 'khrul pa'i mgo 'khor gyis// rmongs pa bdag la thugs rjes gzigs// dus gsum dri med kun mkhyen pa'i// bla ma mchog dang sangs rgyas sras// skyabs gnas lha yi lha mchog rnams// dad ldan bdag la thugs rjes gzigs// re sa'i skyabs mchog bla ma la// kha zhe med pa'i mos gus kyis// gsol ba rtsa gcig 'debs lags na// thugs rje'i char chen dbab tu gsol// las nyon 299)sdig sgrib byang ba dang*// rkyen ngan bar chad kun zhi zhing*// chos thun 'dod dgu myur 'grub nas// lam sna zin par byin gyis rlobs// bla ma sangs rgyas byang sems dang*// yi dam mkha' 'gro chos srung tshogs// ma lus thugs rje'i nus stobs kyis// gsol ba btab don 'grub par shog ces pa 'di ni gnas chen po lha zhol nā ga ko ṭa'i pho brang dam pa nas/ rgyal sras sprul pa'i skyed yum rdo rje bu khrid kyi bzhed pa skong phyir mtha' khob kyi ri khrod nas phul ba dge/ ma lus rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bsam yas kun// dbyer med rdo rje'i slob dpon skur rdzogs pa'i// ngo mtshar rnam thar rgyan gyi rol pa la// bdag yid dad pas gsol ba snying nas 'debs// 'od dpag med mgon chos sku'i rang mdangs las// spyan ras gzigs dbang gzugs sku'i 'od dkar shar// pad+ma 'byung gnas sprul sku chu zla'i gar// gdul bya'i zhing kun khyab la gsol ba 'debs/

300)/mngal skyon dri bral pad+ma'i lhums nas 'khrungs// rgyal po'i sras mdzad rgyal khams chos la bkod// gnas chen dur khrod brtul zhugs rtsal gyis bcags// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i gtso la gsol ba 'debs// shākya'i bstan zhugs rig pa'i gnas kun mkhyen// 'chi med sku grub bdud dang mu stegs btul// chos kyi sgron mes rgyal bstan gsal bar mdzad// ston pa'i rgyal tshab mchog la gsol ba 'debs// gangs can bod du gdug pa'i 'dre srin btul// sa gzhi byin brlabs gtsug lag 'dus sdes bkangs// dus gsum lung bstan zab gter chos mdzod gtams// snyigs mtha'i 'gro mgon mchog la gsol ba 'debs// rnga yab gling byon srin
