po'i kha gnon bzhugs// dus bzang tshes bcur sprul pas bod khams 'gengs// nam mkhas gar khyab thugs rje'i bkod pas khyab// skyabs gnas kun 'dus rje la gsol ba 'debs/ 301)/ris med bstan la sprul pa'i mdzad phrin ni// bsam mi khyab kyang bdag sogs 'dul skal du// snyigs dus 'dren mchog 'dzam gling grags pa nyid// sprul pa'i 'phreng bar byon la gsol ba 'debs// thams cad ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma'i skur// lhun gyis rdzogs la nges shes rtse gcig gis// dus gsum rgyun du gsol ba 'debs pa'i bu// brtse bas skyong zhing byin gyis brlab tu gsol// 'di nas mthar thug byang chub ma thob bar// de srid skyabs gnas bla ma mchog khyed kyi// gdul byar gyur nas sgo gsum smin cing grol// rang gzhan don kun chos kyis 'grub par shog ces o rgyan rin po che la rnam thar gyi sgo nas gsol ba 'debs pa mdor bsdus 'di ni/ skyabs mchog rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs bzang po'i zhabs kyi phyag phyi ba bsod nams rab mdzes pas bskul ngor bkod pa'o// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ kun khyab chos dbyings dag pa'i snod chen por// rang rig 302) lhan skyes ye shes bdud rtsis bkang*// tshogs drug 'dod yon 'dzin med rang grol gyi// mchod pa 'khor 'das dus gsum yongs khyab 'di// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba kun gtso sman gyi bla// rigs lnga yi dam lha tshogs mkha' 'gro ma// drang srong rig 'dzin brgyud bcas bka' srung tshogs// mchod 'os skyabs gnas ma lus mchod par bgyi// rang lus snang stong rta phag yab yum dang*// sems nyid gdod ma'i ye shes gu ṇa rje// 'gag med rig rtsal rnam rol ḍā kir bcas// rang rig 'du 'bral med pa'i bdud rtsis mchod// phyi nang snod bcud rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor la// dngos 'byor yid sprul zag med bdud rtsi yi// mchod pa phul bas bdag sogs 'gro ba kun// dam chos bdud rtsis smin cing grol bar shog

ces gso ba rig pa 'dzin pa rnams la phan phyir bla sgrub sdug bsngal mun sel dang mthun pa'i ja mchod 'di nyid bla ma drung 'tsho ba gzhan phan bzang pos bskul ba mdzad 303) pa'i ngor bkod pa dge legs 'phel// e ma/ gdod ma'i khyab bdag kun bzang rdo rje 'chang*// 'og min zhing du sman rgyal rigs lngar bstan// bai ḍūr+ya zhing mchog sprul sman gyi bla// dbyer med mahā gu ṇar gsol ba 'debs// dpal ldan 'phreng ba klu sgrub dpa' bo dang*// 'tsho byed gzhon nu skyes bu me lha sogs// 'phags yul 'chi med dgos 'dod stsol mkhas kun// gcig bsdus ma hā gu ṇar gsol ba 'debs// pad+ma 'byung gnas dam pa sangs rgyas dang*// zla 'od gzhon nu mnyam nyid rdo rje sogs// snyigs dus 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon thams cad kyi// ngo bo ma hā gu ṇar gsol ba 'debs// 'gro ba'i las nyon rgyu 'bras zug rngu kun// sel mdzad gso rig brgyud pa'i bla ma dang*// drin can rtsa ba'i bla mar bcas rnams kyi// spyi gtsug ma hā gu ṇar gsol ba 'debs// bdag dang mkha' mnyam pha ma sems can rnams/ 304)/dug gsum nad dang 'khrul pa'i gdon gyis gzir// 'di las skyobs mdzad skyabs mchog bla ma rje// brtser gzigs byang chub go 'phang sar 'god gsol/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā gu ru gu ṇa sid+dhi hūm̐/ zhes pa 'di yang 'tsho mdzad gzhan phan bzang pos bskul ba don ldan du bgyis pa'o// phyogs dus rgyal ba sras bcas ma lus pa'i// thugs rje mnyam med 'dzam gling grags pa'i sku// gcig bsdus dpal ldan phrin las bzang po'i zhabs// dad brgya'i gtsug mtshor rdo rje'i sku brtan zhing*// rang rig dngos stobs yongs 'dzin thugs rje'i bdag /'gro kun bde chen ye shes dbang bsgyur gyi// phrin las zhi drag du mas chos nyid gzhir// klong grol rnam 'dren mchog la gsol ba 'debs// sna tshogs gdul bya'i skal ba dang mthun par// ral grol phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub kyis// bdag sogs mkha' mnyam 'gro kun smin mdzad de// tshe gcig
305)sangs rgyas thob nas gang 'dul gyi// rnam 'phrul bstan pa'i sgron me 'gyed par shog

ces dad pa'i yul gyur rnam pa gsum la gsol ba 'debs pa smon lam gyi mtha' rten dang bcas pa nyung ngur bsdus pa dgos zhes dad ldan ma ṇi bha dras bskul ba ltar bkod pa ste mtshan rnams mtshal yig tu bris pa las shes par bya rgyu'o// na mo gu ru rat+na sarba sid+dhi hūm̐/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems yi dam lha// bla ma brgyud bcas mkha' 'gro chos skyong sogs// mtshan dang rnam 'gyur cha lugs cir bstan yang*// rtsa ba'i bla ma'i ngo bor thag chod pa'i// nges shes dad pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// bdag gi sgo gsum maṇ+ḍal mchod par 'bul// dam tshig nyam chag ci mchis snying nas bshags// ci mdzad legs par mthong ba'i yi rang 'bul// mkha' mnyam 'gro la thugs rje'i chos 'khor bskul// skye 'chi 'pho 'gyur bral ba'i skur bzhugs gsol// bdag gis dge ba'i rtsa ba gang bsags 306)kun// rje btsun khyed kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs phyir bsngo'o// 'di phyi bar do tshe rabs kun tu ni// skyid sdug legs nyes bzang ngan ci byung yang*// drin can skyabs mchog khyed nyid ma gtogs pa// re yul gzhan na med pas gsol ba 'debs// dmigs med thugs rje phyogs ris med na yang*// gsol 'debs bu la lhag par brtse ba can// khyod kyi thugs dgongs zag med mkha' klong las// byin rlabs rgyun chad med pa'i dngos grub stsol// dam chos snying po skyed rdzogs zung 'jug don// theg pa'i yang rtse rdzogs pa chen po'i bcud// bdag rgyud smin cing grol ba'i bka' drin stsol// mchog gi dngos grub thob par byin gyis rlobs// lam log 'khrul pa'i bar chad mi 'byung shog /bdag 'dzin chags sdang zhen pas mi 'ching shog /sa lam nyams rtogs yon tan mthar phyin shog /sku gsum mngon gyur 'gro don lhun grub shog ces pa 'di bla ma shākya bstan 'phel gyis bskul bar mdzad pa'i ngor

307) sgod phug brag gi yang dben du bris pa'i dge legs bkra shis kyi char chen dad ldan gdul bya'i zhing la 'bab par gyur cig// rang gi spyi gtsug 'ja' 'od 'khyil ba'i klong*// pad+ma nyi zla brtsegs pa'i gdan gyi steng*// drin can rje btsun rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid// o rgyan slob dpon pad+ma'i cha lugs can// pad zhwa rgod ldem dar dpyangs dbu la mdzes// phod ka chos gos ber gyi na bzas brjid// rdo rje thod pa kha ṭ+wam̐ phyag mtshan bsnams// dkar dmar mdangs ldan zhi 'dzum mdzes pa'i sku// rdo rje skyil krung bag dro lhun chags bzhugs// snang la rang bzhin ma grub 'od kyi sku'i// spyi bo mgrin pa snying ga'i gnas gsum la// 'ja' 'od lnga ldan thig le re yi nang*// oṃ dkar āḥdamar hūm̐ mthing gsum gyis mtshan// skyabs gnas kun 'dus ma hā gu ru la// bdag gi sgo gsum gtan 'dun mchod par 'bul// 'di bzung byang chub bar du thugs rjes bzung*// tshe gcig sangs rgyas 308)'grub pa'i dngos grub stsol/ ces mos pas bskyed la/ bar 'dir gsol 'debs le'u bdun dang gzhan yang gu ru'i gsol 'debs gang mang*/ rtsa ba'i bla ma'i gsol 'debs sogs ji tsam nus pa byas la/ de nas nyams len dngos ni/ spyi bo'i bla ma la mos gus rtse gcig ma yengs pa'i ngang nas gsal 'debs kyi sngags/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐/ zhes nyin mtshan 'gro 'dug nam du'ang rgyun ma chad par bzlas pas chog cing*/ skabs skabs su bla ma'i gnas gsum gyi yig 'bru gsum las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum 'phros pa rang gi spyi bo mgrin pa snying ga gsum du thim pas/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin brlabs dang dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs thob pa'i mos pa bya/ gzhan yang dus rtag tu bla ma spyi bor 'bral med bzhugs pa la mos gus kha zhe med par rtse gcig tu bya ba dang*/ khyad par 'jigs skrag

na tsha/ rkyen ngan/ sdug bsngal/ 'chi ba dang bcas pa ci byung yang de ma thag bla ma dran par byas la sems gzhan du ma yengs par blo khel ba gcig pus chog shi khar bla ma spyi bor bzhugs pa la sems rtse gcig gtad na 309) 'pho ba de las lhag pa bya rgyu med pa dang*/ lar nyams su len nus tshe 'di'i nyams len 'di gcig pus chog pas na/ gsol 'debs kyi bzlas pa rgyun chad med par 'bad par bya'o/ zhes bla ma'i rnal 'byor snying por dril ba 'di nyid yon tan dbang phyug gis bskul ngor rgod phug mya ngan med pa'i nags khrod du bkod pa dge'o// bdag nyid phung khams skye mched bzod ma nas// yi dam lha yi dkyil 'khor lhun grub pa'i// snying ga'i mi shigs thig le 'od lnga'i klong*// bka' brgyud bla ma skyabs gnas kun ngo bo// mtshan grangs du mar bstan yang re zhig 'dir// bai ro'i 'od zer sna tshogs rang grol ni// dkar dwangs 'dzam gling grags pa'i zhal dbyibs ltar// mdzes 'dzum brtse ba'i nyams ldan gzugs bzang ba// chos gos rnam gsum pan zhwa leb zhar gsol// chos 'chad mnyam bzhag skyil krung zhi dul tshul// sna tshogs pad+ma'i steng du 'od skur bzhugs// zhal mthong tsam gyi tshe 'di'i snang ba 'gag 310)/dran pa tsam gyi 'khrul pa'i 'dzin pa zhi// gsol ba btab pas ting 'dzin sgo brgya 'byed// byin rlabs thugs rje'i bdag nyid bla ma la// 'khor 'das snod bcud bdag lus gtan 'dun bcas// mchod par 'bul gyi tshe gcig 'di nyid la// khyed dang dbyer med 'grub pa'i dngos grub stsol/ gu ru rat+na maṇ+ḍa la pū dza me gha sa mu tra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ zhes pa'ang rig 'dzin chos nyid glong grol dpal bzang po'i thugs bzhed ltar rgod tshang phug nas phul ba maṅga laṃ// mtshungs bral chos kyi rje rgyal sras rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ bdag la rang ming gsal por byas pa'i gsol 'debs rgyun khyer du byas chog pa dgos shes bka' phebs na'ang*/

spyir yang gsol ba gdab yul du rung ba ni skyon kun zad cing yon tan thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig dgos mod kyi/ bdag 'dra las nyon gyi rgya mtshor kun rtog gi rba rlabs drag por 'khrug pas dbang med du bskyod bzhin pa mngon sum tshad mas grub gda' bar gsol ba btab rung 311) gdab pa po ngal ba'i rgyud zad mod la/ de bas kyang*/ sangs rgyas byang sems bka' brgyud bla ma thugs rje'i gter ldan rnams la gsol ba gdab pa legs shing*/ 'on kyang bzhed don gyi bka' stsal zhal log tu ma gyur tsam kho na la bsam te/ 'di bzhin phul ba lags kyi des na rgyal ba rnams kyi thugs ye shes kyi snying po ni/ sems can kun gyi khams dbang rtog tshogs thams cad dang tha mi dad par rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor nyid du ye grub chen po'i rgyas bkab cing*/ gnas skabs su yang gsol 'debs kyi brjod byar bdag gi ming tsam smos kyang mos gus kyi 'ben gyi gtad so ni/ rgyal dbang pad+ma kā ra/ dran mchog 'dzam gling grags pa/ rje btsun bha dra badz+ra rnams dbyer ma mchis pa'i gsang gsum mi zad rgyan 'khor la rtse gcig phur tshugs su yid gtod pa'i ngang nas grags stong mgrin pa'i rnga sgra 'di ltar du bsgrag par zhu'o// e ma hoḥ gdod nas dag pa'i sems nyid 'od gsal ba// 'gags med sgyu 'phrul bla ma'i snang ba shar// 'char mkhan 'char rgyu gnyis med ye grol 312)che// sna tshogs rang grol zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// srid zhi 'khor 'das bla ma'i dkyil 'khor la// dag dang ma dag gnyis 'dzin 'jur mdud zad// de nyid mkhas mchog pad+ma legs sgrub rtsal// rang snang 'dzin med ngo bor gsol ba 'debs// ma lus rgyal ba'i mkhyen rtse'i nyi gzhon 'bum// gdul bya'i blo mun sel la ro gcig par// mngon gyur karma rig 'dzin rnam par rgyal// nges legs lam bzang snang la gsol ba 'debs// rgyal rnams 'gro ba'i don las gzhan mi mdzad// thugs rje'i 'od la gsal 'grib mi mnga' yang*// bdag blo'i re ba ma rdzogs gdung shugs kyi// gsol ba btab la dbyings nas dgongs par mdzod// snang grags rtog tshogs bla ma'i dkyil 'khor du// lhun gyi grub kyang ma rig lhan skyes kyis// 'khrul pas mun ldongs bdag dang bdag 'dra'i tshogs// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i 'gro la thugs rjes gzigs// mtshan dpe bzang po rdo rje sku'i ngo bo// chos gsung 'jam dpal

313)phyogs mthar grags pa'i dbyangs// sgrib bral pad+ma'i 'byung gnas zab dbyangs thugs// ye shes 'khor lo ro gcig bla ma mkhyen/ kye ho/ skyabs kun ngo bo gcig bsdus pa// bla ma sangs rgyas chos kyi sku// rang rig gnyug ma'i ye shes su// 'du 'bral med par byin gyis rlobs// rang la gnas pa'i chos nyid don// rang ngo ma shes gnyis 'dzin gyi// 'khor ba'i khams su 'khyams pa las// rang grol mdzod cig drin can ma// bde sdug sems kyi btags pa la// dngos 'dzin a 'thas gdon gyis rlams// rang snang gzhan du 'khrul pa 'di// gtan zad mdzod cig nus ldan rnams// srid pa'i bde 'byor sgyu ma'i 'phrul// mi rtag 'jig pa'i chos can la// zhen chags rang mgo rang bslu'i sems// yongs grol mdzod cig skyabs mchog rnams// bdag dang 'brel thogs ji snyed dang*// mkha' khyab ma rgan 314)sems can gyi// ltos yul bla ma rje las med// 'bral med thugs rjes skyabs mdzad gsol// bla ma sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang yi dam lha// mkha' 'gro dam can chos srung zhes bya'i rnam 'gyur mtshan// mtha' dag drin can rje btsun bla mar dbyer med gang*// rang sems ma bcos rang babs klong du e ma ho/ zhes pa 'di yang rig 'dzin chos nyid klong grol dpal bzang po gang gi thugs bzhed bskong ba'i slad du/ dpal ri'i rgod phug nas mi rgan sna tshogs rang grol gyis phul ba maṅga lam// na mo gu ru/ spyi bo'i gtsug na pad+ma nyi zla'i steng*// ngo bo drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid// skyabs mchog rgyal dbang pad+ma 'byung gnas sku// mdzes 'dzum mtshan dpe gzi brjid 'od du 'bar// pad zhwa zab ber chos gos na bza' dang*// rin chen snyan rgyan la sogs mdzes par spras// rdo rje thod pa kha ṭ+wam̐ phyag mtshan ldan// snang la rang bzhin ma grub 'ja' 'od skur// rdo rje skyil 315)krung bag dro lhun chags bzhugs// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong dang*// sangs rgyas byang sems dkon mchog rin po che// thams cad gcig tu 'dus pa'i ngo bo nyid// bdag sogs 'khor ba'i sems can skyabs med tshogs// 'di phyi bar do'i gnas skabs nam du'ang*// 'bral med thugs rjes gzigs shig byin gyis rlobs// tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'grub pa'i dngos grub zhu'o/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐/ zhes dad pa dang mos gus rtse gcig pa'i ngang nas gsol 'debs kyi bzlas pa 'di la gcig dril du 'bad cing*/ na tsha sdug bsngal legs nyes 'jigs skrag 'khrul snang rkyen ngan bar chad kyi rnam pa ci dang ci lta bu byung kyang*/ spyi bo'i bla ma dran zhing gsol 'debs la blo khel ba gal che ba dang*/ 'chi kha'i dus su yang rnam par rtog pa gzhan du ma yengs par spyi bo'i bla ma nyid la dad 'dun rtse gcig pa'i ngang la dbugs song nas ngan song gi skye sgo khegs nus pa'i lam khyer gcig dril du thugs 316) nyams su zhes 'tshal/ zhes pa 'di yang rgyal yum rdo rje bu khrid kyi thugs bzhed skong phyir phul// na mo gu ra we/ lhar bcas 'jig rten ma lus thams cad kyi// skyabs dang skyob par gyur pa'i sangs rgyas kun// gcig bsdus thugs rje'i 'dod 'jo zla med pa'i// dpal ldan bla ma mchog zhabs spyi bos 'dud// gang la gang gis 'dul ba'i phrin las kyi// sgyu 'phrul chu snod ji snyed mtshungs pa'i zla// bgrang yas so skye'i blo yi yul min kyang*// rang skal 'tshams par ston mdzad bla mar 'dud// mgon po zas gtsang sras kyi bstan 'di la// grub pa'i rig 'dzin gtsug rgyan sam bha wa// gangs can sgrub rgyud rtsa lag 'dzam gling grags// rnam 'dren nyi zla zung der gsol ba 'debs// de nyid slar yang snyigs mtha'i 'gro 'dren du// mchog sprul mtshan dpe'i skur byon su badz+ra// sgrub pa'i srog shing pad+ma su sid+dhi// gang 'dul der snang zung 317)la gsol ba 'debs// rgyal bstan lha lam yangs pa'i dbyings chen du// bstan pa rab 'byams rgyu skar rnam bkra ba'i// chos dang chos don dri med la spyod pa// kun la dag snang ris med gsol ba 'debs// snang grags srid gsum bzod nas yongs dag pa'i// bde gshegs snying pos ma khyab gnas med phyir// thams cad rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor lhun grub tu// rtogs shing nges pa'i sgo nas gsol ba 'debs// de ltar gsol ba btabs pa'i don gyi snying*// bdag gzhan nam mkha' khyab pa'i sems can rnams// rang ngo rang rig rang byung chos sku dngos// lhan skyes dri mas ma sgribs mthong bar shog

/gsol ba 'debs yul 'debs mkhan gnyis 'dzin gyi// sbrul mdud chos nyid mkha' la rang grol te// sku gnyis mngon gyur srid pa ji srid bar// sprul pas 'gro ba 'dren las g.yel med shog ces pa'i gsol 'debs 'di nyid/ rgyal ba shākya'i rgyal tshab 318) mtshungs pa med pa bdag nyid chen po gu ṇa rat+na'i rigs dang chos kyi ring lugs yang dag par 'dzin pa'i skyes chen mthu stobs bstan 'dzin dbang po'i sde'i bka' bzhin/ spong ba rgan po sna tshogs rang grol gyis bris nas phul ba maṅga lam// e ma ho/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mkhyen brtse// thugs rje nus pa kun gcig bsdus// 'jigs med dga' ba yi rdo rje// gsol ba snying nas rang 'debs so// snyigs dus chos med kyi ser gzugs// log 'tsho dkor dred kyi tshogs la// gdams ngag rnam thar gyis ston mdzad// sna tshogs rang grol zhabs mkhyen no// dam pa rnam gnyis kyi thugs rje// nye ring phyogs ris dang bral yang*// las nyon 'khrul rtog gis rmongs pa'i// gdul bya bdag 'dra la gzigs dang*// skye ba grangs med nas da bar// 'khor bar gtan khyams su lus te// thar pa'i go skabs kyis dben la// brtse bas lam sna zhig ston dang*// mi lus lan gcig tsam thob 'dir// dam pa'i lha chos rang bsam kyang*/ 319) /snyoms las le lo la 'chor na// sgo gsum smin grol du mdzod dang*// rang sems bzo med du bzhag kyang*// rnam rtog rba rlabs kyis bskyod nas// bag chags ngan rjes su 'breng na// gang shar rang grol du mdzod dang*// mi tshe rmi lam gyi yun tsam// 'khrul snang zhen 'dzin la 'byams 'di// gtan chod nyams len la cig dril// nus par byin gyis rang rlobs shig /'di nas tshe rabs kyi 'phreng bar// rje btsun rnam gnyis kyi rjes bzung*// rang gzhan don gnyis kun myur 'grub// sangs rgyas go 'phang la 'khod mdzod/

ces pa'i mthar/ skyabs mchog bla ma rin chen rnam gnyis mkhyen no/ zhes brgya stong khri 'bum grangs med du gsol ba rtse gcig gdab par bya'o/ de ltar gsol ba 'debs pa 'di ni/ mnyam med zla 'od gzhon nu'i rigs dbon ma rnams pa las 'khrungs pa'i sku mdun chos mdzad ma rig 'dzin dbang mo'i bzhed skongs su spong ba pa legs grub rtsal gyi mtshams nas phul ba shu bham/

320)kye ho/ phyogs dus kyi rgyal ba ma lus pa'i// spyi gzugs la dpal ldan bla ma zhes// mdo rgyud dang man ngag kun la grags// mos gus kyis gsol ba snying nas 'debs// chos dbyings kyi dgongs klong ro gcig kyang*// gdul bya la 'dul byed tha dad kyi// zlos gar nyid mi zad rgyan 'khor lor// sprul bsgyur du mdzad la gsol ba 'debs// gsang sngags kyi ston pa pad+ma 'byung*// gangs can gyi mgon po 'dzam gling grags// gsar snying gi bstan pa'i gtsug rgyan mchog /rtsod med du gyur la gsol ba 'debs// zab gter gyi mnga' bdag 'ja' mtshon snying*// snyigs dus kyi skyabs gcig bzang po'i zhabs// sgrub rgyud kyi srol 'dzin legs grub rtsal// mchog gsum gyi ngo bor gsol ba 'debs// rab 'byams kyi zhing kun yongs gang ba'i// bstan pa dang bstan 'dzin rnam dag kun// sangs rgyas kyi phrin las ro mnyam par// ris med kyi dad pas gsol ba 321)'debs// skyabs gnas kun 'gro ba'i don chen las// g.yel maid la bsnyel ba'i skabs bral yang*// bdag yid kyi re 'dod ma zad pas// gdung shugs kyi 'bad la thugs rjes dgongs// las ngan gyi sgrib tshogs dag pa dang*// 'gal rkyen gyi bar chad zhi ba dang*// chos bzhin gyi bsam pa kun 'grub par// byin gyis rang rlobs shig bla ma rnams// mi tshe 'di chos kyi 'da' ba dang*// chos min gyi bsam pa mi skye bar// chos phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub kyis// tshe gcig byang chub la 'god par shog ces pa 'di dpal ldan sgam po pa'i gdung rigs dri ma med pa las 'khrungs pa'i lcam mo chos nyid dbang mo'i bzhed pa skong phyir/ sna tshogs rang grol gyi ming 'dzin pa'i spong pa rgan pos phul // gsol 'debs 'di'i mjug tu/ rgyal ba kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma mkhyen no/ zhes pa yang brgya stong sogs ci nus 'phreng ba la 'dran pa yang byin rlabs lhag par myur ba lags so//

322)mtshungs pa med pa'i sku drin stsol mdzad pa'i// rje btsun dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid// dgongs pa sangs rgyas kun dang dbyer med kyang*// gang 'dul skyes rabs ston der gsol ba 'debs// thub dbang nye gnas 'phags pa kun dga' bo// srong btsan spyan sngar thon mi sam+bho ṭa// o rgyan drung du lo chen bai ro'i zhabs// bstan pa'i sgron me rnams la gsol ba 'debs// rngog lo chen po blo ldan shes rab dang*// sa skya paṇa chen g.yag sde paṇa chen dang*// paṇa chen 'bum phrag gsum pa bya 'dul 'dzin// mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan rnams la gsol ba 'debs// khyung po rnal 'byor dpal chen chos ye dang*// gnyal ston sangs rgyas grags dang zur khar ba// rdza yig chos rje tshul khrims rgyal mtshan sogs// grub pa'i dbang phyug rnams la gsol ba 'debs// gter ston rdo rje gling dang kun skyong gling*// g.yag char sngon mo bsam gtan bde chen gling*// mchog 323)ldan mgon po shes rab 'od zer sogs// zab gter mnga' bdag rnams la gsol ba 'debs// bskal pa'i mtha' ma rtsod ldan snyigs dus 'dir// mdo sngags zung 'jug khyad par snga 'gyur gyi// bstan pa spel mdzad bstan 'dzin rdo rje dang*// sna tshogs rang grol zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// sangs rgyas mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab phyir// las lus gcig las gcig brgyud ma yin te// sku gsung thugs yon phrin las rnam 'phrul tshogs// dpag med 'gro ba 'dren der gsol ba 'debs// de ltar sprul pa'i rnam grangs 'di dang gzhan// phyogs bcu'i zhing khams kun tu rdul snyed sku// ji snyed rnams la mos pas gsol btab pa'i// dge bas bdag sogs bla ma mchog 'grub shog /sgo gsum nyams chags dri mas mo sa shing*// zhabs tog rnam gsum mnyes pa mthar phyin 224)te// sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs dngos grub kun// bdag gi rgyud la deng 'dir 'jug par shog

/'di nas byang chub bar gyi skyabs gnas mchog /rje btsun bla ma las gzhan mi sems shing*// gang gi mdzad phrin yon tan de 'drar bdag /myur 'grub mkha' khyab sems can smin grol shog ces pa 'di yang rang gi gcung pos bskul pa bzhin bkod pa'o// dpal ldan tshogs gnyis thugs rje'i sprin phung las// byin rlabs ye shes bdud rtsi'i char chen gyis// dad ldan gdul bya'i zhing sar byang chub kyi// myu gu smin mdzad rje btsun chos kyi rgyal// dpag med bskal pa'i gong nas thugs bskyed de// khams gsum 'gro la brtse ba'i gzhan dbang gis// rmad byung rnam 'phrul mtha' yas 'gyed mdzad pa'i// thugs rje'i bdag nyid bla ma rin po che// bdag sogs rtsod ldan snyigs ma'i gdul bya rnams// las nyon sdug bsngal 'khrul 'khor drag pos g.yengs// bslu byed tshe 'di'i 'dun mas 325)mi tshe zad// dal 'byor stong log mkhan la thugs rjes gzigs// nam 'chi cha med de yang myur du 'chi// 'chi khar dgos nges dam pa'i lha chos la// 'bad par ma nus lto gos rtsol bas mnar// snyoms las le lo can la brtse bas gzigs// 'chi ba'i nangs par cis kyang mi stongs shing*// dge sdig rgyu 'bras bslu med rjes 'brang zhing*// 'khor ba gang skyes bde ba'i go skabs med// de las skyobs phyir thar pa'i lam du drongs// da res dal 'byor legs thob chos dang mjal// gtan gyi 'dun ma bsgrub pa'i dus gcig 'dir// bar chad ngan rkyen dbang du mi 'gyur bar// byang chub lam sna zin par byin gyis rlobs// dam tshig sdom ldan thos bsam bsgom la brtson// bla ma mnyes shing 'gro la phan pa 'grub// rang don mthar phyin gzhan don lhun grub par// gsol btab smon lam don ldan 'byung bar shog 326) ces pa 'di ni/ yon tan dbang phyug gis bskul ngor bris pa'o// sgrib bral ye shes mchog gi gzigs pa ni// rtag par g.yel ba med pa'i skyabs mchog rje// khams gsum zla med rgyal ba 'ja' tshon snying*// snying nas gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes gzigs// don dam skye 'chi'i mtshan ma mi mnga' yang*// ltar snang gzugs sku'i nyi ma dbyings nub na// 'khor ba'i mun 'khyams ltos bcas bu 'bangs rnams// lam ston ye shes sgron me su la re// chos nyid bde chen dag pa'i dgongs klong nas// 'gags med mkhyen brtse rol pa'i thugs rje'i 'phrul// rmad byung phrin las sgo brgya phyes mdzod la// bdag sogs mkha' khyab gdul bya drang tu gsol/

ces pa ni rig 'dzin chen po de nyid dgongs pa chos kyi dbyings su thim pa'i tshe gdung pas gsol ba btab pa'o// mi mjed zhing gi ston pa shākya'i dbang*// mchog gsang gdul bya'i skal ngor rdo rje 'chang*// kha ba can du bdud 'dul pad+ma 'byung*// dbyer med 'dzam gling grags par 327)gsol ba 'debs// de nyid rtsod ldan mtha' ma'i gdul bya la// dpal ldan bzang po dga' ba'i rdo rje sprul// chos nyid klong grol pad+ma legs grub bcas// skyabs mchog rnam gsum zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// rab 'byams zhing khams rgya mtsho'i sangs rgyas kun// drin can bla ma gcig pu'i zlos gar du// yin par shes pa'i dad pa brtan po yis// gsol ba 'debs la thugs rjes gzigs su gsol// tshad med mkhyen brtse rmad byung nus stobs mthus// bdag sogs mkha' khyab sems can las nyon gyi// bag chags 'khrul 'khor sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras la// gtan du spyod 'di yang dag lam du drongs// 'jig rten 'khrul zhen snang ba bzlog tu gsol// nyon mongs dug lnga'i gcong rnying sbyang du gsol// nga bdag 'dzin pa'i khang khyim sgyel du gsol// 'khor ba'i sa bon drungs nas phyung du gsol// deng nas byang chub mngon du ma gyur bar// rnam 'dren dam pa'i 328)zhabs pad nyer bsten zhing*// zab gsang chos mdzod thob nas nyams blangs te// smin grol go 'phang sa lam mthar phyin shog /'gal rkyen nyer 'tshe med cing sku gnyis 'grub// smon lam thugs rje'i stobs kyi mkha' mnyam 'dren// dpal ldan bla ma'i phrin las rji snyed kun// bdag gis 'grub par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes pa 'di ni rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs rje btsun bzang po'i zhabs kyi mnyes gsung sgrub pa'i nye gnas pa thub bstan rab dga'i bzhed pa ji lta bar/ rgan po pad+ma legs grub kyis chos dbyings 'od gsal rtse mo'i dben khrod nas phul ba maṅga laṃ/

bha wan+tu/ na mo gu ru/ sems nyid gdod nas dag pa'i ngo bo gang*// bla ma chos kyi sku ru lhun gyis grub// rang babs ma bcos ngang nas gsol ba 'debs// khyab gdal chos dbyings klong nas byin gyis rlobs// 'gag med rang gsal ye shes zang thal gang*// bla ma longs spyod rdzogs sku'i rang bzhin shar// 'dzin med blo 'das ngang nas gsol ba 'debs// shar grol dus 329)mnyam chen por byin gyis rlobs// sna tshogs cir yang 'char ba'i sgyu 'phrul gang*// bla ma sprul pa'i sku ru ma gyur med/ dgag sgrub rang grol ngang nas gsol ba 'debs/ yengs med dran rig 'khor yug byin gyis rlobs// gzugs snang bla ma sprul skur shes pa dang*// grags tshad bla ma longs skur rang grol zhing*// rtog tshogs bla ma chos skur ro gcig pas// las snang chags sdang rjes su ma 'breng shog /'khrul pa'i ngo bo gzhi la ma grub kyang*// med bzhin snang ba'i bag chags ngan goms 'dis// 'khor ba thog mtha'i bar med gtan phung bsgrubs// da nas gzhi med rtsa bral klong grol shog /bla ma'i mchog rab rang sems sangs rgyas la// mos gus snying po rang rig dran pa yis// gsol ba 'debs mkhan 'debs yul ro mnyam mthus// byin rlabs phyag rgya chen po mngon gyur shog /'khor ba myang 'das dngos po mtshan ma'i gzugs// ye nas mi dmigs chos skur 330)ro gcig kyang*// de ltar ma rtogs rmi lam lta bu'i 'gro// thams cad gdod ma'i ye shes la 'god shog ces pa 'di bla ma mi pham bstan pa'i rdo rje'i bzhed pa skongs phyir spong ba pa rgan po sna tshogs rang grol gyi ming 'dzin pas/ shar phyogs kong po'i yul mtha' zad pa'i nags khrod nas phul ba maṅga laṃ/ chos dbyings ye shes sgyu ma'i rol pa las// thugs rje mtshan dpe'i skur snang ngo mtshar gter// gdul bya'i blo mun sel ba'i nyi ma mchog /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs pad gcug gis mchod// rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab mnyam med 'dzam gling grags// snyigs dus gdul bya'i mgon du slar byon nas// sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i sgron me sprul pa'i sku// bzang po rdo rje'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// thugs rjes gzigs shig

thugs rjes gzigs shig thugs rjes gzigs shig chos sku'i rang zhal mthong bar byin gyis rlobs shig /rgyal ba'i gdung las rgyal ba dngos byon nas// rgyal bstan dri med 'dzin skyong spel ba yi// mdzad phrin mchog tu 331)gyur pa'i zla 'od can// chos nyid klong grol zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// thugs rjes gzigs= /ma rig 'khrul zhen dag par byin gyis rlobs shig /snyigs dus nyon mongs phung po'i chos gzugs rnams// rang rgyud dred por 'chor ba'i gcong chen la// thabs mkhas thugs rje'i sman gyi gso mdzad pa// sna tshogs rang grol zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// thugs rjes gzigs shig= /gang shar lam du lhongs bar byin gyis rlobs shig /sangs rgyas thams cad bla ma'i ngo bor 'dus// mtshon byed dpe yi bla ma rnam gsum dang*// mtshon bya don gyi bla ma rang rig 'di// dbyer med gdod ma'i ye shes mngon gyur te// mkha' khyab 'gro ba sangs rgyas sar 'god shog ces pa 'di dad ldan sgam po ye shes rab gsal gyi bskul ngo ltar bris pa'o// bskal bzang 'dren pa stong gi gser ri'i dbus// thugs rje'i mthu stobs mngon 'phags lhun po'i dbang*// zas gtsang sras kyi rgyal tshab thu bo ru/ 332)/dbang skur zla 'od gzhon nur gyur pa nyid// lnga bdo'i rnam 'gyur dar ba'i bsil ldan yul// gang 'dir bstan gnyis sgron ma sbar ba'i mgon// lha lam khyab pa'i dbus nas 'gran bral nyid// 'dzam gling grags pa'i 'od zer tshar dngar gdung*// dri med sgrub rgyud bstan srog 'dzin pa'i dpal// chos nyid ji bzhin gzigs pa mngon gyur gyis// chos can ji snyed ye shes klong grol ba'i// 'dren pa mchog khyed bskal brgyar zhabs brtan gsol// rgyal dgongs gdod nas yongs dag 'gyur med gshis// 'khor 'das dus gsum ro mnyam chen po ru// 'tsho zhing bzhes las nam yang ma g.yos bzhin// gdul bya'i snang ngor de ltar gsol ba 'debs// mi zad thugs rje'i gter mnga' rgyal ba'i tshogs// 'chi med rig 'dzin grub dbang sprul 'khor bcas// byin rlabs mthu dang chos nyid bden stobs kyis// gsol ba btab pa don ldan 'grub byin rlobs/

rgyal sras rin po chos nyid klong grol dpal 333) bzang po'i sku tshe brtan bzhugs su sna tshogs rang grol gyis phul ba maṅga lam// rab 'byams rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bsam yas kyi// khyab bdag mtshungs bral pad+ma sam bha wa'i// bstan pa'i yang snying phrin las rgya mtsho'i mdzod// dbang bsgyur mchog gi sprul sku zhabs brtan gsol// grangs med bskal par thugs bskyed sa bon las// bslu med legs tshogs ljon pa'i dpal yon gyi// grib bsil phan bde'i khyon yangs 'gro ba'i skyabs// dpag bsam mchog gi sprul sku zhabs brtan gsol// 'dod 'byung rin chen byang sems dbang gi rgyal// tshogs gnyis chu gter che las legs 'ongs pas// bskal bzang dam chos 'dod pa 'jo ba'i dpal// re skong mchog gi sprul sku zhabs brtan gsol// byams pa'i rjing bur snying rje'i myu gu 'khrungs// gzhan la phan par dga' ba'i 'dab brgya bzhad// ris med btang snyoms chen po'i zil mngar 'gyed// dri bral mchog gi 334)sprul sku= /'gyur med sku yi rdo rje mtshan dpe'i gter// 'gag med gsung gi gsang ba zab rgyas bcud// dmigs med thugs rje'i 'od brgyas zhing kun khyab// mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo zhabs brtan gsol// bdag sogs mkha' mnyam 'gro ba las nyon gyi// sdug bsngal mi zad mtsho chen myur skem nas// mchog tu mi 'gyur kun tu bzang po yi// go 'phang bla na med la 'god mdzad gsol// rgyal ba sras bcas dkon mchog rin po che// rtsa gsum lha tshogs bden pa'i stobs mnga' ba// ma lus byin rlabs mthu la smon pa'i don// myur 'grub chos dang bkra shis gong 'phel shog ces pa 'di ni/ thub bstan rdo rje'i brag gi gdan sar rig 'dzin mchog gi sprul skur brtan bzhugs su phul ba'o// ༈ na ma sarba bud+dha bo d+dhi satwa gu ru rat+na bh+yaḥ gang zhig phyogs bcu rab 'byams zhing kun gyi// sangs rgyas byang sems rnam 'gyur gang snang ba// ma lus rigs bdag bla ma kho na yi// rnam par 'phrul pa'i

335)zlos gar 'ba' zhig sar// mdo rgyud man ngag mtha' dag dgongs mthun na// ma dag 'gro blo'i snang ngor tha mal pa'i// mi gzugs phal par lta ba'i log 'khrul ni// da nas rnam pa kun tu gtan spangs te// bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos dge 'dun// yi dam lha dang mkha' 'gro chos srung sogs// skyabs gnas dkon mchog ma lus bla ma'i skur// dbyer med nges shes brtan pos rgyud bskul bas// gsol ba snying nas 'debs so bla ma rje// bdag sogs mkha' mnyam 'gro ba las nyon gyi// bag chags sdug bsngal shugs drag rba klong 'khrug /nyam thag 'khor ba'i mtsho las bsgral du gsol// dus 'di nas bzung mthar thug byang chub bar// mnyam med bla ma mchog gis zhabs pad la// nyer bsten mnyes gsum mthar phyin byin rlabs zhugs// bla ma sku bzhi dbyer med bdag 'grub shog /rgyal ba ma lus bla ma'i 336)ngo bor gcig /bla ma rang rig chos skur yongs rdzogs pa// ye nas yin pa'i gnas lugs mngon gyur te// 'gro kun don dam bla ma'i sar 'god shog

ces pa ni/ zab yangs mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i pho brang chen po nas/ lha sras mañdzu nā tha la phul pa'o// na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ gang zhig 'jigs rung 'khor ba'i mtsho chen las// nges pa kho nar skyobs nus skyabs kyi mchog /dkon mchog ma lus 'dus pa bla ma'i zhabs// rtag par spyi bo'i rgyan du gus pas mchod// sangs rgyas thams cad gdul bya'i bskal ngo dang*// nye bar mtshungs pa'i sgyu 'phrul nyid lags na// bdag sogs snyigs dus gdul bya so so yi// gang la mos pa'i bla ma de sangs rgyas// yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong kun kyang de// gang la gang gis 'dul ba'i de tshul gyi// rnam 'gyur grangs med ston yang don dam par// ye shes ngo bo gcig gi rang rtsal nyid// yin la yin par rtogs pa'i nges shes dang*// legs 337)nyes thugs rjer go ba'i mos gus dang*// gang byung byin rlabs shes pa'i blo khel bcas// kha zhe snying mthun dad pas gsol 'debs na// rgyal ba'i thugs rjer nye ring ma mchis kyang*// byin rlabs 'jug sgo mos gus rjes 'gro'i phyir// bdag sogs skye ba 'di nas byang chub bar// 'bral med thugs rjes nyer bzung byin gyis rlobs// ma rig las nyon sgrib tshogs byang ba dang*// gnas skabs 'gal rkyen bar chad zhi ba dang*// dgos 'dod bsam don chos mthun 'grub pa sogs// thun mong dngos grub kun gyi re skong gsol// legs par brtags bzhin snying pos dben pa'i chos// 'di snang rmi lam tsam la mi zhen par// rgyal kun bgrod pa gcig pa'i dam chos la// legs brtson rang rgyud smin grol gzhan phan 'grub// tshe gcig sangs rgyas go 'phang mngon gyur shog ces pa ni/ mi dbang rin chen sgang pa pad+ma rdo rje la phul ba'o// swasti pra dzñā bh+yaḥ 338)gang gi rang bzhin chos dbyings 'dus ma byas// spros pa'i mtshan ma kun zhi ye shes sku'i// rang gdangs 'gag med sgyu 'phrul chu zla'i ga

/byin rlabs bla mar snang ba'i sku la 'dud// ye shes sprul pa'i zhing khams rab 'byams kun// thugs rje tshad med sku yi bkod pa'i 'phrul// ji snyed bstan yang ngo bo dbyer med pa'i// rigs kun khyab bdag bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// bdag dang mkha' mnyam sems can 'di dag la// dmigs med klong nas brtse chen thugs rje yis// rgyun chad med par gzigs pa dri med kyi// stobs ldan mchog la gsol ba snying nas 'debs// 'khor ba thog med nas bzung da lta'i bar// ma rig lhan skyes sgrib pa tshan re che// las nyon 'khrul pa'i mun par 'thums pa 'di// bla ma'i thugs rje'i 'od kyi bsal du gsol// tshe 'dir dal 'byor thob cing bstan la zhugs// dam chos spyod pa'i skal bar ldan na yang*// bag 339)chags ngan goms lto gos don la g.yeng*// mi tshe stong zad gyur 'dir thugs rjes gzigs// kha chos za chog tsam gyi slob gnyer dang*// ltar snang chos pa'i gzugs brnyan tsam 'di yis// 'chi khar lam sna zin pa'i thabs ma mchis// dam chos snying nas nus par byin gyis rlobs// nyin mo rnam g.yeng mtshan mo gnyid kyi ngang*// bar mtshams bza' btung tshe 'di'i don la 'byams// dkor dang nyes ltung 'khur rtsa zhor la 'grub// blo rgyud dge la 'gyur bar thugs rjes bzung*// da lta'i snang ba rmi lam yun tsam 'di// yengs ma lam la mi tshe tug gi zad// lus sems bral nas bar dor 'khyams dus der// skyabs mgon bla ma mchog gi mdzad du gsol// tshe 'dir 'gal rkyen bar chad med pa dang*// chos min bsam sbyor rgyud la mi skye zhing*// sdom gsum dam tshig nyams chags med pa yis// thos bsam sgom gsum mtha' ru 340)phyin par shog /mos gus chen pos bla ma dkon mchog mnyes// dag snang 'byongs pas mched grogs dam sel med// snying rje byang sems 'gro la phan pa shog /skyed rim zhing khams dag pa rab 'byams shar// rdzogs rim rtog tshogs ye shes rdo rjer grol// zung 'jug mi zad don gyi 'khor lor grub// tshe gcig rdo rje 'chang dbang mngon gyur shog

/de las thugs rje phrin las thogs med kyis// sprul pa rgya mtshos nam mkha' gar khyab par// 'gro ba'i khams dbang bsam pa dang mtshungs pa'i// gzhan phan 'khor mtha' ji srid 'grub gyur cig ces pa ni/ shākya lhun grub kyis bskul ngor ro/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ chos sku'i zhing khams 'od gsal rdo rje snying*// longs sku'i zhing khams tshangs pa rnga sgra'i gnas// sprul pa sku yi zhing khams tshangs chen te// sku gsum zhing mchog rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// sangs rgyas sprul pas mdzad pa mngon 341)bstan pa'i// 'dzam gling byang chub snying po rdo rje gdan// bya rgod spungs ri dpal ldan 'bras spungs che// sham bha la sogs rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// chos 'khor so so'i gnas dang rgyal byed tshal// nai rañdza na rtswa mchog dur khrod brgyad// o rgyan sprul pa'i zhing sogs yul nyer bzhi// mchog gi gnas chen kun la phyag 'tshal lo// ti se la phyi dpal 'bar yol mo gangs// zab lung mkhar chu stag tshang ti gro dang*// chos 'khor lha sa yer pa sgrags yang rdzong*// dpal gyi bsam yas rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// mchims phu khra 'brug yar lung shel gyi brag /sham bu mkha' spyod rtsā ri dwags lha sgam// 'bri stag tshal thel ra sgreng mtshur ra lung*// sa dge'i gdan sa kun la phyag 'tshal lo// rgya bod bal yul lho mon e gnyal byar// dwags kong mdo khams bod dang bod chen po// hor 'jang rgya nag la sogasu yul kun gyi// sgrub 342)gnas gtsug lag rten gsum phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal ba rigs gsum sprul pa'i skyes mchog tshogs// chos rgyal byang sems grub thob rig 'dzin dang*// gu ru chen pos byin brlabs zhabs bcags pa'i// sbas yul gnas chen rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// phyi nang gzhan gsum gzod nas dkyil 'khor cher// yongs grub snod bcud rten dang brten pa'i tshul// ma lus ye shes rdo rje'i zhing chen por// lhun grub dag pa rab 'byams la phyag 'tshal// ma rtogs yul sems gnyis 'dzin mthol zhing bshags/

gang shar chos nyid rol pa'i maṇ+ḍal 'bul// snang srid rnam dag sku gsum zhing chen por// bdag sogs mkha' mnyam 'gro kun sgrol bar shog ces pa 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes legs bshad mthar phyin gyis bskul ngor bris pa dge'o// phyogs dus rgyal ba thams cad kyi// thugs rje byin rlabs gcig bsdus sku// bla ma yid bzhin nor bu mchog /zhabs la phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// ye shes rdo rje'i sku nyid la// skye 'chi'i mtshan ma dang bral yang*// bdag sogs 'khrul rmongs snang ngo ru// 'chi med rdo rje'i sku brtan 343) gsol// dus 'di nas bzung byang chub bar// rgyal ba khyed kyi zhabs pad drung*// 'bral med mnyes gsung bsgrub nus shing*// phrin las 'gro phan rgya chen shog ces pa ni sbyin bdag bsod nams chos 'phel bza' mis bskul ngor ro/ na mo gu ru/ rgyal ba'i mdzad pa dpag med kyis// gdul bya'i zhing dang gang 'tsham pa'i// rnam par 'phrul pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs// bsam mi khyab la gus phyag 'tshal// byang sems me tog zla tshes dang*// zla 'od gzhon nu bi ma la// mnyam med 'dzam gling grags pa sogs// sngon byon rnams la gus phyag 'tshal// kun mkhyen bkra shis rnam par rgyal// mchog sprul nor bu brgyan pa nyid// slar yang bdag sogs gdul bya'i ngor// bzang po rdo rje gus phyag 'tshal// thub pa'i zhabs 'bring kun dga' bo// thon mi lo chen bai ro dang*// rdor gling la sogs gter ston gyi// skyai brgyud rnams la gus phyag 'tshal// rngog 344)lo sa paṇa bya 'dul dang*// khyung po rnal 'byor rdza yig pa// g.yag sde paṇa chen gnyal ston sogs// mkhas grub rim brgyud gus phyag 'tshal// dus mtha'i 'gro ba bdag sogs kyi// skyabs mgon bstan 'dzin rdo rje dang*// mkhas mchog pad+ma legs grub rtsal// rtsa ba'i bla mar gus phyag 'tshal// rgyal ba'i khyab bdag pad 'byung rje// drin can mchog sprul rnam gnyis bcas// bdag yid gus pa phyag 'tshal zhing*// snying nas skyabs mchi thugs rjes gzigs// sangs rgyas ma lus 'dus pa'i spyi gzugs mchog

/zla bral skyabs gnas sprul pa'i sku rnam gnyis// snyigs dus gdul bya mgon med bdag sogs la// brtse bas dgongs te bskal brgyar zhabs brtan gsol// sgyu 'phrul ye shes rdo rje'i sku mchog la// skye 'chi 'pho 'gyur mtshan ma mi mnga' yang*// bdag sogs gdul dka'i skye bo skal dman la// skyo bar 345)mi mdzad thugs rjes skyangs mdzad gsol// bdag gi tshe 'di phyi ma bar do dang*// skye ba'i phreng brgyud mthar thug byang chub bar// re yul drin can rnam gnyis ma gtogs pa// skyabs gnas gzhan na ma mchis thugs rjes dgongs// sgo gsum gtan 'dun mtha' dag mchod par 'bul// nyes ltung sdig sgrib ci mchis mthol zhing bshags// mdzad phrin kun la yi rangs bka' bzhin bsgrub// mkha' mnyam 'gro la gang 'dul chos 'khor bskul// zhi ba'i dbyings su mi bzhugs bstan 'gro skyongs// dge tshogs ma lus dgongs pa rdzogs phyir bsngo// sgyu lus zang zing chos kyi zhabs togs kun// rje btsun rnam gnyis mnyes pa'i rgyur gyur cig /tshe rabs thams cad bla ma'i gdul bya dang*// 'khor du gyur nas dam chos sha stag gis// bdag rgyud smin cing grol te bstan 'gro'i don/ 346)/'bad med yang dag 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// log lam bdud kyi bar chad mi 'jug par// byang chub snying po'i go 'phang mngon gyur nas// pha mar gyur pa'i mkha' khyab sems can kun// sangs rgyas sa la myur du 'god byed shog ces pa 'di ni/ don gnyis mchog grub kyi ngor bris pa'o// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gdod ma'i gnas lugs khyab bdal che// phyogs ris ma grub kun tu mnyam// ma bcos rang babs chos sku'i klong*// 'dzin med ngang nas gsol ba 'debs// ngo bo stong pa chen po yi// rang gdangs ma 'gag 'od du gsal// gsal dang stong pa zung 'jug pa'i// snang tshul rig pas gsol ba 'debs// rnam pa sna tshogs sgyu ma'i 'phrul// med bzhin snang la snang bzhin stong*// rol rtsal sna tshogs 'phro 'du las// bdag 'dzin bral bas gsol ba=

e ma/ rang sems sangs rgyas sku gsum 'di// rang la gnas kyang 347)ma rig pas// 'khor ba'i 'khrul 'khor shugs drag pos// bskyod 'di rang gi las kyi mthu// thog ma med nas da lta'i bar// 'gro ba rigs drug tha dad kyi// lus ngan blangs shing las ngan spyad// da dung bsun dang skyo ba med// bdag tu 'dzin pa'i bag chags kyis// chags sdang las nyon dug lnga'i sems// ma bslab shes pa'i ngan goms can// g.yo sgyu'i las kyi rang phung sgrub// bzang po'i bag chags mi dran par// ngan pa'i blo sna zad med 'phel// snyigs dus chos gzugs bdag 'dra bas// chos kyi mdo don ci yis 'grub// dag snang mig 'phang dma' ba dang*// log lta'i mgo khyer mtho ba dang*// rgyu 'bras las spyod rtsing ba yis// thar pa'i lam sna ga la zin// nyin mtshan g.yeng bas 'da' byed cing*// bag med dkor la longs spyod pa'i// rab byung gzugs kyi ngar 'dzin can// 'chi khar 348)blo gdengs gang la byed// 'jig rten skye bos mchod pa'i yul// gshin gson dkor la ngom med du// spyad kyang rang nyid shi ma thag /gar 'gro gar skye'i nges pa ci// sems rgyud chos kyi ma thul bzhin// chos kyi tshig tsam brjod shes kyang*// ne tso'i 'don pa ji lta bar// rang gzhan su la phan par nus// rtsa ba bzhi yang mi bsrung zhing*// dge sbyor chos bzhi mi shes par// dge 'dun dkor la ham pa yi// btsun gzugs rang mthong rang bslu mkhan// bdag dang bdag 'dra'i chos rdzu rnams// dkon mchog ye shes spyan mnga' bas// gsal bar gzigs shing khrel na yang*// dus mtha'i 'gro la snying rjes dgongs// rgyal ba'i phrin las nus pa bsam mi khyab// las ngan 'gro ba'i blo rgyud chos la bsgyur// mi rtag nges 'byung snying la dran nas kyang*// dam pa'i chos la 'bungs nus byin gyis rlobs// 'khor ba'i zhen chags bdag gzhan phyogs 'dzin

349)dang*// 'jig rten chos brgyad skyid 'dod rnam g.yeng las// lto gos tshe 'di'i dgos cha bsgrub pa sogs// chos pa'i rkang 'dren mi byed byin gyis rlobs// rang la tshig zur mtho dman mi bzod bzhin// gzhan la skur 'debs brnyas bcos byed pa la// nyam nga spu tsam med pa'i snying stobs dang*// log rtog rgyud la mi skye byin gyis rlobs// 'di phyi kun phung sha chang bud med la// ngos lkog du mar spyod bzhin tshul 'chos kyis// dad rdzas dkor zas tshim pa med spyod pa'i// rang gzhan gnyis phung mi byed byin gyis rlobs// rgyu 'bras rnam dbye tsam yang ma gos bar// thos bsam sgom gsum yod rdzu'i stong zob dang*// lto phyir zol zog mi byed dgu byed pa'i// chos pa'i phung 'drer mi 'gyur byin gyis rlobs// rang ma smin par gzhan gyi 'dren pa dang*// mi nus bzhin du gzhan don byed lo 350)dang*// rang 'dod phug gcug nor rdzas 'dod pa yis// brdzus ma'i 'gro phan mi byed byin gyis rlobs// mdor na 'di bzung byang chub ma thob bar// sgo gsum dam pa'i chos kyi gzhung bzhin du// g.yo zol spangs nas bla ma mnyes sgrub cing*// dam pa'i rnam thar tshul bzhin spyod byin rlobs// legs par spyad pa'i rgyu 'bras bslu med kyi// legs lam mthar phyin rang gzhan don bzang 'grub// nam mkhas gar khyab pha ma sems can kun// yang dag byang chub lam la 'god par shog ces byang chub 'od zer gyi ngor bris pa'o// na ma ma hā gu ṇa ye/ rgyal ba kun gyi bdag nyid sman gyi bla// ye shes mkha' 'gro gtso mo dpal ldan 'phreng*// khams gsum 'gro ba'i skyabs gcig g.yu thog mgon// gsol ba 'debs so byin rlabs char rgyun phob// thugs sras mchog gyur mkhas grub sum ston zhabs// dpal ldan gzhon nu gtsang ston sangs rin dang*// mkhas btsun 351)rin rdor don grub rgyal mtshan dpal// gsol ba 'debs so byin rlabs=

/brang ti dkon skyabs dpal ldan 'tsho byed dang*// 'tsho byed rin chen rnal 'byor bsod nams dbang*// rnal 'byor chen po ri khrod zhig po rje// gsol ba= /bai ros byin rlabs mtshungs med zur mkhar ba// bshad pa'i mnga' bdag legs byung pad+ma skyabs// zar ban byams pa slob dpon mgon po dpal// gsol ba= 'gro don pa dang sman bla don kun grub// thams cad mkhyen pa nor bu brgyan pa'i mchog /'ja' mtshon snying po sna tshogs rang grol rje// gsol ba= /yi dam rta phag mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i tshogs// bka' srung dam can sde dgu sprul 'khor bcas// sman gyi lha me drang srong rig 'dzin la// gsol ba= /mdo rgyud man ngag bstan bcos kun gyi bcud// 'gro la phan pa'i snying po gso rig gi /tshig don man ngag lag lon gnad mtha' dag /tshul bzhin rgyud la 'byor ba byin 352)gyis rlobs// mkhas rlom nga rgyal chags sdang 'gran sems dang*// phrag dog g.yo sgyu khe grags zas nor 'dod// chos brgyad la sogs log pa'i sems rigs kyi// dri ma rdul tsam med par byin gyis rlobs// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug rgyu yi nad// rlung dang khrag mkhris bad kan rkyen gyi nad// ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal 'bras bu'i nad// ma lus drung nas 'byin par byin gyis rlobs// mkha' khyab 'gro ba pha ma sha stag kun// las nyon 'khrul pa'i gcong gis snyam thag pa// thams cad byang chub sems kyi sman mchog gis// gtan bde rdzogs byang go 'phang la 'khod shog

ces sman gyi rgyud bzhi sogs gso rig spyi'i bla rgyud gsol 'debs 'di ni/ gzhan phan nor bus bskul ngor bris pa'o// ༈ ye grol gdod ma'i gnas lugs 'dus ma byas// rang rtsal 'gag med snang ba'i bla ma ni// rang dang 'du 'bral mtshan mas ma gos par// yin lugs ji bzhin rtogs pas gsol ba 'debs// med 353)bzhin sna tshogs snang ba'i bag chags gzugs// gang la bden par bzung ba'i rmi lam la// legs nyes du mar btags pa'i bar chad gegs// lto 'gro'i mdud bzhin grol bar byin gyis rlobs*// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pas nyer bsdus pa'i// chos kun rang sems gcig pu'i 'du 'god du// shes kyang mkhris nad ma byang dung mdog ltar// log 'khrul 'dzin pa zhi bar byin gyis rlobs// bdag ma grub la bdag tu 'dzin blo dang*// de la brten nas gzhan zhes tha dad bzung*// de las chags sdang kun slong du ma 'phel// gnyis 'dzin rab rib zhi bar byin gyis rlobs// bzang po'i bag chags byang ba'i go skabs bral// log min bag chags ngan goms rtsi yis thebs// byang chub dam pa'i spyod la mi 'jug pa'i// blo sems chos kyis thul bar byin gyis rlobs// chos kyis rnam grangs bgrang yas ji snyed pa'i/ 354)/dgos don rang rgyud 'dul thabs gcig pur mngags// de phyir gang thos lag tu longs pa dang*// snyem khengs khong sran med par byin gyis rlobs// grub mtha' mtha' dag rang rang sa na bzang*// rnam mkhyen bar du grub mtha'i tshad zin dka'// mthar thug don la grub mtha'i dngos pos dben// gcig shes kun grol chen por byin gyis rlobs// sdom dang dam tshig rim pa bsam yas pa// thams cad nyon mongs rang gar mi 'chor thabs// gnad kyi dam par tha ma'i a 'thas blo// skad cig tsam yang mi 'byung byin gyis rlobs// bskur thob mtshan 'dzin spros pa byis rtsed kyi// dbang dang dbyibs la lhar bzung bskyed rim sogs// dang po'i las can khrid pa'i zlos gar la// mi zhen dgos don snying po lon byin rlobs// skyed rdzogs mngon du ma gyur thun mong gi

/las tshogs phra mos rang blo mi g.yeng bar// dgos med dran pa'i 355)bsnyen pa legs thems te// mkha' mnyam thar gling sgrol nus byin gyis rlobs// mtshan bcas mtshan med rdzogs rim zab mo yi// yang snying sgo gsum ye shes rdo rje nyid// bsgrub la mi 'bad zag bcas yon tan tsam// chog 'dzin zhen pas mi 'ching byin gyis rlobs// chen po gsum sogs nges don zab mo'i gsang*// bzang bzang mtho mtho'i ming la pho rus kyis// bdag tu bzung ba'i sgom chen mi byed par// rang rig rjen pa skyong bar byin gyis rlobs// nam mkha' sprin dang rgya mtsho'i rlabs bzhin du// sna tshogs gang ltar shar yang sems nyid las// min bzhin bzang ngan 'byed dang spong len sogs// chu la ri mo mi 'brir byin gyis rlobs// nyams rtogs skye dang mi skye'i re dogs dang*// yon tan ltar snang phra mor dga' brod sogs// lha bu'i bdud kyis ma bslus yang dag pa'i// grub 356)rtags bdag 'dzin zhi bar byin gyis rlobs// rnam rtog gnyen pos gzhom la mi re dang*// rnam rtog nyid las gzhan pa'i sgom mi 'tshol// rnam rtog shar mkhan 'char rgyu ngo shes gsum/ rang rig gcig pus chog par byin gyis rlobs// chu bur lus dang dbugs kyi thag pa dang*// bdag tu 'dzin pa'i sems kyi ri mo rnams// ma yal de srid rtsol med dran rig dang*// ma bral 'khrul rjes mi 'brang byin gyis rlobs// rang rig ma smin gzhan don ltar snang gi /rnyed tshol 'gro don gnyis phung mi byed par// dus babs rtsol med 'gro don rlabs po ches// 'khor ba dong sprugs nus par byin gyis rlobs// de ltar gsol ba gdab dang smon pa'i tshig /'di ni phyi ru ma yin rang rgyud kyi// kun khyab chos sku'i bla mar gsol btab pas/ byin rlabs rang gi rgyud la 'bab 357)gyur cig ces skye nas skye bar dam pa'i mdzad pa la goms pa yang dag mthar son pas shes bya'i chos so cog la mi 'phrog pa'i spobs pa brnyes shing*/

chos don chos bzhin spyod pa'i rang dbang can/ sprul pa'i skyes mchog chos kyi nyi 'od mtshan don mthun pa gang gi bzhed skongs su phul ba shu bham// sangs rgyas thams cad rtsa ba'i bla ma'i skur// dbyer med gdod nas gcig pa'i ngo bo ni// sna tshogs rang grol pad+ma legs grub rtsal// zhabs la phyag 'tshal skyabs mchi gsol ba 'debs// dus 'di nas bzung mthar thug byang chub bar// re sa skyabs yul gzhan na ma mchis pas// dmigs med thugs rjes rtag tu gzigs nas kyang*// sgo gsum sku gsung thugs kyis byin gyis rlobs// rdo rje'i sku la skye 'chi'i 'pho 'gyur gyi// mtshan 'dzin bral yang bdag sogs gdul bya'i tshogs// gnyis 'dzin blo yi 'khrul rtog ma zad bar// spyi bo'i rgyan du 'bral med bzhugs nas kyang*/ 358)/bdag sogs 'gro la brtse ba'i thugs rjes dgongs// nad gdon bar chad zhi ba byin gyis rlobs// bsam don chos bzhin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// las nyon sdig sgrib dag par byin= /sgo gsum dge la 'khor bar byin= /'brel tshad thar lam 'dren par byin= /tshe dang sgrub pa mnyam par byin= /'chi khar gnad gcod med par byin= /bar dor rang ngo shes par byin= /ngan 'gro skye sgo chod par byin= /myur du sangs rgyas thob par byin= /mkha' mnyam gzhan don 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ ces pa 'di ni dad ldan byang chub rin chen la'o// na mo gu ru rat+na bh+yaḥ chos dbyings 'dus ma byas pa'i zhing mchog nas// rgyal kun rdo rje 'chang du ro gcig pa'i// rnam rol ye shes sgyu ma'i zlos gar 'phreng*// rtsa rgyud bla mar snying nas gsol ba 'debs// rigs kun khyab bdag gang 'dul ye shes sku// mtha' yas gdul bya'i yul mthun sprul mdzad pas// zhing 'dir bdag sogs 359)snang ngor thugs rje'i gter// rtsa ba'i bla mar snying nas gsol ba 'debs// grangs med sngon nas chos skur sangs rgyas kyang*// snyigs dus gdul bya'i dngos 'dzin gzhig pa'i slad// chos brgyad dri spangs byang chub dpal bzang po// 'khrul zhig mchog der snying nas gsol ba 'debs// gangs can sgrub rgyud srog 'dzin kun dga' dpal// la sogs mkhas grub du ma'i thugs bcud kyi// gsang mdzod 'dzin pa blo gros grags pa dpal// grub dbang mchog der snying nas gsol ba 'debs// rang don 'bras bu'i rtse mor legs son yang*// gzhan don las 'bras bslu med spang blang gnas// ston la thabs mkhas mi pham bstan 'dzin rje// yongs 'dzin mchog der snying nas gsol ba 'debs// rgyal ba'i rgyal mchog 'jig rten dbang phyug gi

/phrin las yang dag bsgrub la ngal med 360)pa'i// dpal ldan karma lhun grub rnam par rgyal// skyabs gnas mchog der snying nas gsol ba 'debs// rdo rje'i phung khams skye mched snod bcud kun// gzod nas yongs dag gsang gsum dkyil 'khor che// lhun grub 'khor lo sdom pa bde ba'i mchog /sprul 'khor bcas der snying nas gsol ba 'debs// rgyal bstan rin chen skyong bar nyer blangs te// log 'dren tshar gcod dam ldan bu bzhin skyong*// ma hā ka la lcam dral sde dpung bcas// bstan srung mchog der snying nas gsol ba 'debs// ngo bo dbyer med snang tshul tha dad pa'i// thugs rje'i sprul bsgyur bla ma yi dam lha// mkha' 'gro chos srung skyabs gnas dkon mchog la// rtse gcig gus pas snying nas gsol ba 'debs// rin chen bstan pa bshad sgrub nyams len gyi// srog 'dzin thos bsam sgom brtson 'dus sde rnams// mi mthun bar chad bdud las rnam rgyal zhing*/ 361)/bstan pa phyogs mthar 'phel rgyas byin gyis rlobs// bstan srog tshul bzhin 'dzin pa'i rnam 'dren dang*// tshogs sam dben par spyod pa'i dge 'dun kun// bzhed mthun byang chub bsgrub la bar chad med// rang gzhan don gnyis mthar phyin byin gyis rlobs// bdag sogs mngagan khyod gdul byar gyur pa kun// rnam g.yeng chos brgyad nyon mongs las ngan dbang*// mi 'chor zab don snying pos rgyud grol te// tshe gcig byang chub 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// bla ma rgyal ba rab 'byams sprul 'khor bcas// thugs rje'i mkha' khyab 'gro kun rjes bzung nas// mngon par mtho dang nges legs dpal 'byor gyi// bkra shis 'jig rten yongs la khyab gyur cig ces rje btsun dpal ldan bla ma grub pa'i gtsug rgyan 'khrul zhig chen po khyi thul ba zhes mtshan gyi grags dkar lha lam khyab pa gang gi thugs rje'i sgyu 'phrul ye shes sku'i bkod

362) 'phreng rim byon rnams la gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni/ rje btsun mchog de'i thugs rje chos kyi bka' drin las 'khrungs pa'i skyes chen dam pa karma mi pham mgon po'am mtshan gzhan/ nges don mthar phyin dpal bzang pos thugs bsam rnam par dag pas bskul bar mdzad pa'i bzhed dgongs dang mthun par bkod pas bkra shis byin rlabs kyi dpal du 'bar bar gyur cig oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po gdod ma'i gshis// skye dgag gnas dang 'gro 'ong mtshan mas dben// brjod bral lhan skyes ye shes ngo bo nyid// ma bcos lhun grub 'di ni bla ma'i sku// chos sku khyab bdal chen por gsol ba 'debs// ye grol 'gyur med klong nas byin gyis rlobs// zhe 'dod rtsol sgrub ngal ba'i bar chad kun// rang sar rang grol nyid du 'grub par shog /chos nyid gsal stong zung 'jug rang gdangs las// 'gag med 'char sgo'i snang ba rab 'byams kun// snang yang bden 'dzin zhen pas ma bcings pa/ 363)/rang gsal 'dzin med 'di ni bla ma'i sku// longs sku mtshan rdzogs chen por gsol ba 'debs// mi zad rgyan 'khor klong nas byin gyis rlobs// yul sems tha dad bzung ba'i 'khrul rtog kun// ma spangs rang grol nyid du 'gyur ba shog /rtsal mdangs cir yang 'char ba'i sgyu 'phrul gyi// bkod pa 'bum phrag ston yang ngo bos stong*// snang stong tha dad med pa'i rang bzhin gyi// kun byed rgyal po 'di ni bla ma'i sku// sprul sku 'gro 'dul chen por gsol ba 'debs// shar grol dus mnyam klong nas byin gyis rlobs// sgyu ma bden par bzung ba'i bag chags kyi// a 'thas gzhi rtsa med par zhi bar shog /sku gsum dbyed med rigs bdag bla ma nyid// rang sems gnyug ma 'di dang tha dad med// gnyis med rang ngo shes pa'i mos gus kyis// gsol ba 'debs bya 'debs byed ma dmigs pa'i// bcos

364)min mos gus tha mal shes rig la// bcos ma'i lhad kyi ma bslad ma bsgyur ba// bla ma rang rig sgom yengs las 'das pa'i// klong du 'khor 'das dus gsum 'bral med hūm̐// gnas lugs gdod ma'i ye shes spros mtshan gyi// dri mas ma sgribs don dam bla ma yi// rang zhal mngon gsum mjal ba 'di ji bzhin// mkha' mnyam pha ma 'gro kun skye med āḥ /bdag nyid 'di bzung skye ba'i 'phreng brgyud mthar// bdag tu 'dzin pa'i ri mo ma yal bar// de srid zang zing bsdu thabs ma yin pa'i// 'gro don rlabs chen spyod pa'i sprul skur oṃ// rtag tu gzhan la phan pa yang dag gi /byang sems spyod pa ngal med sgrub byed cing*// ngar 'dzin chos brgyad bdud kyis ma bcoms par// bla ma mchog gi go 'phang myur 'grub shog ces nges don dang mthun pa'i sku gsum gsol 'debs 'di bzhin bri dgos zhes/ gtsang phyogs rgyal byed tshal gyi chos grwa chen po'i mkhan 365) rin po che mi pham chos 'phel ba'i bskul ngor bkod pa'o// na mo gu ru/ bdag lus phung po khams dang skye mched chos// mtha' dag gzod ma nyid nas yongs dag pa'i// rang bzhin dpal ldan bla ma'i dkyil 'khor du// snang srid snod bcud cir snang de bzhin no// 'on kyang mos blos rang gsal gdab pa'i phyir// spyi gtsug dad brgya'i 'dab stong nyid zla'i steng*// dran mchog rje btsun bla ma mtshan dpe'i skur// snang stong rang rig ngo bor lam mer shar// mchod bya mchod byed gnyis snang rtog pa'i 'phreng*// kun rjob sgyu ma'i maṇ+ḍal ma yin par// rang sems bla ma'i ngo bor thag chod pa'i// gang dag don gyi maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar bgyi/ oṃ gu ru rat+na maṇ+ḍal pū dza ma gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ e ma hoḥ gdod nas rnam dag gi zhing khams// ye grol ka dag gi klong nas/ 366) /rang rig chos sku yi bla ma// sgom med blo 'das rang mkhyen no// 'od gsal lhun grub kyi zhing khams// snang srid yongs dag gi dkyil 'khor// 'gag med longs sku yi bla ma// yengs med 'dzin bral rang mkhyen no// sna tshogs sgyu 'phrul gyi rol rtsal// cir yang nges med kyi dgar mkhan// kun byed sprul sku yi bla ma// 'khrul med rang grol rang mkhyen no// sku gsum dbyer med kyi gnas lugs// sangs rgyas lag bcangs su ston mdzad// sku drin mtshungs med kyi rje btsun// rtsa ba'i bla ma rang mkhyen no// chos thams cad blo yi snang tshul tsam// sangs rgyas kun gdul bya'i bskal ngor sprul// bdag nyid kyi rang skal ji bzhin du// sangs rgyas zhes khyed las gzhan su gang*// rab 'byams kyi zhing dang gdul bya dang*// 'dul byed dang 'dul thabs ji snyed pa// thams cad kyang bla ma'i sgyu 'phrul las// don gzhan du

367)bdag ni mi sems so// thugs rje la bskul bar mi 'tshal zhing*// byin rlabs la rgyun chad med mod kyang*// bdag yid kyi mos pa'i gdung dbyangs 'di// rje bla ma'i snyan du gsan lags sam// bdag thog med dus nas da bar du// las nyon mongs ma rig 'khrul pas 'thums// rje thugs rje'i nyi ma gsal 'bar khyed// snying thag pas gsol 'debs 'bad la gzigs// rje sku gsum ngo bo dbyer med nyid// bdag gdul bya'i khams la yongs khyab kyang*// blo ma rig rmongs pas gnyis su snang*// da gnyis med du 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// bdag chos gzugs snyoms las rnam g.yeng mkhan// pha khyed las re sa gzhan med pas// thugs snying rje chen po'i dbyings rum nas// sku rdzu 'phrul gyi bkod pa bstan du gsol// chos brgyad khri bzhi stong bsam yas kyang*/ 368)/don 'gro ba 'dul thabs gcig nyid phyir// gnad zab mo nges don bdud rtsi'i char// bdag mos pa'i bu yi rgyud la phob// sems 'khrul rtog gi rdzun snang rmi lam bzhin// 'dis rang phung du 'khor ba'i btson rar 'jug /da cog bzhag gi klong du cham grol bar// khyed thugs rje'i mthu yis mdzad re ran// bdag khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can la// pha thugs rje'i gter mnga' rje btsun khyed// dus rtag tu g.yel med brtse chen gyis// gzigs mdzod dang lha yi lha gcig pu/ kye ho/ bdag dang bla ma gsol ba gdabs pa gsum// don la rang rig chos skur ro gcig kyang*// mngon du ma gyur rmongs pa'i bu 'bangs la// thugs rjes myur du gzigs dang bla ma mchog /'khor 'das snang grags bde sdug rtog tshogs kun// rang sems 'char sgo sems nyid bla ma'i thugs// gnyis su med kyang zhen 'dzin rba la 369)g.yeng*// 'khrul zhen chu rgyun chod cig bla ma mkhyen// 'di phyi bar do lus ngag sems snang kun// rmi lam yul bzhin bden pas dben na yang*// da dung a 'thas 'khrul phyir 'brang ba'i bu// bdag 'dra'i sdug bsngal bsal mdzod bla ma mkhyen// dgra 'dre nad rkyen sems kyis btags pa tsam// sems nyid sgyu ma'i lus la zhen pas phung*// zhen 'dzin bdag tu bzung ba'i chags sdang can// rkyen ngan lam du longs mdzod bla ma mkhyen// yul 'khor zas gos longs spyod g.yeng ba'i rgyu// skyid 'dod tshe 'di'i 'dun mas mi tshe zad// 'chi khar lag stong 'gro ba'i snying med po// zhen log rgyud la 'char mdzod bla ma mkhyen// don dam chos nyid mngon du ma gyur bar// rten 'brel rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i tshul// go zhing shes kyang mi dge zhor gsog mkhan/

370)/blo kha chos la bsgyur mdzod bla ma mkhyen// skye 'chi 'khor ba'i 'khrul 'khor shugs drag pos// rtag pa rgyun du srid pa'i 'khor lor 'khyams// da nas yang dag byang chen lam bzang la// myur ba nyid du khrid mdzod bla ma mkhyen// a la la ho/ ngo mtshar sprul bsgyur gang 'dul rol pa yis// 'gro rnams bde blag sgrol ba'i ya mtshan de// bla ma mchog khyed sku yi rnam par thar// de bzhin bdag lus sprul pa'i sku 'grub shog /zab rgyas tha dad 'gro ba'i mos skal dang*// rjes mthun dam chos 'dod dgu'i char phabs pas// gdul bya smin mdzad khyed gsung rnam par thar// de bzhin bdag ngag longs skur lhun grub shog /rtog med thugs rje rmad byung ye shes kyi// dbyings nyid gdod ma'i mgon por dngos kun la// khyab 'di khyed thugs rnam thar 'dus ma byas// de bzhin bdag yid chos sku mngon gyur shog /lha 371)sngags dkyil 'khor zhing khams chos kun kyang*// don la rgyal ba khyed las gzhan mi dmigs// sangs rgyas gcig 'dus nyid la gsol btab pas// sku bzhi dbyer med bdag gi rtag 'grub shog oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho/ srid zhi kun mnyam rdzogs kyi mkha' dbyings su// khyab bdag gi rgyal mchog kun tu bzang*// dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas bskyed pa'i yab// drin can gyi bla mar bdag yid chos// drang don dang nges don rab 'byams chos// ma lus kyi snying po'i bcud mthar thug /rang sems dang sangs rgyas bla ma gsum// dbyer med du gcig pa'i bka' drin thob// 'khor ba dang lam dang myang 'das gsum// tha mal gyi shes pa so ma'i steng*// mnyam 'jog la dga' 'dam ma dgos pa'i// bdag blo de khyed thugs gcig pur gtod// khams gsum gyi 'dren mchog skyabs gnas kun// dus gcig tu bdag mdun byon gyur na'ang*// bdag 372)yid ni pha mchog khyed las gzhan// skyabs gnas kyi ltos yul 'tshol ma lags// sku gsung thugs ye shes rdo rje che// yongs rdzogs kyi byin rlabs dbang gi mchog

/bskur thob kyi mtshan ma'i 'dzin rtog bcas// rang grol klong yangs kyi ngang du gdal// mtshungs bral drin can bla ma de// bdag dang 'du 'bral ye med bzhin// nges shes mos gus drag po yis// gsol ba btab don myur 'grub shog /'jig rten 'khrul pa'i 'dun ma la// zhen pas mi tshe mi skyel bar// grub thob rgyud pa'i rnam thar 'khyongs// tshe dang sgrub pa mnyam par shog /kun rdzob spros bcas 'du byed kyi// chos la blo kha mi yengs par// byang chub tshe 'dir 'grub nus pa'i// zab don rtse gcig sgom par shog /rang rgyud chos kyi ma smin par// ltar snang gzhan don bslu brid kyis// gnyis phung don med mi byed par// dam bcas mtha' ru phyin par shog /chos 373)sku'i gtan srid ma zin bar// mngon shes grub rtags ltar snang gi /rang mthong 'gong pos mi bslu bar// snang bzhi mtha' ru nges phyin shog /sku gsum sgo 'phang mngon gyur tshe// 'bad med thugs rje'i rol gar gyis// 'khor mtsho dong nas sprugs nus pa'i// phrin las nam mkha' mnyam par shog /de ltar bdag gis dpal ldan bla ma mchog /bsgoms shing bsgrubs dang gsol ba btab pa yis// dge ba 'dis mtshon tshe rabs thams cad kyi// rnam dkar ji snyed 'gro ba'i don du bsngo// gzhi dang lam dang 'bras bur btags pa dang*// lta sgom spyod sogs ming du cir brjod pa'i// nyams len bla mar rang sems dbyer med kyi// don 'di 'gro ba kun gyis rtogs 'grub shog /bdag dang sems can bla ma zhes pa'i ming*// kun kyang da lta'i rig pa bcos min 'dir// cog bzhag khyab brdal rang babs gnyug ma'i gshis/ 374)/mnyam yangs rdzogs pa chen po'i klong du phaṭaḥ

ces yang dag don gyi bla ma'i rnal 'byor gsol 'debs smon lam dang bcas pa 'di nyid rang gi gcung po spros med gcig car la mos pa'i rnal 'byor su dharma ti'i nyams len rgyun khyer du gdams pa'o// ༈ dus gsum rgyal rnams chos sku dbyer med kyang*// 'dul bya'i skal ngor rnam 'gyur mtha' yas pa'i// mtshan dang mdzad pa rgya mtsho'i phrin las gter// dbang bsgyur rtsa ba'i bla mar gsol ba 'debs// shākya'i dbang po'i yab mchod las 'khrungs shing*// mdo sde 'dzin mchog rgyal ba'i zhabs 'bring mdzad// 'od srungs rjes su ston pa'i rgyal tshab mchog /'phags pa kun dga' bo la gsol ba 'debs// stod lung sku 'khrungs chos rgyal srong btsan gyi// chos blon 'phags yul rig pa'i gnas lnga sbyangs// bod yul yi ge'i bstan pa btsugs mdzad pa// thon mi sam+bho ṭa la gsol ba 'debs/ 375)/gtsang du sku 'khrungs rgya gar mkhas pa ni// nyer lnga'i drung du theg pa kun la sbyangs// lo tsā'i yang rab 'ja' lus 'od skur bzhugs// bai ro tsa na'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// yar 'brog rngog rigs sku 'khrungs bka' gdams sbyangs// rgya bal bod kyi mkhas grub ma lus bsten// dpal ldan gsang phur sde snod chos grwa btsugs// blo ldan shes rab zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// g.yung du 'khrungs nas dga' ba gdong la sogs// chos grwa mang por thos bsam sgro 'dogs bcad// zul phur 'dul gra'i bstan srog chos kyis bzung*// bya 'dul brtson grus 'bar la gsol ba 'debs// sa skya'i gdung las 'jam dbyangs rnam 'phrul byon// gnas lnga mthar phyin bal por mu stegs btul// gangs can mkhas pa'i mchog gyur sa paṇa che// kun dga' rgyal mtshan zhabs la gsol 376)ba 'debs// rgya gar lho phyogs paṇa grub kun gyi gtso// bod byon bo dong e yi chos grwa btabs// glegs bam gdon can rdzu 'phrul mthu yis btul// paṇa chen 'bum phrag gsum par gsol ba 'debs// nye mor sku 'khrungs bon dang rdzogs chen mkhas// rgya gar mkhas grub chen po brgya bdun cu'i// zhabs zin bod du shangs pa bka' rgyud dar// grub thob khyung po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// gtsang rong g.yag sder 'khrungs nas gsar rnying gi

/rnam 'dren mang bsten mdo sngags kun la mkhas// rdzogs chen sems phyogs bstan pa spel mdzad pa// paṇa chen brtson grus dar la gsol ba 'debs// 'bri gung phyogs 'khrungs skyob pa'i nye gnas mdzad// tsā ri'i gnas su mchog gi dngos grub brnyes// gnas chen rnams su sgrub grwa'i bstan pa bskyangs// dpal chen chos ye'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ 377)/grwa phyi khang dmar rig 'dzin rgyud du 'khrungs// gu ru'i zab gter che chung brgya rtsa brgyad// sgo phyes smin grol chos kyi nyi ma shar// gter ston rdo rje gling par gsol ba 'debs// shangs su 'khrungs nas zab lung gnas sgo phyes// rdor gling skye ba'i bag chags gsal dran pas// sngar gyi gter mdzod kun la rang dbang bsgyur// pad+ma kun skyong gling par gsol ba 'debs// yar klungs 'khrungs nas dzam lha'i dngos grub thob// mdo sgyu sems gsum la mkhas rngog thil bzhugs// dpal chen yang dag lha tshogs zhal gzigs pa// gnyal ston sangs rgyas grags la gsol ba 'debs// stod du sku 'khrungs chos dang bon gnyis ka'i// shes bya ma lus mngon gyur gter sgo phyes// bka' srung bran bkol brtul zhugs mthar phyin pa'i// g.yag char sngon mo'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// lho brag 378)dben sar sku 'khrungs pad gling gis// chos kyis bdag por dbang bskur rgyal tshab bskos// mtha' dmag bzlog cing skal ldan smin grol mdzad// rig 'dzin mchog ldan mgon por gsol ba 'debs// shar phyogs dwags yul la thog zur mkhar 'khrungs// sman rgyal g.yu thog dngos mjal byin rlabs zhugs// gso rig bstan pa'i srog bzung phyag rdzogs kyi// mnga' bdag mnyam nyid rdo rjer gsol ba 'debs// mdo khams kaḥthog sku 'khrungs thos bsam sbyangs// bod yul mkhas grub kun bsten mchog thun grub// rdza yig la sogs sgrub sde dpag med spel// tshul khrims rgyal mtshan zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// byang phyogs 'khrungs nas e waṃ chos gra ru// mdo phyogs sbyangs mthar sngags kyi dngos grub brnyes// zab gter mang bzhes 'gro don mtha' ru phyin// 'phreng po sher 'od zhabs la gsol

379)ba 'debs// kong po nga lar grub thob rgyud 'khrungs nas// dwags phyogs mdo sngags sbyangs shing smin grol brnyes// kong long snga 'gyur bstan pa'i sgron me mchog /mtshungs med bstan 'dzin rdo rjer gsol ba 'debs// sna tshogs gdul byar sna tshogs 'dul thabs kyis// thugs rje'i sgyu 'phrul srid pa ji srid bar// rgyun chad med ston drin can rang grol rjer// gsol ba snying nas 'debs so thugs rjes gzigs// gang gi skyes rabs ngo mtshar mdzad pa'i 'phreng*// yon tan rjes su dran phyir gsol btab pas// mgon khyod rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes dang*// dbyer med go 'phang bdag kyang 'grub par shog ces pa'i skye rgyud rnams kyi rnam thar mdor bsdus gsol 'debs su bgyis pa 'di ni/ long yul pad+ma chos gling gi sgrub sde nas bla ma chos dbyings yongs grol gyis bskul ngor bkod pa'o// ༈ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ chos dbyings 'dus ma byas pa'i mkha' klong las/ 380)/'gags med rang gsal ye shes sgyu ma'i sku// rgyal kun thugs rje'i 'od zer gu ru rje/ gsol 'debs su byed na/ /gsol ba 'debs so zhes kha bsgyur ro/ /mchod par 'bul lo mchog thun dngos grub stsol// rgyal yum sher phyin dbyings las mtshan dpe'i sku// mkha' spyod grub pa'i rgyal mo man+dha ra// zab gter bka' yi bsdu mdzad mtsho rgyal ma// mchod pa 'bul lo= /dha na ko ṣa'i mtsho dbus pad sdong las// skyon bral yon tan rdzogs pa'i skur byon pa// yan lag bdun ldan mtsho skyes rdo rje'i sku// mchod par 'bul lo= /rgyas sras tshul bzung mnga' 'bangs thar lam bkod// brtul zhugs spyod pas bsil tshal dur khrod gshegs// snang srid dbang sdud pad+ma rgyal po la// mchod pa 'bul lo= /gdod nas chos kun thugs kyi klong rdzogs kyang*// gdul bya'i snang ngor rab byung thos bsam mdzad// paṇa chen

381)gtsug rgyan pad+ma sam bha wa// mchod pa 'bul lo= /mtha' dag shes bya'i gnas la byang chub ste// 'chi med rig pa 'dzin pa rdo rje'i sku// yongs grub blo ldan mchog sred 'gro ba'i mgon// mchod pa 'bul lo= /gnas yul dur khrod nye ba'i zhing kun tu// phyogs las rnam rgyal brtul zhugs mthar phyin mdzad// mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug nyi ma 'od zer dpal// mchod pa 'bul lo= /shākya'i bstan la shākya'i srol bzung nas// bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan phyogs bcur 'dzug mdzad pa// ston pa'i rgyal tshab shākya seng ge'i zhabs// mchod pa 'bul lo= /log rtog grub mtha' ngan pa tshar bcad cing*// bdud kyi sde dpung drag rtsal mthu yis bcom// bstan srung rgyal po seng ge'i sgra chen sgrog /mchod pa 'bul lo= 382)gangs can lha srin gdug pa'i bar chad kun// ting 'dzin rnam rol gar dgu'i nyams kyis btul// bgegs 'dul drag po rdo rje gro lod rtsal// mchod pa 'bul lo= /sprul pa'i zhing mchog rnga yab pad+ma 'od// rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dbus nas/ thugs rje rgyun chad med gzigs thod phreng rtsal// mchod pa 'bul lo= /mgon khyod mchod cing gsol ba btab pa'i mthus// mkha' mnyam 'gro dang bdag sogs gdul bya'i tshogs// las nyon bar chad zhi zhing chos don 'grub// tshe gcig byang chub dngos grub bstsal du gsol/ ces gu ru rin po che pad+ma 'byung gnas yab yum sprul pa'i mtshan brgyad dang bcas pa rnams la gsol 'debs ja mchod gang dgos byed chog pa 'di bzhin dgos zhes/ rgya bod mtshams kyi la mo'i rtse'i dben gnas nas/ bla ma rin po che byams pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams pas 383) bskul ba ltar bkod pa dge'o// e ma hoḥ srid dang zhi ba 'khor ba myang 'das sogs// snang srid brtan g.yo'i dngos po ji snyed kun// chos sku khyab gdal chen po'i zhing khams las// ma 'das bdag gzhan dus gsum mtshan mas dben/

1 /rang gsal 'gag med sgyu 'phrul bdag lus kyi// phung khams skye mched chos ltar gang snang ba// ma lus rdo rje gsum gyi dkyil 'khor du// gdod nas lhun grub ma sgoms rang bzhin shar/ 2 /bde chen 'khor lor 'dab stong nyi zla'i steng*// kun bzang rdor 'chang la sogs rigs bdag gi /mtshan dang cha lugs bkod pa cir bstan yang*/ 3 /thams cad yongs 'dus ma hā gu ru rje// 'das dang ma byon da lta'i sangs rgyas dang*// zhal mthong gsung thos 'brel thogs bla ma kun// thams cad o rgyan chen po'i rnam rol 'phrul// yin la yin par thag chod mos gus kyis/ 4 384)/phyag 'tshal skyabs mchi mchod 'bul sdig pa bshags// yi rangs chos 'khor bskul dang brtan bzhugs gsol// dge rtsa bsngo ba'i dpang dang gsol 'debs yul// kho na gcig pur rtsa ba'i bla ma 'o/ 5 /dus gsum sgrib med mkhyen pa'i pad+ma 'byung*// byin rlabs thugs rje'i bdag nyid rje btsun mchog /bdag sogs khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can rnams// brtse bas g.yel med gzigs shig byin gyis rlobs/ 6 /yun gyi las ngan sdig sgrib sbyang du gsol// 'phral gyi nad gdon bar chad bsal du gsol// yid la 'dod dgu chos bzhin 'grub mdzad gsal// myur du thar pa'i go 'phang thob mdzad gsol/ 7 /skye ba 'di nas mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi// 'bras mchog mngon du ma gyur de srid bar// legs nyes skyid sdug bzang ngan ci byung yang*// skyabs dang re yul gzhan du mi 'tshol 385)ba'i// blo gtad bu la yal bar ma 'dor bar// 'di phyi bar do gnas skabs nam du yang*// bdag dang pha ma mkha' mnyam 'gro ba kun// thugs rjes bzung nas khyod dang dbyer med shog ces pa 'di ni/ khyim pa'i gzugs kyi zab don spyod pa dharma pā la'i ming can gyis bskul ngor gdams pa dge'o// na mo gu ru rat+na bh+yaḥ gdod ma'i gnas lugs kyi zhing khams// ma bcos rang babs kyi klong nas// rang grol chos sku yi bla ma// gsol ba snying nas rang 'debs so// mtha' bral gnyug ma yi sems nyid// rang grol byin gyis rang rlobs shig

/'gag med rang gsal gyi zhing khams// stong gsal 'dzin med kyi klong nas// rang grol longs sku yi bla ma// gsol ba snying nas rang 'debs so// snang stong dbyer med kyi mtshan nyid// rang grol byin gyis rang rlobs shig /rtsal mdangs cir yang du 'char ba'i/ 386)/rol rtsal sna tshogs kyi rnam 'gyur// rang grol sprul sku yi bla ma// gsol ba snying nas rang 'debs so// tshogs drug bzang ngan gyi zhen rtog /rang grol byin gyis rang rlobs shig /rje btsun rang grol gyi bla ma// rang sems rig thog tu bzhugs kyang*// gnyis 'dzin ngan goms kyi bu la// thugs rjes g.yel med du gzigs te// 'di bzung byang chub kyi bar du// 'bral med byin gyis rang rlobs shig /bla ma'i sku yi byin rlabs kyis// lus sprul sku 'grub par mdzad du gsol// rje btsun gsung gi byin rlabs kyis// ngag longs skur smin par mdzad du gsol// skyabs gnas thugs kyi byin rlabs kyis// yid chos skur grol bar mdzad du gsol// rje bla ma'i go 'phang bdag 'grub nas// mkha' mnyam 'gro kun 'dren par shog 'di ni rnam pa gsol 'debs su byas kyang don ngo sprod gsol 'debs kho na yin 387) no// zhes pa 'di/ d+yā na gar+bha'i bskul ngor bris pa'o// khams gsum 'dren mchog rgyal ba shākya'i dbang*// bstan pa'i mnga' bdag mchog la gsol ba 'debs// mkhyen pa'i 'byung gnas byams mgon 'jam pa'i dbyangs// sa bcu'i dbang phyug gnyis la gsol ba 'debs// rgyal bas lung bstan 'dzam gling mkhas pa'i gtso// 'phags mchog klu sgrub zhabs la gsol= /dga' ldan gnas byon byams pas rjes su bzung*// 'phags pa thogs med zhabs la gsol= /pad+mar brdzus skyes 'ja' lus 'od skur grol// ār+ya de wa'i zhabs la= /smon lam stobs kyis mngon pa'i bstan pa gsos// mkhas mchog dbyig gnyen zhabs la= /'jam dbyangs dngos mjal bka' yi dgongs don 'khrol// phyogs kyi glang po'i zhabs la=

/tshad ma sde bdun pha 388)rol rgol ba 'joms// chos kyi grags pa'i zhabs la= /'dul ba'i bstan la ston pa'i phrin las mdzad// dgra bcom yon tan 'od la gsol= /'dul gzhung rgya mtsho'i pha mthar son pa'i rje// gnas brtan shākya 'od la gsol= /'dzam gling mkhas pa'i rgyan drug sde snod 'dzin// klu sgrub thogs med mchog gnyis gtsug gi rgyan// zab mo lta ba rgya chen spyod pa yi// shing rta'i srol byed rnams la gsol ba 'debs// thub bstan snying po sde snod gsum gyi don// mun sprul log lta'i grub mthas ma bslad par// yang dag lta spyod zung 'brel dri med kyis// rin chen bstan srog 'dzin par byin gyis rlobs// tha snyad tshig gi mtha' la mi 'byams par// nges pa don gyi mdzod la dbang thob ste// rang gzhan grub mtha' rgya mtsho'i pha mthar phyin// kun mkhyen rgyal ba mchog dang dbyer med shog 389) ces pa 'phags yul gyi mkhas pa rgyan drug mchog gnyis rnams la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di ni/ bde legs dpal byor bas bskul ngor bkod pa'o// rang lus 'di ye gdod ma nas rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor nyid du lhun gyis grub pa yin la yin par shes pa'i spyi bo'i steng du bla ma brgyud pa rnams tho brtsegs su gcig gi steng na gcig ma reg tsam 'ja' 'od 'khyil le bzhugs par bsam zhing*/ rang byung rang gsal rang rig 'di// mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal kun gyi rab// rang rig bla ma nyid mchod pas// rang grol chen po'i dngos grub gsol/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'od gsal rdo rje snying po kun khyab zhing*// mtha' dbus thal ba'i ston pa kun tu bzang*// ye grol gdod ma'i sangs rgyas chos kyi sku// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// longs spyod rdzogs pa tshangs pa rnga sgra'i zhing*// rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag mchog /rgyud sde rgya chen ston mdzad

390)rdo rje 'chang*// gsol ba= /tshangs chen sprul sku'i zhing du 'gro 'dul gyis// mtshan dpe'i sku bstan zhi dang khro tshogs kyi// sgyu 'phrul gar mkhan rdo rje sems dpa' la// gsol ba= /rgyal rnams thugs rjes bka' bgros mi yul du// zab don rdzogs chen ston par rabs sngags pa'i// sprul sku dga' rab rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i dbang*// gsol= /rgya nag yul 'khrungs rgya gar mkhas grub kyi// gtsug rgyan 'gran zla bral ba rdzogs chen bdag /shrī singha 'ja' lus zag med sku// gsol= /rgyal ba kun gyi thugs rje nus mthu kun// gcig bsdus ge sar pad+ma'i sbubs las byon// khams gsum zil gnon pad+ma thod phreng zhabs// gsol= /lha lcam nus 'byin gsal le smon lam stobs// yang dag smin pas gu ru'i gter mdzod thob// bstan gnyis gling pa pad+ma tshe dbang rgyal// gsol= /gter gton de yi sras kyi thu bor gyur// dam 391)chos sangs rgyas dgongs 'dus chos kyi bdag /rig 'dzin bde chen bzod pa 'gro ba'i mgon// gsol= /dga' rab rdo rje snyigs dus mtha' khobs kyi// gdul bya 'dul phyir rdzogs chen nyams len gyi// grub brnyes mkha' la 'phur mdzad ngag dbang grags// gsol= /dzñā na ku mar dus mtha'i 'gro 'dren sprul// bod yul bde thabs brten cing 'brel 'byung gi /mnga' bdag rig 'dzin blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal// gsol= /gangs can mkhas dang grub pa'i gtso bo mchog /snga 'gyur bstan pa'i sgron me gcig pu pa// ma hā lo tsā gzhan phan rdo rje'i zhabs// gsol= /'dus byas sgyu ma'i rang tshul rig nas kyang*// sgrub rgyud gong ma'i rnam thar mdzad srol tshul// ston la nges med rje btsun rang grol zhabs// gsol ba= /nyang stod tshe sprul 392)mkha' 'gro'i gsang phug nas// gter byon rdzogs chen 'bum phrag drug cu'i bcud// zab chos rdzogs chen phung po zag med la// gsol ba=

/rtsa ba rgyud pa'i bla ma thugs rje'i bdag /bdag dang gnyis su med kyang gnyis 'dzin gyi// 'khrul pas bskyed pa'i lus ngag yid kyi rgya// rang zhig zag med 'od skur grol nas kyang*// mkha' khyab 'gro ba'i don chen 'grub gyur cig

ces gsol ba btab pas bla ma thams cad gong nas rim pa ltar gcig thim nas rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim/ bla ma nyid kyang rang gi spyi bor thim ste bla ma rang rig dbyer med du mnyam par bzhag par bya'o// zhes pa 'di ni dbon po nges 'byung bzang pos bskul ngor bris pa dge'o// ༈ na moḥsarba bud+dha ma hā gu ru bh+yaḥ phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i rgyal ba ma lus pa'i// sku dang zhing khams rnam 'gyur mtha' dag kun// gdul bya so so'i skal ngor bstan 393)pa tsam// don la rtsa ba'i bla mar ma 'dus med// rigs brgya rigs lnga gsang chen rigs gcig sogs// kun gyi khyab bdag kun bzang rdo rje 'chang*// rje btsun bla ma las gzhan ma mchis par// thag chod nges pa brnyed pas gus phyag 'tshal// skyabs gnas dkon mchog rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor dang*// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma tshogs chos srung bcas// kun kyang rigs bdag rje btsun bla ma'i sprul// kho nar nges pa brnyes pas skyabs su mchi// mkhas mang bye ba'i legs bshad mtha' yas kyi// mchog dang snying por gyur pa nges pa'i don// pad+ma thod phreng dgongs bzhed ji lta bar// legs par ston mdzad de la gsol ba 'debs// grub pa'i skyes chen mtha' dag gshegs shul ni// rtsal gsum rdzogs pa'i ri dgas rgyal po bzhin// 'jigs bral dben pa'i ri ngogs ting 'dzin gyi// rol gar 394)ston bzhin 'pho 'gyur med gsol 'debs// rgyal ba gzhan gyi gdul byar ma gyur ba'i// snyigs ma lnga bdo'i sems can bdag sogs 'gro// sna tshogs las nyon 'khrul snang sgrog tshud las// rang grol bde chen thob par byin gyis rlobs// mgon po khyod kyi thugs rje'i nyi 'od la// phyogs ris gsal 'grib bral yang rmongs pa'i 'gro// bdag sogs 'di nas byang chub ma thob par// khyed kyi gdul bya'i mchog tu 'gyur bar shog /skye nas skye bar dal 'byor phun tshogs thob// theg chen bstan bzhugs thos bsam sgom mthar phyin// tshul min gnas grogs zas dang spyod log gi

/dri bral rgyal sras spyod la 'jug gnas shog /'jig rten chos brgyad bdud kyi bslu brid dang*// bar chad rkyen gyis ma bskyod rgyal ba nyid// gang du bzhugs der mnyes gsum bsgrub pa yis// thugs rjes 395)bdag rgyud smin cing grol bar shog /bskyed dang rdzogs chen lam mchog zab mo'i don// ka dag lhun grub khreg chod thod rgal gyi// nyams len mngon gyur gnas lugs chos kyi sku'i// gtan srid zin nas sprul pas 'gro 'dren shog /mdor na bdag dang mkha' khyab pha ma'i tshogs// rje btsun rang grol mchog gi thugs rje yis// skad cig tsam yang g.yel ba med gzigs te// bla ma mchog dang dbyer med 'grub gyur cig ces skyes ma thag nas las smon 'brel pas rang la ltos pa snying nas 'chang ba'i dad btsun rat+na dkon mchog tshul khrims shī las bskul ba bzhin bris pa maṅga laṃ bha wan+tu// dge'o//
